name: 4FINGERS Crispy Chicken
description: At 4FINGERS, we're nuts about chicken. So when we discovered the Best Korean crispy chicken in New York City's grungy subway scene, we knew we had to share it. And so began the revolution of crispy chicken. Spicy, crispy, unique and downright addictive - it's chicken that's so good, it's bad. And there are thousands who would agree with us.

name: 7-Eleven
description: 7-Eleven is now the store of choice, not just for convenience needs but for a wide range of lifestyle needs such as exclusive snacks, meals on-the-go, top-ups and bill payment services.

name: AL-AMAN EXCHANGE
description: AL-AMAN EXCHANGE offers reliable and convenient currency exchange services with competitive rates for a wide range of foreign currencies. Whether you’re traveling or shopping, enjoy quick, secure, and hassle-free transactions at Causeway Point.

name: Aburi-EN
description: Specialised in quality Japanese grilled meats. Aburi-EN offers a variety of high-quality donburi (rice bowls) at affordable prices in a comfortable and affable ambiance. Aburi-EN takes pride in its homemade umami-packed meat sauce, as well as the high-quality imported pork and the A4/A5 Miyazaki Wagyu it uses which has won Japan’s “National Wagyu Award” four consecutive times. At Aburi-EN, you can enjoy the best of Japanese drinking culture with an extensive selection of highballs, beers, shochu and sake that complements the array of grilled meats. Focusing on premium ingredients grilled to perfection and offered at affordable prices, it’s little wonder why Aburi-EN is a favourite amongst many.

name: Adidas
description: Adidas is globally renowned for its innovative products. Sporting enthusiasts enjoy its constant innovations in both apparel and footwear, while featuring only the best for creators and athletes.

name: AfactivecasualXKaftanique
description: AfactivecasualXKaftanique is your one-stop destination for stylish modestwear, blending sporty elegance with everyday sophistication. From premium activewear by AF Active Casual to the flowy, modern kaftans of Kaftanique, our collections are thoughtfully designed for the modern Muslim woman. Discover modest fashion that moves with you—whether you're working out, traveling, or celebrating in style

name: Ah Ma Chi Mian
description: Ah Ma Chi Mian was incepted in March 2020, striving to deliver a different approach of "Bak Chor Mee" and focusing on bringing values to people. Ah Ma always smile and say "eat more, eat more" which inspired the founder to curate the slogan "Ah Ma Chi Mian not only keep you full, but also make you smile".

name: Ajisen Tanjiro
description: A brand extension of their flagship Ajisen Ramen, Ajisen Tanjiro features signature favourites from its parent brand and more! Beyond its ramen offerings, Ajisen Tanjiro's expanded menu includes Maze Soba, rice set meals and a delectable selection of side dishes to complete the meal.

name: Annabella Patisserie
description: Driven by an unwavering commitment to excellence, the journey to create the finest macarons began. Ms. Annabella Sonwelly spent over a decade exploring esteemed bakeries and chocolatiers worldwide, meticulously researching ingredients to perfect macarons using a French-Japanese fusion technique. This culinary adventure continues to shape every aspect of her macaron production. With each delightful bite, you can taste the founder's profound passion and inspiration woven into Annabella Patisserie's exquisite cakes and macarons.

name: Aureus Academy
description: Aureus Academy specializes in providing individually tailored piano, violin, guitar, and vocal lessons to students of all ages and abilities. They believe one-on-one is the best environment to learn a musical instrument, but the trick is keeping students engaged while making the lessons fun and rewarding! Their lessons are designed to engage each student in a way that suits their learning style.

name: Bagus by Kopitiam
description: Bagus by Kopitiam offers an inviting and conducive dining atmosphere in which patrons can relax amidst an air-conditioned environment. It showcases 12 food stalls serving some of the best halal-certified hawkerfare along with international cuisines at affordable prices. Savour Singaporeans' favourite kaya toast with kopi or be spoilt for choice with a wide selection of the yummiest local desserts.

name: Bali Thai
description: At Bali Thai, we bring you the best of both Thai and Indonesian cuisines. We want you to relish, experience, and enjoy this perfect fusion at affordable prices. Each Bali Thai restaurant boasts unique interior décor, blending contemporary style with traditional elements to offer a modern yet exotic dining experience. Perfect for family celebrations or casual business meals, Bali Thai consistently delights customers with delicious, affordable dishes. Our Halal certification also makes us a popular choice within the Muslim community. Some of the all-time favourites at Bali Thai include Tahu Telur - a must try typical Indonesian appetiser. This simple beancurd dish is fried with crispy egg fluffs coated on the outside and smooth eff residues on the inside. The specially prepared sweet peanut sauce that comes with it adds the extra oomph to the taste. For seafood lovers, opt for our popular Combi Bakar, which is a combo platter of mixed barbecue items, - fish, prawn, cuttlefish, chicken and satay. And what is Thai food without tasting the authentic, traditional Thai Green Curries? Diners will drool over a choice of our tender Chicken or Beef slices cooked in spicy hot curries, served together with fragrant steamed rice. For the best Thai soup, nothing beats the sour spicy Tom Yum Goong or Talay, which is best known among the Thais as their proud signature dish. It is flavourful and always unforgettable.

name: Banana Story
description: Discover a selection of gift and lifestyle products, especially mobile phone cases & accessories. The available mobile phone products includes accessories in various colors and styles to meet a wide range of preferences and personal choices.

name: Bank Of China
description: Established on 15 June 1936, Bank of China Singapore Branch holds the Qualifying Full Bank License (QFB) in Singapore. It has a network of five sub-branches and one remittance centre. With over 70 years of presence in the local banking industry, leveraging on the Group's extensive global network and team of experienced professionals, Bank of China Singapore Branch provides a full range of financial services to its customers from Singapore, China as well as the surrounding region. Over the years, it has demonstrated its long-term commitment to promote bilateral economic and trade relations between China and Singapore. The main businesses of Bank of China Singapore Branch include corporate banking, retail banking, trade financing and international trade settlement, with specialized knowledge and expertise in China-related trade financing and settlements, and remittance services.

name: Bata
description: Home to Bata's Asia Pacific and Africa operations, the Singapore office manages 3,000 outlets in the region and its many dealers and suppliers. As the Procurement Centre for Bata, we also work closely with our corporate partners and dealers through efficient manufacturing and sales service support in our own factories as well as our affiliates in the Far East Region. This means we can apply the very same technology and quality standards for Bata shoes to help our clients achieve their expectations without compromising on their brand identity.

name: Bath & Body Works
description: We make the world a brighter, happier place through the power of fragrance. Bath & Body Works is a global leader in personal care and home fragrance, including the #1 selling collections for fine fragrance mist, body lotion and body cream, 3-Wick candles, home fragrance diffusers and liquid hand soap. Bath & Body Works serves and delights customers however and wherever they want to shop, from welcoming, in-store experiences at more than 8 stores operating in Singapore.

name: Beauty Language
description: Beauty Language is the largest homegrown hair and beauty retail chain in Singapore. Our journey started in 2000, when our founders were frustrated by the lack of good hair and beauty regimes in the market then. This led to a life-long search and passion to uncover better answers. We constantly globetrot to discover the latest new products that work for our customers. Here you will find the best mix of exclusive and major commercial brands to suit different lifestyles, budgets and occasions.

name: Become Aesthetics Clinic
description: Experts in innovative anti-ageing skin and face solutions for a younger and better you. From pigment removal, V Shape face lifting to skin rejuvenation, Become Aesthetics Clinic understands your concerns to help elevate your beauty through quality service and safe evidence-based treatments.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Beijing 101 Hair Consultants
description: With 90% visible results in increased hair growth and 4 decades of experience, Beijing 101 Hair Consultants also won numerous international awards. It is dedicated to treating common hair issues such as hair scalp concerns, greying hair, premature or excessive white hair, male/female pattern hair loss problems. All Beijing 101 hair treatments use premium-grade natural herbs to treat not just the symptoms of hair and scalp issues, but also the very root of the problem in an integrative and harmonious way, that is in line with TCM practices.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: Better Vision
description: Better Vision was founded in 1965 as a modest optical store aspiring to provide eye-care consultations and solutions. Driven by their passion to improve eye-care services and provide cutting-edge solutions to a wider clientele, they have expanded across the region to become a leading eye-care provider. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10:30am - 11:30am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Bites By Scarlett
description: Bites By Scarlett is a Chinese supermarket that offers value-for-money products in a variety of snack items. A wide range of products is available to ensure that the needs of locals and Chinese are met

name: Boon Lay Power Nasi Lemak
description: Boon Lay Power Nasi Lemak is a highly sought after Nasi lemak in Singapore. The best and most tasty Nasi Lemak is a famous traditional Malay recipe that is served hot, just the way you like it.

name: Boost Juice Bars
description: Boost Juice - the nation’s favourite makers of fresh smoothies and juices! We serve millions of Singaporeans our iconic green cups, filled with fruit and veggie deliciousness. Deliciousness that comes from simple, natural goodness, served to you with a love life attitude that will make you so happy you’ll probably end up high fiving random strangers. It’s about making healthy living easy!! So naturally, nutrition is a key component in developing our range of smoothies and juices that sees us blending through millions of tonnes of fruit and veggies every year.

name: BreadTalk
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. The signature 'see thru' kitchens allow Chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste... BreadTalk's attention to detail does not stop here. The brand strives to stay ahead constantly, making every effort to improve your BreadTalk experience because they want your trip to BreadTalk to be as deliciously rewarding as the buns you select.

name: Butter & Cream
description: Butter & Cream Bakery focus on muffin, egg tart and burnt cheesecake. Everyday, they are dedicated to achieve an unparalleled level of integration that ensures quality and freshness products to meet customer’s needs.

name: CHAGEE
description: CHAGEE is an international tea brand that brings traditional tea to modern life. Drawing from centuries of tea heritage, we craft premium whole-leaf brews that blend tradition with innovation — creating shared moments of connection, every day, in every cup. CHAGEE TOGETHER.

name: Challenger
description: Unveil the world of Challenger – Singapore’s exclusive homegrown electronics chain since 1982. Explore the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials trusted by over half a million loyal members across 40+ island-wide stores. Embrace peace of mind with hassle-free returns and warranties covering 50,000+ top-tier products, including favorites like Apple, Samsung, and an array of other leading names.

name: Charles & Keith
description: Fashion entrepreneurs, Charles and Keith Wong founded Charles & Keith in 1996 upon identifying the potential of footwear designs catered for Asian women. Today, Charles & Keith is the go-to fashion destination for stylish urbanites, recognised for its accessible fashion and curated collections of relevant designs. A lifestyle brand that embraces a culture of innovation, it has developed a full-fledged line of footwear, bags, eyewear, accessories and costume jewellery.

name: Chateraise
description: Chateraise have over 470 stores across all of Japan and over 15 stores in Asia. All of their sweets are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as pure natural water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms in Japan. They directly deliver all their sweets from Japan to stores around the world.

name: Chicken Ka Kee
description: A casual dining concept celebrating chicken rice and the Singaporean heritage. Hatched by the second generation of Boon Tong Kee (est. 1979), renowned Chicken Rice restaurant, Chicken Ka Kee offers a welcoming space for families and friends to gather and feel at home over a comforting meal.

name: Chip Lee Jewellery
description: Our mission is to provide top-quality jewellery and services that our customers deserve, by providing ASSURANCE through our COMMITMENT in everything we do. Our position in the jewellery market focuses on establishing fullTRANSPARENCY, ensuring our messaging centers around educating our customers about our products and services.

name: Chiropractic First
description: Chiropractic First is the undisputed and most trusted leader in Chiropractic care globally, with over 35 clinics operating in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, China, UK and Europe. They have over 50 highly-trained certified doctors from all over the world. For over 20 years, Chiropractic First has built excellent patient testimonials and countless documented successful results. They have built long lasting patient loyalty with families continuously in wellness care with them in the past 20 years.

name: Clinique
description: Clinique was the first ever dermatologist-created, prestige cosmetic brand. Today, Clinique's mission remains what it was from the beginning: to provide the highest quality and most effective collection of products to enhance every skin type and tone. The brand's customised approach and quality products are all meticulously tested and carefully formulated with the latest science, making Clinique one of the leading skin care authorities in the world. All makeup and skin care products are allergy-tested and 100% fragrance free.

name: Clippers Barber
description: Clippers Barber is your affordable classic barbershop with a modern revamp. It is a place where men of all ages can sit back, relax, enjoy a professional grooming service at the hands of the expert barbers, who pride themselves for their superior fades and clean cuts. Focusing on mastering the art of no frills personal grooming for quintessential gentleman, Clippers Barber constantly challenge itself to combine technology and social media with the time honored art of barbering, so as to deliver on its promise of service quality at wallet friendly prices; leaving every customer with a fresh new look and a smile on their face.

name: Couple Lab
description: Couple Lab specialises in personalised jewellery for couples and individuals. Their laser engraving service extends to non-in-house products as well.

name: Courts
description: Courts first came to Singapore as a furniture retailer in 1974 and has grown through the years to become the leading electrical, IT and furniture retailer in Singapore. In line with its mission to 'make aspirational home products easily affordable', Courts abides by the 'Courts Price Promise' and is committed to offering competitive prices across its product range. In addition, Courts Flexi-Scheme, its in-house credit, is available as one of the payment options. Innovative sub-brands that have been launched include Courts Connect, Solutions Bar, Sleep Clinic and Dr Digital. With a dedicated team of more than 800 employees in Singapore, Courts is committed to providing excellent customer service. It is the only electrical, IT and furniture retailer awarded the CASE Trust Gold Certification, the highest accreditation companies can achieve for their commitment to fair trading and transparency to customers.

name: Crave
description: Savour the nation's favourite by indulging at Crave! Enjoy some award-winning Adam Road Nasi Lemak by Selera Rasa, topped off with crunchy flavourful ikan bilis, nuts and the tantalising iconic sambal!

name: Crocs
description: Born in Boulder, Colo. as a simple, comfortable boat shoe, today Crocs™ footwear can be found across the globe and in more than 120 styles for men, women and children. With distinct collections, Crocs offers colorful, lightweight comfort for any occasion and every season. All Crocs™ shoes are uniquely designed and manufactured using the company’s proprietary closed-cell resin, Croslite™, a technology that gives each pair of shoes the soft, comfortable, lightweight, non-marking and odor-resistant qualities that Crocs wearers know and love. Crocs™ footwear is ideal for casual wear, as well as for professional use and recreational activities. More than 100 million pairs of Crocs™ footwear have been sold. So what are you waiting for? “Feel the love™” and try a pair of Crocs™ shoes today. We promise your feet will thank you for it.

name: Crystal Jade Hong Kong Kitchen
description: Step into our kitchen and enjoy timeless Cantonese favourites, lovingly reimagined. Sincere and efficient hosts bring the heart-warming familiar flavours of Hong Kong’s bustling restaurant scene to all who walk through our doors. Savour traditional flavours with signature twists, from dim sum, congee and roasted delicacies to sizzling wok specialties. Gather round the table and share nourishing classics in a vibrant modern ambience where everyone’s welcome.

name: Customer Service Counter (Causeway Point)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Délifrance
description: A journey to France - this is Délifrance promise to you. For over 30 years, Délifrance Singapore has dedicated itself to bringing a taste of Paris closer to home. The Délifrance brand is centred upon a desire to make every day delicious. This is a testament to their unending search for and provision of the simple pleasures in life put forth in creative and transformative ways. Their French roots and history exist as the foundational structure upon which they innovate authentic cultural fare, culminating in inspired creations of outstanding taste and convenience.

name: Dian Xiao Er
description: Dian Xiao Er, the must eat herbal roast duck in Singapore! Using only the finest quality of Cherry Valley ducks paired with freshest ingredients, our duck are prepared and freshly roast daily. They are marinated with a revitalising blend of Chinese herbs and spices for hours, roasted at a precise temperature to retain its juice while in the oven. Crisp to the touch, and golden brown in appearance, our herbal roast duck is complemented with our specially concocted herbal sauce that makes it impossible to resist!

name: Dough Culture
description: Dough Culture Pte Ltd is the largest manufacturer of You Tiao in Singapore. Being a pioneer in its industry and a firm believer in innovation, the company constantly engages in the research and development of new food products with strategic partners, to introduce exciting new brands such as Dough Culture to the market. Dough Culture brand of products are manufactured under the most stringent food safety and hygiene standards. Our products are HACCP and Halal certified.

name: Dr. Kong
description: Dr Kong Healthy Shoes Shop was established in 1999. We were the first to promote our innovative “Check & Fit” foot examination and insole fitting service and provide free professional foot examination to people of all ages. According to our customer’s feet condition, we recommend the most suitable and economical foot care products. Dr Kong is a corporation with a sense of mission.

name: Dunkin' Donuts
description: Dunkin' Donuts is Singapore's favourite every day, all-day stop for great coffee and baked goods. Visit us to enjoy a fantastic selection of donuts including all-time favourites Mr Happy, Boston Kreme and Strawberry Filled Donut as well as delightful limited edition options.

name: Dunlopillo
description: Dunlopillo, with nearly a century of innovation and achievement, is one of the world’s most beloved bedding brands and a leading manufacturer of latex products, dedicated to providing high-quality sleep and comfort solutions for all our customers. Over the years, we have given millions of people worldwide the peace of mind that their bedrooms are personal havens for celebrating special moments.

name: Each-a-Cup
description: Back in the 1990s, while our founder, a food connoisseur, was running a confectionery business in Taiwan, he was intrigued by the innovative combination of delicious milk teas and the chewy tapioca balls called boba in the street food markets. So he decided to bring bubble tea to Singapore and Each-a-Cup was established in 1999. Each-a-Cup was chosen because our founder desires for each and everyone to enjoy a special cup of tasty bubble tea, bringing them wellness benefi its at the same time. To achieve this mission, we have been endlessly pursuing product innovation and quality, striving to satisfy every of our customers. With market research backed by our Taiwan headquarters and carefully crafted flavors to suit Asia’s palate, we have come to lead in a new era largely defined by a lifestyle concern for health and wellness. The top quality contents that go into each cup, combined with an extraction method that preserves the freshness of the tea’s nutrients, make for the perfect beverage.

name: Eat 3 Bowls
description: Welcome to Eat 3 Bowls, your gateway to an unforgettable culinary journey through the rich diversity of Taiwanese cuisine. Our vibrant space is not just a restaurant; it's a portal that transports you to the heart and soul of Taiwan's culinary treasures. At Eat 3 Bowls, we wholeheartedly celebrate the essence of Taiwanese culture with every dish we serve. Whether you're savoring our iconic "Braised Pork Rice," reminiscent of the warm, home-cooked meals of Taiwan, or exploring our diverse street food menu, each bite immerses you in Taiwan's flavors and traditions. Our mission is to do more than just serve food; we’re here to ignite your senses, stir your memories, and create new ones. With each dish meticulously crafted to honor the essence of Taiwanese culture, we’re bringing a piece of Taiwan’s heart and soul right here to Singapore. Join us at Eat 3 Bowls, where the joy of eating isn’t confined to just one bowl. Indulge, explore, and immerse yourself in the flavors that beckon you to savor not just a meal, but an experience that resonates with the People, Culture and Food from the beautiful country, Taiwan. One bowl simply won’t suffice.

name: Eazea Smart Lock
description: Singapore no.1 digital lock provider, Eazea, has more than 3,000 5* Reviews on Facebook and Google. Make your life Eazea!

name: epitex
description: Inspiring comfort, with a single-minded dedication to bring exceptional comfort in every thread, every fabric, to every home. With a wide collection of quality bed sheets, bed linen and pillows, Epitex constantly unfold dimensions of cosy, to suit every kind of sleeper and daydreamer.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Eu Yan Sang is Asia's leading integrative healthcare and wellness company with a strong foundation in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). Founded in 1879 with the mission of 'Caring for Mankind' - Today, Eu Yan Sang is a trusted household brand. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: FairPrice Finest
description: FairPrice Finest seeks to bring the finest things in life to customers. It combines the heritage of a trusted brand with a whole new experience of fine living at affordable pricing. Scrumptious delis and vintage wines in our gourmet selection are a sensory delight to the gastronome. Our fresh seafood along with our seasonal produce and international selection are carefully hand-picked from all over the world to please even the most discerning palates. Not forgetting the health-conscious; they can take delight with our expanding range of prized organic items and fresh fruits. From the conventional to the epicurious, here is where you can celebrate the finest things in life.

name: Famous Amos
description: Since 1975, Famous Amos has been Singapore's go-to for freshly baked cookies. Our legendary cookies boasts that irresistible crunch and melt-in-your-mouth satisfaction that generations have loved. Beyond the iconic crunchy cookie flavours you know and love, be spoilt with our range of chunky cookies, fluffy muffins, brownies and more. Need a smile, a perfect perk-me-up or the ideal gift for any special occasion? Our cookie gift items are the perfect treat to share with friends, family or simply indulge in yourself. They're guaranteed to bring back happy memories and create new ones!

name: Fish & Co.
description: Fish & Co. is a casual, family restaurant chain serving fresh seafood in a pan. This unique dining experience drew inspiration from the simple practices of the fishermen in the Mediterranean who caught seafood fresh from the seas, cooked and ate the freshly cooked seafood immediately from the pan. Designed with a casual, nautical ambience, Fish & Co. uses only the freshest fish and seafood, as well as natural ingredients like olive oil, herbs and various spices from around the world. Fish & Co. has been delighting customers with great tasting meals in generous portions and warm, friendly service - true marks of quality and value.

name: Food Republic
description: With a total of 17 stalls and three mini-restaurants among its tenant mix, Food Republic at Causeway Point serves up endless options for foodies. The spacious food atrium with a breezy white garden concept features a light-coloured, airy and elegant design concept, giving diners a sense of serenity as they tuck into their meals.

name: Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

name: Four Star
description: Established in Singapore, Four Star has more than 50 years of expertise in bedding and mattresses. We have been making ground-making innovations for our products and provided customers with better sleep since 1968. Four Star is proud to be the first mattress company to introduce Anti-static and Pocketed Spring Mattresses in Singapore. The multiple international awards we received over the years are a testament to our innovative spirit and quality assurance. Four Star is committed to providing comfort to everyone and this is evident in the partnership we have with the World Federation of Chiropractic (WFC). The WFC helps to develop effective products in the world for people with chiro pain problems and they have allowed us to gain valuable insights on back problems affecting sleep quality. Four Star has become a trusted household brand that has continued to innovate and grow. We are constantly striving to provide technologically advanced mattresses that aim to improve sleep quality for many generations to come.

name: Fujitec
description: FUJITEC, stands as a distinguished brand within the esteemed OGAWA Group . Gracing the vibrant cityscape of Singapore, FUJITEC arrives with a singular purpose: to enrich daily life with a touch of opulence. With a heritage steeped in innovation and an unwavering pursuit of excellence, FUJITEC presents an exquisite selection of offerings tailored to elevate the essence of home, lifestyle, and everyday indulgence.

name: Fun Claw
description: Fun Claw is a brand-new concept of automated Claw Catcher machine launched in 2018. Our concept is to create a space exclusively for claw machines where families and friends can bond over the simplicity of having a fun time while shopping together. Our family friendly environment offers a cosy game play experience that prominently differentiates us from others. Fun Claw aims to rekindle the excitement of visiting the shopping malls and encourage people to step outside to have fun.

name: G2000
description: G2000 is the savvy executive’s choice, with a sharper, cleaner cut that takes business to a personal level. It flaunts a versatile range of work wear that offers a balance of tailored elegance and sharp style, as well as smart essentials that are comfortably affordable.

name: Gadget Mix
description: Gadget Mix appeals to the highly-connected modern society by providing a range of uniquely designed IT lifestyle gadgets and personal mobility that is both trendy and affordable.

name: Gain City
description: Established in 1981, Gain City started out with a simple quest of improving lifestyles and a focused vision to be Singapore's trusted air-conditioner retailer. Today, renowned as Singapore's largest air-conditioner retailer, the brand is synonymous with excellent air-conditioning installation and maintenance service, as well as being the preferred go-to 1-Stop retailer for consumer electronics. With more than 800 staff, a pool of BCA-certified installation technicians and a fleet of over 180 service vehicles, they are your trusted choice.

name: Geláre
description: Geláre is a great place for a perfect meal at anytime of the day. We serve a variety ranging from hot western cuisine and light bites to desserts. Their specialty, freshly baked waffles, is paired with a wide selection of premium ice creams to be enjoyed by all.

name: Giordano
description: Giordano is a leading international retailer of men's, women's and children's apparel. Established in 1981, Giordano now operates 3,000 stores and counters worldwide. The pursuit of simplicity is at the core of the Giordano culture. The company's unwavering commitment to providing simple, clean lines, quality workmanship, and attentive customer service has helped build a strong and loyal following throughout the world. In Singapore, Giordano has 53 stores Island-wide, affirming their position as a leading fashion retailer.

name: GK Global
description: GK Global strives to provide excellence customer services and quality products. Our stores carry a wide range of phone accessories, headphones and lifestyle gadgets. We also offer phone/tablet repairs, top-up service and phone prepaid cards.

name: Glimpse
description: A wide selection of chic and stylish eye-wear to cater to every different individual’s needs. Glimpse provides instant services and glasses that will be ready in 20 minutes.

name: Goldheart
description: With more than 40 years of heritage, Goldheart is the first and leading gold and diamond jeweller in Singapore that introduced the concept of wedding bands in white gold and platinum. With exclusive in-house designs that exude artistry and masterful craftsmanship, every Goldheart boutique is a treasure trove of 999 & 916 gold jewellery for discerning customers. They have continuously pushed the boundaries of creativity in gold jewellery design. As the exclusive distributor of Celestial® diamond, Goldheart also flaunts the world’s first 73-facet starburst diamond that scintillates with the supreme luminosity of the brightest star. Honouring Goldheart’s rich heritage in love and romance, the exclusive concept of Pure Blue™ was introduced. The Pure Blue™ sapphire is embedded in the inner ring band as the perfect symbol of purity and fidelity.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 138 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Pharmacy services available! Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for consumers' health and beauty needs. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at all stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. We continue to build on our rich healthcare heritage with an award-winning team of pharmacists who have consistently won multiple pharmacist awards every year.

name: Helen
description: Since 1999, HELEN by Helen Accessories has been offering trendy fashion accessories for women. With over 20 stores island-wide today, it has become a well-recognised fashion accessories powerhouse.

name: Ho Kee Pau
description: Established in 1994, Ho Kee Pau is a Chinese traditional bun manufacturer which has grown from a small food stall to a food and snacks chain. With 14 outlets island-wide, it sells traditional pau, dim sum, congee and other local fare. Ho Kee Pau aims to serve customers with the best quality food at affordable prices.

name: Hockhua Tonic
description: Hockhua Tonic, a household name in Singapore and Malaysia since 1989, is known for its retail chain of stores stocked with traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), health supplements and tonics. Renowned for its quality ginseng and wide range of bird's nest products, it also offers seafood delicacies such as abalones, dry scallops, Chinese herbs and a variety types of self-manufactured nutrition organically grown products.

name: Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart
description: Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart has been all the rage in South East Asia since June 2016. Originating from Hokkaido, our resident bakers worked with counterparts from Hokkaido, Japan to further improve the recipe of this baked pastry to ensure a uniqueness in taste and texture. The soft and creamy centre is made with a blend of three different types of specialty cheeses, piped into a crunchy shortcrust pastry base. Tasting best when it is right out of the oven, the Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart also taste awesome when chilled, giving you a smooth and refreshing experience. When frozen, the tart is alike a creamy cheesy ice cream. Try all the ways of eating it and decide which one you like best! Apart from the delicious original flavour, we now have the decadent chocolate and the King of Fruits, Durian.

name: Home's Harmony
description: At Home's Harmony, we're here to help you craft your home with style, comfort, and functionality. We've curated an exquisite collection of bedlinen, bedding accessories, bath essentials and lifestyle décor that elevate your living spaces to new heights.

name: Honor
description: The first HONOR Experience Store in Singapore to showcase the full and latest range of smartphones, tablets and wearables from HONOR. It will provide a condusive environment for customers' hands-on experience of HONOR's range of devices. Future product range will expand to include laptops and IoT.

name: Hot Tomato
description: Hot Tomato Cafe & Grill is a modern contemporary restaurant that serves steak, seafood, sides and pasta. They value their customers and prioritise quality food and service. For the celebration of special occasions or a simple meal with family and friends, they have dishes ready for your enjoyment at their outlets.

name: HUGABO
description: Hug A Bowl of HUGABO's flavourful, nutritional soup! When you eat better, you feel better. That's why HUGABO uses only all-natural and nutrient-dense ingredients for their stock. Each stock is painstakingly double-boiled for hours in-house to create their signature rich and super-tasty base. Customize your soup the way you love from a wide variety of superfoods (legumes, leafy greens, seafood, etc.) to give your health a further boost! Through their soups, they hope you'll experience warmth and comfort, just like you would with a loving embrace.

name: Ichiban Boshi
description: Ichiban Boshi introduces Japanese dining with a dash of modern simplicity offering the best premium quality sushi, sashimi, seafood and a variety of set meals. With an emphasis on quality, Ichiban Boshi is proud to present premium Japanese cuisine at reasonable prices right throughout the year.

name: Ilham Empire
description: A homegrown brand that specialises in Muslimah apparel, swimsuit, and plus size clothing that's trendy yet affordable. Customised tailoring is also available at Ilham Empire.

name: innisfree
description: Innisfree is the first natural Korean brand that shares the benefits of nature from Jeju Island. They offer innovative beauty solutions powered by the finest natural ingredients responsibly sourced from Korea’s pristine Jeju Island. Thanks to its volcanic origins, this fertile oasis has a unique ecosystem with unparalleled resources to nurture beautiful skin.

name: iStudio
description: iStudio retails the full range of Apple products including the latest MacBook Air with Retina display, MacBook Pro with Touch Bar, iMac Pro, Mac mini, iPad, iPad Pro, iPhone, Apple Watch, Apple TV 4K, AirPods Pro and more. iStudio also offers a wide variety of Apple and third-party accessories that best complements your Apple devices, ensuring that you get the perfect pairing for the device you own.

name: Jean Yip Beauty & Slimming
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: Jean Yip Hairdressing
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: JML
description: Great products from our variety of household, cookware, cleaning equipment, electrical appliances, heath supplements, car care products, fitness machines and many more to helps you to get things done easily and stay in shape within the comfort of your own home. JML is also a partner with Mediacorp in bringing the popular Deals for Joy program onto your TV screen with Mediacorp artists as hosts to demonstrate the affordablilty and ease of use of their products. JML Makes Your Everyday Easier!

name: Joyre TCMedi Clinic
description: Joyre TCMedi Clinic is a pioneer in integrating Traditional Chinese Medicine with modern spa treatments and beauty aesthetics services to deliver personalized treatments that match each individual’s body constitution, and lifestyle to bring about a sense of balance and total wellness.

name: Kaleido
description: Kaleido is a local jewellery label based in Singapore. Powered by a belief in individual self-expression, each product is designed to live with you. It’s about fun and freedom and being content with yourself today.

name: Karva Salon For Ladies
description: At KARVA, our highly motivated team of Stylists, Scalp Consultants & Nail Therapists are committed to deliver excellence in service at the highest level. The salon uses the latest techniques, equipment and products from France. Germany and Italy that include Coty’s Professional Beauty products such Wella, System Professional and Nioxin. All KARVA’s guests are treated with a complimentary selection of beverages, including premium tea.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: KFC
description: Captivating aroma, succulent juicy chicken and thoughtful service are what KFC lovers come back for. Choose between our signature Original Recipe chicken prepared with Colonel Sander's secret blend of 11 herbs & spices, or the all-time favourite Hot & Crispy chicken. Check out the perennially popular KFC a.m. Breakfast menu and the variety of food items from Rice to Egg Tarts as well. Visit KFC today for an experience that is so good.

name: Kiddy Palace
description: Kiddy Palace's objective is to be the premier specialty retailer of children's wear and maternity products by providing customers with a broad and comprehensive range of products at value prices.

name: KIMOJ
description: KIMOJ is a designer fashion accessories retail chain store founded in 2013. KIMOJ houses the latest collection of fashion jewellery, hair accessories, eyewear, handbags and lifestyle items shipped weekly from designer houses all over the world.

name: Kitchen+Ware
description: Kitchen+Ware is a kitchenware plus homeware store. They carry an extensive range of kitchen utensils, and other more wares for the home. You can find baking accessories, woks and pans, cooking pots, dining utensils and wares, vacuum airpots etc, and must-have items for the living room, bedroom or bathroom. Find brands such as Zojirushi, Tiger, Zebra, KAI, Hoover, Saemmi, 3M, Garbath & more!

name: Kskin
description: Kskin is a Korean Express Facial Salon that caters to both genders. Customers walk in to enjoy their facial treatment with no need for any appointment booking. Cashless payment can be made at self-serve payment kiosks before service, and there is no package selling involved. Using our specially formulated, pharmaceutical grade proprietary solutions, coupled with the latest machines in skin care technology, the duration of the facial treatment only requires 15 minutes to ensure skin is refreshed, prepped, and glowing. The premium quality of skin care ingredients, paired with Kskin's proprietary treatment efficiency, enable our customers to maximize time in the midst of their busy schedule to achieve their skincare goals without compromising results.

name: Laaziiz
description: We prioritise using only the finest ingredients, ensuring that our products not only meet but also exceed the expectations of our consumers. Our unwavering commitment to quality is evident in every step of our manufacturing process, from sourcing raw materials to the meticulous preparation and packaging of our signature Dendeng and Serunding.

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Lao Huo Tang
description: Share a tureen or two of traditional Cantonese-style soups from any of our 10 Lao Huo Tang Restaurants with your loved ones. Made fresh daily from scratch, these salubrious broths are made with vegetables, lean meat, pork ribs and other natural ingredients and simmered for hours. They are low in fat, calories and also low in sodium — no MSG, oil, cream or butter is used and its refillable for all dine-in customers. In addition to the nourishing soups, tuck into other traditional home-style dishes in the comfortable restaurant, which is both baby and wheelchair-friendly.

name: Lenskart
description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer brand that retails best quality, fashionable eyewear at surprisingly low prices. Lenskart achieves this by establishing a direct route to customers - straight from manufacturing to retail, and by eliminating 7 layers of middlemen. Lenskart has 2 unique products BLU lenses and Air frames. BLU lenses are designed for the digital age. They block blue rays from smartphones and other digital devices, helping prevent eye damage. Lenskart BLU is a fully loaded lens scratch proof, superhydrophobic and aspheric. Air frames are lightweight, flexible, robust and are designed for ultimate comfort and style.

name: Levi's
description: The Levi's® brand epitomizes classic American style and effortless cool. Since the invention and patent of riveted clothing by Jacob Davis and company founder Levi Strauss in 1873, Levi's® jeans have become the most recognizable and imitated clothing in the world - capturing the imagination and loyalty of people for generations. Today, the Levi’s® brand portfolio continues to evolve through a relentless pioneering and innovative spirit that is unparalleled in the apparel industry. Their range of leading jeanswear and accessories are available in more than 110 countries, allowing individuals around the world to express their personal style.

name: Lifexp
description: Shop for your favourite lifestyle products such as headphones/earphones, mobile accessories, IT gadgets and more.

name: Lovisa
description: At Lovisa, we are driven by our passion for the perfect accessory. Our trend-forecasting departments worldwide take inspiration from runways and current street style to provide the latest trends in fashion accessories.The first Lovisa store opened in Australia in 2010, and since then we have established ourselves as an industry leader, with over 340 stores across 15 countries which includes the US, South Africa, UK to name a few.

name: Luxebags
description: Selling Imported Branded Brand New Handbags for Prada, Miu Miu, Gucci, Coach, Kate Spade, Michael Kors. 100% Authentic Guarantee.

name: M1
description: M1, a subsidiary of Keppel Corporation, is Singapore’s first digital network operator, providing a suite of communications services, including mobile, fixed line and fibre offerings, to over two million customers. Since the launch of its commercial services in 1997, M1 has achieved many firsts – becoming one of the first operators to be awarded one of Singapore’s two nationwide 5G standalone network license, first operator to offer nationwide 4G service, as well as ultra high-speed fixed broadband, fixed voice and other services on the Next Generation Nationwide Broadband Network (NGNBN). M1’s mission is to drive transformation and evolution in Singapore’s telecommunications landscape through cutting-edge technology and made-to-measure offerings. For more information, visit www.m1.com.sg.

name: Ma Kuang TCM
description: Ma Kuang's team of medical staffs aims to treat their patients with "Love, Service, Professionalism, Sincerity", physicians, TuiNa therapists, assistance offer a comprehensive and professional TCM healthcare services. By modernization of traditional Chinese medicine and discriminating process, Ma Kuang is committed to promote the philosophy of TCM worldwide and hopes to help the public to "walk out" of their illnesses and enjoy a healthy lifestyle at the same time. Ma Kuang provides a reliable and high quality one-stop TCM clinic and healthcare services network to the public to become one of the leaders in industry. Ma Kuang has established a professional branding image and has obtained a good branding reputation.

name: Mabel Story
description: Mabel Story is a store specialising in modern Malay ladies fashion, offering a selection of bags, hand jewellery, masks, t-shirts and dresses, perfect for both working professionals and students.

name: MADERA.SG
description: Since 2002, Madera de Mango (M.d.M.) has been serving customers with grace. Its wide range of products include hand-made crafts from flowers, vases, wooden crafts, geomancy fountains, paintings, silk to aromatherapy.

name: Maxi-Cash
description: Maxi-Cash is the first public-listed pawnbroker in Singapore. Besides providing pawnbroking services, Maxi-Cash also retails brand new gold, diamond jewellery and preloved luxury goods.

name: Maybank
description: A Qualifying Full Bank (QFB) in Singapore, Maybank is one of the top five banks in ASEAN offering a diverse range of financial services for corporate, business and individual clients. Some of the products they offer include savings and current accounts, credit and debit cards, loans, investments, insurance services as well as Islamic, Private and Premier Banking. Besides offering great value through their promotions, Maybank also partners global brands and established merchants to bring you a wide range of exciting events and deals as well as unique experiences.

name: Mayer
description: Mayer story begins in 1987. Founded in Singapore, we became a leading distributor and retailer of quality home and kitchen appliances. Passionate about expanding our house label (Mayer and Mistral), we are dedicated to sourcing trendy, reliable, durable, sustainable and reasonably priced products for our valued customers.

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's business is never just about providing quick meals. It's always been about you - your tastes, your lifestyle, your choices. And they'd like to keep it that way, with you lovin' every moment of it. This is how McDonald's put their heart and soul into each and every one of their delicious, wholesome meals. Each 'mmm' and 'ahhh' from you is thanks enough. As you change and grow, McDonald's will be right there with you every step of the way. Today and tomorrow.

name: Metro
description: Metro is an iconic brand synonymous with exciting shopping experiences. Trusted by generations for its design, quality and value, discover a curated selection of well-designed products across beauty, fashion and home for every taste.

name: Mister Minit
description: Mister Minit was established in 1957, we launched our first 'Heel Bar' in a Brussels department store in Belgium. The fashion of the day was stiletto heels that broke by the thousands on the cobblestone streets. Although the heel bar only repaired heels, it was such a curiosity at the time that hundreds of people would crowd around to watch the action. Policeman had to clear the people off the stairways above us and as a result of the commotion we caused, we were nearly moved out of our excellent location. Over half a century later we now fix over 10 million problems annually in the services of Shoe Repairs and Care, Key Cutting, Watch Repairs, along with Car Key Duplication, Remote Controls for Garage and Gates and Sharpening. Our team is highly committed to fixing your problems through excellence in quality and customer service. To this day, we still love your shoes and cannot wait to fix your favourites!

name: MoneyMax
description: MoneyMax is a leading pawnbroker, retailer and trader of jewellery, pre-owned luxury bags and watches, with a presence in both Singapore and Malaysia. MoneyMax is proud to be the first ISO 9001 (ISO9001:2008) and CaseTrust Accredited Pawnbroker in Singapore.

name: MOS Burger
description: MOS Burger is a premium Japanese hamburger chain restaurant which offers a wide variety of unique and original tasting burgers. To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers’ order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: MUNCHI PANCAKES / ALC RICEBOWLS
description: At Munchi Pancakes, we serve classic Min Jiang Kueh that’s crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. We also offer Munchi pancakes filled with creative yet delicious hot and cold fillings. We take pride in using premium ingredients to ensure the freshest taste and we offer vegan-friendly options so everyone can enjoy our delicious creations. Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation with every bite. ALC Rice Bowls serves delicious, affordable, and healthy meals with a wide variety of options including chicken, fish, beef, and vegetarian choices. Whether you dine in or enjoy our fresh bowls delivered to your door, we focus on quality and satisfaction in every bite.

name: Nail Palace
description: Nail Palace is one of the best at its craft because the company thrives on passion and attention-to-detail rather than being profit-oriented. They strive to provide quality services that will pamper your nails and reinvent your style. One requirement that their technicians must fulfill is the love for the job. Nail Palace's range of products and services are highly diverse and readily available to meet and satisfy any needs. Besides first-class pedicures and manicures, they provide nail art services, foot

name: Nailz Gallery
description: At Nailz Gallery, we believe that every man and woman has the right to look and feel their best. Colour is the answer, not only for our nails, but for the ways we show up and express ourselves regardless of gender roles, social status, or feeling the need to “fit in”. Whether you are looking for manicure, pedicure, hand/foot spa, nails treatments, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery or waxing services, we can do it all!

name: Nelly's Retro Snacks
description: Founded on 9 April 2017, Nelly's Retro Snacks aims to keep their products at an affordable price and offering the largest and widest variety. They hope that the history of traditional school retro snacks will be enjoyed and appreciated by many generations.

name: NiKU iKU
description: NiKU iKU brings you authentic grilled & simmered Japanese takeout, crafted for comfort and satisfaction. From flame-kissed yakiniku to slow-simmered nitsuke, every bowl features rich flavour & the finest cuts — paired with premium Niigata rice and proprietary sauces. Every meal is a satisfying experience.

name: Nine Fresh
description: Nine Fresh is a home-grown brand specializing in a wide selection of chilled taro ball desserts that are freshly scooped and served daily. With 3 different types of signature bases (Bean Curd, Grass Jelly and Ai-Yu Jelly) and a huge variety of toppings such as beans, jellies as well as chewy delights (signature taro balls, mini taro Q and black pearl), they cater to different palates and preferences!

name: Nippon Home
description: Nippon Home Pte Ltd. was established in the year 2013 to provide a wide variety of quality products to customers at competitive prices. The company logo of the cherry blossom flowers symbolizes hope for the future and optimism. The color blue symbolizes trust & responsibility, similar to the concept of the business which is to create a “one stop shopping mall like” environment with good customer service that allows customers to browse, find & buy products easily allowing them to leave the shop feeling satisfied. The company aims to be responsive to the customers' needs and to gain the customers' trust in the company`s services and products. The products/merchandise of the store caters to customers of all age groups including toys, stationeries, household, electrical accessories, hardware and many more. Nippon Home Pte Ltd also includes services such as key duplication, plumbing services & handyman services.

name: Nomad Ventures
description: Nomad Ventures presents a retail concept store showcasing a curated mix of pre-packed food, halal snacks, fashion accessories and lifestyle essentials. With frequently refreshed offerings from a variety of partner brands, the space delivers a distinctive shopping experience that blends variety, discovery and everyday convenience.

name: NTUC LearningHub
description: NTUC LearningHub is the leading Continuing Education and Training provider in Singapore which aims to transform the lifelong employability of working people. Since its corporatisation in 2004, NTUC LearningHub has helped over 25,000 organisations and achieved over 2.6 million training places across more than 500 courses with a pool of over 600 certified trainers. They have also accelerated its foray into virtual learning by working with best-in-class partners such as IBM, DuPont Sustainable Solutions and GO1, asynchronous online courses.

name: OCBC
description: OCBC and its subsidiaries offer a broad array of specialist financial and wealth management services, ranging from consumer, corporate, investment, private and transaction banking to treasury, insurance, asset management and stockbroking services.

name: Odoroki
description: Experience fun-filled surprises for less than the price of a cup of coffee. An eye-catching concept of neon gachapon machines to relive your childhood joy by discovering the wide range of intriguing and attractive capsule toys with a spin of the knob.

name: Ogawa
description: Dive into the world of wellness with Ogawa Singapore. Massage chairs, gaming seats, slimming massagers, massage pillows & more.

name: Oh! Sunny
description: Say Hi to Oh! Sunny, for all things sun-safe and stylish! Oh! Sunny is Singapore’s one-stop shop for sun-protective clothes and accessories for the family. They take pride on proprietary industry-leading fabric technology to provide ultimate UV protection for daily adventures. Their twilight fabric is UPF50+ rated, the highest standard in the industry, effectively blocking 99% of harmful UV rays. Oh! Sunny is passionate about fusing fashion with technology and performance. With products that are trendy and comfortable, meant to be mixed, matched and layered, for your family’s everyday styles.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Old Chang Kee is a household name famous for it's delectable curry puffs that are filled with curried potatoes, chicken and a slice of hardboiled egg, all cooked with special herbs and spices. Other than curry puffs, Old Chang Kee also boasts spring rolls, crab claws, sotong wings and yam pies amongst it's vast product range.

name: OPPO
description: OPPO offers a wide range of OPPO smartphones and tablets, from sleek flagships to budget-friendly options. Need accessories? They’ve got you covered with chargers, earbuds, and protective cases. But that’s not all! Stay connected with their variety of SIM cards for different telco. Whether you’re a data-hungry streamer or a frequent traveler, we have options to suit your needs. Visit them today and experience the world of OPPO!

name: Oriental Hair Solutions
description: Oriental Hair Solutions was created to help people with hair and scalp problems caused by a stressful lifestyle, environmental damages, genetic problems and harsh chemicals used in various hairdressing techniques.

name: OSIM
description: OSIM is about the experience of total well-being. It is about living an inspiring life. We channel our Brand at each and every customer touch point, communicating our values through our products, our outlet, our brand image, our service excellence and in-depth knowledge of holistic health. OSIM is the global leader in branded healthy lifestyle products and has over 30 years of experience and uncompromising dedication in developing innovative and reliable healthy lifestyle products. OSIM is the name you can trust for a healthier lifestyle and overall well-being. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 11am - 12pm Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Owell BodyCare
description: OWELL BodyCare is a fast expanding retailer of healthcare products. OWELL is innovation-driven and emphasizes on the importance of service quality and product quality and safety. OWELL products are uniquely designed to cater to the lifestyle of today’s fast paced society. Easy to use and portable products provide great convenience for those who are constantly on the go. As an advocate for service excellence, OWELL ensures each staff is trained to identify and understand the unique needs of every customer and to provide simple and non-invasive health services such as body oxygen level check, vascular age check and blood circulation analysis.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: Pandora
description: Discover hand-finished quality jewellery and beautiful new designs with endless styling opportunities for personal expression. Choose from our range of charms, bracelets, rings, earrings, necklaces, and pendants. Find the perfect gift for yourself or that someone special. A universe of jewellery awaits you.

name: PastaMania
description: PastaMania is the largest halal-certified Italian casual dining chain in Singapore offering a diverse range of pastas. From Italian classics like Prawn Aglio and Carbonara, to specially crafted fusion delights like Seafood Tom Yum, Otah Aglio and even pizzas, there’s something for everyone!

name: Pezzo
description: Welcome to Pezzo where every pizza has its own unique character and taste. Meet Big Daddy, Meat Munchers or Garlic Chick for a novel way of enjoying some scrumptious tasting pizzas on-the-go!

name: PINC
description: PINC is the leading local nail specialist in the beauty and wellness industry. We strive to beautify the world through care and cosmetics. Our loyal and efficient beauticians ensure that customers will be treated with the best care. Some of the services rendered include Nail Care, Body Waxing, Eye Brow Shaping, Facials and Eyebrow Extensions.

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Expect a leisure pedicure and manicure spa, or simply an afternoon of escape to beautify your nails with an exceptional customer service and high standards of hygiene practices in a relaxing ambience of cosiness, complemented with soothing music and variety options of treatments that is a perfect venue for an affordable indulgence. Not only you can get to beautify your nails, you can leave your eyelash, eyebrow, lips and many many more to us! A salient feature of Pixie Nail Spa is never to compromise on hygiene practices. All equipment used are sanitised, placed in a sanitising pouch and subsequently kept in a UV Steriliser before using it on our clients. Our experienced manicurists are trained with our standard operating procedures and are sent to specific courses to ensure that they are competent before being assigned to meet our clients’ nail spa treatment requirements.

name: Playmade
description: A curated menu featuring PlayMade’s iconic handcrafted pearls, made fresh daily. Flavours include innovative options such as pink cactus, burnt caramel and seasonal varieties. Teas are brewed to perfection using high-quality ingredients, ensuring a refreshing and flavourful drink. The menu is complemented by a range of sweet treats and snacks, including delectable egglets and creamy gelato, perfect for pairing with their signature beverages.

name: Poh Heng Jewellery
description: Since 1948, Poh Heng Jewellery has been a symbol of dedication and craftsmanship in Singapore. From our coveted Trust diamonds to the iconic Si Dian Jin Collection, we blend timeless elegance with meticulous craftsmanship. Experience timeless elegance and unwavering quality at Poh Heng.

name: Poke Theory
description: Poke Theory is a healthy fast food-first concept serving up modern Hawaiian poke bowls, acai bowls and cold-pressed juice.

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Polar prides itself for its long and rich heritage as a three-generation-old family business that has been faithfully serving consistent quality products to its customers since 1926.

name: POPULAR Bookstore
description: The POPULAR Bookstore is a one-stop retail hub that provides a comprehensive range of merchandise that includes books, stationery, multimedia, music and audio-visual products.

name: POSB ATM/AXS
description: POSB's first priority is helping you and your family save for the future. Join their community, share your journey with them, because "we’re neighbours first, bankers second."

name: Poulet
description: Poulet is a modern French-themed bistro offering affordable French classics to the mass public since 2012. The French Roast Chicken maestro serves freshly roasted chicken that are brined overnight using an in-house secret recipe. The Poulet Roti is complemented with 4 signature sauces, they create a perfect symphony for the signature dish. Poulet presents itself as the perfect place for any occasion worth celebrating, with something for everyone to savour and indulge in.

name: PrimaDéli
description: PrimaDéli serves all-time favourites that everyone loves and enjoys. With an extensive selection of premium quality cakes and scrumptious treats, signature products include Chicken Pie, Egg Tart, Singapore Curry Puff, Premium Pandan Chiffon, Mango Delight Cake as well as their immensely popular Waffles.

name: Raffles Dental
description: Raffles Dental is an established team-based dental practice comprising dental specialists and general dental surgeons in Raffles Hospital, and supported by a network of dental clinics located island wide. Raffles Dental’s dentists work across specialties with each other to prevent, diagnose, and treat a full range of dental and oral diseases. General services include routine dental checkups, screening and maintenance, dental X-rays, crowns and bridges, dentures, braces and aligners, extractions, fillings, implants, and teeth whitening. Raffles Dental clinics are approved under the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus, and Medisave scheme.

name: Raffles Medical
description: Raffles Medical is the primary care network of Raffles Medical Group, which provides family medicine, health screening, and dental services. Besides operating clinics in China, Japan, Vietnam, and Cambodia, it is one of the largest network of family medicine clinics in Singapore. Our team of family physicians provides care for patients of all ages, including treatment and management of acute and chronic diseases, vaccinations, travel health, and health screening. Raffles Medical clinics are approved to serve Singaporeans under various healthcare and government schemes including the Healthier SG programme, Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus and Flexi-Medisave scheme.

name: Red Ginger
description: Red Ginger is the creation of a dedicated team of food lovers, having decades of experience in the F&B industry. It first started operating at IMM Building since 2000, gaining a strong presence in the West region of Singapore through serving a remarkable spread of Nasi Padang dishes. Red Ginger's niche expertise lies in halal cuisine with a modern twist, dedicated to bringing top-notch fare to customers at affordable prices. A strong focus on its traditional cooking methods of Nasi Padang complemented with authentic local wok dishes ensures a gastronomical experience that must not be missed!

name: rrooll
description: Freshly baked daily, rrooll is a halal certified bakery who is the first to offer a swirl of both sweet and savory flavours rolled up in our signature soft and fluffy dough. Their rolls are free of preservatives and artificial flavours. They use only the freshest ingredients paired with precise techniques to bring out the best combination of flavours, texture and aroma. Combining the freshest grade A cinnamon powder topped with their signature cream cheese frosting, rrooll classic cinnamon roll will leave you craving for more!

name: Samsung Experience Store
description: At Samsung Experience Stores, everything is easier. A place to explore our latest range, learn more about your device, get expert advice and receive technical support. Exclusive sneak peeks of our newest products and other great events are happening all the time. The possibilities are endless.

name: Sea Horse
description: "Sea Horse" brand was establish in the mid 80s' in Hong Kong. The major product lines focus on household products. The brand aims at the general public, famous for its excellent quality with economic pricing. In 1987, the Sea Horse Healthy Mattress was launched. The products has been applauded by the users since then. According to SRH report, Sea Horse Mattress and pillow have been the number one best sellers in Hong Kong since 1989. Sea Horse brand is a ideal choice for consumers looking for top grade products with reasonable price.

name: Sephora
description: Explore an unrivalled selection of makeup, skincare, hair, fragrance & more from classic & emerging brands. Sephora is the world’s leading global prestige beauty retail brand. Sephora connects customers and beauty brands within the world’s most trusted and dynamic beauty community. We serve a highly engaged community of hundreds of millions of beauty followers across our global omnichannel network of stores and iconic flagships, and our e-commerce and digital platforms, offering personalized and immersive seamless experiences across every touchpoint. With our curation of brands and our own label, Sephora Collection, we offer the most unique and diverse range of prestige beauty products, tailored to our customers’ needs from fragrance to make-up, haircare, skincare and beyond, as we constantly reimagine the world of prestige beauty. Since our inception in 1969 in Limoges, France, and as part of the LVMH Group since 1997, we have been disrupting the prestige beauty retail industry. Today, we continue to break with convention to drive our mission: champion a world of inspiration and inclusion where everyone can celebrate their beauty.

name: SF Fruits & Juices
description: SF started off with its first outlet in Orchard Road in 2004 selling cut fruits and juices. They now have around 30 outlets island wide with some selling whole fruits as well. SF strives to provide quality fruits and farm produce to all at affordable prices.

name: Shabu Sai
description: An authentic Japanese restaurant that serves all-you-can-eat Shabu-Shabu and Sukiyaki buffet, Shabu Sai serves up to seven tasty soup bases and a splendid array of more than 40 items on the buffet table. The brand earns in name from the word “Shabu” – the sound of ingredients being swished in a boiling pot – and “Sai” which means vegetables. The must-try Shabu Sai specialities include the Tonkotsu soup, prepared using the same recipe as the restaurant’s outlets in Japan, the Sukiyaki soup that offers a sweet-and-savoury Shoyu-based stock for the freshest ingredients to simmer in, as well as signature items such as the pork, beef or chicken served in bamboo.

name: Shine Korea
description: Singapore's leading retailer of Korean product, Shine Korea provide the reliable delivery of authentic Korean products at the best price. The wide range of product available from noodles to snacks to sauces and cooking ware makes Shine Korea the go-to-place for everything Korean.

name: Singtel Exclusive Retailer
description: Singtel provides an extensive selection of Singtel services, encompassing mobile and fixed broadband as well as prepaid and postpaid options. You can enjoy a diverse array of choices, from the latest mobile phones to lifestyle-related accessories and gadgets, catering to all your communication and lifestyle needs. We are Asia's leading communications group, providing a diverse range of Innovative services including fixed mobile, data, internet, ICT and TV.

name: Singtel Shop
description: We are Asia's leading communications group, providing a diverse range of Innovative services including fixed mobile, data, internet, ICT and TV.

Putting great emphasis on innovation and design excellence, SK Jewellery is known for its high quality jewellery that is meaningfully conceptualised and beautifully crafted.

With the belief that you deserve to shine, every piece of jewellery is meaningfully conceptualised and beautifully crafted. Unparalleled in design excellence and innovation, SK Jewellery is the contemporary jeweller known for its high quality and exquisite jewellery.

description: SL Aesthetic Clinic offers a continuously-updated array of minimal to non-invasive FDA-approved, CE-marked, and HSA-approved medical aesthetic treatments in Singapore. We hope to empower you to live amply, feel confident, and be the best version of yourself.

For Internet at home or on the go, StarHub Broadband offers the best-value plans and value-added services. Visit StarHub today and get more from the latest promotions and services for your personal or business needs.

name: Steak 99

The porous structure of the stone naturally absorbs excess fat, delivering lower-calories healthier steak without compromising taste. Lava stone uses infrared ray effect and exceptional heat retention and ensures the meat stays hot, flavorful , and juicy from the first bite to the last, creating a unique and satisfying dining experience.

name: Stryv

And whilst we’re doing this, we always strive to protect this beautiful planet and the people who depend on it. We don’t do it this way because it’s fashionable. Today, not only is The Dim Sum Place a popular Halal restaurant among Singaporeans, it is also a must-visit for international tourists. Over the years with valuable feedback from our customers and guidance from renowned international chefs. The team improved the food quality and is consistently curating new dishes that cater to a wider range of taste buds.

name: The Green Party
description: The Green Party is dedicated to offering consumers a diverse selection of stylish and innovative green products designed to enhance their lifestyles.
