description: Tiong Bahru Jian Bo Shui Kueh is a home-grown heritage brand selling traditional local food. The brand diligently adheres to time-tested recipes for 2 consecutive years and they have been awarded the highly acclaimed Bib Gourmand in MICHELIN Guide Singapore.

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is a Singaporean contemporary coffee chain rooted in the recreation of Nanyang coffee and toast culture popular during the 1960s and 70s. Step inside and be greeted by the fragrance of coffee made from freshly-ground caramelised coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites. The enticing aroma of brewed coffee and flavourful local delights infuse vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the nostalgic taste of a bygone era. In addition to preserving the taste of Nanyang at home, Toast Box is now also brewing in Hong Kong, Jakarta, Johor Bahru, Kuala Lumpur, and Chinese-Taipei, sharing the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: TOG - Toy or Game
description: TOG is Singapore's largest retail chain store for video games from PlayStation, Xbox & Nintendo and also the latest toy figures & merchandise.

name: Tonkatsu ENbiton
description: The very essence of our brand name, 'EN' representing a gathering place, and 'Biton' meaning beautiful, perfectly captures the soul of our restaurant. Tonkatsu ENbiton, a destination for authentic tonkatsu experiences. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour. Our skilled chefs meticulously prepare each tonkatsu dish to perfection, using airy, light, and crispy panko (bread crumbs) imported from Saitama Prefecture of Japan for that delightful texture. Whether you're indulging in our tonkatsu or exploring our diverse menu of signature dishes like the A4/A5 Miyazaki gyukatsu, black curry ramen, sandos, or a simple take-out bento, expect a culinary journey celebrating the rich and complex flavours of Japanese cuisine

name: UNIQLO
description: About UNIQLO LifeWear - Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. A perfect shirt that is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hiding the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people’s lives.

name: Unity Pharmacy
description: Originally established in 1992, Unity Pharmacy's mission is to improve the health and total well-being of its customers by being the most professional pharmacy chain while delivering the highest level of customer satisfaction at the most competitive prices. There are currently some 60 Unity Pharmacy stores island-wide, which offer a wide range of health supplements, healthcare and skincare products, medicines and first aid items. Pharmacists are trained to give professional advice on health concerns, and can help in services such as dispensing of medication, medication reviews, advice on chronic disease management and drug interaction.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty is your go-to destination for quality beauty and household cleaning products at unbeatable prices. Explore our curated selection of skincare, haircare, and cosmetics, alongside an array of effective household cleaning essentials. Discover a diverse range of beauty items, from skincare and cosmetics to haircare essentials, all designed to make you feel radiant without breaking the bank. Indulge in a delightful shopping experience where affordability meets quality. From skincare essentials to household must-haves, Venus Beauty is your one-stop destination for budget friendly beauty and cleaning solutions. Elevate your routine without compromising your budget – Visit Venus Beauty today and experience the joy of affordable excellence.

name: Vincent Watch
description: Founded by a visionary entrepreneur with an unwavering passion for horology, Vincent Watch set out to redefine the luxury watch retail landscape, making it not just exclusive but accessible to the discerning locals. Establishing its first boutique in 1985, Vincent Watch quickly became a symbol of trust and authenticity in the realm of high-end timepieces. The meticulously curated collection boasted renowned brands such as Tudor, Tag Heuer, Longines, Tissot, Rado, Mido, Baume & Mercier, Yema, Maurice Lacroix and Oris. The Vincent Watch boutiques were not just retail spaces; they were immersive experiences. The knowledgeable and passionate staff transformed each visit into a journey through the history and artistry of watchmaking. The brand's commitment to providing an exceptional customer experience, paired with a diverse collection of world-class watches, solidified Vincent Watch as a trusted name in Singapore's mid-luxury retail landscape.

Our offerings include optical frames, sunglasses, prescriptive lenses, night lenses, and contact lenses, along with comprehensive eye examinations tailored to individual needs by age group. Get a complete pair of branded eyeglasses with prescriptive lenses starting from just $158 for Ray-Ban, with more premium selections available from Oakley, Gucci, Prada, and other top fashion brands. In today’s digital age, regular eye screenings are essential to detect various eye conditions and diseases early. We also specialize in myopia management for children. www.woptics.sg

name: Wang Lu Hotpot
description: Wang Lu Hot Pot is a steamboat restaurant catered for local families. Its vision is to offer high quality food and service to customers of all ages. The unique individual pot design allows every customer to have their own pot for cooking. With a focus on hygiene and a comfortable dining environment, along with 16 types of soup bases, Wang Lu will definitely satisfy your hot pot cravings.

Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

Since then, we have expanded our product offerings to cater to diverse consumer needs.

With a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, the restaurant offers better ingredients and delicious Hunan dishes, winning over countless diners over the years.

description: Xiaomi to-date has created remarkable hardware, software, and internet services. expanding its footprint across the world to become a global brand. Experience its range of Xiaomi smartphones, AIoT, ecosystem and lifestyle products today!

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.

name: Yale Smart Shop
description: Yale is trusted by millions of people every day to keep what’s important safe. Its innovations have protected homes, families and belongings for over 180 years. Yale has expanded from being a leader in mechanical lock engineering to innovating connected smart locks and homes by making an effort to push the boundaries in a changing world. Yale Smart Shop is positioned to lead the smart lock industry and shape its future: offering Yale Smart Lock owners increased functionalities and integrations via Yale Access app. Yale Access ecosystem includes Smart Safes, Smart Storage and a wide range of Smart Locks for a comprehensive home security system.

name: Yolé
description: Yole created probably the best ice cream and frozen yogurt in the world without adding any sugar. Yolé products are full of taste, delicious, low in calories and 0% sugar added. From the noodle dough to the broth and kimchi, every food is meticulously prepared and served. While certain things may have changed over the years, the core belief that customers deserve fresh food still remains. Starting out as a small fried chicken eatery tucked in 2nd floor corner of City Plaza, Arnold's Fried Chicken's humble beginning is the brainchild of 2 entrepreneurs who were on the verge of being jobless. Nonetheless, that is a story for another day. So, with sheer hard work, determination, some brilliant ideas and strokes of luck along the way, Arnold's Fried Chicken moved in a slow but steady pace to what it has become today. The success of Arnold's Fried Chicken is not without its loyal customers, who have put their faith into the company's integrity. Over the years, Arnold's Fried Chicken have seen generations of families who come back because they know that it does not get fresher anywhere else.

name: ASLOWE
description: ASLOWE is a Singapore homegrown brand, born from the passion for jewelry that unites a team of strong, modern women. The tagline, "The Real, Honest Jewelry", represents their commitment to designing and producing genuine and high-quality jewelry at an honest price point.

name: Asterspring
description: AsterSpring is a leading chain of professional skincare salons and kiosks in ASEAN and Hong Kong, treating more than 10 million faces since 1984. With more than 36 years of experience, AsterSpring remains committed to achieving its customers’ best skin health by providing safe, effective and personalised skin health solutions.

name: Auntie Anne's
description: Auntie Anne's, the renowned pretzel bakery, takes pride in offering handcrafted and oven-baked pretzels, made fresh daily in their stores. With a vast selection of over 20 sweet and savoury flavors, Auntie Anne's Singapore is halal certified and caters to a wide range of tastes and preferences, ensuring there's something for everyone. The dough is egg-free and dairy-free, making our pretzels both vegan and vegetarian-friendly when ordered without meat, chocolate, or butter. They're here to add an unexpected twist to your day and help you make the most of each moment, satisfying your craving for excitement.

name: Aureus Academy
description: Aureus Academy specializes in providing individually tailored piano, violin, guitar, and vocal lessons to students of all ages and abilities. They believe one-on-one is the best environment to learn a musical instrument, but the trick is keeping students engaged while making the lessons fun and rewarding! Their lessons are designed to engage each student in a way that suits their learning style.

name: Avenue
description: AVENUE is a growing popular footwear and apparels boutique with multiple branches across the country. Consisting of brands like Cat Footwear and Sperry, AVENUE brings you a wide selection of exclusive ranges such as, sneakers, slides, and work shoes fit for any occasion and situations.

name: Ayam Penyet President
description: Ayam Penyet President is a chain of Halal-certified casual dining restaurants serving authentic Indonesian cuisine. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, their signature Ayam Penyet is served with sambal that packs one helluva punch so you'll definitely want to try their Avocado Juice to balance it out. Or perhaps indulge in one of their more interesting concoctions - Soda Gembira (Happy Soda) and Teh Botol Sosro (Indonesian Bottled Jasmine Tea).

name: Bagus Food Hall by Kopitiam
description: From shared laughter over meals to long-overdue catch-ups with your favourite people, these are the everyday moments that make life a little more Bagus. ⁣ Good food. Good vibes. 100% Halal.⁣ ⁣ Come by, bring your people, and make yourself at home.

name: Ban Heng Teochew Porridge
description: Ban Heng Teochew Porridge's comforting bowls of porridge serve as the perfect accompaniment to their extensive variety of dishes. Theyspecialise in two types of porridge - sweet potato and plain, each providing a unique taste experience. These comforting bowls of porridge serve as the perfect accompaniment to our variety of dishes. Ban Heng's menu boasts an array of options such as sweet and sour fish, sautéed mushrooms, braised cabbage, braised aubergine, and fried taukwa with minced meat. Each dish is crafted with care, ensuring a home-cooked feel that resonates with our customers. Particularly noteworthy is their fried taukwa with minced meat, reminiscent of traditional family recipes. The sweet and sour fish, known for its freshness and soft texture, is another crowd favourite. All the dishes are enhanced by our specially made chilli, adding an extra layer of flavour to your meal.

name: Baskin Robbins
description: At Baskin-Robbins, they sell fun, not only ice cream! As the world’s largest chain of ice cream specialty shop, Baskin-Robbins is known for its unrivalled collection of ice cream flavors. Their passion to inject creativity into flavors has inspired the “Flavor of the Month” program, which introduces a new flavor every month to ice cream enthusiasts. From their growing line of ice cream cakes to ice cream sundaes and beverages, there is always a new creation for you at Baskin-Robbins. To them, there is nothing quite as thrilling as a happy face enjoying ice cream. So come on down to Baskin Robbins and join them for a tasty ice cream revolution!

name: Bata
description: Home to Bata's Asia Pacific and Africa operations, the Singapore office manages 3,000 outlets in the region and its many dealers and suppliers. As the Procurement Centre for Bata, we also work closely with our corporate partners and dealers through efficient manufacturing and sales service support in our own factories as well as our affiliates in the Far East Region. This means we can apply the very same technology and quality standards for Bata shoes to help our clients achieve their expectations without compromising on their brand identity.

name: Beard Papa’s
description: Since 1999, Beard Papa’s has been baking The World’s Best Cream Puffs. They began in Japan and have expanded to 430+ stores in the world; committed to serving pastries that are super oishii! (delicious!). Beard papa’s signature custard cream is made only from fresh and natural ingredients. You can smell the aroma of genuine vanilla bean, one of the most valuable spices on the planet and the richness of luxurious whipping cream and butter.

name: Beauty Language
description: Beauty Language is the largest homegrown hair and beauty retail chain in Singapore. Our journey started in 2000, when our founders were frustrated by the lack of good hair and beauty regimes in the market then. This led to a life-long search and passion to uncover better answers. We constantly globetrot to discover the latest new products that work for our customers. Here you will find the best mix of exclusive and major commercial brands to suit different lifestyles, budgets and occasions.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that has redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Beijing 101 Hair Consultants
description: With 90% visible results in increased hair growth and 4 decades of experience, Beijing 101 Hair Consultants also won numerous international awards. It is dedicated to treating common hair issues such as hair scalp concerns, greying hair, premature or excessive white hair, male/female pattern hair loss problems. All Beijing 101 hair treatments use premium-grade natural herbs to treat not just the symptoms of hair and scalp issues, but also the very root of the problem in an integrative and harmonious way, that is in line with TCM practices.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: BenTahir
description: BenTahir begins with a vision and purpose to meet modest Muslimah’s desire in wearing hijabs, scarves and accessories that will appeal to all women at all times. They supply high-quality products for all muslimah; to feel comfortable and confident while wearing it; as they would be happy to wear themselves, without compromising the quality and at affordable prices.

name: Berries World of Learning School
description: Berries World of Learning School has been teaching Chinese since 1993 and is well-known for its fun, multi-sensory approach. The preschool curriculum is specifically designed to foster a learning environment in which children's interest in and proficiency in the Chinese language is fostered. Its comprehensive primary school curriculum, in accordance with the Ministry of Education's syllabus, provides an effective method of teaching the language while having serious fun through imaginative and dynamic learning methods. Berries World of Learning School pupils' consistent exceptional success in the PSLE attests to their teaching style, making the school a trusted learning partner for many Singapore primary school students.

name: Better Vision
description: Better Vision was founded in 1965 as a modest optical store aspiring to provide eye-care consultations and solutions. Driven by their passion to improve eye-care services and provide cutting-edge solutions to a wider clientele, they have expanded across the region to become a leading eye-care provider. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10:30am - 11:30am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: BeuTea
description: Beutea - a modern tea beverage brand using "Freshly Brewed Chinese Tea" (a combination of ancient Chinese and modern tea beverage). Beutea practices the four ancient tea ceremony skills “moisten”, “soak”, “boil”, and “brew” using extract from the finest hand-picked tea leaves originating from tea mountains of Yunnan and Wuyi in China as the base of their beverages. It is then blended with modern flavours such as fresh milk and fresh fruits to brew unique, exquisite, aromatic and delicious fresh tea beverages. “A sip of tea lingers, two sips come with a long aftertaste” serves as the purpose of founding the brand as they aspire to be the top unique and delicious fresh tea beverage brand.

name: Blackoutz
description: Blackoutz provides ear and nose piercing, engraving services and offers a wide range of Rhodium and stainless steel accessories.

name: BolotreeSG
description: BolotreeSG hopes that the brand philosophy of “Technology will never replace the company” can reach every family, offering every child more time staying with their parents whilst playing high-quality toys. BolotreeSG has been trying hard to create the playability, expansibility and interactivity of its products. Based on British EYES early childhood education system and Gardner's Multiple Intelligence, BolotreeSG has developed a concept of "8Core"(Early Development of Eight Core Competitive Advantages) and established a product system and curriculum suitable for the continuous development and learning of children. The eight majors’ modules that interconnect with each other are made up of well-designed and challenging products covering children’s interests and demands in all fields. We encourage children to learn while playing and play while learning, thereby exploring the world naturally and enjoyably.

name: BONIA
description: Founded in 1974, BONIA is a lifestyle brand that creates both timeless and reimagined classics, with vision rooted in craftsmanship and individuality.

name: Boost Juice Bars
description: Boost Juice - the nation’s favourite makers of fresh smoothies and juices! We serve millions of Singaporeans our iconic green cups, filled with fruit and veggie deliciousness. Deliciousness that comes from simple, natural goodness, served to you with a love life attitude that will make you so happy you’ll probably end up high fiving random strangers. It’s about making healthy living easy!! So naturally, nutrition is a key component in developing our range of smoothies and juices that sees us blending through millions of tonnes of fruit and veggies every year.

name: BreadTalk/Toast Box
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. The signature 'see through' kitchens allow their chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste. Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: British Essential
description: British Essential is a one-stop beauty destination with assortments of prestige beauty products from Korea and International Brands.

name: Bugis Xin Yuan Ji
description: Bugis Xin Yuan Ji is renowned for its quality fish soup.All ingredients are freshly prepared daily to ensure the freshness of their soup! Multiple selection of fish and carbs like their 0 calories mixian!

name: Burger King
description: Welcome to the home of flame-grilled perfection! Enjoy the best-selling, signature flame-grilled WHOPPER®️ as well as other top BK favourites such as the velvety smooth Double Mushroom Swiss, deliciously juicy Tendergrill®️ Chicken that is made of chicken thigh fillet and the irresistible sides such as Onion Rings, Taro Turnover, HERSHEY’S®️ Sundae Pie and more! Sink your teeth in our juicy burgers now.

name: Cai-Ca
description: Capturing a Moment of Nature, Serving a Sip of Emotion At Caica, we believe every great cup of tea begins with respect for nature. From the careful picking of the finest tea leaves to the smooth blend with Japanese soy milk, we craft each drink with purity, balance, and care. Blending traditional artistry with modern wellness, our teas deliver natural aroma, refined taste, and heartfelt comfort in every sip. Your Moments, Our Tea.

name: Capitol Optical
description: Capitol Optical is committed to delivering exceptional eye care, eyewear, and customer service for all ages. Their expert optical team provides personalized services, including Myopia Management and Axial Length Measurement, and specializes in Ortho-K for children. Capitol Optical ensures every visit is enjoyable, whether for an eye test or choosing frames that suit your style. As their brands and stores expand with your support, they aim to elevate the standards of eye care and eyewear in Singapore.

name: Cat & the Fiddle
description: From the culinary mastermind of Award-Winning Celebrity Pastry Chef Daniel Tay comes Cat & the Fiddle - Singapore’s First and Foremost Premium Cheesecake Retailer, the cheesecake specialist shop with its message of quality and affordability for all, and sustainability for the environment. At Cat & the Fiddle, you’ll find a diverse selection of 21 varieties of gourmet cheesecakes comprising faithful classics, Asian and local-inspired creations like Mao Shan Wang Durian Cheesecake, Mango Cheesecake and Milo Dinosaur Cheesecake, and even specially-composed medleys of our best-sellers, Fickle Feline, so you get to try 10 spectacular flavours in one neat cake! Perfect for birthdays, special occasions, and simply indulging, Cat & the Fiddle has every cheesecake lover’s whim and fancy catered for.

name: Cellarbration
description: Cellarbration is the first-ever local online alcohol delivery platform to launch in Singapore. An online and retail destination with the largest selection of beers, wines, spirits and whiskies in Singapore and South-East Asia, Cellarbration is a pioneer in the online liquor industry with a country-wide presence of 10 retail outlets in and around Singapore’s central districts. Cellarbration welcomes all who share an interest and passion for liquor and is known as a one-stop alcohol beverage hub that aims to provide for celebrations and festive occasions of any scale.

name: CFoot
description: CFoot offers customized insoles designed for those with foot problems or those looking to prevent them. Their shoes are not only comfortable but also help correct foot posture and walking gait, making them suitable for both young people and the elderly. CFoot 's insoles and shoes are suitable for all ages, from children to young adults to seniors, ensuring everyone can benefit from them.

name: Challenger
description: Unveil the world of Challenger – Singapore’s exclusive homegrown electronics chain since 1982. Explore the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials trusted by over half a million loyal members across 40+ island-wide stores. Embrace peace of mind with hassle-free returns and warranties covering 50,000+ top-tier products, including favorites like Apple, Samsung, and an array of other leading names.

name: Chao Yue Xuan Dim Sum Express
description: Chao Yue Xuan Dim Sum Express is renowned for its commitment to culinary excellence and health-conscious dining. The restaurant upholds the highest standards by using only the freshest, premium ingredients, ensuring all dishes are MSG-free and prepared with less oil and salt. Guests can savor exquisite all-day dim sum and cuisines meticulously crafted by distinguished owner-chefs, Chef Sean and award-winning Chef Vanness. Each dim sum is handcrafted from scratch, reflecting the restaurant's unwavering commitment to quality and authenticity. Patrons can expect to experience exceptional flavors in a refined, welcoming atmosphere. Chao Yue Xuan Dim Sum Express sets the benchmark for dim sum excellence, where every dish represents a dedication to culinary mastery and superior dining experience.

name: ChaPanda 茶百道
description: In 2008, the first cup of “ChaPanda” was born in Chengdu, the "Land of Abundance". Adhering to the brand mission of "making daily drinks that everyone loves", ChaPanda has adhered to an independent product research and development model for many years. With "good tea as the base, creating freshness" as the core brand concept, it focuses on product conception and constantly explores the combination of natural ingredients and Chinese tea. ChaPanda is known for its fresh fruit and premium tea-based drinks. Their signature drinks include Taro Ball Milk Tea and Mango Pomelo Sago.

name: Chateraise
description: Chateraise have over 470 stores across all of Japan and over 15 stores in Asia. All of their sweets are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as pure natural water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms in Japan. They directly deliver all their sweets from Japan to stores around the world.

name: Cheers
description: Step into a world of convenience at Cheers for all your needs, with a range of drinks, snacks, services, local food, products and more to keep you going! Come and discover your Cheers.

name: CHICHA San Chen
description: Originating from Taiwan, CHICHA San Chen was founded in 1998 with a mission to make high-quality freshly brewed teas accessible to discerning tea drinkers. The brand holds a prestigious Highest International Authority ITI certification for quality, and utilises an exclusive patented Teapresso machine that allows custom settings and temperature control brewing technique to bring out the tea’s best flavour and natural scent, and maintain consistency in the quality and taste profiles of their tea. With high-quality tea as its mainstay, CHICHA San Chen marries the best of bubble tea with traditional tea bringing one of life’s greatest pleasures to the world.

name: Chip Lee Jewellery
description: Providing you with the finest gold jewellery and ornaments since 1984. Chip Lee Jewellery’s brand is built on a solid foundation of trust. Their extensive and comprehensive gold products range bears the hallmark of the Singapore Assay Office - which represents stringent gold purity standards are met. Hallmarking gives them the added confidence to ensure that they provide quality products to their customers.

name: Chiropractic First
description: Chiropractic First is the undisputed and most trusted leader in Chiropractic care globally, with over 35 clinics operating in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, China, UK and Europe. They have over 50 highly-trained certified doctors from all over the world. For over 20 years, Chiropractic First has built excellent patient testimonials and countless documented successful results. They have built long lasting patient loyalty with families continuously in wellness care with them in the past 20 years.

name: CHJ JEWELLERY
description: Founded in 1997 with the mission of promoting oriental culture. CHJ Jewellery is a Chinese modern jewelry brand with oriental character and global vision, creating contemporary fashion jewellery and inheriting the civilization and beauty of the Orient in an innovative way.

name: Chocolate Origin
description: Be it a celebration or to simply fix your chocolate cravings, Chocolate Origin has got you covered. Specialising in chocolate cakes and confectioneries, we use the most finest, quality ingredients to ensure mouth-watering goodness with every bite! Who says you can’t buy happiness? Slowly it gained a loyal following, mostly through word-of-mouth recommendations of a growing fan base. This was undoubtedly due to its commitment to offer only the best chocolate cake that one could find, not just merely within Changi Village, but the whole of Singapore.

name: Chomel
description: Chomel is an established fashion jewelry and accessories brand in Singapore for over 20 years. Chomel philosophy is to offer contemporary quality accessories at affordable prices to women of all ages.

name: Citispa
description: Citispa is an established and trusted Spa Group with 37 years of experience. It has 24 outlets in Singapore -- 19 Citispa Suites and 5 SHINE Studios. Citispa makes every women feel beautiful and confident to express her personal style through providing more than 80 of the latest and most effective spa, face, body and beauty treatments. We pledge to delight customers and to offer high quality products, knowledgeable therapists and consultants and the latest technology, so as to create unparalleled results.

name: City Chain
description: Welcome to City Chain, your trusted source for exquisite timepieces. Founded in 1985, City Chain has grown to become a leading retailer of stylish and high-quality watches across Asia. Whether you seek timeless elegance or contemporary flair, their expert team is dedicated to helping you find the perfect watch. Experience the blend of style, quality, and exceptional service that has defined City Chain for decades.

name: Clippers Barber
description: Clippers Barber is your affordable classic barbershop with a modern revamp. It is a place where men of all ages can sit back, relax, enjoy a professional grooming service at the hands of the expert barbers, who pride themselves for their superior fades and clean cuts. Focusing on mastering the art of no frills personal grooming for quintessential gentleman, Clippers Barber constantly challenge itself to combine technology and social media with the time honored art of barbering, so as to deliver on its promise of service quality at wallet friendly prices; leaving every customer with a fresh new look and a smile on their face.

name: CocoNutnut
description: At CocoNutnut, they believe in nothing but FRESH! Beverages and desserts are made daily with freshly extract coconut milk and fresh ingredients.

name: COLLIN'S
description: A celebration of passion, for the craft of good food and great service to our guests. Established since 2012, COLLIN’S® is one of Singapore’s leading restaurant chains that brings premium Western cuisine to the masses. Using the language of food, COLLIN’S® seek to bring families, friends and loved ones closes as they gather and indulge in good food and company. With a wide selection of great grills, succulent meats, woodfired pizzas and carefully selected wine/beverage list, COLLIN’S® offers an extensive menu that is curated to delight customers from all walks of life. Today, Chef Collin and his team continues to innovate its offerings to ensure the brand stays fresh and relevant in the market.

name: Confucius Mandarin
description: Confucius Mandarin Institute specialises in Chinese tutoring and offers Chinese Language courses for people from all walks of life. The courses are available for students of varying academic levels from pre-school, primary, secondary and tertiary, to working adults.

name: Coslab
description: Coslab is a premier beauty & body slimming spa. It is the perfect beauty spa for relaxation and tranquility. Coslab offers a variety of treatments, including Massage Therapy with registered Massage Therapists (I.T.E.C), Aroma-therapy Massage, Traditional Javanese Massage, Advanced Facial Treatments , Anti Stress Ear Candling, Body Polish and Wraps and other skin & body treatments. At Coslab, we also offer special exotic treatments as well as our signature & exclusive anti wrinkle treatment.

name: Cotton On
description: Cotton On is a Australian fashion and lifestyle brand founded in 1991. With stores in 22 countries, it’s bringing the laid-back Aussie lifestyle to the world. Cotton On’s style is effortless, lived-in and accessible to everyone. Inspired by the everyday guy and girl with an eye for the latest trends and a drive for self-expression. From day one, Cotton On has always been about people and community, and doing good along the way

name: Cotton On Kids
description: Cotton On Kids deliver the latest and greatest for the kids because the future looks more than bright with them in it. They are the magic makers and the kindness warriors, the animal lovers and the planet protectors. They are our future. We believe that shopping for our kids should be easy and ultra-affordable, we work hard to deliver the product they need to absolutely run the world.

name: Country Brot by Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

name: Crave
description: Savour the nation's favourite by indulging at Crave! Enjoy some award-winning Adam Road Nasi Lemak by Selera Rasa, topped off with crunchy flavourful ikan bilis, nuts and the tantalising iconic sambal!

name: Crolo
description: CROLO is a brand new speciality concept by Swee Heng Bakery. With their homegrown roots, CROLO seeks to bring some excitement to the world of confectionery. Specialising in croissants and croffles (yes, you read it right! Their perfect combination of croissants & waffles) are baked from scratch every day to ensure that each bite is buttery, flaky and oh-so-flavourful! At CROLO, they believe in spoiling their customers. So swing on by to check out their variety of sweet and savoury bites to have your cravings satisfied.

name: Cupid
description: Founded in 2004, CUPID has established itself as a vibrant icon in the fast fashion industry. Specializing in affordable and trendsetting apparel, CUPID epitomises the spirit of "Always something new. From chic urban wear to casual classics, CUPID ensures every wardrobe is effortlessly up-to-date and distinctly stylish.

name: Customer Service Counter (Northpoint City)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: D&C (Design & Comfort)
description: D&C (Design & Comfort) specialises in stylish, comfortable and affordable everyday footwear, bag and accessories.

name: Dabba Street
description: Dabba Street brings a vibrant blend of Indian and Mediterranean flavours to Singapore’s fast‑casual dining scene, offering customisable bowls, biryanis, pitas and wraps prepared with fresh ingredients and halal‑certified standards. Known for its bold spices, generous portions, and healthier preparation—free from ghee, heavy oils, MSG, and artificial additives—it’s a popular choice for quick, satisfying meals.

name: De Arte Hair Studio
description: Experience a subtle change or a complete transformation. De Arte Hair Studio get your desirable hair style with the exclusive hair care system. Create a healthy foundation of hair by focus on every single steps of process to continue a beauty radiance hair.

name: De Silver
description: De Silver was established in year 2000 (Singapore), with the belief that stylish, high-quality jewelry doesn’t have to break the bank. With the simple idea as our guide, we’ve strived to bring our customers up-to the-minute fashionable accessories alongside a collection of timeless, everyday basics; all at an exceptional value.

name: Délifrance
description: A journey to France - this is Délifrance promise to you. For over 30 years, Délifrance Singapore has dedicated itself to bringing a taste of Paris closer to home. The Délifrance brand is centred upon a desire to make every day delicious. This is a testament to their unending search for and provision of the simple pleasures in life put forth in creative and transformative ways. Their French roots and history exist as the foundational structure upon which they innovate authentic cultural fare, culminating in inspired creations of outstanding taste and convenience.

name: Dian Xiao Er
description: Dian Xiao Er, the must eat herbal roast duck in Singapore! Using only the finest quality of Cherry Valley ducks paired with freshest ingredients, our duck are prepared and freshly roast daily. They are marinated with a revitalising blend of Chinese herbs and spices for hours, roasted at a precise temperature to retain its juice while in the oven. Crisp to the touch, and golden brown in appearance, our herbal roast duck is complemented with our specially concocted herbal sauce that makes it impossible to resist!

name: Din Tai Fung
description: Ranked as one of the world's Top Ten Best Restaurants by The New York Times, the Michelin-star restaurant has its roots dating back to Taiwan more than 40 years ago. The arrival of Din Tai Fung in Singapore in 2003 made waves in the local dining scene and has since built a huge following with its famous signature Xiao Long Baos (Steamed Pork Dumplings), Steamed Chicken Soup and Fried Rice with Shrimps & Eggs amongst many popular favourites.

name: Dollars & Scent
description: Dollars & Scent was founded in September, 1997. What started out as a single outlet in Lucky Plaza, Dollars & Scent has since grown -- with more than 10 outlets island wide. Despite this, they believe that they deliver that personal touch that many of our customers value - and this is what sets them apart. The Dollars & Scent Team are well-versed with the latest releases as well as the hard-to-find classics that you can't get enough of! With this expertise, their friendly & approachable retail staff are able to recommend the right fragrance for you, specific to your needs. If you are a fragrance connoisseur, and looking for something special, they carry a select range of niche brands that are sure to pique your interest.

name: DON DON DONKI
description: DON DON DONKI is a Japanese specialty brand that offers wide variety of high quality Japanese products from premium Japanese meat to ready-to-eat meals. Find everything you're looking for and discover things you never knew you needed, only at DON DON DONKI.

name: Dorra Slimming
description: With the advanced slimming formulation and state-of-the-art technology, the award-winning slimming brand, dorra Slimming has helped over 80,000 women. With it's Signature Intense Fat Burning Slimming Treatment that promises up to 5cm loss in a 20 minute session, it is able to burn stubborn fat, tone and shape bulging tummies, chunky thighs and wide hips. Our fast and effective treatments is perfect for the everyday busy women who wants to slim down, tone up, or achieve overall wellness with no downtime. Make an appointment today at any of our conveniently located outlets island wide.

name: Dough Culture
description: Dough Culture Pte Ltd is the largest manufacturer of You Tiao in Singapore. Being a pioneer in its industry and a firm believer in innovation, the company constantly engages in the research and development of new food products with strategic partners, to introduce exciting new brands such as Dough Culture to the market. Dough Culture brand of products are manufactured under the most stringent food safety and hygiene standards. Our products are HACCP and Halal certified.

name: Dough Magic
description: Dough Magic specialises in handmade buns made with Taiwanese traditional recipes and aims to serve the best quality food at affordable prices. Tantalise your taste buds with its signature food items which includes Golden Pumpkin Cake, Steamed Purple Taro Bun, Taiwanese Mince Pie and Potato Cake with Bacon and Ham.

name: DRX MEDICAL AESTHETICS X-PRESS
description: The DRx Group consists of The DRx Clinic, The DRx Medispa, and the award-winning DRx Trichology Centre. The DRx Clinic is one of the pioneer clinics to specialize in aesthetic since 1999 and has been awarded the Singapore Prestige Award in 2023. Their expert panel of doctors stationed in their outlets treats every customer with utmost personalized care by recommending suitable non-surgical medical aesthetics treatments and a customized skincare regimen.

name: Dunkin' Donuts
description: Dunkin' Donuts is Singapore's favourite every day, all-day stop for great coffee and baked goods. Visit us to enjoy a fantastic selection of donuts including all-time favourites Mr Happy, Boston Kreme and Strawberry Filled Donut as well as delightful limited edition options.

name: Dyson
description: Dyson technology works differently. So the best way to understand it, is to experience it. That's why we created the Dyson Demo Store – a place that brings the science and engineering to life. Here, you can also access exclusive services, offerings and support from Dyson Experts.

name: Eastern Rice Dumpling
description: Today Eastern Rice Dumpling produces a diverse range of rice dumplings to cater to its wide variety of loyal customers it has built in the last thirty years.

name: EAT.
description: EAT. is a “one-stop” food outlet serving your favourite local traditional fare like fishball noodles, minced meat noodles (‘bak chor mee’), and laksa, enjoyed in a comfortable and cosy setting. You can also find finger foods such as traditional handmade ngoh hiang and homemade iced lemon tea.

name: EduFirst Learning Centre
description: EduFirst Learning Centre was set up with the aim of providing a premium education service for our students. With an extremely class size of between 4 to 8 students, we seek to maximize the potential of each child. The small group size creates a conducive environment for optimal learning through close teacher to student interaction. Our tutors are carefully handpicked and had gone through stringent selection to ensure that potential of each child is maximized. EduFirst Learning Centre offers tuition services from Pre-Primary to O Level students.

name: Encik Tan
description: Recognising the demand from the Muslim counterparts for authentic Chinese hawker fare, the Encik Tan brand was introduced as a Halal-certified mini food atrium concept that dishes up a parade of popular local Chinese dishes, such as Hainanese Curry Rice, Wanton Noodles, Ban Mian, and Claypot Rice. All recipes are adapted using Halal ingredients and fine-tuned to deliver the same nostalgic flavour and taste of the original dishes.

name: epitex
description: Inspiring comfort, with a single-minded dedication to bring exceptional comfort in every thread, every fabric, to every home. With a wide collection of quality bed sheets, bed linen and pillows, Epitex constantly unfold dimensions of cosy, to suit every kind of sleeper and daydreamer.

name: Estetica
description: With over 40 years of expertise and a commitment to innovation, Estetica offers a distinguished array of award-winning aesthetic services. Our treatments are crafted with inspiration from Nobel Prize-winning research and the latest in technological advancements. Experience the pinnacle of luxury with our meticulously curated beauty services, delivered by highly trained estheticians. At Estetica, rest assured that every customer is always In Good Hands.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Eu Yan Sang is Asia's leading integrative healthcare and wellness company with a strong foundation in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). Founded in 1879 with the mission of 'Caring for Mankind' - Today, Eu Yan Sang is a trusted household brand. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Eurotex
description: Eurotex Singapore is Singapore’s leading luxury bath, bedding, bedsheet and ready-made designer curtain brand. Aside from its own range of products, the homegrown label is also an authorised licensee for authentic Disney bedding, bedsheet and bath products in Singapore since 2008.

name: EX Beauty
description: EX beauty is dedicated to professional beauty services using the latest technology and methodology in the beauty industry. Our beauty salons staffs are from the beauty industry with more than 10 years of working experience in various high-profile beauty brands. All of our staff are equipped with recognized professional qualifications in the industry. We are committed to upgrading ourselves consistently professionally in our specialized field to bring the best services to our customers.

name: EX Style
description: EX Style, an AVEDA Salon in Singapore strongly emphasizes the importance of strengthening healthy hair and providing wellness for our customers. We believe that healthy and luscious hair can be achieved through professional care and guidance provided by our hair stylist and therapist. EX Style strives to be the only hair salon that gives you a one-of-a-kind experience by integrating AI mirrors that help to map and analyses facial features data to accurately recommend suitable hairstyles.

name: Express Money Exchange
description: Express Money Exchange is a one-stop station for all your currency changing needs and services offering the best rates in town.

name: Fa Ji Lao Wan Mian
description: Authentic Shaanxi-style handmade noodles steal the spotlight in this Chinese restaurant. Grab your chopsticks and dive into a world of slurpy goodness.

name: FairPrice
description: From one supermarket, NTUC FairPrice has grown to become a leading retailer in Singapore serving more than half a million shoppers daily through a network of over 370 outlets. It comprises FairPrice supermarkets, FairPrice Finest, FairPrice Xtra, FairPrice Shop, Cheers convenience stores, FairPrice Xpress, and Unity pharmacy. Today, with its multiple retail formats serving the varied needs and interests of people from all walks of life, NTUC FairPrice has kept pace with the changing needs of its customers while remaining committed to its social mission and its aspiration to be Singapore’s leading world-class retailer with a heart.

name: Famous Amos
description: Since 1975, Famous Amos has been Singapore's go-to for freshly baked cookies. Our legendary cookies boasts that irresistible crunch and melt-in-your-mouth satisfaction that generations have loved. Beyond the iconic crunchy cookie flavours you know and love, be spoilt with our range of chunky cookies, fluffy muffins, brownies and more. Need a smile, a perfect perk-me-up or the ideal gift for any special occasion? Our cookie gift items are the perfect treat to share with friends, family or simply indulge in yourself. They're guaranteed to bring back happy memories and create new ones!

name: Feng Food
description: Home of good aunthentic Taiwanese food in Singapore, featuring fried rice with specialty marinated pork chop, Hakka-style braised meat rice, shrimp & pork wontons with fiery chilli oil, and more.

name: First Lady Nails & Beauty
description: First Lady Nails is everyone’s number 1 nail salon where warmth and hospitality greet you at the door. Their cozy and inviting atmosphere to make every visit feel like catching up with old friends. They take pride in treating their customers like family, ensuring personalised care and attention to every detail. Whether you’re here for a quick colour change or a luxurious manicure, their skilled nail technicians are dedicated to delivering stunning results. At First Lady Nails, they combine high-quality nail services with a warm and welcoming environment, creating a delightful experience that will keep you coming back.

name: Fitflop
description: Fitflop provides carefully curated shoes made with the unbeatable combination of biomechanics, comfort, and fashion, offering a wide range of footwear from sandals, sneakers to sliders.

name: Fortune Wigs
description: Fortune Wigs is one of Singapore’s most established wig boutiques, spanning a history of 30 years. Our major goals are to provide professional, yet personalised customer service and to preserve our unequaled standard of high quality products.

name: Fragrance
description: Fragrance Foodstuff Pte Ltd is a Singapore brand with a long heritage, established in 1969. "Fragrance" is named after the natural aroma of barbecued meat. Over the years, the company has grown from a single stall to multiple outlets island-wide. With over 55 years of experience, Fragrance is known for their product quality, innovation, and numerous certifications and awards. As a household brand, "Fragrance" has expanded its range of products to include Barbecued Meat (Bak Kwa/Jerky), Flosses, Snacks, Confectionery products, and Ready-to-Cook Meals.

name: Fried Chicken Master
description: Fried Chicken Master is now MUIS Halal Certified. Come enjoy Taiwan‘s Leading Halal No.1 Fried Chicken at Fried Chicken Master! Their chicken is crispy, juicy, and tender – the perfect bite with every taste. From a-la-carte dishes and delicious bento sets starting from just $7.80, to tasty snacks and refreshing soft drinks! Visit them today and treat yourself to the ultimate fried chicken experience!

name: Fruit Box
description: Fruit Box, with its pure quality, is the best nutritious partner for the city dweller! Providing 100% fresh fruit juices that are all-natural, containing phytonutrients; which are disease-fighting compounds and the healthiest beverage choice. Fruit Box only uses and purchase natural ingredients from reliable, and accredited suppliers who provide high-quality ingredients.

name: Fun Claw
description: Fun Claw is a brand-new concept of automated Claw Catcher machine launched in 2018, creating a space exclusively for claw machines where families and friends can bond over the simplicity of having a fun time while shopping together.

name: Fun Toast
description: Bringing back the traditional Nanyang Coffeehouse nostalgia, Fun Toast serves well-brewed fragrant local Coffee and Tea, deliciously fresh Yuan Yang Soft Bun, Ham & Cheese French Toast and many more. Give their homemade signature Soya Sauce Chicken a try too. It will definitely keep you coming back for more. Check out their new range of merchandise as well, not to be missed!

name: G-SHOCK Casio
description: G-SHOCK, the watch that brought the new concept of toughness to the timepiece. It began with a reckless challenge to the conventional wisdom of the day, a developer's belief that it was possible to construct a watch that wouldn't break, even if dropped, Project Team Tough was formed to build it in 1981.The team created over 200 prototypes one after another over a period of about two years. They finally arrived at a shock-resistant structure. This marked the birth of a technology that is tough to the core.

name: G2000
description: G2000 is the savvy executive’s choice, with a sharper, cleaner cut that takes business to a personal level. It flaunts a versatile range of work wear that offers a balance of tailored elegance and sharp style, as well as smart essentials that are comfortably affordable.

name: Gain City
description: Established in 1981, Gain City started out with a simple quest of improving lifestyles and a focused vision to be Singapore's trusted air-conditioner retailer. Today, renowned as Singapore's largest air-conditioner retailer, the brand is synonymous with excellent air-conditioning installation and maintenance service, as well as being the preferred go-to 1-Stop retailer for consumer electronics. With more than 800 staff, a pool of BCA-certified installation technicians and a fleet of over 180 service vehicles, they are your trusted choice.

name: Geláre
description: Geláre is a great place for a perfect meal at anytime of the day. We serve a variety ranging from hot western cuisine and light bites to desserts. Their specialty, freshly baked waffles, is paired with a wide selection of premium ice creams to be enjoyed by all.

name: Genki Sushi
description: With over 20 outlets islandwide, Genki Sushi Singapore is never far from your next sushi fix! Powered by their iconic Kousoku Express delivery system, your favourite plates zoom straight to your table, fast, fresh, and always fun. Paired with the seamless BYOD ordering system, every visit turns into a uniquely playful dining adventure that Genki fans can’t get enough of. Feeling the sushi cravings already? Genki Sushi is right around the corner!

name: Giordano
description: Giordano embodies today’s contemporary lifestyle choices – simplicity in design and quality in substance. Their total commitment to superior service and outstanding quality and value has enabled the company to successfully grow the brands Giordano, Giordano Ladies, Giordano Junior, BSX, and Beau Monde. The essence of Giordano is to provide relevant, essential and timeless fashion for all; and to develop apparel for everyone regardless of ethnicity, nationality or culture, truly illustrating their brand value “World Without Strangers”.

name: Glimpse
description: A wide selection of chic and stylish eye-wear to cater to every different individual’s needs. Glimpse provides instant services and glasses that will be ready in 20 minutes.

name: Gochi-So Shokudo
description: Gochi-so Shokudo actively promotes a transparent, healthy eating practice from farm-to-table. The restaurant is dedicated to being an avenue for customers to enjoy all-natural pork.

name: Gokoku Japanese Bakery
description: Originating from Kobe, Japan, Gokoku Japanese Bakery is an authentic Japanese ‘wa’ (和) bakery boasting a heritage in bread production since 1961. Gokoku Japanese Bakery stays true to using established Japanese techniques and quality ingredients sourced from Japan to produce hearty, wholesome buns that are freshly baked daily. The use of nourishing ingredients abundant in minerals is believed to contribute to the happiness and health of customers, ultimately leading to good fortune. Signature Gokoku Shichifuku Pan (五穀七福) – translating to "5 grains and 7 fortunes" in Japanese – is a soft, chewy dough crafted from hearty grains that provide essential daily nutrients, and is a must-try item.

name: Goldheart
description: With more than 40 years of heritage, Goldheart is the first and leading gold and diamond jeweller in Singapore that introduced the concept of wedding bands in white gold and platinum. With exclusive in-house designs that exude artistry and masterful craftsmanship, every Goldheart boutique is a treasure trove of 999 & 916 gold jewellery for discerning customers. They have continuously pushed the boundaries of creativity in gold jewellery design. As the exclusive distributor of Celestial® diamond, Goldheart also flaunts the world’s first 73-facet starburst diamond that scintillates with the supreme luminosity of the brightest star. Honouring Goldheart’s rich heritage in love and romance, the exclusive concept of Pure Blue™ was introduced. The Pure Blue™ sapphire is embedded in the inner ring band as the perfect symbol of purity and fidelity.

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang is a 100% local-owned brand that was established in 2017 to provide a unique Ma La cuisine experience while retaining the authenticity of the local fan favourite dish. GYMLT offer drinkable Ma La soup bases that do not leave a greasy or overwhelming aftertaste, so that customers can enjoy it till the very last drop. GYMLT understands that different people have different dietary needs and spice preferences. Hence, GYMLT offers other soup bases such as Mushroom, Pork bone, Tomato and Pickled Vegetable soup bases for those who do not enjoy spices We have also come up with a vegetarian friendly soup for our vegetarian consumers.

name: Greendot
description: Greendot is the largest meat-free chain in Singapore. It is an asian-fusion fast casual dining concept aiming to help people take care and love themselves by making meat-free meals accessible and convenient to everyone.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 138 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Pharmacy services available! Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for consumers' health and beauty needs. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at all stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. We continue to build on our rich healthcare heritage with an award-winning team of pharmacists who have consistently won multiple pharmacist awards every year.

name: Guzman Y Gomez
description: At Guzman y Gomez (GYG), our passion is creating delicious food out of real ingredients. Up to 24 hour marinades, chip-tasting sessions and chillies really get us going! We don’t take shortcuts in our restaurants - we use fresh ingredients and authentic techniques. It’s not always easy, but it’s always worth it. ¡Buen provecho!

name: HaiDiLao
description: HaiDiLao has always been dedicated to achieving the perfect blend of authentic traditional Chinese food - Hot Pot with the convenience of modern trend.

name: Hakka Yu
description: Founded in 2013, Hakka Yu (客语) is a celebrated name in Hakka cuisine with over 80 locations across China and a legacy spanning more than 20 years. Dedicated to preserving authentic Hakka flavours, Hakka Yu merges traditional, natural cooking techniques with fresh, regionally sourced ingredients, delivering the rich, mountain-inspired flavours of Hakka culture to urban diners. Through continuous innovation, Hakka Yu reinterprets classic Hakka dishes with a contemporary flair, broadening its appeal while ensuring its legacy of quality endures in both domestic and international markets. Hakka Yu’s commitment to culinary excellence has earned it multiple accolades, including recognition among China’s Top 100 Restaurant Brands (2019-2020), designation as a Guangzhou Culinary Landmark (2021-2024), and a spot on Dianping’s prestigious "Must-Eat List" (2022 and 2024).

name: Han Dian TCM
description: Han Dian TCM 汉典中医 provide one stop “Traditional Chinese Medicine” practices to promote the best health care of their customers.They also combine with the latest scientific technology to further improve the wellbeing of their customers.

name: Hang Ten
description: Hang Ten’s enduring appeal lies in its ability to blend its rich surf heritage with contemporary fashion sensibilities, making it a beloved brand for those who appreciate both tradition and modernity in their wardrobe choices.

name: Hao Yi Tou
description: Designed to provide an immersive escape that combines the comforting journey of a first-class in-flight experience, Hao Yi Tou transports guests to a headspace like no other, with a comprehensive range of therapeutic reflexology services at affordable prices. Guests can check in feeling completely at ease before pampering themselves to a range of reflexology services including foot, shoulder, back and full body massage. The reflexology services come equipped with individual tablets for guests to enjoy their favourite shows and games at no additional charge.

name: Happy Walker
description: Happy Walker is an international foot care retail chain store, specializing in custom made insoles and a wide range of anatomic sport, dress and casual orthopedic footwear. Happy Walker is the one and only company is Singapore that provides whole foot 3D scan to capture your feet contour, replacing cement form box or dirty plaster casting which generally used in Hospital till today. Having its own manufacturing laboratory, Happy Walker uses the most advance CNC machine to produce the best insole in Singapore.

name: Harvey Norman
description: Harvey Norman from Australia is a leading electronics, IT, Furniture and Bedding chain in Singapore. You will find a wide range of products ranging from the latest home entertainment systems and computers, to the most stylish and innovative home appliances for your everyday use. You will also find Australian-Made and Italian furniture and bedding products from top brands. Look out for weekly promotions that bring you great value deals so you can shop with confidence.

name: Hatsumi Donburi & Soba
description: From the Land of the Rising Sun, Hatsumi Donburi & Soba brings the soul of everyday Japanese cuisine to your table. Savor the warmth of handcrafted donburi bowls, the delicate simplicity of soba noodles, and the timeless flavors that make every meal a comforting experience.

name: Helen
description: Since 1999, HELEN by Helen Accessories has been offering trendy fashion accessories for women. With over 20 stores island-wide today, it has become a well-recognised fashion accessories powerhouse.

name: Hockhua Herbal Tea
description: Enjoy Hockhua Herbal Tea’s specialties – a variety of bottled Herbal Tea and beverage made from ingredients such as luohan fruit, chrysanthemum and many more. Hockhua Herbal Tea produces herbal drinks every day to ensure what our customers get is fresh and of excellent quality, allowing everyone to easily enjoy these healthy concoctions without taking long hours to prepare them.

name: Hockhua Tonic
description: Hockhua Tonic, a household name in Singapore and Malaysia since 1989, is known for its retail chain of stores stocked with traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), health supplements and tonics. Renowned for their quality ginseng and wide range of bird's nest products, they also offer seafood delicacies such as abalones, dry scallops, Chinese herbs and a variety types of self-manufactured nutrition organically grown products.

name: Home's Harmony
description: At Home's Harmony, we're here to help you craft your home with style, comfort, and functionality. We've curated an exquisite collection of bedlinen, bedding accessories, bath essentials and lifestyle décor that elevate your living spaces to new heights.

name: Hong Kong Egglet
description: Bringing a taste of Hong Kong to our shores, Hong Kong Egglet is a chain of food kiosks peddling gai daan zai (egg waffles) that are freshly-made using a traditional secret recipe obtained from a well-established egglet vendor in Hong Kong. Besides the Original egglet with its iconic “bubble” texture and toasty flavour, Hong Kong Egglet also offers unique variations of the classic. such as Pizza, Chicken Floss and Spicy Shrimp, as well as timeless favourites – Chocolate, Pandan and Strawberry.

name: Hong Lim Curry Puff
description: Welcome to the Hong Lim Curry Puff - made with fresh and high quality ingredients served piping hot, where you’ll experience the finest and most delicious curry puffs in town. Their secret recipe has been passed down through generations, ensuring that every bite is filled with authentic flavors that will transport you to the streets of Singapore. From the flaky pastry to the perfectly spiced fillings, each curry puff is made with love and care, using only the freshest ingredients. Whether you’re looking for a quick snack or a satisfying meal, their curry puffs are sure to satisfy your cravings. So come on down to Best Curry Puff in Singapore and taste the difference!

name: Hot Tomato
description: Hot Tomato Cafe & Grill is a modern contemporary restaurant that serves steak, seafood, sides and pasta. They value their customers and prioritise quality food and service. For the celebration of special occasions or a simple meal with family and friends, they have dishes ready for your enjoyment at their outlets.

name: HUAWEI
description: HUAWEI is dedicated to bringing cutting-edge digital technology to every person, home, and organization, creating a fully connected and intelligent world. Visit their HUAWEI Authorized Store at Northpoint City, where you'll find a wide selection of Smartphones, Smartwatches, Tablets, and Wearables. Their expert team is committed to delivering top-notch service, helping you discover the ideal HUAWEI product tailored to your needs.

name: Hush Puppies
description: Hush Puppies was founded in 1958, an era where uncomfortable dress shoes were your only choice of footwear – even on the weekends. They set out to find a solution for sore feet, otherwise known as “barking dogs.” Introducing the world to casual shoes and a more casual lifestyle, Hush Puppies created shoes to help them hush their puppies. They’ve stood for comfort from the beginning, and they continue to innovate through their Bounce Technology platform today.

name: Hush Puppies Apparel
description: In 1958, Hush Puppies created the world's first casual shoe, signalling the beginning of today's relaxed style. Today, Hush Puppies isn't only about shoes! The brand has redefined what it means to be modern and casual expanding its repertoire to include casual apparel. Relaxed and classic in design, Hush Puppies apparel is available in over 135 countries across the world.

name: i.Dental
description: A trusted and recognised name in the field of dentistry that has been providing quality, value and innovative dental treatment to Singaporeans for over 3 decades, i.Dental is an established family dental practice that is dedicated to providing premium quality patient care services. Specialising in professional dental care that utilizes the latest in dental laser and treatment technology, i.Dental’s comprehensive suite of dental care services range from regular dental health screening and hygiene services, cosmetic and restorative dentistry, prosthodontics (crowns, bridges and dentures), orthodontics (straightening of crooked teeth), periodontics (gums and gum diseases), to endodontics and pain management. i.Dental is committed to delivering expert Invisalign, Braces and Veneers solutions, focusing on crafting happy, healthy, and beautiful smiles for their patients.

name: I Love Taimei
description: I Love Taimei is a local F&B brand established with a passion and goal to share the best of Taiwanese street food culture with the world. The brand features well known Taiwan delicacies such as Taiwan Fried Chicken, Braised Chicken Rice (Lu Rou Fan), Fried Snacks such as Taiwan Tempura and Bubble Tea.

name: @i MANGO COTTON ICE FRESH MILK TEA OMELETTE RICE
description: @i MANGO COTTON ICE FRESH MILK TEA OMELETTE RICE - A local Singaporean brand, recognized by diners as the most popular Cotton Ice and Fresh Milk Tea brand among young people in Singapore. 50% sugar, twice the health - This is the philosophy @ i MANGO upholds. All products use only half the sugar, with a commitment to 100% fresh fruit, 100% low-sugar health, and 100% pure milk. @i MANGO COTTON ICE FRESH MILK TEA OMELETTE RICE not only offers Cotton Ice from Taiwan but also a range of Fresh Milk Tea with no additives. Additionally, freshly made Egglet are prepared on-site, ensuring a diverse and healthy selection. @ i MANGO is dedicated to creating a sweet yet guilt-free space where customers can indulge with peace of mind. Whether you're craving Cotton Ice, indulging in Fresh Milk Tea, or savoring a crispy Egglet, @ i MANGO's addition of Japanese Omelette Rice brings even more mouthwatering choices to the table—perfect for every palate.

name: iTea
description: Launched in 2011, iTea is a premium drinks’ outlet in Singapore, with a mission to provide a refreshing experience of premium milk tea made with pure and natural ingredients.

name: IVI Aesthetic
description: Their obsession with perfect, healthy balanced skin has led to the launch of IVI Aesthetic. Because they believe in correction rather than concealment, their goal is to help customers get healthy skin from within.

name: Japan Home
description: With more than 65 outlets island-wide, Japan Home has grown from strength to strength. Embodying a philosophy for quality without compromise, Japan Home prides itself in the provision of a wide range of household products at affordable prices. Today, Japan Home is a household name with an unrivaled reputation as a one-stop provider for all your household needs.

name: Japan IPL Express
description: Not your typical IPL salon. Japan IPL Express is the first unisex salon, committed to offering the most effective and convenient Hair Removal and Skin Solution services dedicated to your needs and wants: “No Packages, No Appointments” – that’s our modus operandi.

name: JC Global
description: Experience seamless currency exchange and efficient money transfers with JC Global. Our trusted services ensure hassle-free transactions, offering competitive rates and secure processes to ensure your confidence. Whether you're exchanging currencies for travel or transferring funds internationally, JC Global offers both reliability and convenience you can rely on.

name: Jean Yip Hairdressing/ Jean Yip Slimming & Beauty
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: Ji De Chi Dessert
description: Specialising in Asian desserts and snacks (a mixture of local Chinese, Taiwanese and Hong Kong desserts), Ji De Chi Dessert has a wide variety of desserts and snacks sure to satisfy your craving.

name: Jianghu Hotpot
description: Jianghu Hotpot is famous for its Sichuan-style hotpot. Whether you are trying it for the first or fifteenth time, you are guaranteed to be amazed by the skills of their chefs. They serve up a variety of Sichuan ingredients and soup bases that are guaranteed to blow your mind and palate with the authentic spices and flavours. If the idea of sitting down to a wonderful hotpot meal in a relaxed setting sounds right up your street, you’re bound to fall in love with Jianghu Hotpot.

name: Jinjja Chicken
description: JINJJA Chicken is a trendy Korean fast casual chain of restaurants that is best known for their Korean Fried Chicken and Jjajangmyeon. They serve authentic Korean food that is fast, minimally processed, affordable, all within an ambience that is inspired by the streets and trends of South Korea. JINJJA Chicken is also halal-certified to cater to the growing Muslim community all over the world.

name: Joe & Dough
description: Joe & Dough was founded in 2009 with the dream to make good specialty coffee and handcrafted bakes accessible to everyone. They believe in doing it right with a great deal of care, sincerity and pride. From sourcing the best Arabica beans that they grind on demand, to insisting on baking our own breads and choosing only the finest ingredients, Joe & Dough serve coffee and food that they are genuinely proud of. There is no secret ingredient for great taste, just good, honest food made by people who care.

name: K-Market
description: K-Market (Koryo Mart) provides variety stocks of Korean groceries, authentic ingredients, all-time-favourite snacks which are shipped right from Korea. K-Market is a place where you can take a break, find comfort and refresh your time. Beyond simple daily necessity items and services, strives to provide a daily life platform for recharging and reinvigoration the day.

name: Kappa / Sergio Tacchini
description: Founded in 1967, Italian brand Kappa combines classic sportswear with contemporary Fashion styling. It’s collections often feature a distinctive palette of vibrant colours, reflecting its fun brand personality. Kappa's rich history and innovative design places it on the global scale across sports and lifestyle.

name: Karva Salon for Ladies
description: At KARVA, our highly motivated team of Stylists, Scalp Consultants & Nail Therapists are committed to deliver excellence in service at the highest level. The salon uses the latest techniques, equipment and products from France. Germany and Italy that include Coty’s Professional Beauty products such Wella, System Professional and Nioxin. All KARVA’s guests are treated with a complimentary selection of beverages, including premium tea.

name: KAZO
description: KAZO® (卡滋屋) is a patisserie bakery specializing in Taiwanese premium handmade baked goods. From Crispy Cream Puff, Signature Polo Bun to Baked Cheese Tart, KAZO values freshness, quality, simplicity, and, of course, taste. With a rigorous ingredient selection and product creation process, they put all their love and passion into the oven, baking fresh every day.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: Kebabs Faktory
description: Since 2018, Kebabs Faktory has been the one-stop kebab shop for authentic, made-to-order, gourmet kebabs. Think wraps, rolls, and bowls, packed with flavour. The idea is simple: food served fast doesn’t have to be ‘fast food'. From burritos to shawarmas, döners to gyros, our signatures bring the world’s best kebabs under one roof. We believe real ingredients taste better - this is our commitment to every dish we serve: Always fresh, made with love. This is street food done right, spreading happiness, one kebab at a time.

name: KFC
description: Captivating aroma, succulent juicy chicken and thoughtful service are what KFC lovers come back for. Choose between our signature Original Recipe chicken prepared with Colonel Sander's secret blend of 11 herbs & spices, or the all-time favourite Hot & Crispy chicken. Check out the perennially popular KFC a.m. Breakfast menu and the variety of food items from Rice to Egg Tarts as well. Visit KFC today for an experience that is so good.

name: Kiddy Palace
description: Kiddy Palace is a children’s departmental store providing a one-stop shopping experience for doting mummies and daddies. We aim to be a trusted household brand name in Singapore as a specialty retailer for kids, toddlers, children and expectant mothers.

name: Kiehl's
description: Kiehl's was founded in 1851 as an old-world apothecary in New York’s East Village neighbourhood. Throughout the years, Kiehl’s remained dedicated to providing uniquely efficacious skin, hair and body care products. Their nature-inspired, scientifically-proven formulas are powerful yet safe and help improve overall skin quality for visibly healthier-looking skin. “Try Before You Buy” is the pharmacy’s unofficial motto. Drop by for a Derma Reader Deep Skin Analysis to accurately diagnose your unique skin concerns and receive personalized samples after. Experience Kiehl’s personalized consultation to discover the products that are right for you.

name: Kim Able Household
description: One-stop shop for all your home improvement needs. Ranging from household appliances to gardening and plumbing accessories, bathroom wares, lighting equipment, hardware tools and DIY products.

name: Kimage
