description: Kimage believes in individuality. Our experienced, professional stylists provide personal consultations based on your personality and lifestyle. Then they work their magic and transform your look, letting your crowning glory shine through a range of innovative, creative hair services that are customised based on your needs.

name: Kin Teck Tong
description: Established in 1967, Kin Teck Tong is one of Singapore’s home grown TCM brand with multiple branches across Singapore currently. Being the exclusive TCM partner for 4 national sports associations and panel clinics for multiple corporate insurance companies, Kin Teck Tong is trusted by many to provide quality TCM treatments and services.

name: Kinohimitsu
description: Kinohimitsu is the No.1 best selling beauty functional drink in Singapore and Malaysia. All Kinohimitsu products possess nature-based extracts that are vital to nature's self-regulating system. Focusing on Detox, Health and Beauty on the principles of the holistic approach to improve human well-being, Kinohimitsu offers safe and effective consumption of natural products. Kinohimitsu improves your life without making any demands and intrusions on your time and energy, giving you the freedom to live a better life.

name: Kitchen+Ware
description: Kitchen+Ware is a kitchenware plus homeware store. They carry an extensive range of kitchen utensils, and other more wares for the home. You can find baking accessories, woks and pans, cooking pots, dining utensils and wares, vacuum airpots etc, and must-have items for the living room, bedroom or bathroom. Find brands such as Zojirushi, Tiger, Zebra, KAI, Hoover, Saemmi, 3M, Garbath & more!

name: Kiyo
description: Kiyo was established in Singapore in 1993. Under the flagship fashion label Kiyo, a wide range of ladies' fashion apparel and shoes can be found. At Kiyo, product designs are conceived from a process based on upcoming trends, comfort and durability to meet the metropolitan lifestyle needs of our customers. The design theme focuses on smart casual and business formal ranges of ladies' wear. Are you looking for exclusive collection of premium apparels and shoes with trendy and unique designs, with special emphasis on comfort and durability? Hurry, come on down to Kiyo!

name: KOI Thé
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: KOI Thé Express
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: Komala's
description: The founders of Komala’s are from a family of Restaurateurs who have been in the restaurant business for more than 75 years. The Komala’s Group was founded by Mr M.Rajoo and it started as a single restaurant serving traditional south Indian vegetarian meals. The brand has built up a high reputation for its quality, value-for-money authentic Indian food, as well as its commitment to cleanliness and hygiene. It's the commitment to such values that earned Komala ‘s popularity with all in its 75-year history in Singapore. Though the brand started with authentic South Indian food, today the brand also serves North Indian, Chindian and other Vegetarian varieties.

name: Koong Woh Tong
description: Koong Woh Tong first began its business of making and selling traditional herbal jelly ‘GuiLingGao’ and herbal tea, namely ‘Ya Sei Mei’ and ‘Wong Lo Kat’ in a small stall in inland China. Due to the popularity and healing effects of these healthy products, the business has since flourished and has been carried on by family member generation after generation. As herbal jelly and herbal tea have proven efficacy, they are becoming popular and well recognized by the people from over 20 countries worldwide. Over the past 25 years, the brand has grown from strength to strength and has become synonymous with Chinese Herbal healthcare product.

name: Kopi & Tarts
description: “Kopi & Tarts” is a new local Halal coffee concept by Mayson Bakery, where we marry the love of coffee with our freshly baked tarts and pastries. We aim to delight the palate with both sweet and savoury offerings, allowing family, friends and loved ones to take a break and enjoy the simple pleasures in life.

name: Kopitiam
description: Kopitiam serves a wide selection of local favourites plus a smorgasbord of international cuisines like Indian Vegetarian, Local, Korean and Japanese food, to tempt even the most discerning gourmands. From brands recognised by Michelin Guide to foodie favourites, there are more than 20 stalls for you to explore, from Nasi Lemak Ayam Taliwang, King Grouper Fish Soup, Shami Banana Leaf and Feng Xiang Bak Kut Teh, just to name a few.

name: Krispy Kreme
description: Krispy Kreme an American Icon is home to world-famous awesome doughnuts. Made fresh daily, it delivers an array of delicious taste through our wide variety of doughnuts and beverages. Krispy Kreme creates the most awesome doughnut experience imaginable as our mission is to touch and enhance lives through the joy that everyone deserves a happy place.

name: KSkin
description: Kskin is a Korean Express Facial Salon that caters to both genders. Customers walk in to enjoy their facial treatment with no need for any appointment booking. Cashless payment can be made at self-serve payment kiosks before service, and there is no package selling involved. Using our specially formulated, pharmaceutical grade proprietary solutions, coupled with the latest machines in skin care technology, the duration of the facial treatment only requires 15 minutes to ensure skin is refreshed, prepped, and glowing. The premium quality of skin care ingredients, paired with Kskin's proprietary treatment efficiency, enable our customers to maximize time in the midst of their busy schedule to achieve their skincare goals without compromising results.

name: Kuriya Japanese Market
description: Kuriya Japanese Market is your one-stop shop for quick, satisfying Japanese meals and grocery selections. Savour the freshest sushi and seafood, carefully selected and air-flown directly from Japan three times weekly for the highest quality, alongside other imported Japanese seasonings, condiments, snacks, and exclusive sakes. There is also the option to enjoy a variety of Japanese-inspired bento prepared on demand for a fulfilling meal on-the-go. From ready-to-eat sushi boxes and snacks, to sashimi party platters, there is something for everyone!

name: La Belle
description: At La Belle, they are committed to utilizing their knowledge and superior products in order to provide effective treatments for the face, slimming, hair removal, nails and much more. We only use 100% natural marine ingredients skincare along with science-based products that carry no dyes, colors, perfumes or additives. Their goal is to deliver unparalleled customer care by remembering the importance of each individual client and treating them with respect, courtesy and attentiveness. Here, they individually formulate and customize each treatment to improve your specific skin care needs and concerns. They strive to enhance our client’s life by providing a relaxing experience, improving their overall health and well-being.

name: La Vida & Nailz Haus
description: LA VIDA™ is a one-stop brow and lash boutique, specialising in cosmetic artistry for eyebrow, eyeliner and lip, eyebrow shaping and designing and facial treatments. Using top-notch certified-safe colours and strict hygiene procedures, customers can indulge in their luxurious spa-like environment, while their highly skilled therapists work on creating the perfect arches which are the ultimate flattery for the face. Within LA VIDA™ lies another oasis of relaxation under the brand - Nailz Haus™, where you get to enjoy a complete nail spa experience, transforming nail care into social activities in their own right. Nailz Haus™ also offers gel manicure scrubs and whitening effects for customers who want more, on top of regular manicure and pedicures.

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Laneige
description: LANEIGE is a leading skincare brand known for its innovative and effective hydrating products. Launched in 1994, LANEIGE believe that water, being the source of life, is the key to youthful and lively skin. Through 20 years of research on the interaction between water and skin, LANEIGE developed its own exclusive technology "WATER SCIENCE(TM)" to help bold and confident young women achieve naturally hydrated and supple skin anytime, anywhere. With a focus on delivering luxurious skincare solutions, LANEIGE has gained a reputation for excellence in the beauty industry, offering a wide range of products designed to meet various skincare needs and enhance overall skin health.

name: Lenskart
description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer brand that retails best quality, fashionable eyewear at surprisingly low prices. Lenskart achieves this by establishing a direct route to customers - straight from manufacturing to retail, and by eliminating 7 layers of middlemen. Lenskart has 2 unique products BLU lenses and Air frames. BLU lenses are designed for the digital age. They block blue rays from smartphones and other digital devices, helping prevent eye damage. Lenskart BLU is a fully loaded lens scratch proof, superhydrophobic and aspheric. Air frames are lightweight, flexible, robust and are designed for ultimate comfort and style.

name: LeNu
description: Affordable yet remarkable, LeNu is a casual Chinese noodle bar that strives to achieve perfection in every bowl to delight all diners at an affordable price. Pair the signature broths with your preferred noodles option and different meat selections including pork, chicken and beef for a perfectly customised bowl of Chinese noodles. Apart from using the finest ingredients, the proportion of ingredients are also carefully measured to ensure consistency in every bowl of goodness.

name: Levi's
description: The Levi's® brand epitomizes classic American style and effortless cool. Since the invention and patent of riveted clothing by Jacob Davis and company founder Levi Strauss in 1873, Levi's® jeans have become the most recognizable and imitated clothing in the world - capturing the imagination and loyalty of people for generations. Today, the Levi’s® brand portfolio continues to evolve through a relentless pioneering and innovative spirit that is unparalleled in the apparel industry. Their range of leading jeanswear and accessories are available in more than 110 countries, allowing individuals around the world to express their personal style.

name: Little Pond
description: Little Pond has gained acclaim for its distinctive culinary expertise, specializing in the art of 'Beyond Fish Mastery, Also Excelling In Prawn Culinary', resulting in a culinary masterpiece. Their team of culinary professionals is devoted to crafting a variety of beloved local Singaporean dishes. They meticulously curate the ingredients, aiming to provide customers with cuisine of the utmost quality and deliciousness, all while maintaining affordability. 小鱼塘，以“做鱼是招牌 做虾更拿手”的独特技艺而闻名，堪称烹饪的一绝。他们的厨师团队由专业料理大师组成，专注于研发出新加坡本地人钟爱的多元口味菜式。他们的食材精选，力求让顾客在花费更少的钱的同时，享受到最优质、最美味的美食。

name: llaollao
description: Born in 2009 in Spain, llaollao ™ is currently a company with an international presence. It has more than 400 yogurt shops located in five continents and ranks as the leader in the frozen yogurt sector. llaollao is proud to serve customers the freshest and most delicious frozen yogurt, using the finest ingredients to maintain both the authenticity and health benefits of yogurt.

name: L’OCCITANE
description: L’OCCITANE is loved worldwide for its extensive range of skincare, hair care, body care, and hand care. Inspired by and made with the ingredients of Provence, L’OCCITANE’s products are formulated by experts and produced exclusively in France at its eco-certified factory and laboratories in Manosque.

name: Long John Silver's
description: Long John Silver’s mission is to provide everyone great tasting, reasonably-priced seafood and chicken in a fast, friendly manner. Their secret batter is prepared fresh throughout the day and makes Long John Silver's seafood and chicken tastes like no other in the world.

name: Love & Co.
description: Welcome to Love & Co., where love isn't just an occasion — it's a celebration, every day, your way. Their engagement rings aren't just symbols of commitment; they're the spark of your life's adventure. More than metal circles, their wedding bands are the sweet and tangy tales of your love story, a pledge to dive into a wild ride together. And their si dian jin isn't just gold; it's a work of art blending tradition and love, connecting yesterday's tales to the thrill of your future escapades. But they're not just about the big milestones. Birthdays, anniversaries, or just because — it's all covered. Love isn't confined to a calendar; it's an everyday thing.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Luckin Coffee is a pioneer of a technology-driven new retail model that offers coffee and other F&B products of high quality, high affordability and high convenience to our customers. Their vision is to build a world-class coffee brand and become part of everyone's daily life.

name: Luminous Dental @ Yishun
description: At Luminous Dental Group Holdings, we believe in brightening lives through building meaningful relationships and providing quality and ethical dental treatment. We are a family orientated dental practice that prides itself in providing treatment of highest level possible with minimal discomfort. We understand that some patients may have an inherent “phobia” of dental treatment that is why we take extra time and effort to manage their apprehensions.

name: LWL
description: LWL is a retailer that offers a range of women's clothing and bags that are known for their quality and stylish designs. The products are priced reasonably.

name: M&G LIFE
description: M&G LIFE isn't just a brand — it’s a lifestyle. Founded in 2016, they have become known for their cultural and creative lifestyle collections. Their aim is to inspire, innovate, and bring joy to everyday life with their unique products. At M&G LIFE, you can dive into a world of stylish stationery, perfect for writing your life stories. Find home decor items that turn your space into a beautiful and cozy haven. Check out the cool educational supplies that make learning fun for everyone. Enjoy designer toys that bring joy and creativity to both kids and adults. Try out the latest IT gadgets that keep you connected and entertained. Pamper yourself with beauty accessories that boost your style and well-being. Here, you will always find more than you ever expected, with each product designed to enrich and elevate your daily experiences.

name: Maki-San
description: Maki-san serves up customisable sushis and salads with an incredibly wide selection of very tasty ingredients. So you can pick your own favourites for a crazy combo anytime you like!

name: Malaysia Boleh!
description: Malaysia Boleh! is the go-to stop for authentic Malaysian street hawker fare. They strive to bring Malaysian delights such as Penang Yong Kee Char Kway Teow, Damansara Chilli Ban Mee and Kuantan Nasi Lemak into the heartlands of Singapore. Take yourself and your taste buds on a tour around Malaysia, without having to cross the border or bring a passport!

name: Maxi-Cash
description: Maxi-Cash is the first public-listed pawnbroker in Singapore. Besides providing pawnbroking services, Maxi-Cash also retails brand new gold, diamond jewellery and preloved luxury goods.

name: Maybank
description: A Qualifying Full Bank (QFB) in Singapore, Maybank is one of the top five banks in ASEAN offering a diverse range of financial services for corporate, business and individual clients. Some of the products they offer include savings and current accounts, credit and debit cards, loans, investments, insurance services as well as Islamic, Private and Premier Banking. Besides offering great value through their promotions, Maybank also partners global brands and established merchants to bring you a wide range of exciting events and deals as well as unique experiences.

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's business is never just about providing quick meals. It's always been about you - your tastes, your lifestyle, your choices. And they'd like to keep it that way, with you lovin' every moment of it. This is how McDonald's put their heart and soul into each and every one of their delicious, wholesome meals. Each 'mmm' and 'ahhh' from you is thanks enough. As you change and grow, McDonald's will be right there with you every step of the way. Today and tomorrow.

name: Mei Heong Yuen Dessert
description: Mei Heong Yuen Dessert has it roots connected to the iconic Farmer Brand groundnuts, and is the brainchild of Connie and Clara Lee, daughters of Mei Heong Yuen's founder. It specializes in different varieties of pastes and steamed egg pudding.

name: Mi Store
description: Mi Store has the latest offerings of Xiaomi smartphones and Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) smart devices in Singapore. Known for its affordable and innovative products, be sure to find the latest smartphones, mobile accessories, household appliances, lifestyle products and more from Mi/Redmi.

name: Mincheng Bibimbap
description: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭 is a renowned establishment specializing in Chinese Korean （中国朝鲜族）ethnic cuisine, offering a unique blend of flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture in China. Our menu boasts diverse dishes, with the iconic Mincheng Bibimbap taking center stage. In addition to this signature dish, we offer Stone Plate series and a selection of savory soups inspired by Korean traditions. Complementing these are complimentary offerings like Rice Kimchi and seaweed soup, ensuring a complete and satisfying dining experience.

name: MINISO
description: Established in Tokyo, Miniso was jointly founded by Miyake Junya, the chief designer of MINISO, and Ye Guofu, a young Chinese entrepreneur, with the aim of advocating a fashionable and relaxed lifestyle. Today, Miniso is a global fast fashion designer brand, offering a wide range of products across 10 product categories including lifestyle, home, gifts, and electronics. Miniso is dedicated to providing customers with quality and creative products at affordable prices.

name: Ministry of Rojak
description: Ministry of Rojak, an expansion of Abdhus Salam Rojak (hailing from Ayer Rajah hawker centre) is dedicated to providing authentic traditional Indian hawker food with an innovative twist without compromising neither its quality nor taste. Its famous sweet potato sauce has a smooth nutty touch that lends a nice texture to the overall sensation and not forgetting a delicious array of Pratas and all the famous mamak gorengs accompanied with its famous hot and cold beverages.

name: Minmed Clinic
description: Minmed Clinic offers a wide range of high-quality primary healthcare services for individuals and families. With conveniently located clinics islandwide, we provide GP consultations, health screening, vaccinations, chronic disease management, and work permit screening. Our patient-focused approach, CHAS accreditation, and acceptance of various corporate health plans ensure comprehensive care for all. With its diverse range of medical services, experienced healthcare professionals, and commitment to patient care, Minmed Clinic is a trusted provider of healthcare services for all.

name: Mister Donut
description: Makers of the legendary Pon De Ring donuts. An iconic Japanese chain with over 900 stores across the country, Singapore's specialty store promises the same high-quality donuts, made using ingredients from Japan and prepared by staff with careful training at the Mister Donut academy in Osaka.

name: Mister Minit
description: Mister Minit specialises in the services of shoe repairs, key cutting and duplication, engraving and watch service. Established in 1957, the Mister Minit team continues to build a strong service brand through commitment to excellence in customer service and continual improvements in relation to our customers changing needs.

name: MIXUE
description: MIXUE is a national chain brand dedicated to creating fresh ice cream and tea for young people. Since establishment in 1997, it has always been adhering to the principle of high quality and affordable price, and committed to promoting better and faster development of the global ice cream and tea industry!

name: Mobile Life
description: Trusted mobile phone repair partner in Singapore. Mobile Life offer island-wide repair services of your choice: Two-way home deliveries, MRT meet-ups and self-pickups! Dealing with a broken phone is undeniably frustrating, catching us off guard and disrupting our daily lives significantly. At Mobile Life, they're here to restore your peace of mind by assuring you that your phone is in expert hands. Their mission is to ease the inconvenience of unexpected phone accidents by offering reliable solutions and exceptional service to every customer.

name: Mobilestop
description: One stop shop for all your mobile accessories needs, featuring cases and gadgets from Aukey, Casetify, Case-Mate, Burga, Moft, and more.

name: Moley Apparels
description: Moley is a retailer that offers an extensive range of apparels. They are constantly innovating to bring our customers new products from time to time. Their belief is to provide value to customers and strive to do this by producing unique self designed products at affordable prices and also at the same time emphasizing on quality, comfort and functionality.

name: MoneyMax
description: MoneyMax is a leading pawnbroker, retailer and trader of jewellery, pre-owned luxury bags and watches, with a presence in both Singapore and Malaysia. MoneyMax is proud to be the first ISO 9001 (ISO9001:2008) and CaseTrust Accredited Pawnbroker in Singapore.

name: Monster Curry
description: Monster Curry is Singapore’s leading Japanese curry chain restaurant. Be mesmerized by the distinct flavour of the curry sauce, made from fresh fruits and a special blend of spices, resulting in a truly unique Japanese curry. With a spiciness level of your choosing, coupled with a range of assortments on a whopping plate size of 41cm in diameter, no one will leave feeling unfulfilled. The even bigger Japanese combo curry rice options are perfect for sharing. Other items such as Japanese pastas, curry ramen and honey toast are available to round out your meal.

name: MOS Burger
description: MOS Burger is a premium Japanese hamburger chain restaurant which offers a wide variety of unique and original tasting burgers. To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers’ order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

name: Mothercare
description: Since its establishment in 1984, Mothercare in Singapore has stood as a beacon of trust and quality in the world of mother and baby products. With a presence spanning nearly four decades, it has grown to become a household name, providing an extensive range of essential items for mothers and their little ones. Renowned for its specialization, quality, and unwavering commitment to safety, Mothercare consistently brings the latest products to its customers, accompanied by exceptional services tailored to the unique needs of mothers, mothers-to-be, and babies. As a brand dedicated to supporting the entire parenting journey, Mothercare is not just a store; it's a partner in the remarkable adventure of parenthood.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with tr

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values. With a visionary and dedicated management team, Mr Bean is poised to expand rapidly in the region. Current overseas outlets are located in Japan (ie. Tokyo), and The Philippines, with continued plans to expand across Asia.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: Mr Teh Tarik Express
description: Today, under Mr Teh Tarik Group's brand portfolio are Mr Teh Tarik Eating House, Mr Teh Tarik Express and My Briyani House. In order to support and grow with the expansion, a wider variety of drinks, local and international cuisines have also been added to their outlets at affordable prices. Some well-received customer favourites are their Mutton / Chicken Briyani, Mee / Nasi Goreng, Prata and Thosai options. There is something for everyone! Their value proposition in maintaining high standards of quality assurance and product consistency is achieved through strict preparation standards in the central kitchen. As they continue to strive in serving their customers better, Mr Teh Tarik Express hope to garner more support for their humble homegrown brand.

name: MS NEW
description: Welcome to MS NEW, a distinguished Singaporean brand in the world of women's fashion retail. With 15 years of experience, MS NEW is a household name in the local retail scene, offering a diverse range of high-quality apparel. MS NEW believes that fashion should know no age, and their collection caters to women of all generations.

name: Munchi Pancakes
description: At Munchi Pancakes, they offer the classic Min Jiang Kueh—crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and filled to perfection. Their menu features pancakes which are made with hot and cold fillings for a fresh twist on tradition. For those who prefer smaller bites, the Mini Munchi offers bite-sized treats packed with irresistible flavors. They take pride in using fresh ingredients to ensure the freshest taste. Plus, they offer vegan-friendly options so everyone can enjoy the delicious creations. Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation with every bite.

name: My Digital Lock
description: My Digital Lock is the Sole Agent of Korean brand EPIC in Singapore and also Authorized Dealer of Samsung brand in Singapore. EPIC Based on quality proven software development technology and management know-how in the world market. EPIC Digital Locks with Durable metallic body against external shocks and fire, Auto-lock, Re-lock, double lock function for user convenience and security. Random Number and Multi-touch features that enhance, password security (1time entry password available).

name: My English School
description: My English School is a chain of English Enrichment Centres with branches across Singapore that aims to lay strong English literacy foundations to nurture curious and creative learners and critical thinkers from 2.5 years old up to Primary 6. My English School provides two distinct in-house developed programmes; My English Reading Programme and My Primary English Programme. To ensure that there is sufficient attention from the teacher to the individual student, we have a small number of students per class. Last but not least, our native-level English speaking teachers bring creativity, enthusiasm and professionalism that make the My English School lessons come alive.

name: Nail Palace
description: Nail Palace is one of the best at its craft because the company thrives on passion and attention-to-detail rather than being profit-oriented. They strive to provide quality services that will pamper your nails and reinvent your style. One requirement that their technicians must fulfill is the love for the job. Nail Palace's range of products and services are highly diverse and readily available to meet and satisfy any needs. Besides first-class pedicures and manicures, they provide nail art services, foot hydro-spa therapy, sole renewal treatment and other services. They also have products from well-known brands such as Seche, OPI, Gelish and Ezflow that consumers love.

name: Nails N Lash
description: Nails N Lash offers a range of high-quality services for nails, eyelashes, and eyebrows. Their services are known for their exceptional quality and attention to detail. Customers can expect top-notch results that enhance their nails, eyelashes, and eyebrows.

name: Nailz Gallery
description: At Nailz Gallery, we believe that every man and woman has the right to look and feel their best. Colour is the answer, not only for our nails, but for the ways we show up and express ourselves regardless of gender roles, social status, or feeling the need to “fit in”. Whether you are looking for manicure, pedicure, hand/foot spa, nails treatments, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery or waxing services, we can do it all!

name: Nakhon Kitchen
description: Nakhon Kitchen was founded on the basis of making delicious and authentic Thai food affordable and easily available to everyone. At Nakhon Kitchen, their chefs uses the freshest and choicest ingredients to create honestly good dishes that appeal to the hearts and palates of their diners. They believe in serving their customers delectable and authentic Thai cuisine at affordable prices, so that everyone can enjoy the true taste of Thailand.

name: Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specialises in traditional handmade pau from authentic traditional recipes of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in-house. You can also indulge yourself in a hearty serving of mee hoon kuay or ke kou mian as well as lor mai kai (glutinous rice chicken) and siew mai, just to name a few.

name: Namu Bulgogi
description: First ever Korean Oakwood Smoke-Grill barbecue restaurant in Singapore. Nothing is served until it's perfect. A Feast For Your Sense Pleasing to the eyes, Pleasant to smell - All before stepping into a wondrous world of oakwood-grilling.

name: Natrahea
description: At NATRAHEA 康愈源, they believe passionately that our bodies are masterfully designed to heal itself. An ideal balance of the body’s qi, skeletal, and muscular elements is what keeps us healthy and energetic. Perfectly safe and non-invasive treatments like Chiropractic, TCM, and Functional Wellness rebalance our body’s elements to make room for natural self-healing. Practicing Chiropractic, Functional Wellness, and TCM side by side works wondrously and achieves effective results. These treatments are worlds apart, but that’s what makes them extraordinary together— they complete the Circle Of Healing. The Circle Of Healing is where qi, skeletal and muscular system, work together to keep you healthy and energised. Which is why they recommend treating your qi, skeletal, and muscular system, side by side. This not only helps with recovery but is found to boost your body’s natural resistance and ability to self-heal.

name: Ngee Soon Jewellery
description: Established in 1990, Ngee Soon Jewellery Pte Ltd was originally located in Yishun Central and was one of the first goldsmiths to be located in the suburban area of Singapore. Known for its wide range and variety of quality 916 and 999 gold jewellery, Ngee Soon Jewellery has been featured in several magazines and press releases. As a result of the redevelopment plans of Yishun Central by the government, Ngee Soon Jewellery moved its headquarters to Yishun Ring Road (Khatib) in 2011. With the expansion and opening of Northpoint City, Ngee Soon Jewellery has returned to Yishun Central to bring convenience to its customers who are familiar with the company’s brand name and product offerings.

name: Nine Fresh
description: Nine Fresh is a home-grown brand specializing in a wide selection of chilled taro ball desserts that are freshly scooped and served daily. With 3 different types of signature bases (Bean Curd, Grass Jelly and Ai-Yu Jelly) and a huge variety of toppings such as beans, jellies as well as chewy delights (signature taro balls, mini taro Q and black pearl), they cater to different palates and preferences!

name: Nippon Home
description: Nippon Home Pte Ltd. was established in the year 2013 to provide a wide variety of quality products to customers at competitive prices. The company logo of the cherry blossom flowers symbolizes hope for the future and optimism. The color blue symbolizes trust & responsibility, similar to the concept of the business which is to create a “one stop shopping mall like” environment with good customer service that allows customers to browse, find & buy products easily allowing them to leave the shop feeling satisfied. The company aims to be responsive to the customers' needs and to gain the customers' trust in the company`s services and products. The products/merchandise of the store caters to customers of all age groups including toys, stationeries, household, electrical accessories, hardware and many more. Nippon Home Pte Ltd also includes services such as key duplication, plumbing services & handyman services.

name: NK Robotics
description: NK Robotics is an enrichment centre focusing on providing children (aged 6 to 14) education in Robotics and Coding. At NK, teachers are as passionate about Robotics and Coding as they are at passing on these valuable life skills to every interested budding inventor. Groom the generation that’s going to build the future with NK Robotics.

name: Novita
description: novita Air.Water.Body concept store. A homegrown lifestyle brand, novita gives new meaning and definition to contemporary living. Serving to be a constant enrichment to modern households today, novita products will enhance your quality of life with continuous innovations and creative solutions. Driven for Continuous Innovation, Designed for Continuous Improvement.

name: OCBC
description: OCBC and its subsidiaries offer a broad array of specialist financial and wealth management services, ranging from consumer, corporate, investment, private and transaction banking to treasury, insurance, asset management and stockbroking services.

name: Ogawa
description: Dive into the world of wellness with Ogawa Singapore. Massage chairs, gaming seats, slimming massagers, massage pillows & more.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Old Chang Kee is a household name famous for it's delectable curry puffs that are filled with curried potatoes, chicken and a slice of hardboiled egg, all cooked with special herbs and spices. Other than curry puffs, Old Chang Kee also boasts spring rolls, crab claws, sotong wings and yam pies amongst it's vast product range.

name: Old Tea Hut
description: At Old Tea Hut, they brew fresh all day long, just for you. They offer an exciting gastronomic menu experience of providing different flavours of tea and coffee beverages from time-honoured traditional drinks to original Old Tea Hut creations, as well as flavourful alternative beverages. So whatever your preference is, they'll have the right beverage to tantalise your taste buds! Discover and enjoy a taste of Old Tea Hut today.

name: OMEGA PORK NOODLE
description: Omega Pork Noodle serves comforting bowls of Malaysian-style pork noodles, featuring rich, slow-simmered broth, tender pork slices, and springy noodles. Our menu includes Soup Noodle, Dry Noodle, Herbal Soup, Rice, and a signature side dish for a complete, satisfying meal.

name: One2play Handicraft
description: One2Play is a vibrant, family-friendly destination offering a wide range of toys, games, and interactive play experiences for children of all ages. Designed to spark creativity and fun, the store features an exciting selection of educational toys, collectibles, and play essentials, making it a go-to spot for parents and young enthusiasts alike.

name: Only Fashion
description: Only Fashion is a fashion retail business in Singapore. They carry a wide and beautiful range of clothing, exclusively for the ladies.

name: OPPO
description: OPPO offers a wide range of OPPO smartphones and tablets, from sleek flagships to budget-friendly options. Need accessories? They’ve got you covered with chargers, earbuds, and protective cases. But that’s not all! Stay connected with their variety of SIM cards for different telco. Whether you’re a data-hungry streamer or a frequent traveler, we have options to suit your needs. Visit them today and experience the world of OPPO!

name: Osaka Owl
description: Osaka Owl is an emerging backpack brand orignated from Japan. They sponsor bags to Singapore National Bowling Team. Their products are innovative and presentable, often bought as gift or for important life events.

name: Osim
description: OSIM is about the experience of total well-being and living an inspiring life. They channel their brand at every customer touch point, communicating their values through their products, outlet, brand image, service excellence and in-depth knowledge of holistic health. With over 40 years of experience and uncompromising dedication in developing innovative and reliable healthy lifestyle products, OSIM is the name you can trust for a healthier lifestyle and overall well-being.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: Pandora
description: Discover hand-finished quality jewellery and beautiful new designs with endless styling opportunities for personal expression. Choose from our range of charms, bracelets, rings, earrings, necklaces, and pendants. Find the perfect gift for yourself or that someone special. A universe of jewellery awaits you.

name: Papa Ayam
description: Established in 2018 with a food kiosk concept, Papa Ayam deliver the fusion of crispy fried chicken with Indonesian authentic sambal. Ayam (Chicken) and Geprek (Smashed or Crashed) served with traditionally-made original sambal on mortar and pestle that you can choose your spicy level from Level 1 – level 15! Papa Ayam assure you the freshness of the sambal as it is made on the spot according to your spice level. Apart from that, they also serve Sambal Matah (Balinese sambal) and Cabe Ijo (green chilli).

name: Paris Baguette
description: Born from a love of bread and a passion for quality, Paris Baguette is an international, fast-casual bakery founded in 1988 specialized in French-inspired baked goods offering chef-inspired cakes, pastries, freshly made sandwiches and salads with signature coffee and tea. Paris Baguette aims to offer a unique experience to thousands of guests daily.

name: Party Palace
description: Party Palace is a one stop shop which provides all types of party items such as banners, plates, cups, candles, table cloth, loot bags, packed goodies bags etc. Helium balloons are suitable for various occasions like birthdays, baby showers, weddings, graduation with a wide range of selection (cartoons, numbers & letterings). We also carry branded toys, stationeries and gifts. Our product quality and services will make a great difference for your special day.

name: PastaMania
description: PastaMania is the largest halal-certified Italian casual dining chain in Singapore offering a diverse range of pastas. From Italian classics like Prawn Aglio and Carbonara, to specially crafted fusion delights like Seafood Tom Yum, Otah Aglio and even pizzas, there’s something for everyone!

name: Peniwern
description: Peniwern is your go-to source for styles influenced by the latest fashions with an added flair. They aim to make fashion affordable to everyone, without degrading quality and expectations.

name: Pet Lovers Centre
description: Pet Lovers Centre (PLC) boasts of having the widest range of the freshest stock for pet owners to pamper their pets and offers quality pet services including pet grooming, veterinary consultations and excellent home delivery service to reduce the hassle while shopping. PLC also has its very own pet care consultants whom customers can approach with questions regarding their pets!

name: Pezzo
description: Welcome to Pezzo where every pizza has its own unique character and taste. Meet Big Daddy, Meat Munchers or Garlic Chick for a novel way of enjoying some scrumptious tasting pizzas on-the-go!

name: Phillip Investor Centre
description: An integrated Asian financial house with a global presence in more than 15 countries, PhillipCapital offers a comprehensive suite of financial products and services, mainly through their best in class award-winning trading platform, POEMS. Their products and services include Fund Management, Managed Accounts, Unit Trusts, Insurance Planning, Regular Savings, Contracts for Difference, Exchange Traded Funds, Equity Financing and broking in Bonds, Securities, Futures, Foreign Exchange, Precious Metals and Commodities to retail, high net worth, corporate and institutional customers. They always believe that investors deserve better. Phillip Investor Centre prides itself as a one-stop financial hub with a team of professional investment consultants and in-house equities specialists offering investors of all ages holistic advice on attaining the most suitable financial portfolio.

name: PickyPic Photobooth
description: Capture your moments with PickyPic Photobooth, a self-photobooth studio from Korea — the place where the concept of self-photobooths started. PickyPic's NPC outlet has a variety of props to spice up your photos and a total of three different rooms to choose from — Pure White, Peach Pink, and our very own Shiny Pink Upper Camera Light Room.

name: Pierre Cardin
description: Pierre Cardin Lingerie is a brand that is synonymous with fashion. Since its introduction to Singapore in 1995, the brand has been inviting women to redefine themselves by offering the most current and stylish designs tailored for the Asian woman in mind.

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Expect a leisure pedicure and manicure spa, or simply an afternoon of escape to beautify your nails with an exceptional customer service and high standards of hygiene practices in a relaxing ambience of cosiness, complemented with soothing music and variety options of treatments that is a perfect venue for an affordable indulgence. Not only you can get to beautify your nails, you can leave your eyelash, eyebrow, lips and many many more to us! A salient feature of Pixie Nail Spa is never to compromise on hygiene practices. All equipment used are sanitised, placed in a sanitising pouch and subsequently kept in a UV Steriliser before using it on our clients. Our experienced manicurists are trained with our standard operating procedures and are sent to specific courses to ensure that they are competent before being assigned to meet our clients’ nail spa treatment requirements.

name: Pizza Nation
description: Pizza Nation brings decades of pizza-making experience to the table, serving handmade, affordable, and delicious pizzas. With more than 20 flavors to choose from, along with fresh salads and tasty sides, there’s something for everyone. Designed for quick and convenient takeaway, Pizza Nation’s kiosk-style concept ensures a fast and hassle-free experience, perfect for busy individuals, casual diners, and family gatherings. Pizza Nation strives to continue to bring people together over great food. After all, there’s always A Slice for Everyone!

name: PlayMade
description: PlayMade has captivated the hearts of tea enthusiasts with our commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. Their handcrafted bubble tea has become a beloved destination for those seeking imaginative and flavourful tea creations. Without the use of additives or preservatives, our bobas exemplify freshness. The result? Bobas that are not only delicious but also healthier, offering a delightful bounce and exceptional flavour.

name: Poh Heng Jewellery
description: Since 1948, Poh Heng Jewellery has been a symbol of dedication and craftsmanship in Singapore. From our coveted Trust diamonds to the iconic Si Dian Jin Collection, we blend timeless elegance with meticulous craftsmanship. Experience timeless elegance and unwavering quality at Poh Heng.

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Polar prides itself for its long and rich heritage as a three-generation-old family business that has been faithfully serving consistent quality products to its customers since 1926.

name: Popeyes
description: Over 300 years ago, seven distinctive culinary traditions came together to create the uniquely American cuisine, Louisiana cooking. Now Popeyes is serving it up like nobody else can. Carefully blending their own spices and seasonings, hand battering their famous fried chicken, and tenderly cooking up every delicious bite long slow and easy – with a lot of heart. All to give you an incredibly rich soul-satisfying taste of history!

name: POPULAR Bookstore
description: The POPULAR Bookstore is a one-stop retail hub that provides a comprehensive range of merchandise that includes books, stationery, multimedia, music and audio-visual products.

name: Potato Corner
description: Global french fries chain Potato Corner has been delighting fries lovers all over the world since 1992, serving up what many have called the “world’s best flavoured fries”. Fries are prepared fresh, fried to order, seasoned with passionately formulated flavours, and served hot and crispy. Take your pick from Cheese, Barbecue, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili Barbecue and a whole lot more!

name: PrimaDéli
description: PrimaDéli serves all-time favourites that everyone loves and enjoys. With an extensive selection of premium quality cakes and scrumptious treats, signature products include Chicken Pie, Egg Tart, Singapore Curry Puff, Premium Pandan Chiffon, Mango Delight Cake as well as their immensely popular Waffles.

name: PRISM+
description: PRISM+ is Singapore’s fastest-growing consumer electronics brand. Known as the country’s #1 TV and Monitor brand, it has recently become the first local brand to launch its own Smart Air Conditioner System, Smart Ceiling Fan, Smart Air Purifiers, and Refrigerators. With a reputation for delivering wallet-friendly products that are packed with features and backed by award-winning customer service, PRISM+ continues to define the future of smart home technology.

name: Purpur
description: Founded locally in 2002, Purpur is now a well established fashion brand with an international e-commerce store and outlets islandwide. At Purpur, we aim to allow every lady to feel joyful and comfortable in our clothes. Our pieces are thoughtfully designed focusing on comfort, quality and affordability. Here at Purpur is where you can be your own kind of beautiful, everyday.

name: PUTIEN
description: PUTIEN serves cuisine from the Fujian Province in China: characteristically light, down-to-earth, and flavourful food with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Signatures like Fujian Red Mushroom Seafood Lor Mee, ‘100-Second’ Stewed Yellow Croaker and PUTIEN Bian Rou Soup showcase the culinary richness of Fujianese cuisine that will fill your stomach and heart.

name: Q & M Dental Surgery
description: Q & M Dental Group was first established in November 1996 at Bukit Batok. Over the years, it has grown from strength to strength and now has more than 100 clinics island-wide, thus making it the largest private dental healthcare group in Singapore. Q & M Dental Group is also CHAS/Merdeka Generation (MG)/Pioneer Generation (PG)/Medisave/Baby Bonus accredited. We look forward to serving you there!

name: Qi Ji
description: Embracing quality and consistency as their cornerstones, Qi Ji has captivated people’s taste buds for decades with their irresistible and original recipes. As a Singaporean foodie, they aspire to preserve the heritage of authentic Singapore fare and grow its prominence on the culinary world map.

name: Raffles Medical
description: Raffles Medical is the primary care network of Raffles Medical Group, which provides family medicine, health screening, and dental services. Besides operating clinics in China, Japan, Vietnam, and Cambodia, it is one of the largest network of family medicine clinics in Singapore. Our team of family physicians provides care for patients of all ages, including treatment and management of acute and chronic diseases, vaccinations, travel health, and health screening. Raffles Medical clinics are approved to serve Singaporeans under various healthcare and government schemes including the Healthier SG programme, Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus and Flexi-Medisave scheme.

name: Refash
description: REFASH is the largest thrift store brand in Singapore. With a mission to 'inspire the next generation of consumers to think secondhand first', we give new life to millions of used clothing, offsetting the environment and financial cost of fashion. Discover your love for thrifting at any of our outlets islandwide, featuring brands you love like Zara, Love Bonito, The Editor's Market, Lovet & more at up to 90% off retail prices!

name: Rive Gauche Patisserie
description: Rive Gauche is a patisserie dedicated to the fine art of crafting delight. Inspired by the French tradition, we create cakes and pastries by hand with heart and skill, to fill everyone and every occasion with joy.

name: Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine
description: Experience the rich, slow-cooked flavours of Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine, where hearty claypot dishes take centre stage. Savour signature Claypot Grilled Qing Jiang Fish in Green Pepper Sauce, Beef Brisket with Potato and Radish, or Tomato Salt Baked Chicken, each meticulously prepared to perfection. The menu also features many other flavourful claypots and a selection of other Cantonese dishes, perfect for enjoying hot, comforting meals.

name: rrooll
description: Freshly baked daily, rrooll is a halal certified bakery who is the first to offer a swirl of both sweet and savory flavours rolled up in our signature soft and fluffy dough. Their rolls are free of preservatives and artificial flavours. They use only the freshest ingredients paired with precise techniques to bring out the best combination of flavours, texture and aroma. Combining the freshest grade A cinnamon powder topped with their signature cream cheese frosting, rrooll classic cinnamon roll will leave you craving for more!

name: Sa Sa
description: One of the leading beauty product retailing groups in Asia, Sa Sa exclusive brands cover over 9,000 skincare, fragrance, make-up, hair care and body care products, inner beauty products, and beauty equipment. Sa Sa prospers on its success-proven “one-stop beauty product specialty platform” concept which aims to provide customers with the widest range of high-quality products at the most competitive value.

name: Sakon Thai
description: Sakon Thai serves authentic Thai food with light customization to suit the local taste. The food concept combines flavors from the original Sakon Town located in Northeast Thailand and the Gau Yuak Temple in Chiang Mai. The founder has been a regular donor to the temple and has stayed there for some time. He was so impressed by the dishes cooked by the locals for the temple visitors and has since brought these special flavors to Singapore, in 2008 opening the first Sakon Thai in Serangoon North. Today if you visit Sakon Thai you can taste these special recipes in the dishes like the Fried Fish Red & Green Sauce and the Sambal fried kanggong.

name: Sakunthala's Restaurant
description: Experience authentic Indian cuisine, both North Indian and South Indian at Sakunthala’s Restaurant. Thosai, Briyani, Fish Head, Butter Chicken, Naan, Prata, Tandoori Chicken and many other dishes served on a banana leaf. An eating house that will delight and leave an impression on all your senses where comfort food is prepared with passion and handpicked ingredients.

name: Sanook Kitchen
description: Come to Sanook Kitchen and savour a wide variety of authentic Thai food classics ranging from appetisers, soup, curries to seafood and more at wallet-friendly prices!

name: Scarlett Choice
description: Scarlett Supermarket is the leading one-stop supermarket which sells an extensive range of popular Chinese snacks, dried goods, necessities and beverages imported directly from China. One can find household names like Hai Chi Jia Suan La Fen, Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea and Tsingtao Beer at the most affordable prices islandwide here.

name: Scarlett Supermarket
description: Scarlett Supermarket is a China supermarket offering customers value-for-money products with a variety of stock from groceries to all-time-favourite snacks. The wide range of products includes confectionery, noodles, beverages, alcohol, frozen food, sauces, seasoning and daily essentials to ensure that the needs of both locals and Chinese are met.

name: SEORAE Korean Charcoal BBQ
description: SEORAE Korean Charcoal BBQ, the first Korean restaurant in Singapore that offers the signature Korean galmaegisal (premium pork skirt meat). At SEORAE, they only use the best meat cuts sourced from the best farms. They believe that you deserve only the best quality for the perfect dining experience.

name: Seoul Garden
description: With Seoul Garden's signature Korean Barbeque grill and steamboat dining concept and a wide range of food to choose from, Seoul Garden caters to all type of guests. Allow them to create your next memorable experience. Celebration better with family and friends, here at Seoul Garden Buffet.

name: Seoul Garden HotPot
description: Introduced in 2010 – It is all about Personal portions and preferences at Seoul Garden HOTPOT, with Korean cuisine served piping-hot and sizzling through till the last drop of flavours. Personal Pots of GOODNESS is served wholeheartedly in generous portions, fulfilling a well-balanced diet. Using the finest quality ingredients and the dedication of their team of chefs, it is their top priority to deliver a piping HOT meal packed with great nutritional value. Seoul Garden HOTPOT is where taste meets health. A well-balanced meal of great nutritional value fulfils not just the stomach, but the body too.

name: Shabu Sai
description: An authentic Japanese restaurant that serves all-you-can-eat Shabu-Shabu and Sukiyaki buffet, Shabu Sai serves up to seven tasty soup bases and a splendid array of more than 40 items on the buffet table. The brand earns in name from the word “Shabu” – the sound of ingredients being swished in a boiling pot – and “Sai” which means vegetables. The must-try Shabu Sai specialities include the Tonkotsu soup, prepared using the same recipe as the restaurant’s outlets in Japan, the Sukiyaki soup that offers a sweet-and-savoury Shoyu-based stock for the freshest ingredients to simmer in, as well as signature items such as the pork, beef or chicken served in bamboo.

name: Shafeek Exchange Money Changer
description: Shafeek Exchange Money Changer offers currency exchange services for major currencies with reasonable rates.

name: Sharetea Premium
description: Sharetea Premium is exclusive to the Singapore market and retains the core of Sharetea’s identity but improving the overall experience. A new way was used to make old favourites. Through cold-brewing, innovative new concoctions are presented, bringing customers a different milk tea experience. With a myriad of toppings and drinks to choose from, there is something for everyone.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks
description: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks® is everybody's favorite Taiwanese food chain featuring popular snacks from the alleys of Taiwan's night markets. Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shimmer & Shine
description: Shimmer & Shine provides a sanctuary where you can take some time out from the everyday challenges of your progressively demanding life to relax and recharge yourself. Their incredible grooming and conditioning techniques are certain to keep your hands and feet looking their best.

name: SHINE
description: SHINE aims to provide quality, trendy, and affordable shoes for every cosmopolitan women, keeping their style simple and elegant.

name: Shu Liu Xiang
description: Indulge in classic dishes like old chengdu style roast duck and stir fried velvet antler mushrooms, each prepared with a mastery that balances heat and savory richness at Shu Liu Xiang. Our vibrant ambiance, infused with the fragrant essence of Sichuan peppercorns and chili, sets the stage for a culinary adventure unlike any other.

name: Sichuan Chef
description: Sichuan Chef serves Sichuan cuisine. You can look forward to savouring the best of Sichuan dishes that reflect the flavours of Sichuan at the restaurant.

name: Singapore Pools
description: Set up to provide a legal, safe and trusted avenue for people to place bets, Singapore Pools play a vital role in countering illegal gambling activities. Over the years, they have evolved rapidly to keep their games relevant while creating a secure and responsible gaming environment for all. Through it all, Singapore Pools as a fully-owned subsidiary of the Tote Board, which reports to the Ministry of Finance, remains steadfast in uplifting the community by channelling all surpluses to fund worthy causes that better the lives of Singaporeans.

name: Singtel Exclusive Retailer
description: Singtel is Asia's leading communications group, providing a diverse range of Innovative services including fixed mobile, data, internet, ICT and TV.

name: SK Gold
description: SK Gold is a concept under the SK Jewellery group, offering an assortment of gold and diamond jewellery. With a larger collection of 999 and 916 gold, SK Gold is the choice to make when looking for everyday gold jewellery pieces, traditional Si Dian Jin, Gold collectibles and more. Established in 2003, SK Jewellery was created with the belief that the beauty, luxury and allure of fine jewellery should be attainable to all women. Putting great emphasis on innovation and design excellence, SK Jewellery is known for its high quality jewellery that is meaningfully conceptualised and beautifully crafted.

name: SK Jewellery
description: SK Jewellery was created with the belief that the beauty, luxury and allure of high-quality jewellery be made accessible to all women. With the belief that you deserve to shine, every piece of jewellery is meaningfully conceptualised and beautifully crafted. Unparalleled in design excellence and innovation, SK Jewellery is the contemporary jeweller known for its high quality and exquisite jewellery.

name: SK Treasures
description: Explore their extensive 999 Pure Gold and diamond collection, get expert advice from their skilled staff, and experience the exceptional customer service in any of their jewellery shops in Singapore.

name: Skechers
description: Our story begins in a California beach house, where Skechers was born as a utility boot and became an icon of the grunge era. More than 25 years later, we’ve evolved into a footwear powerhouse with styles for men, women and kids around the world.

name: SkinGO!
description: Experience the skin revolution! SkinGO! redefines the meaning of express facials and we believe that express facials are just as effective if not more than the traditional facials. Using advanced technology from Korea, our facials are designed to re-energise and hydrate skin in 15 minutes. Suited for all ages and skin type, you can now be on the road to flawless smooth skin.

name: SLEEPNIGHT
description: SLEEPNIGHT, a home-grown award-winning brand has been providing many happy customers in Singapore a good night’s sleep since 2013. SLEEPNIGHT Lifestyle Mattress believes that sleep is more than just a necessity. It is a lifestyle choice that reflects your personality and preferences. Their products are made with UK’s cutting-edge technologies that combine technology, human ergonomics, and aesthetics to deliver a comfortable and satisfying sleep experience. They offer a range of quality mattresses and bedding essentials that are tailored to your needs and lifestyle. Whether you prefer a firm or soft mattress, a cool or warm feel, or a classic or modern design, they have something for you. SLEEPNIGHT Lifestyle Mattress, the rest of your life.

name: Smiggle
description: When it comes to dreaming up new products Smiggle live by the motto - never boring, always fun, something for everyone! With Smiggle you will be able to organise your work or play space with rainbow brights and bold designs, whether it be at home, at school or at the office. Smiggle is passionate about their stuff and they promise to provide you with lots of new stationery and storage ideas in a huge range of colours.

name: Smoovee Skin
description: Smoovee Skin is Korea's specialist in Hair Removal and Skin Rejuvenation Salon. It is a revolutionary salon that provides services for both males and females. Their services are suitable for all skin colours and types at an affordable price tag. Smoovee Skin is different as they believe in a ""No Appointment and No Package"" concept. Their treatments require zero down-time, in which they are non-invasive and painless. Smoovee Skin strive to meet our customers' desired goals by ensuring quality is assured and our treatments are highly effective with 3x faster results.

name: snacKING Retro Biscuits Express
description: Snack your way through a day with snacKING Retro Biscuits, a taste worth remembering. Have been searching high and low for the particular snack that used to be widely available while growing up but unable to find it anymore? Wondered how play time was before technology gadgets took over? With a large varieties of old school biscuits, snacks, candies and toys, there is always options to fulfil your snacking or party needs. Relive your childhood memories with old school biscuits, snacks, sweets and toys with snacKING Retro Biscuits!

name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh
description: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh have come a long way from one food cart on the street. Yet their pushcart icon reminds us what they are about, an original Bak Kut Teh experience: tender, fall-off-the-bone pork ribs; hot, flavourful, spicy-peppery soup; a 1960s roadside dining ambience. At Song Fa, the heritage of Bak Kut Teh lives on in its truest sense.eritage of good old Bak Kut Teh in it's truest sense.

name: Sorella
description: Sorella believes in treasuring and celebrating every woman's innate femininity. We aim to highlight and enhance your natural beauty and sexy curves with our high quality lingerie, which provide unparalleled support, superior shaping, desired toning and overall flawlessness. Cherish yourself with Sorella and unveil your true feminine allure. Discover, indulge in your body and love yourself entirely through our premium lingerie.

name: Sothys Premium Salon
description: Sothys, one of the original beauty institute and spa brands, was created in 1946 during the new wave of French beauty.

name: Spacio TCM Wellness
description: Embrace the holistic approach to health and wellness with Spacio TCM Wellness. Whether you're seeking relief from specific ailments or simply striving to achieve balance and harmony in your life, Spacio TCM Wellness is your destination for authentic TCM remedies and expert advice.

name: Sparkle
description: Sparkle was established in 2019 and have a wide range of products such as gifts, stationery, toys, electronic accessories, party accessories, and other trendy products. Their target segment focuses on the younger spectrum - toddlers, children, adolescents, and young working adults. Sparkle is managed by a young, dynamic, and dedicated team with coverage over the brand's in-house sourcing, merchandising, design, and logistics.

name: Spectacle Hut
description: Spectacle Hut is your partner for all things eye care. We prioritise your eye health by providing quality vision care and tailored solutions to you, your families and friends. We offer extensive range of eyewear product from fast fashion to luxury brands and wide selection of prescriptive lens solution for different needs. Visit us today to find your favourite pair, with complimentary eye screening.

name: Sri Murugan Supermarket
description: Sri Murugan Trading Pte Ltd, having its presence in India, Malaysia, Indonesia and Australia running 16 retail Outlets Island wide in Singapore by offering wide range of high quality products is moving into establishing its own flagship supermarket.

name: Stalford Learning Centre
description: At Stalford Learning Centre, they aim to provide quality education and excellent service to all our students, assisting them in realising their dreams. Our proven teachers and proven methods will help you obtain proven results. Throughout the years, Stalford Learning Centre has strived to bring nothing short of excellence for our students, be it our strong team of over 600 qualified tutors, friendly and efficient staff, carefully aligned curriculum, a conducive and mentally-stimulating environment, and the best teaching materials. With the support of believers of our pedagogy, Stalford Learning Centre has successfully expanded from a mere outlet to a full-fledged education chain with 20 branches islandwide.

name: Stalford Learning Centre
description: At Stalford Learning Centre, they aim to provide quality education and excellent service to all our students, assisting them in realising their dreams. Our proven teachers and proven methods will help you obtain proven results. Throughout the years, Stalford Learning Centre has strived to bring nothing short of excellence for our students, be it our strong team of over 600 qualified tutors, friendly and efficient staff, carefully aligned curriculum, a conducive and mentally-stimulating environment, and the best teaching materials. name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Starhub
description: StarHub is a leading telecommunications provider in Singapore, offering a range of services to meet your lifestyle needs. Mobile Services: StarHub provides mobile plans, handsets, and accessories. You can explore the latest smartphones and choose from various mobile plans tailored to your preferences. Broadband Services: StarHub offers broadband internet access with plans ranging from 2Gbps to 10Gbps. Enjoy ultra-fast and reliable connectivity for your home. Cable TV: StarHub’s cable TV service includes a variety of channels, on-demand content, and exclusive shows. You can personalize your TV experience with different packages and add-ons.

name: Steak 99
description: Steak 99 offers a comforting blend of Japanese favourites and casual Western mains in a relaxed dining setting. Their steaks are prepared using lava stone cookware, allowing excess fat to be naturally absorbed while locking in flavour and juiciness for a healthier, more satisfying bite. Paired with flavourful ramen, hearty pastas, and family-friendly kids’ meals, Steak 99 is made for everyday enjoyment.

name: Stellar
description: Stellar is Singapore’s leading ear-piercing specialist, offering professional services for all ages, including babies as young as 2 months old. With 8 outlets in Singapore and 2 in Malaysia, they ensure a smooth, virtually painless experience using premium earrings suitable for sensitive skin. Explore their stunning jewelry collections, from everyday essentials to elegant statement pieces, perfect for all occasions. Their experienced team provides personalised care, styling advice, and post-piercing support to complete your journey.

name: Strip
description: Strip is the market leader for premium hair removal services. With its advanced techniques and first-of-its-kind products and treatments, it has pruned more than 4 million bushes worldwide across its network of over 50 outlets.

name: Stryv
description: Stryv sells hairdryers, styling tools, personal grooming devices. Stryv believe in beginning each morning on the right note with the help of personal care tools and products that empower everyday folks with the confidence they need to shine. Their products (luxuries you can afford, as we like to call them) are designed to complement your unique lifestyle and make sure every day begins with a spring in your step. After all, it’s our own reflection we see in the mirror every morning before we face the rest of the world. No matter who you are or where you come from, you deserve to feel good about yourself. And if at first you don’t succeed, stryv and stryv again.

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a fast casual kiosk chain focused on Mexican and Turkish takeaways. Serving exceptionally tasty burritos and kebabs, the food is made and prepared fresh daily, right in front of you. The made to order flow allows you to choose whichever toppings you like, and their succulent grilled chicken is remarkably tasty as it is healthy. With its energetic customer base which swears by the food, many have invented their own secret menu of their favorite food combination. Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

name: Subway
description: SUBWAY® is the undisputed leader in fast, healthy food. Our easy-to-prepare sandwiches are made to order right in front of the customer, precisely the way they want – using freshly baked breads, select sauces and a variety of delicious toppings.

name: Sukiya
description: SUKIYA is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant, founded in 1982 in Yokohama, and has over 2,600 locations across the world. SUKIYA specializes in Gyudon – a delicious combination of thinly-sliced tender beef cooked in a soy sauce-based savory sauce with onions all served on top of fluffy, perfectly-cooked Japanese rice. Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic service, SUKIYA uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.

name: Sunday Mobile Telecommunications
description: Discover the latest in mobile technology at Sunday Mobile — your one-stop destination for cutting-edge smartphones, stylish accessories, and convenient prepaid calling cards. Whether you're upgrading your device or looking for the perfect add-on, we've got everything you need to stay connected in style.

name: Sunflower Piano House
description: Discover excellence in classical music education at Sunflower Piano House, Singapore's pinnacle of piano instruction. As the exclusive Asian partner of the prestigious Liszt International Music Elite Program from the Liszt Academy of Music in Hungary, Sunflower Piano House specialize in nurturing talented pianists and facilitating their studies in Europe. Their students regularly win awards in international and domestic competitions. They also organize annual music tours to the Liszt Academy, providing unparalleled learning experiences. Join Sunflower Piano House for regular concerts and immerse yourself in the world of classical music excellence.

name: Sunshine Childhood Playland
description: Enjoy a fun childhood here at Sunshine Childhood Playland, where they strive to provide a fun and safe indoor playground for children to explore, learn, and play!

name: Suparakki Ramen
description: Suparakki means "Super lucky" in Japanese; that aims to make their customers Super lucky with each bowl of goodness, served with authenticity and passion. They only use freshly made Hakata style ramen, with 6 hours of hard boiling to achieve a full collagen richness in our broth without adding MSG. Suparakki aims to create a ramen culture with an affordable price that would satisfy cravings and we will continue to strive for new, passionate and innovative dishes. They seek to bring smiles and a good experience at their shops.

name: Super Sushi
description: Super Sushi believes in serving fresh and delicious sushi. Their commitment to use only fresh, never frozen, salmon and the finest Niigata rice, along with specially made red vinegar rice prepared fresh in-store, ensures an unparalleled sushi experience. Explore their innovative sushi creations that artfully blend tradition with unique flavors—each bite is a testament to their dedication to delight their customers through quality and creativity.

name: Supergreen
description: Welcome to Supergreen, where they believe in the power of fresh, wholesome food to fuel your day and brighten your plate. Supergreen is dedicated to delivering quality salads made from carefully selected, nutrient-rich ingredients. They embrace vibrant flavors and a diverse range of ingredients to offer you a delicious and convenient way to enjoy a balanced diet.

name: Sushi Express
description: One of the biggest conveyor belt sushi brands in Asia, offering more than 80 different variations of sushi from $1.50++ per plate. Sushi Express understand that it’s not always about value when it comes to serving their customers, it is about consistently providing quality and innovative products competitively.

name: Sushi Tei
description: Sushi Tei's thoughtfully curated menu showcases more than 370 authentic Japanese cuisines, marrying the intricacies of Sashimi & Sushi to the theatrical flair of Yakimono & Nabemono. Using only fresh and quality ingredients to deliver classic Japanese fare with an innate intuition of local tastes; forging an inimitable and unique epicurean identity to truly remember.

name: Swee Heng 1989 Classic
description: Established in 1989, Swee Heng Bakery is one of the leading bakeries in Singapore. It offers baked products such as bread, cakes, traditional Chinese kuehs and other confectionery items through its chain of physical retail outlets. Swee Heng 1989 Classic is an upgrade of the original brand. Premiered in 2014, this new concept brings back the memories of the 1980s through a nostalgic thematic approach. Premium bread, cakes and other confectionery items which incorporate a blend of Singapore flavour with Taiwanese style are offered in attractive packagings, such as paper sleeves and plastic carriers. It is targeted at younger consumers, including working adults and the youth population.

name: Sweet Home
description: Sweet Home is a one-stop home concept store that offers premium home textiles, cleaning & disinfection, storage, and personal care products made of the finest materials to brighten your home. We have eight outlets at shopping centers in Singapore. We bring you a premium selection of home products backed by a 100% product satisfaction guarantee.

name: Swensen's
description: Swensen’s is synonymous with sweet celebrations enjoyed together with loved ones for all occasions. A delectable tradition treasured by families. Swensen's is Singapore’s Family Restaurant of Choice, championing bonding over food, serving families & ice cream cakes since 1979.

name: SYOUJIN
description: Syoujin is committed to provide you with a one-stop beauty body, health, slimming, hair removal and other diversified care. In addition to having more than a world-class advanced equipment, the treatments are specially selected from internationally renowned high-quality products, and made more personal, and even medical-grade service solutions to meet the modern pursuit of perfect skin for the demands of men and women .

name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Tai Cheong Bakery was started in 1954 by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. After taking over Tai Cheong Bakery, Au Yeung pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts, refining several other recipes using techniques he learned from his previous work in a hotel baking cakes. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. The popularity of Tai Cheong remains till today.

name: Tai Chong Kok
description: At Tai Chong Kok, we have been making mooncakes and traditional Cantonese pastries the same way since 1935 - from scratch and by hand. For 3 generations we have used only premium ingredients to produce our authentic Cantonese confectionary. Tai Chong Kok mooncakes are renowned for their genuine taste of tradition.
