We are one of the very few bakeries left in Singapore that still produce our fresh lotus paste by hand using 100% pure lotus seeds with no preservatives added and these fill mooncakes that are formed in the same traditional wooden moulds used at the original Sago Street store in Chinatown more than 89 years ago. Today, you can still bring home our mooncakes in stringed brown paper bags, just as our forefathers did in pre-war Singapore. Tai Chong Kok is also famed for our traditional Nian Gao (Chinese New Year's cake) that are made using 100% pure glutinous rice. Tai Chong Kok products are handmade and baked daily with no preservative added in Singapore using time-honoured recipes and quality ingredients with full conformity to Stringent Quality Standards of SFA, HACCP and BizSafe.

name: TAKA Jewellery
description: TAKA Jewellery is a household brand established in Singapore with a strong presence of stores islandwide. Step into the wonders of treasures and experience an enchanting feature on a wide array of selections. Ranging from timeless classics to contemporary designs, crafted for the unique you.

name: Talad Thai Banana
description: Talad Thai Banana is an Authentic Thai recipe crafted with love. Their unique batter is made from the freshest ingredients prepared daily with love and good intentions. All products are vegetarian friendly and in fresh batches daily!

name: Tangled
description: Freshly made pastas at affordable prices with a twist of local flavours. Made with all natural ingredients, their fresh pastas do not contain food colouring or preservatives. Tangled is where all the wonderful ingredients tangle up into a flavourful pasta dish.

name: TCL
description: Embark on a journey with TCL, a rapidly growing consumer electronics brand that has captivated over 960 million users globally. Boasting more than 40 years of manufacturing excellence, TCL is a trailblazer in the industry. As the pioneers of Mini LED since 2017, they currently command a staggering 90% market share. Notably, they hold the esteemed title of Global Top 1 Google TV and Global Top 2 TV Brand. Excitingly, TCL is expanding its horizon in Singapore by introducing a range of home appliances, including refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners. The introduction of home appliances underscores their commitment to creating a holistic, smart living experience.

name: Teppan-Yaki
description: Where tradition meets taste, our teppanyaki dishes are cooked to perfection with a famous sauce recipe passed down through generations. Enjoy delicious affordable meals in a casual setting without compromising on quality. Experience the best of teppanyaki at Teppan-Yaki today.

name: The Aroma Hub
description: The Aroma Hub offers a wide variety of natural, locally made scents that allow customers to create any mood or atmosphere they desire. Alongside essential oils, the store provides a comprehensive selection of aromatherapy accessories, including burners, vaporisers, atomizers, and ultrasonic humidifiers in various designs and colours. All products are affordably priced, making quality aromatherapy accessible to everyone.

name: The Ballet School
description: The Ballet School Singapore has been nationally renowned for providing superior dance instruction. Their mission is to nurture and deliver outstanding articulate classical ballet dancers. They are the nation's premier dance institution whose sole purpose is to bring the highest quality of dance education to all who seek to learn and grow. They aim to transform passionate dance students into distinctive dancers who are versatile, well-rounded and competent to progress fluidly in a fast-changing environment.

name: The Belt Shop
description: The Belt Shop offers an array of quality leather accessories and luggage from international brands for your everyday and travel needs. Be spoilt for choice with brands from Paris, USA, Belgium and more.

name: The Body Shop
description: We believe there is only one way to beautiful, nature’s way. We’ve believed this for years and still do. We constantly seek out wonderful natural ingredients from all four corners of the globe, and we bring you products bursting with effectiveness to enhance your natural beauty and express your unique personality. And whilst we’re doing this, we always strive to protect this beautiful planet and the people who depend on it. We don’t do it this way because it’s fashionable. We do it because, to us, it’s the only way.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
description: A premium coffee and tea retailer that offers an extensive variety of expertly crafted beverages, freshly baked pastries, delectable cakes, and party packs. Their whole cakes are perfect for any occasion, and their e-card program rewards loyal customers.

name: The Flip Flop Shop
description: Live, work and play with your toes exposed® and the freedom of flip flops on your feet. Flip Flop Shops® is the authentic retailer of the hottest brands and latest styles of flip flops and casual footwear. It's more than just a shop...it's a lifestyle. They love the water and everything about it. Whether it's surfing at Rincon with friends or standing at the water's edge in Tofino while the waves pull the sand out from under your feet and back to the sea...we love it. They ride powder in Canada, bike the backcountry of New Zealand and raft down the Colorado. They love adventure and traveling. They keep up on the latest fashion trends and make up our own. They sometimes go to bed with salty skin and the smell of the ocean after a day of surfing. They take care of our environment and help out our favorite charities. They love music and singing along with our favourite songs. Their flip flops are an extension of who we are and what we stand for. They live, work and play with their toes exposed® while wearing the freedom of flip flops on our feet.

name: The Green Party
description: The Green Party is dedicated to offering consumers a diverse selection of stylish and innovative green products designed to enhance their lifestyles. We are committed to upholding the essence of style, presenting a contemporary and exquisite range that seamlessly blends quality and comfort for a hassle-free daily life.

name: The Kind Bowl
description: The Kind Bowl was born in line with the current global effort to ‘Go Green’ and the greater awareness of the health benefits “Let food be thy medicine“. They source sustainable ingredients to create a modern, convenient, affordable yet ethical menu. They as individuals believe that everyone can make an impact and make the world a better place by switching to even just 1 plant-based meal a month.

name: The Little Arts Academy - North Campus I
description: Explore the world of music, dance, theatre and visual arts. The Little Arts Academy provide advanced classes for children aged 6 to 12 years, through numerous performing opportunities that will build a child's confidence and ignite their passion for arts. Through the support from The Business Times Budding Artists Fund (baf.sg) children from the financially disadvantaged families were able to fulfil their potential and interest in the arts.

name: The Little Arts Academy - North Campus II
description: Let your children explore the world of music, dance, theatre and visual arts. With nine years of experience providing foundation and advanced classes for children aged 6 to 12 years, we provide learning beyond the classroom through numerous performing opportunities that will build your child's confidence and ignite their passion for the arts. Our mission is to provide equal opportunities for all children to pursue the arts. Through the support from The Business Times Budding Artists Fund (baf.sg) we enable children from financially disadvantaged families to fulfil their potential and interest in the arts. Join us and unleash your child's imagination and creative potential!

name: The Orange Academy
description: The Orange Academy believes in cultivating children to be confident bilingual speakers in English and Mandarin by providing opportunities to hone their linguistic skills. The physical environment and classroom activities are designed to stimulate children’s creative thinking and logical reasoning and ignite their passion for learning. The Orange Academy strive to equip children with life skills, which are embedded in their holistic curriculum.

name: The Original Vadai
description: Serving the best Prawn Vadai in town since 1989, their menu has now expanded to other flavours and skewers! Look nowhere, The Original Vadai are the specialist!

name: The SGFR Store
description: The SGFR Store is Singapore’s leading candy store, bringing the world’s most viral snacks and candies straight to Singapore, from global favourites to limited-edition treats you won’t find anywhere else. They also create their own fun hits such as Mix Pop Ice Cream Bites, Dubai Kunafa Chocolate, and Mochi Meltz. Drop by SGFR for a fun, feel-good snack experience packed with new arrivals, cool finds, and the latest trends from around the world.

name: The Soup Spoon +
description: We travel the world, discovering its cultures, one bowl of soup at a time. From the world, to our kitchen, to you.

name: The Wallet Shop
description: The Wallet Shop houses a wide range of products that inspires style and character. Shelves are filled with products from established brands such as Bellroy, Cabin Zero, Crossing, Doughnut, Jansport, LOQI, Thule and many more, you’ll definitely be spoilt for choice. Bringing you only the best. The Wallet Shop is the one stop destination for all your pocket needs.

name: THEFACESHOP
description: THEFACESHOP is a leading global beauty retail brand offering over 1,000 quality products for skin care, body care, hair care and makeup

name: Timezone
description: Looking for fun activities to do this weekend? Try Timezone. Whether you're a kid or an adult, Timezone will provide you with endless entertainment! Timezone is the ultimate destination for your daily dose of happiness and unforgettable celebrations.

name: Tongue Tip Lanzhou Beef Noodles
description: Tongue Tip Lanzhou beef noodles originated from the Lanzhou, Gansu province in China. This dish was first created by the Muslim Chinese (Hui) people and it’s recipe has been passed on for generations since the Tang Dynasty. Original Lanzhou Beef Noodles, using Halal meats, high quality fresh ingredients and a 15 spice blend premium stock.

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining. The dish is prepared in a 350°C hot stone bowl, where thick noodles and vegetables are placed before hot soup is poured over them, creating a dramatic steam effect that resembles a volcanic eruption. The " Okoge " that forms when ingredients touch the hot stone, adds a fragrant aroma and delightful texture.

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated "Tare" (sauce) for enhanced flavour.

name: Tous les Jours
description: Tous les Jours, which means "every day" in French, began its journey in 1997 in South Korea, inspired by the art of French baking and a commitment to delivering freshly baked delights every single day. What started as a humble bakery quickly grew into a beloved brand, capturing hearts and taste buds with its dedication to quality, creativity, and freshness. Today, Tous les Jours spans the globe, sharing the joy of exceptional baked goods in over 300 locations worldwide, including Singapore.

name: Toy Outpost
description: Toy Outpost rents out small boxes to anyone interested in becoming his/her own boss. From quirky gadgets to collectible merchandise, you can find all sorts of authentic & licensed products that can legally be sold at Toy Outpost.

name: Toys Terminal
description: Toys Terminal specialises in trading cards, collectables, toys and video games for both children and adults.

name: Tree Art
description: Tree Art specialise in providing enrichment art classes for kids and adults, including painting and drawing, tailored to unleash your creativity and develop your artistic talents no matter what age you are at!

name: Triumph
description: A renowned German lingerie brand, with a strong heritage and expertise in designing and manufacturing perfect underwear to enhance women’s inner beauty, Triumph has dedicated itself to quality since 1886, ensuring unrivaled fit, technical craftsmanship, and uncompromising comfort. For over 135 years, Triumph has remained synonymous with quality and fit in the industry. Today, Triumph continues to assert its market leadership in the intimate apparel industry.

name: Tun Xiang Hokkien Delights
description: Tun Xiang Hokkien Delights actively promotes an "affordable Iberico Pork” concept to allow everyone an opportunity to have premium food at a reasonable price.

name: Twyst
description: Twyst is a fast casual F&B concept offering a delectable range of freshly cooked pasta at affordable price points. Their food provides the unexpected twist that gives a delightful surprise, because of their no-holds-barred innovative approach towards flavours that are familiar yet sinfully good

name: UBreakifix.sg
description: UBreakifix.sg provides professional handphone, computer repair services including the replacement of broken screens, damaged microphones and speakers, including mobile phones trade-in.

name: UNIQLO
description: About UNIQLO LifeWear - Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. A perfect shirt that is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hiding the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people’s lives.

name: United Overseas Bank
description: United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and North America. UOB is rated as one of the world's top banks, ranked 'Aa1' by Moody's Investors Service and 'AA-' by both S&P Global and Fitch Ratings. With a global network of 500 branches and offices across 19 countries in Asia Pacific, Europe, and North America.

name: Unusual Express
description: Unusual Express provides imaging gifts such as mug printing, tee shirt printing, photo books with different designs and varying sizes, cocktail books, crystal printing, rock printing, plaque printing, rubick cube printing and clay figurines.

name: V Aesthetics Body Slim
description: V Aesthetics Body Slim is an extension of V Medical Aesthetics Group – Singapore's Largest Aesthetic Group. V Aesthetics Body Slim provide cutting edge technology, and personalized treatment plans for each individual without the need for crash diets, surgeries or pills! With their signature VSlim™ treatment, it effectively targets weight gain issues, water retention, cellulite, flabby arms or thighs, post-natal weight gain or even menopausal weight gain. Explore a whole new experience with them in body sculpting and slimming with V Aesthetics Body Slim today.

name: V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic
description: V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic is one of the largest medical aesthetics group in Singapore. With clinics island wide and over 30 medical doctors, they offer a plethora of non-surgical and non-invasive treatments for your aesthetics goals. From FDA approved medical aesthetic treatments to affordable and transparent pricing, they set strong priorities in providing patient comfort and safety. Be it to achieve a V shaped face, to have luminous and flawless complexion, V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic wants to embark the pursuit of glowing skin with you.

name: Valu$
description: Valu$ delivers exactly what the brand suggest, Value for Money! They offer a wide range of lifestye and home living products at highly affordable prices.

name: Van Heusen
description: The USA #1 dress shirt brand, Van Heusen, has been associated with stylish, modern classic and high-quality dress shirts since 1921. Renowned for its wrinkle-free shirt, Van Heusen is the place to be for the office outfit game changers.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty is your go-to destination for quality beauty and household cleaning products at unbeatable prices. Explore our curated selection of skincare, haircare, and cosmetics, alongside an array of effective household cleaning essentials. Discover a diverse range of beauty items, from skincare and cosmetics to haircare essentials, all designed to make you feel radiant without breaking the bank. Indulge in a delightful shopping experience where affordability meets quality. From skincare essentials to household must-haves, Venus Beauty is your one-stop destination for budget friendly beauty and cleaning solutions. Elevate your routine without compromising your budget – Visit Venus Beauty today and experience the joy of affordable excellence.

name: Vintage Studio Hairdressing
description: We are proud to be featured as a beauty hair salon that prioritizes communication with our clients above all else. We believe that an intimate understanding of our customers’ needs, combined with our creative expertise, enables us to create the best hair solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements and desires of each and every individual.

name: Vivian & Sean
description: Established in 1998, the name Moda Paolo has become synonymous with good quality shoes in the latest designs. Moda Paolo’s shoes are stylish, trendy, durable, comfortable and affordable, providing customers with good value for money. Moda Paolo distinguishes itself as the home-grown footwear retailer which understands consumer preferences in terms of comfort, design and aesthetics especially that of Asian customers. In Nov 2011, the company opened a new outlet under the brand name Vivian & Sean to target at different segment of consumers.

name: Wacoal
description: Wacoal is Japan’s leading creator of intimate apparel for women. Our goal has always been to contribute to the society by helping women everywhere become more beautiful.

name: Wanpo Tea Shop
description: Wanpo Tea Shop, formerly known as Wanpo Island Black Tea, began at a military base village in Taichung, Taiwan. Now has expanded globally. Like any bubble tea store, it has an assortment of flavors you can choose from. Their menu features five categories: Pure Tea, Fruit Tea, Milk Tea, Seasonal, and Cheese. Most of the drinks come in two sizes—medium or large If you are feeling spoiled for choice, we would recommend going for their bestselling seasonal item—Mango Pomelo Sago; expect a fresh mango slushie with heaps of sago topping, grapefruit pulp, taro balls and mango chunks, Alternatively, try Singapore’s first Custard Boba Milk Tea With Oreo. The drink features streaks of custard cream around a cup filled with milk tea, crushed Oreo bits, and pearls. That’s well-loved for being creamy and fragrant. Another unique drink you should consider is the Mochi Soy Creme Tea Latte. The mochi is made to order, so it’s said to be soft and chewy when served.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons is Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer with close to 100 stores islandwide. Watsons seeks to bring ‘more’ to customers’ lives by inspiring and enabling every customer to look good and feel great. Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

name: Welcia
description: Welcia Singapore is a leading health and beauty store dedicated to providing customers with premium Japanese and Korean products and services. Focusing on overall well-being, Welcia offers a carefully selected range of Japanese and Korean Beauty, Healthcare, and Wellness products, many of which are exclusive to Welcia Singapore. Committed to making customers healthy and beautiful, Welcia aims to deliver solutions through a combination of excellent products, hospitality, and top-notch service. Welcia reflects the brand's vision of promoting well-being and customer satisfaction.

name: WJL 永裕隆
description: When you integrate self-care intentionally into your daily routine, you naturally thrive from within. That is the essence of local wellness brand Wing Joo Loong, which curates a diverse selection of products, from wild-harvested ginseng and everyday herbs to convenient health foods and lifestyle wellness products. With a strong history rooted in premium oriental herbs since 1947, Wing Joo Loong is committed to providing high-quality wellness products to support you through every season of life, nurtured by nature's goodness.

name: Winter Time
description: Winter Time has been a long-standing winter wear speciality in Asia, inspiring travel fashion and have grown to be a household brand for winter wear in Singapore.

name: WOK HEY
description: Masters of stir fry ⋅ Lovers of wok hey. Wok Hey serve the best rice and noodles in town. Cos' they just love stir fry.

name: Writers' Guild
description: Turning pens into wands! At Writers' Guild Learning Centre, we believe that all students can be empowered to write compositions with flair. We specialise in English and Creative writing programmes for Primary and Secondary students.

name: Xi Chuan Chuan 喜串串
description: 喜串串 (Xi Chuan Chuan) specialises in Sichuan skewers and specialities.

name: XIANG XIANG HUNAN CUISINE 湘香湖南菜
description: Xiang Xiang Hunan Cuisine was founded in 2009. Its local culinarily team has crafted a menu that suits the local taste bud while still preserving the authentic flavours of Hunan. With a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, the restaurant offers better ingredients and delicious Hunan dishes, winning over countless diners over the years.

name: Xin Wang Hong Kong Café
description: Street favourites of Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore take centrestage at Xin Wang Hong Kong Café, a modern café that offers all-day dining in a modern setting. Boasting an extensive menu with Hong Kong style items, diners can savour comfort food borne from simple recipes characteristic of the typical Hong Kong and Macau cafes, home recipes we grew up on, local Singapore favourites, dim sum and tea-time snacks. Whether it’s breakfast, a brunch meet-up with friends or late night supper with the family, Xin Wang Hong Kong Café is your one stop restaurant for all-day dining.

name: Xpressflower.com
description: Discover Xpressflower, a floral and gifting haven. Elevating gifting with bespoke bouquets, one-of-a-kind gifts, and chic home decor, we cater to the refined tastes of our stylish clientele. Elevate your gifting experience and embrace elegance with their premium selection.

name: XW Plus Western Grill
description: Being the western casual dining place, XW Western Grill is your one-stop for all things grilled. Offering a line-up of smoky favourites such as steaks, chicken and fish, the combination of mouth-watering natural juices and charred flavours are perfect for insatiable palates. The All-You-Can-Eat Salad Bar boasting unlimited servings of hot and cold sides won’t disappoint either, it comes free with any main course order or go straight for the à la carte salad bar. Kick back and enjoy western grub in this vibrant value-for-money diner – a perfect avenue for gatherings with family and friends.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.

name: Yakiniku Shokudo
description: Yakiniku Shokudo is a Japanese Style BBQ dinning place where you get to enjoy a variety of Wagyu Beef and Chicken.

name: Yale Smart Shop
description: Yale is trusted by millions of people every day to keep what’s important safe. Its innovations have protected homes, families and belongings for over 180 years. Yale has expanded from being a leader in mechanical lock engineering to innovating connected smart locks and homes by making an effort to push the boundaries in a changing world. Yale Smart Shop is positioned to lead the smart lock industry and shape its future: offering Yale Smart Lock owners increased functionalities and integrations via Yale Access app. Yale Access ecosystem includes Smart Safes, Smart Storage and a wide range of Smart Locks for a comprehensive home security system.

name: Yappari Steak
description: Yappari Steak from Okinawa, Japan – they are one of the biggest steak chains in Japan with over 100 stores in Japan, Nepal, Australia, and Singapore. At Yappari Steak, they served all their 100% Certified Black Angus Beef Blue, lightly seared on the outside yet red on the inside on top of their signature lava stone that is heated up to 230-degree Celsius. Customers can slice and cook their steak further to the doneness of their liking.

name: YAYOI
description: YAYOI is a Japanese Teishoku Restaurant. They serve "Teishoku" which includes a good balance of steamed rice (Japanese staple food), miso soup, main dish, side dish and other items on a tray. YAYOI will pass down Japan's delicious food to the future and spread it to the world.

name: YGF Malatang
description: Yang Guo Fu is the world’s largest Mala Tang Chain known to have over 5,500 franchise stores around the world, with restaurants in Japan, Canada and now, Singapore. They are known for their signature Spicy Mala Beef Broth, Tomato Broth as well as their Mala Ban – which is a dry tossed sauce variant that turns up the heat with an assortment of aromatic spices and chilies.

name: Yishun Library
description: Yishun Public Library was officially opened at Yishun Street 22 above the Sembawang Town Council on 26 February 1998 by Associate Professor Ho Peng Kee, then-Minister of State for Law & Home Affairs, Member of Parliament for Sembawang GRC. It re-located to Northpoint Shopping Centre in 2008 and underwent renovations and re-opened on 3 February 2018. The library has a collection of about 121,000 books, around 300 magazine titles and 3,000 audio-visual items, for all age groups in the four official languages. Covering an area of 2,530 square meters, it serves residents in Canberra, Chong Pang, Nee Soon Central, Nee Soon East and Nee Soon South.

name: Young Hearts
description: The Young Hearts brand is fun-loving, high-spirited, feminine and young. They are passionate about living a quality life and hence, support and encourage this by creating and producing products with great attention to research, design, detail, variety and quality. They have a wide selection of daily essential lingerie products to whimsical sleepwear and fun lifestyle products. Young Hearts hope to inspire everyone who comes into contact with us to love life with passion, confidence and enjoyment!

name: Yu Cai Education Centre
description: Yu Cai Education Centre offers tuition with MOE syllabus for the mastery of the Chinese language for Nursery, Kindergarten, Primary 1-preparatory, all primary and secondary levels, PSLE, GCE ‘N’ and ‘O’ levels. It also covers creative writing, comprehension, oral & listening, and school holiday enrichment programs.

name: Yu Cai Education Centre
description: Yu Cai Education Centre offers tuition with MOE syllabus for the mastery of the Chinese language for Nursery, Kindergarten, Primary 1-preparatory, all primary and secondary levels, PSLE, GCE ‘N’ and ‘O’ levels. It also covers creative writing, comprehension, oral & listening, and school holiday enrichment programs.

name: Yummi House
description: Yummi House sells natural wild honey, bird nest (dry), honey drinks, steam bird nest, accessories and others.

name: Yun Nam Hair Care
description: Throughout the years, Yun Nam’s philosophy of using Chinese herbs of the highest quality to specifically target each individual’s hair and scalp problems remains unchanged. They have continuously refined their herbal formulas, using advances in modern technology to further enhance the efficacy of their treatments to ensure better absorption and longer lasting effects. From using more well-known herbs like Ginseng, Dang Gui and He Shou Wu, to lesser known but no less effective ones like Salvia, Peony Root, and Dodder Seed, no expense is spared when customizing hair treatments to help individuals regain healthy hair.

name: Zhong Yan Tang
description: Zhong Yan Tang is a fast-growing premium wellness brand specializing in freshly stewed Bird’s Nest. With six nourishing categories including Sea Cucumber, Abalone, Fish Maw, Buddha Jumps Over the Wall, and Bird's Nest Porridge/ Desserts, they redefine traditional Chinese nourishment for the modern lifestyle.

name: ZTP Ginseng Birdnest
description: ZTP is one of the largest health food retail chains and bottled Bird's Nest manufacturers in Singapore. The range of products include Bird's Nest, Australian abalone, Japanese scallops, Mushroom, Ginseng, Cordyceps and many more.

name: ZUS Coffee
description: ZUS Coffee serves high quality Arabica coffee handcrafted to meet specialty coffee standards without the specialty price tag. From bold coffee to matcha, chocolate, and refreshing options, there’s something for everyone. They’re redefining everyday coffee experiences by making specialty coffee a Necessity, not a Luxury.

name: Adidas
description: Adidas is globally renowned for its innovative products. Sporting enthusiasts enjoy its constant innovations in both apparel and footwear, while featuring only the best for creators and athletes.

name: Advanced Dental
description: No two persons are identical, just as no two sets of teeth are the same. At Advanced Dental Group, we are committed to providing our patients with care catered to their unique needs and aspirations. Advanced Dental Group is a growing chain of dental clinics. Our first clinic was established in 1986. With a history spanning more than 30 years, we are proud to be able to provide our patients with the full range of treatments, so that all dental needs can be met in-house. Our team of dentists and dental assistants are trained to provide professional and gentle dental care.

name: Ajumma's
description: Ajumma’s embodies the vibrant, intense flavours of Korean cuisine. We love the comfort that Korean food brings to people, served up in bowls of piping hot stews, wok-seared bulgogis and crispy, savoury pancakes. No matter your craving, sweet, sour, spicy or savoury, we’ve got a generous serving of it!

name: An Acai Affair
description: As Singapore’s largest Açaí brand, An Açaí Affair is proud to serve organic açaí in the purest and least diluted form, without any artificial sweeteners or liquids. Enjoy their açaí bowls as a refreshing and nutritious pick-me-up to combat Singapore's hot weather, at any time of the day.

name: ARTARY
description: Thousands of students have come through the doors of ARTARY to participate in the best art experience. Our children art programmes are designed to deliver a holistic, disciplined, and engaging art learning experience.

name: Au Croissant
description: Au Croissant, which stands for The Croissant, was founded and set up in 2019. The French have been known to produce the best and highest quality bread, inspiring us to make Au Croissant a French inspired bakery.

name: Auntie Anne's
description: Auntie Anne's, the renowned pretzel bakery, takes pride in offering handcrafted and oven-baked pretzels, made fresh daily in their stores. With a vast selection of over 20 sweet and savoury flavors, Auntie Anne's Singapore is halal certified and caters to a wide range of tastes and preferences, ensuring there's something for everyone. The dough is egg-free and dairy-free, making our pretzels both vegan and vegetarian-friendly when ordered without meat, chocolate, or butter. They're here to add an unexpected twist to your day and help you make the most of each moment, satisfying your craving for excitement.

name: Bank Of China
description: Established on 15 June 1936, Bank of China Singapore Branch holds the Qualifying Full Bank License (QFB) in Singapore. It has a network of five sub-branches and one remittance centre. With over 70 years of presence in the local banking industry, leveraging on the Group's extensive global network and team of experienced professionals, Bank of China Singapore Branch provides a full range of financial services to its customers from Singapore, China as well as the surrounding region. Over the years, it has demonstrated its long-term commitment to promote bilateral economic and trade relations between China and Singapore. The main businesses of Bank of China Singapore Branch include corporate banking, retail banking, trade financing and international trade settlement, with specialized knowledge and expertise in China-related trade financing and settlements, and remittance services.

name: Bata
description: Home to Bata's Asia Pacific and Africa operations, the Singapore office manages 3,000 outlets in the region and its many dealers and suppliers. As the Procurement Centre for Bata, we also work closely with our corporate partners and dealers through efficient manufacturing and sales service support in our own factories as well as our affiliates in the Far East Region. This means we can apply the very same technology and quality standards for Bata shoes to help our clients achieve their expectations without compromising on their brand identity.

name: Bedroom Affairs
description: Bedroom Affairs offer a wide range of premium bedding essentials as well as home decorations for bedrooms and living areas. Whether you are looking for comfortable bed linens or simply ways to elevate your your room's aesthetics, Bedroom Affair is your all-in-one destination for every bedroom essentials.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Beijing Language School
description: At Beijing Language School, we aim to explore and bring out the fullest potential in all of our students, to inspire a desire for learning and gaining knowledge and most important of all, to cultivate an inspiring and enterprising spirit in all of them, so as to nurture them and in turn, they are able to contribute effectively towards the society. Through our teachers’ responsibility, patience, care and concern, we are proud to say that among all our students, 90% of them got at least B2 and above for their Chinese Oral Exams and for our Primary 6 Students, 90% of them got an ‘A’ for their PSLE Chinese Exams!

name: Benjamin Barker
description: A modern-day gentlemen’s outfitter. Weaving the art of living into the fabric of life. From suits to shoes, Benjamin Barker will be your one-stop retail destination for a complete look. Experience the #BenjaminBarker lifestyle today.

name: Best Denki
description: Your preferred electrical and electronic store. Best Denki has been a retail specialist in providing a total solution to enhance the lifestyle of Singaporeans with the latest electrical, electronics appliances and gadgets for the past 30 years.

name: Better Vision
description: Better Vision was founded in 1965 as a modest optical store aspiring to provide eye-care consultations and solutions. Driven by their passion to improve eye-care services and provide cutting-edge solutions to a wider clientele, they have expanded across the region to become a leading eye-care provider. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10:30am - 11:30am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Boarding Gate
description: Boarding Gate offers a wide range of fashionable and modern travel goods and accessories from renowned brands, catering to fashionable travelers and discerning shoppers. Our high-quality travel paraphernalia includes daily essentials like luggage, travel accessories, backpacks, wallets, water bottles, and more. Discover worldwide brands from all-time favorites such as Bellroy, Thule, Bric’s, Echolac, Osprey, Eagle Creek, Pacsafe, and more.

name: Bolon Eyewear
description: In the contemporary world where each individual is looking for a unique style, BOLON is a brand that embraces individuality. Because we believe that eyewear is a form of individual expression, and extension of one's personal style, BOLON inspires by providing unique, modern and fashionable designs. This is the story of "My Style, My BOLON".

name: Boost Juice Bars
description: Boost Juice - the nation’s favourite makers of fresh smoothies and juices! We serve millions of Singaporeans our iconic green cups, filled with fruit and veggie deliciousness. Deliciousness that comes from simple, natural goodness, served to you with a love life attitude that will make you so happy you’ll probably end up high fiving random strangers. It’s about making healthy living easy!! So naturally, nutrition is a key component in developing our range of smoothies and juices that sees us blending through millions of tonnes of fruit and veggies every year.

name: Box Hunt
description: Box Hunt delivers the thrill of surprise through blind boxes, offering a fun and mysterious experience for collectors and toy enthusiasts of all ages. Every product at Box Hunt is chosen with care to spark imagination, excitement, and the simple joy of play. Whether you're shopping for yourself or searching for the perfect gift, our mission is to help you unbox happiness, one surprise at a time.

name: BreadTalk/Toast Box
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. Our signature 'see thru' kitchens allow our chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste... Our attention to detail does not stop here. We strive to stay ahead constantly, making every effort to improve your BreadTalk experience because we want your trip to BreadTalk to be as deliciously rewarding as the buns you select. *BreadTalk accepts FRx Gift Cards as well. Toast Box is a Singaporean contemporary coffee chain established in October 2005. It is rooted in the recreation of Nanyang coffee and toast culture popular during the 1960s and 70s. Step inside and be greeted by the fragrance of coffee made from freshly-ground caramelised coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites. The enticing aroma of brewed coffee and flavourful local delights infuse vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the nostalgic taste of a bygone era. In addition to preserving the taste of Nanyang at home, Toast Box is now also brewing in Hong Kong, Jakarta, Johor Bahru, Kuala Lumpur, and Chinese-Taipei, sharing the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: Buddy Hoagies Café & Grill
description: Buddy Hoagies Pte Ltd has been operating Buddy Hoagies Restaurants since April 2004, and is targeted at families, students and executives. Our restaurants offer authentic and great tasting western cuisine in a casual setting. We take pride in our traditional charbroiled steaks, barbecued ribs , poultry and seafood â€“ authentic, old styled sizzling grills. Other signatures include traditional pasta dishes, burgers, pan fried rosti, and not forgetting great desserts to round things up. At Buddy Hoagies, we believe in variety, quality and affordability. Decorated in a unique country charm, our restaurants provide a casual and relaxed ambience for diners. A perfect location for gathering with friends and family.

name: Burger King
description: Welcome to the home of flame-grilled perfection! Enjoy the best-selling, signature flame-grilled WHOPPER®️ as well as other top BK favourites such as the velvety smooth Double Mushroom Swiss, deliciously juicy Tendergrill®️ Chicken that is made of chicken thigh fillet and the irresistible sides such as Onion Rings, Taro Turnover, HERSHEY’S®️ Sundae Pie and more! Sink your teeth in our juicy burgers now.

name: Butter & Cream
description: Butter & Cream Bakery focuses on muffin, egg tart and burnt cheesecake. Everyday, we are dedicated to achieve an unparalleled level of integration that ensures quality and freshness products to meet our customer’s needs.

name: BYD by 1826
description: BYD by 1826 offers the world's first Automotive Lifestyle Experience. Founded in Singapore, BYD by 1826 introduces a visionary concept that fuses eco-friendly automotive innovation with creative culinary experiences. It goes beyond a car brand by offering a curated sustainable lifestyle that transforms how people drive, dine, and live.

name: Cakebar
description: At CAKEBAR, personalize your gifts by mixing and matching our artisan cakes. Each cake is meticulously customized, designed, baked, and packed. Our best seller, 'Kori Lemon', made with 100% pure lemon, adds refreshing citrus to your creations. We're your destination for extraordinary, unforgettable gifts.

name: CARs International
description: CARs International is one of the largest Car Grooming Operator in Singapore. They offer a range of professional restoration services which includes polish & waxing, coating, interior cleaning and cabin sanitizing.

name: Cedele
description: For two decades, Cedele, a trusted food and beverage chain, has specialized in handcrafted, artisan-baked goods. They make clean eating effortless and sustainable by offering fresh bakes and gently cooked meals prepared with high-quality, intentionally sourced natural ingredients. Cedele fosters a healthier relationship with food, allowing for the occasional indulgence with treats that are thoughtfully made with added nutrients and care.

name: CFoot
description: CFoot offers customized insoles designed for those with foot problems or those looking to prevent them. Their shoes are not only comfortable but also help correct foot posture and walking gait, making them suitable for both young people and the elderly. CFoot 's insoles and shoes are suitable for all ages, from children to young adults to seniors, ensuring everyone can benefit from them.

name: CHAGEE
description: CHAGEE is an international tea brand that brings traditional tea to modern life. Drawing from centuries of tea heritage, we craft premium whole-leaf brews that blend tradition with innovation — creating shared moments of connection, every day, in every cup. CHAGEE TOGETHER.

name: Challenger Mobile
description: Unveil the world of Challenger – Singapore’s exclusive homegrown electronics chain since 1982. Explore the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials trusted by over half a million loyal members across 40+ island-wide stores. Embrace peace of mind with hassle-free returns and warranties covering 50,000+ top-tier products, including favorites like Apple, Samsung, and an array of other leading names.

name: CHARLES & KEITH
description: Fashion entrepreneurs, Charles and Keith Wong founded Charles & Keith in 1996 upon identifying the potential of footwear designs catered for Asian women. Today, Charles & Keith is the go-to fashion destination for stylish urbanites, recognised for its accessible fashion and curated collections of relevant designs. A lifestyle brand that embraces a culture of innovation, it has developed a full-fledged line of footwear, bags, eyewear, accessories and costume jewellery.

name: Chateraise
description: Chateraise have over 470 stores across all of Japan and over 15 stores in Asia. All of their sweets are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as pure natural water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms in Japan. They directly deliver all their sweets from Japan to stores around the world.

name: CHICHA San Chen
description: Originating from Taiwan, CHICHA San Chen was founded in 1998 with a mission to make high-quality freshly brewed teas accessible to discerning tea drinkers. The brand holds a prestigious Highest International Authority ITI certification for quality, and utilises an exclusive patented Teapresso machine that allows custom settings and temperature control brewing technique to bring out the tea’s best flavour and natural scent, and maintain consistency in the quality and taste profiles of their tea. With high-quality tea as its mainstay, CHICHA San Chen marries the best of bubble tea with traditional tea bringing one of life’s greatest pleasures to the world.

name: Chicken Ka Kee
description: Chicken Ka Kee is a modern, Halal-certified dining concept by Boon Tong Kee (est. 1979), one of Singapore's most recognisable chicken rice brands. Beyond our signature Chicken Rice, tuck into a spread of Singapore heritage favourites so there's something for everyone at the table.

name: Chocolate Origin & Cacaocat
description: Be it a celebration or to simply fix your chocolate cravings, Chocolate Origin has got you covered. Specialising in chocolate cakes and confectioneries, we use the most finest, quality ingredients to ensure mouth-watering goodness with every bite! Who says you can’t buy happiness? Slowly it gained a loyal following, mostly through word-of-mouth recommendations of a growing fan base. This was undoubtedly due to its commitment to offer only the best chocolate cake that one could find, not just merely within Changi Village, but the whole of Singapore.

name: Clippers Barber & Smoovee Skin
description: Clippers Barber is your affordable classic barbershop with a modern revamp. Smoovee Skin is Korea's specialist in Hair Removal and Skin Rejuvenation Salon. It is a revolutionary salon that provides services for both males and females. Our services are suitable for all skin colours and types at an affordable price tag. Smoovee Skin is different as we believe in a "No Appointment and No Package" concept.

name: CocoCane
description: CocoCane is a new F&B concept which specialises in 100% pure and fresh Coconut and Sugarcane drinks. Beverages sold at CocoCane are fresh and juiced daily. CocoCane aims to be a healthy beverage solution for consumers and, allow consumers hydrate better and healthier.

name: Concierge (Waterway Point)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Cookhouse by Koufu
description: Cookhouse @ Waterway Point features Punggol from the past to present by incorporating elements of the kampong theme in the food offerings and food court's interior design. Bringing back the good old days with traditional food such as kueh tutu, muah chee, Cookhouse also offers international cuisine and popular local food like wanton mee and fish soup from well-established food stalls. Head down to Cookhouse @ Waterway Point to embark on a gastronomic journey and reminisce the kampong experience!

name: Coslab
description: Coslab is a premier beauty & body slimming spa. It is the perfect beauty spa for relaxation and tranquility. Coslab offers a variety of treatments, including Massage Therapy with registered Massage Therapists (I.T.E.C), Aroma-therapy Massage, Traditional Javanese Massage, Advanced Facial Treatments , Anti Stress Ear Candling, Body Polish and Wraps and other skin & body treatments. At Coslab, we also offer special exotic treatments as well as our signature & exclusive anti wrinkle treatment.

name: Cotton On Kids
description: Cotton On Kids deliver the latest and greatest for the kids because the future looks more than bright with them in it. They are the magic makers and the kindness warriors, the animal lovers and the planet protectors. They are our future. We believe that shopping for our kids should be easy and ultra-affordable, we work hard to deliver the product they need to absolutely run the world.

name: Country Brot by Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

name: Crave
description: Savour the nation's favourite by indulging at Crave! Enjoy some award-winning Adam Road Nasi Lemak by Selera Rasa, topped off with crunchy flavourful ikan bilis, nuts and the tantalising iconic sambal!

name: Crocs
description: Crocs, a world leader in innovative casual footwear, is dedicated to the future of comfort. The original and most famous style, the Classic Clog, is instantly recognized around the world, and for good reason: since 2002, Crocs has sold more than 300 million pairs in over 90 countries! We know that smart doesn’t have to mean complicated; we achieved our status as a global leader in the casual footwear category by taking an inherently simple approach to uniting style, modern comfort and value. Every day, we make a choice to have an open mind and look on the bright and colorful side of life. We embrace and celebrate the uniqueness in everyone, inviting the world to Come As You Are™.

name: Daily Chicken
description: Love Korean fried chicken? Our family-friendly restaurant offers the best of Korean street food, from crispy fried chicken to comforting dishes like tteokbokki, gimbap and onmyeon, there’s something for everyone. Dine at Daily Chicken to experience #LoveAtFirstBite!

name: Decathlon
description: A global multi-specialist sports brand catering to beginners and top athletes, Decathlon is an innovative maker of sporting goods for all skills. With more than 100,000 teammates and 1,700 stores worldwide, Decathlon and its teams have been working ever since 1976 to fulfil an ongoing ambition: Move people through the wonders of sport, to help them be healthier and happier in a sustainable future.

name: Délifrance
description: A journey to France - this is Délifrance promise to you. For over 30 years, Délifrance Singapore has dedicated itself to bringing a taste of Paris closer to home. The Délifrance brand is centred upon a desire to make every day delicious. This is a testament to their unending search for and provision of the simple pleasures in life put forth in creative and transformative ways. Their French roots and history exist as the foundational structure upon which they innovate authentic cultural fare, culminating in inspired creations of outstanding taste and convenience.

name: Dian Xiao Er
description: Dian Xiao Er, the must eat herbal roast duck in Singapore! Using only the finest quality of Cherry Valley ducks paired with freshest ingredients, our duck are prepared and freshly roast daily. They are marinated with a revitalising blend of Chinese herbs and spices for hours, roasted at a precise temperature to retain its juice while in the oven. Crisp to the touch, and golden brown in appearance, our herbal roast duck is complemented with our specially concocted herbal sauce that makes it impossible to resist!

name: Din Tai Fung
description: Ranked as one of the world's Top Ten Best Restaurants by The New York Times, the Michelin-star restaurant has its roots dating back to Taiwan more than 40 years ago. The arrival of Din Tai Fung in Singapore in 2003 made waves in the local dining scene and has since built a huge following with its famous signature Xiao Long Baos (Steamed Pork Dumplings), Steamed Chicken Soup and Fried Rice with Shrimps & Eggs amongst many popular favourites.

name: Dollhouse
description: Dollhouse, previously known as Innersense Signature, is a premier beauty salon, offering a holistic range of services that cater to your wellness, nails, and spa needs. With their focus on quality treatments, it is the perfect spot for a well-deserved pampering session.

name: DON DON DONKI
description: DON DON DONKI is a Japanese specialty brand that offers wide variety of high quality Japanese products from premium Japanese meat to ready-to-eat meals. Find everything you're looking for and discover things you never knew you needed, only at DON DON DONKI.

name: Dough Culture
description: Dough Culture Pte Ltd is the largest manufacturer of You Tiao in Singapore. Being a pioneer in its industry and a firm believer in innovation, the company constantly engages in the research and development of new food products with strategic partners, to introduce exciting new brands such as Dough Culture to the market. Dough Culture brand of products are manufactured under the most stringent food safety and hygiene standards. Our products are HACCP and Halal certified.

name: Dunkin' Donuts
description: Dunkin' Donuts is Singapore's favourite every day, all-day stop for great coffee and baked goods. Visit us to enjoy a fantastic selection of donuts including all-time favourites Mr Happy, Boston Kreme and Strawberry Filled Donut as well as delightful limited edition options.

name: Edvox Music School
description: Edvox Music School was established in 2002 with the objective of bringing high quality music education to the heartlands and to all music lovers. Our School offers comprehensive practical and theoretical music classes in various instruments conducted by qualified instructors. We believe in an all-rounded musical education hence we encourage our students to participate actively in our annual concert Talento and various in-house master classes and recitals. By involving themselves in such enriching activities, they will better appreciate the finer aspects of music and have exposure to orchestra skills and learning to cooperate with fellow musicians in performing. These opportunities are hard to come by and are invaluable in developing their musicianship. Our School takes seriously the three-way communication between student, teacher and parents as we know that parents may not always be aware of how to help their child improve or practise, or parents may not have the time to supervise or keep alongside of their child's learning progress. Hence our teacher will gladly take the effort to update parents on their child's progress by maintaining constant correspondence with parents through updating of the Weekly Student Report and also sending out bi-annual Student Progress Report of their child's performance in the various aspects of practical and theoretical learning.

name: Encik Tan
description: Recognising the demand from the Muslim counterparts for authentic Chinese hawker fare, the Encik Tan brand was introduced as a Halal-certified mini food atrium concept that dishes up a parade of popular local Chinese dishes, such as Hainanese Curry Rice, Wanton Noodles, Ban Mian, and Claypot Rice. All recipes are adapted using Halal ingredients and fine-tuned to deliver the same nostalgic flavour and taste of the original dishes.

name: epitex
description: Inspiring comfort, with a single-minded dedication to bring exceptional comfort in every thread, every fabric, to every home. With a wide collection of quality mattresses, bed sheets, bed linens and pillows, Epitex constantly unfold dimensions of cosy, to suit every kind of sleeper and daydreamer.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Eu Yan Sang is Asia's leading integrative healthcare and wellness company with a strong foundation in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). Founded in 1879 with the mission of 'Caring for Mankind' - Today, Eu Yan Sang is a trusted household brand. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Eu Yan Sang TCM Clinic
description: As a most trusted chain of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and integrative health clinics, Eu Yan Sang genuinely cares about providing good lifelong health to our customers. We believe in a holistic approach to total health and well-being. Our TCM and Western General Practitioner clinics offer a comprehensive range of traditional Chinese medicines and therapies for effective healing and renewed vitality. Whether you seek treatment for acute or chronic health conditions or simply want to optimise your health, our professionally qualified and experienced team can provide a complete health assessment and personalised treatment plan.

name: Eyechamp Young
description: Founded in March 2005, EyeChamp Optometrists is committed to providing primary eye care at affordable prices with the highest level of customer service. Our vision is to become a household name in Singapore and a trendsetter in the optical market. We work very closely with leading providers of eye care solutions, such as Essilor, Luxottica and Johnson & Johnson, to deliver eye care solutions of the highest quality. We also partner with authorised distributors to make sure all our products are original. Our friendly team of opticians and optometrists are certified and well-trained to serve you. Visit Optometrists & Opticians Board to check if your optician or optometrist is certified.

name: FairPrice Finest
description: FairPrice Finest seeks to bring the finest things in life to customers. It combines the heritage of a trusted brand with a whole new experience of fine living at affordable pricing. Scrumptious delis and vintage wines in our gourmet selection are a sensory delight to the gastronome. Our fresh seafood along with our seasonal produce and international selection are carefully hand-picked from all over the world to please even the most discerning palates. Not forgetting the health-conscious; they can take delight with our expanding range of prized organic items and fresh fruits. From the conventional to the epicurious, here is where you can celebrate the finest things in life.

name: Famous Amos
description: Since 1975, Famous Amos has been Singapore's go-to for freshly baked, handcrafted cookies. Beyond the iconic crunchy cookie flavours you know and love, we've expanded our menu with chunky delights, fluffy muffins, brownies and more. Craving something extra? We've partnered with Milk & Cookies to bring you the ultimate indulgence: creamy milkshakes and decadent soft serve ice cream that pair perfectly with our cookies. Our cookies are the perfect treat to share with friends, family or simply indulge in yourself. MADE FOR EVERYDAY MOMENTS!

name: Fish & Co.
description: Established in 1998, Fish & Co. is a casual, family restaurant chain serving fresh seafood in a pan. This unique dining experience drew inspiration from the simple practices of the fishermen in the Mediterranean; who caught seafood fresh from the seas, cooked and ate the freshly cooked seafood immediately from the pan. Designed with a casual, nautical ambience, Fish & Co. restaurants, together with her friendly crew, are cheery, inviting and warm. At Fish & Co., all seafood is prepared in a simple and straightforward manner. Using only the freshest fish and seafood, as well as natural ingredients like olive oil, herbs and various spices from around the world, Fish & Co. has been delighting customers with great tasting meals in generous portions and warm, friendly service - true marks of quality and value.

name: Freeman Florist
description: Freeman Florist recommends flowers for any occasion! Specializing in roses, arrangements and with reliable flower delivery.

name: Fun Claw
description: Fun Claw is a brand-new concept of automated Claw Catcher machine launched in 2018. Our concept is to create a space exclusively for claw machines where families and friends can bond over the simplicity of having a fun time while shopping together. Our family friendly environment offers a cosy game play experience that prominently differentiates us from others. Fun Claw aims to rekindle the excitement of visiting the shopping malls and encourage people to step outside to have fun.

name: G2000
description: G2000 is the savvy executive’s choice, with a sharper, cleaner cut that takes business to a personal level. It flaunts a versatile range of work wear that offers a balance of tailored elegance and sharp style, as well as smart essentials that are comfortably affordable.

name: Gain City
description: Established in 1981, Gain City started out with a simple quest of improving lifestyles and a focused vision to be Singapore's trusted air-conditioner retailer. Today, renowned as Singapore's largest air-conditioner retailer, the brand is synonymous with excellent air-conditioning installation and maintenance service, as well as being the preferred go-to 1-Stop retailer for consumer electronics. With more than 800 staff, a pool of BCA-certified installation technicians and a fleet of over 180 service vehicles, they are your trusted choice.

name: Genki Sushi
description: With over 20 outlets islandwide, Genki Sushi Singapore is never far from your next sushi fix! Powered by our iconic Kousoku Express delivery system, your favourite plates zoom straight to your table, fast, fresh, and always fun. Paired with our seamless BYOD ordering system, every visit turns into a uniquely playful dining adventure that Genki fans can’t get enough of. Feeling the sushi cravings already? Catch us at Genki Sushi, right around the corner! 🍣

name: Goldheart
description: With more than 40 years of heritage, Goldheart is the first and leading gold and diamond jeweller in Singapore that introduced the concept of wedding bands in white gold and platinum. With exclusive in-house designs that exude artistry and masterful craftsmanship, every Goldheart boutique is a treasure trove of 999 & 916 gold jewellery for discerning customers. They have continuously pushed the boundaries of creativity in gold jewellery design. As the exclusive distributor of Celestial® diamond, Goldheart also flaunts the world’s first 73-facet starburst diamond that scintillates with the supreme luminosity of the brightest star. Honouring Goldheart’s rich heritage in love and romance, the exclusive concept of Pure Blue™ was introduced. The Pure Blue™ sapphire is embedded in the inner ring band as the perfect symbol of purity and fidelity.

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang is a 100% local-owned brand that was established in 2017 to provide a unique Ma La cuisine experience while retaining the authenticity of the local fan favourite dish. GYMLT offer drinkable Ma La soup bases that do not leave a greasy or overwhelming aftertaste, so that customers can enjoy it till the very last drop. GYMLT understands that different people have different dietary needs and spice preferences. Hence, GYMLT offers other soup bases such as Mushroom, Pork bone, Tomato and Pickled Vegetable soup bases for those who do not enjoy spices We have also come up with a vegetarian friendly soup for our vegetarian consumers.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 138 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Pharmacy services available! Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for consumers' health and beauty needs. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at all stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. We continue to build on our rich healthcare heritage with an award-winning team of pharmacists who have consistently won multiple pharmacist awards every year.

name: Guzman y Gomez
description: At Guzman y Gomez (GYG), our passion is creating delicious food out of real ingredients. Up to 24 hour marinades, chip-tasting sessions and chillies really get us going! We don’t take shortcuts in our restaurants - we use fresh ingredients and authentic techniques. It’s not always easy, but it’s always worth it. ¡Buen provecho!

name: Han's
description: With more than 25 outlets islandwide, Singaporeans have come to love Hans, a place where you can tuck into Han's signature dish and a whole range of quality menus at reasonable prices in a comfortable environment.

name: Heguru Education Centre
description: Heguru Education Centre is a multi-award winning enrichment centre specialising in right and whole brain development of children aged 6 months to 12 years old. Originating from Japan with over 30 years of results, Heguru uses a multisensory approach by integrating auditory, visual and kinaesthetic elements during lessons help children strengthen their brain functions and develop important cognitive abilities. Heguru Education takes pride in its class-leading curriculum and best-in-class teachers who are trained and certified in Japan to ensure the most effective lessons are delivered.

name: Helen
description: Since 1999, HELEN by Helen Accessories has been offering trendy fashion accessories for women. With over 20 stores island-wide today, it has become a well-recognised fashion accessories powerhouse.

name: Henri Charpentier
description: A french-inspired cafe and patisserie serving the best fresh cakes in Singapore. We offer a wide range of delicious fresh cakes (slices and whole), freshly baked financiers which are available in assorted flavours and much more.

name: HockHua Tonic
description: Hockhua Tonic, a household name in Singapore and Malaysia since 1989, is known for its retail chain of stores stocked with traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), health supplements and tonics. Renowned for its quality ginseng and wide range of bird's nest products, it also offers seafood delicacies such as abalones, dry scallops, Chinese herbs and a variety types of self-manufactured nutrition organically grown products.

name: Home's Harmony
description: At Home's Harmony, we're here to help you craft your home with style, comfort, and functionality. We've curated an exquisite collection of bedlinen, bedding accessories, bath essentials and lifestyle décor that elevate your living spaces to new heights.

name: HOOGA
description: HOOGA (hue-guh) is a Singapore home décor brand that is inspired by the Danish art of cosiness. In this Scandinavian concept store, we pursue happiness through appreciating simple pleasures of life as every turn unveils new ornamentations that relate to the many pleasures we associate with everyday living.

name: Hototogisu Ramen
description: Michelin-starred Hototogisu Ramen was founded in 2006 by Chef Atsushi Yamamoto in Tokyo, Japan. Achieving the honour of being awarded the prestigious One Michelin Star for two years in a row in the Tokyo Michelin Guide 2019 and 2020, it has been a journey for a ramen shop which started out as a humble 8-seater. Never resting on his laurels, Chef Yamamoto has once again created an exceptional concept for his 8th shop at Waterway Point. Debuting his “Bubble Soup”, the signature Porcini Cappuccino Ramen and Yuzu Cappuccino Ramen features a light and foamy Porcini and Yuzu sauce resembling the foam cap of a cappuccino.

name: I Can Read
description: I Can Read’s primary focus is to ensure students overcome the challenges and difficulties of reading, developing into confident, independent readers. A full range of English literacy courses are offered to children age 2.5 to 12 years, improving their reading, speaking, listening and writing ability. I Can Read has recorded a total of 300,000 success stories in more than 14 countries.

name: I Love Taimei
description: I Love Taimei is a local F&B brand established with a passion and goal to share the best of Taiwanese street food culture with the world. The brand features well known Taiwan delicacies such as Taiwan Fried Chicken, Braised Chicken Rice (Lu Rou Fan), Fried Snacks such as Taiwan Tempura and Bubble Tea.

name: ICBC
description: Established in 1993, ICBC Singapore Branch is the first overseas institution of the ICBC Group. Apart from the Qualifying Full Bank Licence awarded by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, ICBC Singapore has been the sole RMB Clearing Bank in Singapore since 2013 with authorization from the People’s Bank of China. Based in Singapore, ICBC Singapore provides direct connections with China as well as global outreach. Through efforts spanning 30 years, the bank has established an integrated platform of onshore and offshore financial services in multiple currencies through online and offline channels, covering corporate, institutional, and personal customers. The bank offers a full-fledged suite of financial products and services, including corporate banking, trade finance, global cash management, green finance, forex trading, debt capital market, asset custody and management, retail banking, and private banking. Leveraging on the integrated capabilities and significant technological innovations of ICBC Group, ICBC Singapore has accelerated its pace of internationalization, green transition, and digitalization. These efforts include consolidating its round-the-clock RMB clearing services to connect 47 countries and regions; implementing green and sustainable finance to support low-carbon economy and decarbonization; embracing financial technology and engaging in Singapore’s Smart Nation initiative, which made the Bank a perennial winner of the Global FinTech Award at Singapore FinTech Festival. Incredible Companion, Boundless Connection. ICBC Singapore will continue to serve you with integrity and professional expertise while striving to be your reliable global banking partner.

name: Ichiban Boshi
description: Ichiban Boshi introduces Japanese dining with a dash of modern simplicity offering the best premium quality sushi, sashimi, seafood and a variety of set meals. With an emphasis on quality, Ichiban Boshi is proud to present premium Japanese cuisine at reasonable prices right throughout the year.

name: Innersense Signature
description: Innersense Signature is a premier beauty salon, offering a holistic range of services that cater to your wellness, nails, and spa needs.

name: IVI Aesthetic
description: Our obsession with perfect, healthy balanced skin has led to the launch of IVI Aesthetic. Because we believe in correction rather than concealment, our goal is to help customers get healthy skin from within. Breaking away from traditional facial spa methods and techniques, IVI Aesthetic offers a wide range of treatments using the latest medispa technology and we focuses on medical grade treatments combined with a tinge of traditional practices to bring customers closer to beautiful, flawless and foundation free skin.

name: Japan Home
description: With more than 65 outlets island-wide, Japan Home has grown from strength to strength. Embodying a philosophy for quality without compromise, Japan Home prides itself in the provision of a wide range of household products at affordable prices. Today, Japan Home is a household name with an unrivaled reputation as a one-stop provider for all your household needs.

name: Japan IPL Express
description: Not your typical IPL salon. Japan IPL Express is the first unisex salon, committed to offering the most effective and convenient Hair Removal and Skin Solution services dedicated to your needs and wants: “No Packages, No Appointments” – that’s our modus operandi.

name: Jean Yip Hairdressing Hair Spa & Beauty
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: Jollibee
description: Jollibee is the Philippines’ largest food chain, operating a network of more than 1,100 stores worldwide. A dominant market leader in the Philippines, Jollibee has embarked on an accelerated international expansion plan, now with over 230 international stores in 16 countries. Its world-famous crispylicious, juicylicious Chickenjoy has earned the praise of the late chef Anthony Bourdain, was touted as the best fried chicken in Hong Kong by South China Morning Post, and praised by Foodbeast, a popular US-based food publication.

name: K.Lab
description: One stop shop for all your mobile accessories needs, featuring cases and gadgets from Aukey, Casetify, Case-Mate, Burga, Moft, and more.

name: Kaleido
description: Kaleido is a local jewellery label based in Singapore. At Kaleido, we are powered by the believe that jewellery should be affordable and inclusive — quality designs for all styles, genders, and life stages, empowering self-expression without compromising on value.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are. We provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are in just 10 minutes. kcuts offer Korean themed haircut that is stylish in just 10 minutes.

name: Kiddy Palace
description: Kiddy Palace is a children’s departmental store providing a one-stop shopping experience for doting mummies and daddies. We aim to be a trusted household brand name in Singapore as a specialty retailer for kids, toddlers, children and expectant mothers.

name: Kiehl's
description: Kiehl's was founded in 1851 as an old-world apothecary in New York’s East Village neighbourhood. Throughout the years, Kiehl’s remained dedicated to providing uniquely efficacious skin, hair and body care products. Their nature-inspired, scientifically-proven formulas are powerful yet safe and help improve overall skin quality for visibly healthier-looking skin. “Try Before You Buy” is the pharmacy’s unofficial motto. Drop by for a Derma Reader Deep Skin Analysis to accurately diagnose your unique skin concerns and receive personalized samples after. Experience Kiehl’s personalized consultation to discover the products that are right for you.

name: Kitchen+Ware
description: Kitchen+Ware is a kitchenware, plus, homeware store. They carry an extensive range of kitchen utensils, plus other more wares for the home. You can find baking accessories, woks and pans, cooking pots, dining utensils and wares, vacuum airpots etc. Must-have items for the living room, bedroom or bathroom. Find brands such as Zojirushi, Tiger, Zebra, KAI, Hoover, Saemmi, 3M, Garbath & more!

name: KOI Thé Express
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: Kskin
description: Kskin is a Korean Express Facial Salon that caters to both genders. Customers walk in to enjoy their facial treatment with no need for any appointment booking. Cashless payment can be made at self-serve payment kiosks before service, and there is no package selling involved. Using our specially formulated, pharmaceutical grade proprietary solutions, coupled with the latest machines in skin care technology, the duration of the facial treatment only requires 15 minutes to ensure skin is refreshed, prepped, and glowing. The premium quality of skin care ingredients, paired with Kskin's proprietary treatment efficiency, enable our customers to maximize time in the midst of their busy schedule to achieve their skincare goals without compromising results.

name: Kuriya Japanese Market
description: Kuriya Japanese Market is your one-stop shop for quick, satisfying Japanese meals and grocery selections. Savour the freshest sushi and seafood, carefully selected and air-flown directly from Japan three times weekly for the highest quality, alongside other imported Japanese seasonings, condiments, snacks, and exclusive sakes. There is also the option to enjoy a variety of Japanese-inspired bento prepared on demand for a fulfilling meal on-the-go. From ready-to-eat sushi boxes and snacks, to sashimi party platters, there is something for everyone!

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence.
