Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Laneige
description: LANEIGE is a leading skincare brand known for its innovative and effective hydrating products. Launched in 1994, LANEIGE believe that water, being the source of life, is the key to youthful and lively skin. Through 20 years of research on the interaction between water and skin, LANEIGE developed its own exclusive technology "WATER SCIENCE(TM)" to help bold and confident young women achieve naturally hydrated and supple skin anytime, anywhere. With a focus on delivering luxurious skincare solutions, LANEIGE has gained a reputation for excellence in the beauty industry, offering a wide range of products designed to meet various skincare needs and enhance overall skin health.

name: Lao Huo Tang
description: Share a tureen or two of traditional Cantonese-style soups from any of our 10 Lao Huo Tang Restaurants with your loved ones. Made fresh daily from scratch, these salubrious broths are made with vegetables, lean meat, pork ribs and other natural ingredients and simmered for hours. They are low in fat, calories and also low in sodium — no MSG, oil, cream or butter is used and its refillable for all dine-in customers. In addition to the nourishing soups, tuck into other traditional home-style dishes in the comfortable restaurant, which is both baby and wheelchair-friendly.

name: Lenskart
description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer brand that retails best quality, fashionable eyewear at surprisingly low prices. Lenskart achieves this by establishing a direct route to customers - straight from manufacturing to retail, and by eliminating 7 layers of middlemen. Lenskart has 2 unique products BLU lenses and Air frames. BLU lenses are designed for the digital age. They block blue rays from smartphones and other digital devices, helping prevent eye damage. Lenskart BLU is a fully loaded lens scratch proof, superhydrophobic and aspheric. Air frames are lightweight, flexible, robust and are designed for ultimate comfort and style.

name: Levi's
description: The Levi's® brand epitomizes classic American style and effortless cool. Since the invention and patent of riveted clothing by Jacob Davis and company founder Levi Strauss in 1873, Levi's® jeans have become the most recognizable and imitated clothing in the world - capturing the imagination and loyalty of people for generations. Today, the Levi’s® brand portfolio continues to evolve through a relentless pioneering and innovative spirit that is unparalleled in the apparel industry. Their range of leading jeanswear and accessories are available in more than 110 countries, allowing individuals around the world to express their personal style.

name: LiHO Tea
description: ‘LiHO means “How are you in Hokkien” and we take pride in our name as it celebrates Singapore as a melting pot of culture. A simple greeting of LiHO is a great way for individuals to bond and it is even better with a cup of Singapore’s homegrown tea brand, LiHO Tea. Brown Sugar Pearl, Avocado and Fruit Tea are what LiHO does best and it is the heart of our brand.” Great emphasis is placed on the entire process, from choosing the right tea to roasting, to brewing and finally serving it.

name: Love, Bonito
description: At Love, Bonito, we make infinitely wearable clothes; timelessly feminine pieces that let you be you, ever-ready for your calendar, and all the in-betweens. Designed for all the real, everyday stuff that no one else gets. Clothes designed to give you a breather – because the rest of your life rarely does.

name: Lovisa
description: At Lovisa, we are driven by our passion for the perfect accessory. Our trend-forecasting departments worldwide take inspiration from runways and current street style to provide the latest trends in fashion accessories.The first Lovisa store opened in Australia in 2010, and since then we have established ourselves as an industry leader, with over 340 stores across 15 countries which includes the US, South Africa, UK to name a few.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Founded in 2017, Luckin Coffee pioneers a technological-driven retail concept aims to provide quality coffee and products accessible to its customers. Using only sustainably, ethically sourced coffee beans roasted to perfection by its WBC Champion Team, Luckin Coffee created a range of unique and delicious blend of coffee that has won the hearts of million coffee lovers. Luckin Coffee’s success and rapid growth over the years are a testament to its unique approach to retail that focuses on technology and customer centric approach, and its relentless dedication to customer satisfaction.

name: Maison Berger Paris
description: Maison Berger Paris is a Luxurious French home fragrance brand with over 100 years of history in purifying air with a unique and patented catalytic burner. Diffuse your preferred fragrance while purifying air at the same time!

name: Mamma Mia Trattoria E Caffè
description: Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffè is a casual-style dining restaurant that serves true and simple Italian fare in an unpretentious and inviting Trattoria atmosphere. Artisan pastas that are handcrafted with fresh ingredients and cooked à la minute take centrestage. From antipasti, handcrafted pasta, rice and other mealtime delectables to mouth-watering desserts, the Italian nosh at Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffè is sure to satisfy all palates.

name: Maxi-Cash
description: Maxi-Cash is the first public-listed pawnbroker in Singapore. Besides providing pawnbroking services, Maxi-Cash also retails brand new gold, diamond jewellery and preloved luxury goods.

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's business is never just about providing quick meals. It's always been about you - your tastes, your lifestyle, your choices. And they'd like to keep it that way, with you lovin' every moment of it. This is how McDonald's put their heart and soul into each and every one of their delicious, wholesome meals. Each 'mmm' and 'ahhh' from you is thanks enough. As you change and grow, McDonald's will be right there with you every step of the way. Today and tomorrow.

name: Mind Stretcher
description: Founding in 2002, Mind Stretcher has been providing high-quality tutorial and enrichment programmes to students in Singapore through innovative and effective pedagogies. With their consistent and stellar track record in producing academic Achievers and High Achievers over the years, they are the Tuition and Enrichment centre of choice for many parents. They believe that all students have the potential to excel, regardless of their individual ability. At Mind Stretcher, we strive to stretch every young mind and the potential of each student to the fullest.

name: MINISO
description: Established in Tokyo, Miniso was jointly founded by Miyake Junya, the chief designer of MINISO, and Ye Guofu, a young Chinese entrepreneur, with the aim of advocating a fashionable and relaxed lifestyle. Today, Miniso is a global fast fashion designer brand, offering a wide range of products across 10 product categories including lifestyle, home, gifts, and electronics. Miniso is dedicated to providing customers with quality and creative products at affordable prices.

name: Minmed Clinic
description: Minmed Clinic offers a wide range of high-quality primary healthcare services for individuals and families. With conveniently located clinics islandwide, we provide GP consultations, health screening, vaccinations, chronic disease management, and work permit screening. Our patient-focused approach, CHAS accreditation, and acceptance of various corporate health plans ensure comprehensive care for all. With its diverse range of medical services, experienced healthcare professionals, and commitment to patient care, Minmed Clinic is a trusted provider of healthcare services for all.

name: Mister Donut
description: Makers of the legendary Pon De Ring donuts. Enjoy high-quality donuts made with ingredients from Japan and prepared by staff with careful training at the Mister Donut academy in Osaka.

name: Mister Minit
description: Mister Minit specialises in the services of shoe repairs, key cutting and duplication, engraving and watch service. Established in 1957, the Mister Minit team continues to build a strong service brand through commitment to excellence in customer service and continual improvements in relation to our customers changing needs.

name: Mister Mobile
description: As Singapore's leading one-stop mobile service provider, Mister Mobile caters to your every mobile need. With multiple stores conveniently scattered across the island and efficient doorstep services, they guarantee prompt on-the-spot repairs, seamless trade-ins and stress-free phone purchases. Certified with ISO 9001 and CaseTrust, Mister Mobile is a beacon of unparalleled quality and reliability. Awarded the esteemed Carousell InstantBuy Award and adorned with numerous 5.0-star ratings on Google and Carousell, they consistently deliver excellence and customer satisfaction. Your mobile journey is in safe hands with Mister Mobile — where service seamlessly meets distinction.

name: MoneyMax
description: MoneyMax is a leading pawnbroker, retailer and trader of jewellery, pre-owned luxury bags and watches, with a presence in both Singapore and Malaysia. MoneyMax is proud to be the first ISO 9001 (ISO9001:2008) and CaseTrust Accredited Pawnbroker in Singapore.

name: Monster Curry
description: Monster Curry is Singapore’s leading Japanese curry chain restaurant. Be mesmerized by the distinct flavour of the curry sauce, made from fresh fruits and a special blend of spices, resulting in a truly unique Japanese curry. With a spiciness level of your choosing, coupled with a range of assortments on a whopping plate size of 41cm in diameter, no one will leave feeling unfulfilled. The even bigger Japanese combo curry rice options are perfect for sharing. Other items such as Japanese pastas, curry ramen and honey toast are available to round out your meal.

name: MOS Burger
description: MOS Burger is a premium Japanese hamburger chain restaurant which offers a wide variety of unique and original tasting burgers. To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers’ order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: My Digital Lock
description: My Digital Lock provides one stop solution for your Digital Lock, Laundry Hanger, Security Box, HDB Fire Rated Main Door, HDB Gate and so on. We specialise in KEYWE & EPIC Digital Lock with digital lock installation for EC Condo and BTO HDB Fire Rated main door in Singapore.

name: My First Skool
description: My First Skool (MFS) is the pioneer childcare arm of NTUC (National Trades Union Congress) First Campus Co-operative Limited. It was established as NTUC Childcare in 1977 and became a co-operative in 1992. At My First Skool, we believe that happy children are better learners and this means everything to us. Our teachers build meaningful relationships so that every child is happily engaged in the quality holistic curriculum we offer. Lessons come to life as we recreate everyday activities within and outside our learning environments. Through fun and practical real-life applications at every turn, your child discovers a world of joy and confidence at his fingertips! Give your child a quality and holistic curriculum at affordable fees, by enrolling them at the #1 most sought after preschool in Singapore!

name: Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specialises in traditional handmade pau from authentic traditional recipes of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in-house. You can also indulge yourself in a hearty serving of mee hoon kuay or ke kou mian as well as lor mai kai (glutinous rice chicken) and siew mai, just to name a few.

name: Nine Fresh
description: Nine Fresh is a home-grown brand specializing in a wide selection of chilled taro ball desserts that are freshly scooped and served daily. With 3 different types of signature bases (Bean Curd, Grass Jelly and Ai-Yu Jelly) and a huge variety of toppings such as beans, jellies as well as chewy delights (signature taro balls, mini taro Q and black pearl), they cater to different palates and preferences!

name: Nippon Home
description: Nippon Home Pte Ltd. was established in the year 2013 to provide a wide variety of quality products to customers at competitive prices. The company logo of the cherry blossom flowers symbolizes hope for the future and optimism. The color blue symbolizes trust & responsibility, similar to the concept of the business which is to create a “one stop shopping mall like” environment with good customer service that allows customers to browse, find & buy products easily allowing them to leave the shop feeling satisfied. The company aims to be responsive to the customers' needs and to gain the customers' trust in the company`s services and products. The products/merchandise of the store caters to customers of all age groups including toys, stationeries, household, electrical accessories, hardware and many more. Nippon Home Pte Ltd also includes services such as key duplication, plumbing services & handyman services.

name: NK Hairworks
description: NK Hairworks is the premier destination for exceptional scalp & hair care experiences in Singapore. With 11 conveniently located outlets islandwide, we offer a comprehensive range of services, from haircuts, colouring, perms, and rebonding to advanced hair and scalp treatments. Since 1992, we’ve built a reputation as a trusted name in Singapore’s hair industry, known for our consistent excellence and attentive service. Our team of skilled professionals is dedicated to delivering personalised, transformative experiences that leave every client feeling confident, beautiful, and truly cared for. Experience our commitment to nurturing beauty in every customer, every day.

name: Novela
description: Novela is Singapore's home-grown multi-brand beauty retail chain store. Keeping up with the latest trends, Novela aims to capture the hearts of beauty shoppers with a wide range of luxury beauty products including skin & body care, fragrances and makeup. Novela’s logo is a black quill pen, which is symbolic of a woman’s beauty, elegance and knowledge. Indeed, we believe that you can exude beauty from the inside out with the right beauty regime. By curating the best beauty brands from across the globe and offering them at affordable prices, we aim to simplify and elevate your shopping experience with premium products handpicked by us.

name: NTUC LearningHub
description: NTUC LearningHub is the leading Continuing Education and Training provider in Singapore which aims to transform the lifelong employability of working people. Since our corporatisation in 2004, we have helped over 34,000 organisations and achieved more than 3.2 million training places. As a Total Learning Solutions provider, we forge partnerships to offer a wide range of relevant end-to-end training. The NTUC LearningHub Learning eXperience Platform (LXP) — a one-stop online learning mobile application — offers timely, bite-sized and quality content to upskill anytime and anywhere. Beyond learning, LXP serves as a platform for jobs and skills development for both workers and companies.

name: OCBC
description: OCBC and its subsidiaries offer a broad array of specialist financial and wealth management services, ranging from consumer, corporate, investment, private and transaction banking to treasury, insurance, asset management and stockbroking services.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Old Chang Kee is a household name famous for it's delectable curry puffs that are filled with curried potatoes, chicken and a slice of hardboiled egg, all cooked with special herbs and spices. Other than curry puffs, Old Chang Kee also boasts spring rolls, crab claws, sotong wings and yam pies amongst it's vast product range.

name: One2Play
description: One2Play is a unique handicraft workshop space that gives you the freedom to unleash you creativity. At One2Play, you will be able to create your own personalised creations with just powder and water. This simple, fun and engaging kid-friendly process is the perfect hands-on activity for all age!

name: OneDoctors Family Clinic
description: OneDoctors will be providing medical services as a Family Clinic. As a well-established medical group with thriving practices strategically sited around the island, we aim to provide a premium medical service to the residents of Punggol and the regions beyond. Our resident doctors are mainly accredited Family Physicians with the relevant skills and professional knowledge to provide comprehensive services to every member of the nuclear family, from paediatric, adult to geriatric patients. We are a Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) clinic which provides healthcare subsidies/benefits for CHAS holders, including Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation cardholders.

name: OSIM
description: OSIM is about the experience of total well-being and living an inspiring life. We channel our Brand at every customer touch point, communicating our values through our products, our outlet, our brand image, our service excellence and in-depth knowledge of holistic health. With over 30 years of experience and uncompromising dedication in developing innovative and reliable healthy lifestyle products. OSIM is the name you can trust for a healthier lifestyle and overall well-being. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 11am - 12pm Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: Paik's Noodle
description: Bringing you hot favourites such as Jajangmyeon, Jjamppong & Tangsuyuk by South Korean Celebrity Chef Paik Jong Won! Known in its homeland as “Hong Kong Banjeom 0410,” Paik’s Noodle is a culinary hotspot launched in 2006, in Seoul to provide the best flavours, recipes, and sauces by sustaining the real essence of a Korean Chinese restaurant. Paik's Noodle serves a variety of authentic Korean-Chinese dishes like Jjamppong (a hot, flavourful seafood noodle soup), and Paik’s Signature Tangsuyuk (crispy sweet and sour pork) with both being perfect options for sharing with friends or family. Spicy food lovers will love the spice in Jjamppong while kids would love the sweetness and crispness from Tangsuyuk.

name: Pandora
description: Discover hand-finished quality jewellery and beautiful new designs with endless styling opportunities for personal expression. Choose from our range of charms, bracelets, rings, earrings, necklaces, and pendants. Find the perfect gift for yourself or that someone special. A universe of jewellery awaits you.

name: Pasta Play
description: Best Pasta In Singapore

name: Pezzo
description: Welcome to Pezzo where every pizza has its own unique character and taste. Meet Big Daddy, Meat Munchers or Garlic Chick for a novel way of enjoying some scrumptious tasting pizzas on-the-go!

name: Pictureland
description: Established in 2002, the company offers a wide range of services from canvas prints to personalised gift items and many more, as a one-stop service for all your photography and printing needs. The printing services include custom products from t-shirts to mugs and even calendars, as great choices for oneself, as a gift, or for corporate use.

name: PINC
description: PINC is the leading local nail specialist in the beauty and wellness industry. We strive to beautify the world through care and cosmetics. Our loyal and efficient beauticians ensure that customers will be treated with the best care. Some of the services rendered include Nail Care, Body Waxing, Eye Brow Shaping, Facials and Eyebrow Extensions.

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Expect a leisure pedicure and manicure spa, or simply an afternoon of escape to beautify your nails with an exceptional customer service and high standards of hygiene practices in a relaxing ambience of cosiness, complemented with soothing music and variety options of treatments that is a perfect venue for an affordable indulgence. Not only you can get to beautify your nails, you can leave your eyelash, eyebrow, lips and many many more to us! A salient feature of Pixie Nail Spa is never to compromise on hygiene practices. All equipment used are sanitised, placed in a sanitising pouch and subsequently kept in a UV Steriliser before using it on our clients. Our experienced manicurists are trained with our standard operating procedures and are sent to specific courses to ensure that they are competent before being assigned to meet our clients’ nail spa treatment requirements.

name: Pizza Hut
description: Home of the Original Pan Pizza, Pizza Hut Singapore is now the largest pizza chain restaurant in Singapore with 77 outlets. Started in 1981 with our first Singapore outlet in Jalan Jelita,, we have an unmatched passion for and celebration of our pizzas. We aim to deliver not just a wide array of pizzas, pastas and other quality foods that are always fresh, but also a casual atmosphere that is fun and friendly. All these without compromising what good restaurants have always stood for service and customer satisfaction

name: Playdress
description: With accessible price points and an extensive assortment of fashion-forward styles, PLAYDRESS celebrates confidence, imperfection and inclusivity. From wardrobe essentials to smart casual, PLAYDRESS has something for every mood, every occasion and every BODY.

name: PlayFACTO School
description: PlayFACTO School is Singapore's leading student care and enrichment brand. With 52 beautiful centres island-wide, PlayFACTO School provides its students with an increased capacity and a strong foundation into effective learning. Offering a premium curriculum, award winning interior design comfort, healthy and nutritious, MSG-free meals and a low teacher-student class ratio for more personalised attention, PlayFACTO School is the only school with Positive Psychology instilled into its curriculum that focuses on wellness and resilience, resulting in happy, confident children. Our Coding & Robotics curriculum teaches young students to become inventors learning to code easily, have fun seeing their coding take shape into robotics and learn techniques & solutions for the real world. Join us for a day of inventing and fun. Our unique Creative Math enrichment programme utilizes a fun, play-based learning approach. Through highly interactive and engaging, hands-on activities, our young students build the cognitive framework for a lifetime of success in Math.

name: PlayMade
description: PlayMade has captivated the hearts of tea enthusiasts with our commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. Our handcrafted bubble tea has become a beloved destination for those seeking imaginative and flavourful tea creations. Without the use of additives or preservatives, our bobas exemplify freshness. The result? Bobas that are not only delicious but also healthier, offering a delightful bounce and exceptional flavour.

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Polar prides itself for its long and rich heritage as a three-generation-old family business that has been faithfully serving consistent quality products to its customers since 1926.

name: Popular
description: As a homegrown brand, POPULAR Bookstore’s success over the past century is a testament to the trust and support of generations of Singaporeans. From our early days serving the educational needs of young minds, we expanded our offerings to include a wide range of reading and learning materials, continually evolving to meet the changing needs of our shoppers. Today, our stores are a one-stop retail destination, offering everything from Gadgets & IT products to lifestyle gifts, toys, and more.

name: POSB Bank
description: POSB's first priority is helping you and your family save for the future. Join their community, share your journey with them, because "we’re neighbours first, bankers second."

name: PrimaDéli
description: PrimaDéli serves all-time favourites that everyone loves and enjoys. With an extensive selection of premium quality cakes and scrumptious treats, signature products include Chicken Pie, Egg Tart, Singapore Curry Puff, Premium Pandan Chiffon, Mango Delight Cake as well as their immensely popular Waffles.

name: Punggol Exchange
description: Punggol Exchange is your premier destination for hassle-free currency exchange services. At Punggol Exchange, we pride ourselves on offering competitive exchange rates and a seamless customer experience.

name: PUTIEN
description: PUTIEN serves cuisine from the Fujian Province in China: characteristically light, down-to-earth, and flavourful food with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Signatures like Fujian Red Mushroom Seafood Lor Mee, ‘100-Second’ Stewed Yellow Croaker and PUTIEN Bian Rou Soup showcase the culinary richness of Fujianese cuisine that will fill your stomach and heart.

name: QB House Kids
description: QB HOUSE is the pioneer in quick-cut from Japan, founded in 1995. They made their name in Singapore and became known for giving quick, efficient haircuts in 2005. QB House's mission is to provide the value of “Time”. They do not provide shampooing, coloring or perming services. Their original air vacuum washer is used to replace shampooing, which is highly efficient and time saving. QB House aim to save our customers’ time such that they can enjoy more of their private time.

name: Raffles Medical / Raffles Children's Centre
description: Raffles Medical Raffles Medical is the primary care network of Raffles Medical Group, which operates over 40 family medicine clinics in Singapore. On top of managing common ailments, we offer a comprehensive range of primary healthcare services including management of chronic conditions, health screening and health checks, travel medicine, vaccinations, workplace consultancy, and emergency services at selected clinics. Key services include: Family medicine Health screening Travel medicine Student checkup Statutory health check Advance Medical Directive (AMD) Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) Raffles Children’s Centre Bringing Raffles Children's Centre’s one-stop paediatric centre to where your family lives and plays, we offer services ranging from general paediatric medicine to sub-specialty care, supporting your child’s physical and developmental health from newborn care through to developmental assessments. With busy working parents in mind, we offer extended operating hours on evenings and weekends for their convenience. Key services include: Urgent care and common childhood conditions Infant and newborn care Baby and child vaccinations Atopic condition management Developmental and behavioural assessments Nutritional advice

name: Red Ginger Coffeehouse
description: Red Ginger Coffeehouse is the evolved expression of our beloved culinary journey, crafted by a passionate team of food enthusiasts with over two decades of experience in the F&B industry. Building on the legacy of Red Ginger & Rumah Sayang, we now bring a fresh and modern take to our cherished Malaysian and local Singaporean favorites. We have been dedicated to delivering authentic halal cuisine with an elevated touch—offering a nuanced blend of tradition and contemporary culinary refinement. Our focus remains on signature dishes like Nasi Padang and local wok specialties, prepared using traditional techniques with a modern presentation and improved service that elevates your dining experience. Red Ginger Coffeehouse is where familiar flavors meet modern sophistication—offering slightly higher quality ingredients and a welcoming ambiance that invites you to indulge without the high-end price tag. Join us to rediscover classic tastes, reimagined for today’s discerning palate.

name: Sanook Kitchen
description: Come to Sanook Kitchen and savour a wide variety of authentic Thai food classics ranging from appetisers, soup, curries to seafood and more at wallet-friendly prices!

name: Scarlett
description: Scarlett Supermarket is the leading one-stop supermarket which sells an extensive range of popular Chinese snacks, dried goods, necessities and beverages imported directly from China. One can find household names like Hai Chi Jia Suan La Fen, Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea and Tsingtao Beer at the most affordable prices islandwide here.

name: Sciencewerkz by Stalford
description: At Stalford Learning Centre, they aim to provide quality education and excellent service to all our students, assisting them in realising their dreams. Our proven teachers and proven methods will help you obtain proven results. Throughout the years, Stalford Learning Centre has strived to bring nothing short of excellence for our students, be it our strong team of over 600 qualified tutors, friendly and efficient staff, carefully aligned curriculum, a conducive and mentally-stimulating environment, and the best teaching materials. With the support of believers of our pedagogy, Stalford Learning Centre has successfully expanded from a mere outlet to a full-fledged education chain with 20 branches islandwide.

name: Scoop Wholefoods Australia
description: Scoop Wholefoods offers a wide variety of healthy, raw and natural wholefoods in an environmentally responsible manner at affordable prices. Our products are mainly sourced from Australia and New Zealand growers and we make every effort to ensure that they come from sustainable origins. We offer wide range of unpackaged goods and organic products including nuts, seeds, healthy treats and snacks, grains, pulses, spices, granolas, teas, chocolates and a lot more. We also offer Australia Raw Honey, organic Kombucha on Tap and variety of fresh nut butters made in store. In an enclosed area in the store, you will also find chemical-free household cleaning and personal hygiene products in bulk such as soaps, salts, shampoos and conditioners.

name: Shaw Theatres
description: Shaw Theatres continues to entertain movie lovers in Singapore with the latest cinema technologies. From Hollywood blockbusters to local productions, you are guaranteed a movie experience like no other. Houses 10 screens plus one IMAX theatre, right to the doorsteps of residents in the North-East of Singapore.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food
description: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food® is everybody's favorite Taiwanese food chain featuring popular snacks from the alleys of Taiwan's night markets. Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shugar Spa
description: Shugar Spa, a 100% homegrown brand founded by the mother-daughter duo, Jenny and Lynn. Shugar Spa strives to bring quality and delicate top-to-toe services for the everyday woman seeking a place to relax and be pampered. At the same time, doing our utmost to create a welcoming, family-friendly, and pressure-free salon experience — treating you the same way we’d want to be treated ourselves. So whether you’re looking to give your nails the royal treatment, unwind with a soothing facial or simply keep yourself looking fab — you can be sure of specialized services performed by experienced local therapists who will have you melting in their hands. And with a large variety of treatments available, we’ll have you covered for all your beauty needs.

name: Singtel Exclusive Retailer
description: A brand new concept to discover new possibilities of leading edge integrated services and solutions in an immersive environment, build a personal interest and complete transactions end-to-end with dedicated Sales Specialists. Check out the new, experiential journey at Singtel Shop Waterway Point, #B1-30 from Mondays to Sundays, 11 am to 9 pm!

name: Sinjojo
description: Sinjojo is a brand that embodies a specific concept and mindset that emphasizes self-love, strength, and courage. They offer a range of high-quality products at affordable prices, catering to women of various age groups. Their collections are designed to provide a distinct and versatile style that complements everyday outfits.

name: SK Jewellery
description: SK Jewellery was created with the belief that the beauty, luxury and allure of high-quality jewellery be made accessible to all women. With the belief that you deserve to shine, every piece of jewellery is meaningfully conceptualised and beautifully crafted. Unparalleled in design excellence and innovation, SK Jewellery is the contemporary jeweller known for its high quality and exquisite jewellery.

name: Skechers
description: Our story begins in a California beach house, where Skechers was born as a utility boot and became an icon of the grunge era. More than 25 years later, we’ve evolved into a footwear powerhouse with styles for men, women and kids around the world.

name: SkinLab The Medical Spa
description: At SkinLab The Medical Spa, we believe good skin is the foundation of beauty. We are rooted in science-based research and strive to create skincare solutions to help you look good and feel good, no matter your stage in life.

name: SKP
description: The largest supplier of Disposable Food Packaging and party supplies in Singapore, SKP is the one-stop destination for all packaging and party needs. With a global reach in over 20 countries, SKP has committed itself to engaging in more sustainable packaging solutions without compromising quality through their eco-friendly disposable food packaging series – EcoVue.

name: SL Aesthetic Clinic
description: SL Aesthetic Clinic offers a continuously updated array of minimal to noninvasive FDA-approved, CE-marked, and HSA-approved medical aesthetic treatments in Singapore. We hope to empower you to live amply, feel confident, and be the best version of yourself.

name: Smile Doctor Dentalcare @ Punggol Waterway
description: Our goal here at Smile Doctor is to set the standard of 21st century by placing extra emphasis on high tech, high quality dentistry, comprehensive and friendly care. Top procedures are dental implant, orthodontic and aesthetic dentistry.

name: snacKING Retro Biscuits
description: Snack your way through a day with snacKING Retro Biscuits, a taste worth remembering. Have been searching high and low for the particular snack that used to be widely available while growing up but unable to find it anymore? Wondered how play time was before technology gadgets took over? With a large varieties of old school biscuits, snacks, candies and toys, there is always options to fulfil your snacking or party needs. Relive your childhood memories with old school biscuits, snacks, sweets and toys with snacKING Retro Biscuits!

name: So Do Fun
description: Specializing in "Boiled Live Fish" as its signature dish, SO DO FUN is a popular Sichuan restaurant chain renowned for its "fresh ingredients prepared on-site." With just this one handcrafted boiled live fish dish, it has remained popular for 18 years, operating nearly 100 direct stores across China, Singapore, and Malaysia. For years, it has consistently ranked among the top three on regional Sichuan cuisine lists and dominated as the No. 1 popular Sichuan brand in various markets. It was listed on the "Dianping Must-Eat List" in 2018 and 2023. For 18 years, SODOFUN has used fresh ingredients.

name: So Pho
description: So Pho's cuisine captures the true flavor of traditional Vietnamese cuisine like no other restaurant in Singapore. In So Pho, we offer wide range of food offerings from across Vietnam. Take your pick from spring rolls, to noodles and banh mi as well as other main dishes and desserts.

name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh
description: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh have come a long way from one food cart on the street. Yet their pushcart icon reminds us what they are about, an original Bak Kut Teh experience: tender, fall-off-the-bone pork ribs; hot, flavourful, spicy-peppery soup; a 1960s roadside dining ambience. At Song Fa, the heritage of Bak Kut Teh lives on in its truest sense.eritage of good old Bak Kut Teh in it's truest sense.

name: Sorella
description: Sorella believes in treasuring and celebrating every woman's innate femininity. We aim to highlight and enhance your natural beauty and sexy curves with our high quality lingerie, which provide unparalleled support, superior shaping, desired toning and overall flawlessness. Cherish yourself with Sorella and unveil your true feminine allure. Discover, indulge in your body and love yourself entirely through our premium lingerie.

name: Sparkle
description: Sparkle was established in 2019 and have a wide range of products such as gifts, stationery, toys, electronic accessories, party accessories, and other trendy products. Our target segment focuses on the younger spectrum - toddlers, children, adolescents, and young working adults. Sparkle is managed by a young, dynamic, and dedicated team with coverage over the brand's in-house sourcing, merchandising, design, and logistics.

name: Spectacle Hut
description: Spectacle Hut is your partner for all things eye care. We prioritise your eye health by providing quality vision care and tailored solutions to you, your families and friends. We offer extensive range of eyewear product from fast fashion to luxury brands and wide selection of prescriptive lens solution for different needs. Visit us today to find your favourite pair, with complimentary eye screening.

name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Stellar
description: Stellar is Number one Ear Piercing in Singapore. Ear piercing is an important milestone for all young girls and we want to be the one to witness and celebrate this milestone. Every piercing done with us will be given a ‘Piercing Certificate’ to commemorate this special occasion. Through our vast retail experience in the jewellery industry, we identify the importance of providing products that are "reliable", "safe" and "sterile". Stellar is committed to providing a wide range of fashionable hypo-allergenic jewellery that is suitable for all skin types. Our diverse range of jewellery selection across all stores will surely suit your personal preference for all age groups. We provide a safe and sterile piercing service that is desirable for sensitive skin. Using the most advanced technology from the USA and highest quality jewellery, we create a memorable piercing milestone for both parents and their kids. Our piercing studs present high grade material, ranging from medical grade titanium, 14 karat and 18 karat gold. With our enhanced aftercare solution, our team goes the extra mile to ensure customers understand the importance and how-to care for the newly pierced ears. Stellar provides 2 complimentary aftercare consultations service within 2 months to monitor your piercing's healing process. Aftercare is an important step to ensure that your piercing is healing well to achieve that beautiful look. Our technicians are here to help you in every step of your piercing journey from choosing design to the healing aftercare process. STELLAR RECORDS MORE THAN 10,000 PIERCINGS ANNUALLY! Our experienced technicians are able to provide you with the best advice on the most suitable ear piercing studs and ear piercing positions regardless of shapes and sizes of your earlobes. Let us introduce our yearly ‘Stellar Girl’ campaign! ‘Piercing with confidence at Stellar’ Started in 2018, to encourage children to feel more confident to pierce. Each year has a creative theme in order to make it a fun and fulfilling experience for the kids. The winner will also be the face of the brand for the entire year. With service excellence, we create trustworthy relationships with customers and henceforth being recognised as the most preferred piercing in Singapore. We look towards continuous improvement to enhance every customer experience and satisfaction!

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a fast casual kiosk chain focused on Mexican and Turkish takeaways. Serving exceptionally tasty burritos and kebabs, the food is made and prepared fresh daily, right in front of you. The made to order flow allows you to choose whichever toppings you like, and their succulent grilled chicken is remarkably tasty as it is healthy. With its energetic customer base which swears by the food, many have invented their own secret menu of their favorite food combination. Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

name: Subway
description: SUBWAY® is the undisputed leader in fast, healthy food. Our easy-to-prepare sandwiches are made to order right in front of the customer, precisely the way they want – using freshly baked breads, select sauces and a variety of delicious toppings.

name: SUKIYA
description: SUKIYA is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant with over 2,600 locations across the world. Founded in 1982 in Yokohama, our mission is to serve authentic Japanese food with reliable quality at affordable prices throughout the world.

name: Sushi Express
description: One of the biggest conveyor belt sushi brands in Asia, offering more than 80 different variations of sushi from $1.50++ per plate. At Sushi Express, we understand that it’s not always about value when it comes to serving our customers, it is about consistently providing quality and innovative products competitively.

name: Sushiro
description: SUSHIRO is Japan’s number 1 kaiten sushi chain. With more than 670 outlets in Japan and other countries, Sushiro serves over 100 varieties of delicious sushi and Japanese dishes to about 150 million customers every year. With the core corporate mission, “Tasty Sushi for All. Tasty Sushi for the Heart.” Sushiro maintains its key focus on careful ingredient selection, constant development of new flavours, employment of advanced technology to enhance service quality and is committed to serving high-quality and value-for-money Japanese sushi to customers.

name: Swensen's
description: Swensen’s is synonymous with sweet celebrations enjoyed together with loved ones for all occasions. A delectable tradition treasured by families. Swensen's is Singapore’s Family Restaurant of Choice, championing bonding over food, serving families & ice cream cakes since 1979.

name: Tai Chong Kok
description: At Tai Chong Kok, we have been making mooncakes and traditional Cantonese pastries the same way since 1935 - from scratch and by hand. For 3 generations we have used only premium ingredients to produce our authentic Cantonese confectionary. Tai Chong Kok mooncakes are renowned for their genuine taste of tradition. We are one of the very few bakeries left in Singapore that still produce our fresh lotus paste by hand using 100% pure lotus seeds with no preservatives added and these fill mooncakes that are formed in the same traditional wooden moulds used at the original Sago Street store in Chinatown more than 89 years ago. Today, you can still bring home our mooncakes in stringed brown paper bags, just as our forefathers did in pre-war Singapore. Tai Chong Kok is also famed for our traditional Nian Gao (Chinese New Year's cake) that are made using 100% pure glutinous rice. Tai Chong Kok products are handmade and baked daily with no preservative added in Singapore using time-honoured recipes and quality ingredients with full conformity to Stringent Quality Standards of SFA, HACCP and BizSafe.

name: Talad Thai Banana
description: Talad Thai Banana is an Authentic Thai recipe crafted with love. Our unique batter is made from the freshest ingredients prepared daily with love and good intentions. All products are vegetarian friendly and in fresh batches daily!

name: The Body Shop
description: We believe there is only one way to beautiful, nature’s way. We’ve believed this for years and still do. We constantly seek out wonderful natural ingredients from all four corners of the globe, and we bring you products bursting with effectiveness to enhance your natural beauty and express your unique personality. And whilst we’re doing this, we always strive to protect this beautiful planet and the people who depend on it. We don’t do it this way because it’s fashionable. We do it because, to us, it’s the only way

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
description: A premium coffee and tea retailer that offers an extensive variety of expertly crafted beverages, freshly baked pastries, delectable cakes, and party packs. Their whole cakes are perfect for any occasion, and their e-card program rewards loyal customers.

name: The Green Party PRO
description: The Green Party was established in 2014, mainly focusing on trendy household goods that pursue a green & nature lifestyle. They offer a diverse selection of stylish and innovative green products designed to enhance their lifestyles. The Green Party PRO will be their latest concept.

name: The Pet Safari
description: It's going to get awfully fun! Step into any The Pet Safari outlet and it'll be like stepping into a theme park. Each one is special so you'll never get the same experience, even if you end up visiting all of them. And it has everything your pet needs under one roof; grooming services, pet care consultants, training classes, pet cafes and bakeries, and over 14,000 products to choose from!

name: The Wallet Shop
description: The Wallet Shop houses a wide range of products that inspires style and character. Shelves are filled with products from established brands such as Bellroy, Cabin Zero, Crossing, Doughnut, Jansport, LOQI, Thule and many more, you’ll definitely be spoilt for choice. Bringing you only the best. The Wallet Shop is the one stop destination for all your pocket needs.

name: THEFACESHOP
description: THEFACESHOP is a leading global beauty retail brand offering over 1,000 quality products for skin care, body care, hair care and makeup.

name: THEGREYSPACE.CO
description: THEGREYSPACE.CO is a concept store that offers minimalist products at an affordable price. We curate our products to be functional and affordable without compromising on quality. The brand carries an extensive range of products, ranging from bag to faux leather pouches and more! Our product line includes an exclusive range of self-manufactured bags. If you're looking for something more personalized, we offer monogramming services for our products (selected range) as well!

name: Thomson Paediatric Centre & Thomson Chinese Medicine
description: Thomson Paediatric Centre Thomson Paediatric Centre is dedicated to providing medical care and services for newborns, infants and children. The clinic offers a full range of paediatric services including general paediatric care, developmental assessments, treatment of asthma and allergy, nutrition and growth as well as adolescent health. Thomson Chinese Medicine Started in 2009, Thomson Chinese Medicine (a subsidiary of Thomson Medical Group) is dedicated to providing quality TCM care for the family. We meet the different health needs of adults and children in areas including cough and allergies, pain management, children’s health, fertility support and confinement herbs.

name: Thomson Women’s Clinic
description: At Thomson Women’s Clinics, we are committed to providing modern and comprehensive care for women of all ages. Our experienced team of O&G specialists is dedicated to creating a caring environment where your health and well-being are our top priorities. Our specialists provide specialised services on preventive measures, accurate diagnosis, and personalised treatment plans. Whether you need specialised care for women-related conditions or navigating the journey of childbirth, seeking support for family planning and fertility treatments, or requiring compassionate care through menopause, we are here for you.

name: Tim Ho Wan
description: Best known for serving up quality authentic Hong Kong Dim Sum at affordable prices, Tim Ho Wan started off as a ‘hole-in-the-wall’ eatery in Hong Kong and slowly earned many praises through its accolades of refined flavours and taste consistency. Tim Ho Wan’s Hong Kong flagship restaurant at Sham Shui Po has been awarded with One Michelin Star for 11 consecutive years from 2010 to 2021. Prepared daily in-house and cooked only upon order to ensure freshness of Dim Sum and Mains, some of Tim Ho Wan’s award-winning favourites are its signature Baked BBQ Pork Buns, Pork & Shrimp Dumplings, Pork Congee with Century & Salted Eggs, Glutinous Rice wrapped in Lotus Leaf and Hong Kong Braised Beef Noodles. The crown jewel of Tim Ho Wan goes to their acclaimed Baked BBQ Pork Buns. Known for its fluffy baked buns with crumbly-crisp exterior skin, coupled with oozing barbequed pork char siew fillings, its winning-formula promises a unique bite texture and imparts a comforting sweet-salty flavour finish.

name: Timezone
description: Looking for fun activities to do this weekend? Try Timezone. Whether you're a kid or an adult, Timezone will provide you with endless entertainment! Timezone is the ultimate destination for your daily dose of happiness and unforgettable celebrations. Visit our upsized venue at #02-19, now with a larger space, more games, and two party rooms perfect for any special occasion.

name: Tokyo Shokudo
description: Tokyo Shokudo is a “No Pork No Lard” Japanese dining concept offering an extensive selection of popular and trendy Japanese food like Ramen, Tendon (tempura donburi), Shabu Shabu, Sukiyaki and Rice Sets. Look forward to three exciting Ramen soup bases – Original, Tom Yam and Spicy! Tendon is from award-winning Chef Akimitsu, a five-time gold medalist at Japan Donburi Awards.

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated "Tare" (sauce) for enhanced flavour.

name: Towkay Kia
description: Our passion for perfecting kopi runs deep in our roots. Every cup is freshly brewed, with beans ground in-house and crafted using the traditional 'pull' technique. Today, Towkay Kia continues to serve authentic, time-honored beverages — now with a modern twist.

name: Toys 'R' Us
description: Positioned as 'the Worldwide authority on kids, families and fun', Toys''R''Us is the largest child-related product specialty chain store in the world. Toys''R''Us believes in providing a happy shopping experience to customers with the biggest selection of toys and baby products priced to offer best value for money. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Twenty Loaf Toasties
description: Twenty Loaf Toasties serves made-to-order grilled toasts loaded with fresh ingredients! Try our signature Cheesy Bakkwa Toasties: generous portions of sweet and savoury Chicken Bakkwa and Floss.

name: umisushi
description: Since 2008, umisushi's Japanese quick-service concept offers delicious and nutritious meals like sushi, sashimi, donburi, bento sets and Japanese salads enjoy by customers of all ages. Currently, umisushi has 15 outlets conveniently located island-wide. We also provide delivery service for you to enjoy a fuss-free meal at the comfort of their home, corporate event and celebration!

name: Under Armour
description: Global sportswear brand for your performance needs.

name: UNIQLO
description: About UNIQLO LifeWear - Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. A perfect shirt that is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hiding the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people’s lives.

name: United Overseas Bank
description: UOB is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 470 branches and offices in 19 markets in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Guided by our values and supported by our fundamental strengths, we focus on supporting our customers as we drive performance across our franchise.

name: Unity Pharmacy
description: Originally established in 1992, Unity Pharmacy's mission is to improve the health and total well-being of its customers by being the most professional pharmacy chain while delivering the highest level of customer satisfaction at the most competitive prices. There are currently some 60 Unity Pharmacy stores island-wide, which offer a wide range of health supplements, healthcare and skincare products, medicines and first aid items. Pharmacists are trained to give professional advice on health concerns, and can help in services such as dispensing of medication, medication reviews, advice on chronic disease management and drug interaction.

name: Valu$
description: Valu$ delivers exactly what the brand suggest, Value for Money! They offer a wide range of lifestye and home living products at highly affordable prices.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty is your go-to destination for quality beauty and household cleaning products at unbeatable prices. Explore our curated selection of skincare, haircare, and cosmetics, alongside an array of effective household cleaning essentials. Discover a diverse range of beauty items, from skincare and cosmetics to haircare essentials, all designed to make you feel radiant without breaking the bank. Indulge in a delightful shopping experience where affordability meets quality. From skincare essentials to household must-haves, Venus Beauty is your one-stop destination for budget friendly beauty and cleaning solutions. Elevate your routine without compromising your budget – Visit Venus Beauty today and experience the joy of affordable excellence.

name: Victoria Facelift
description: The UK anti-wrinkle and sagging expert: Victoria Facelift is here to clear all your ageing skin woes. Targeting to help you solve all wrinkle problems and gets rid of crow’s feet, forehead lines, droopy face, double chin, sagging cheeks, loose Jowl, nasolabial folds and more. Victoria Facelift can help you regain a youthful appearance with our unique signature UK Power-Facelift Treatment.

name: VS Salon Hairdressing Spa
description: VS Salon Hairdressing Spa gives customers the most spacious, private space, a mixture of classic, trendy and spa-welcoming environment. The store has 3 departments: the classic for haircut sections, the trendy for colouring/ chemical area and spa area for the treatments. On hand to service you is our international highly-skilled, multi awards winning service oriented crew.

name: Wacoal
description: Wacoal is Japan’s leading creator of intimate apparel for women. Our goal has always been to contribute to the society by helping women everywhere become more beautiful.

name: Wanglu Hot Pot
description: Wanglu Hot Pot is a steamboat restaurant that allows every customers to have their own pot for cooking. Its vision is to offer high quality food and service to customers of all ages. With a focus on hygiene and a comfortable dining environment, along with a wide variety of soup bases, Wang Lu will definitely satisfy your hot pot cravings.

name: Warabimochi Kamakura
description: Explore Warabimochi Kamakura for a genuine slice of Japan with their exquisite Warabimochi and creative Warabimochi Drinks. Each offering is a contemporary take on classic tastes, designed for the sophisticated palate. Warabimochi Kamakura provides a distinctive gastronomic adventure where tradition blends with modernity. Experience the fusion of time-honoured flavours and innovative craftsmanship with every visit.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons is Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer with close to 100 stores islandwide. Watsons seeks to bring ‘more’ to customers’ lives by inspiring and enabling every customer to look good and feel great. Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

name: Wen Zhang Lao Mian
description: Wen Zhang Lao Mian, a specialist in noodle making and soup development, was established in China in 2017. Over the years, our brand has become well-known. Our goal is to provide a unique dining experience and a comforting atmosphere for all our customers. Among our most beloved noodle dishes are Spicy Beef Noodle, Tomato Soup with Fried Pork, Herbal Soup with Braised Pork, Soup Spicy Fish, and Golden Fish Soup. In addition to noodles, we offer a variety of fried rice, Chinese dishes, and enticing desserts.

name: White Restaurant
description: Welcome to White Restaurant, home to The Original Sembawang White Beehoon – an iconic truly-Singaporean delicacy, alongside renowned dishes like Hainanese Chicken Rice and Chilli Crab. Our founder, Mr Tay, originally crafted this comforting dish, which has since captured the hearts of many. The Original Sembawang White Beehoon stands out with its exceptional flavours and distinctiveness. It has earned its own identity and holds a special place in the hearts of food enthusiasts. While many have tried to imitate our signature dish, none can match its unparalleled taste. That’s why we have rebranded ourselves as White Restaurant, symbolizing the heritage and uniqueness of The Original White Beehoon.

name: Wok Hey
description: Masters of stir fry ⋅ Lovers of wok hey. Wok Hey serve the best rice and noodles in town. Cos' they just love stir fry.

name: XGEAR
description: XGEAR - A lifestyle retail store who offers the latest gadgets in the market, Quality audio products and High-end phone cases. Our Specialty is on portable Audio, headphone and earphone. We carry a wide range of audiophile earphones brands in the market and we do offer a non obligation audition on all products. We strongly believe every customer is different and the only way to get the right audio product is to try them on!

name: Xiaomi
description: Xiaomi to-date has created remarkable hardware, software, and internet services. expanding its footprint across the world to become a global brand. Experience its range of Xiaomi smartphones, AIoT, ecosystem and lifestyle products today!

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.

name: Yolé
description: Yole created probably the best ice cream and frozen yogurt in the world without adding any sugar. Yolé products are full of taste, delicious, low in calories and 0% sugar added. You can enjoy different flavours, and formats like cups, waffles, cones or shakes. Yole brings happiness around the world.

name: Young Hearts
description: The Young Hearts brand is fun-loving, high-spirited, feminine and young. They are passionate about living a quality life and hence, support and encourage this by creating and producing products with great attention to research, design, detail, variety and quality. They have a wide selection of daily essential lingerie products to whimsical sleepwear and fun lifestyle products. Young Hearts hope to inspire everyone who comes into contact with us to love life with passion, confidence and enjoyment!

name: ZTP Ginseng Birdnest
description: ZTP is one of the largest health food retail chains in Singapore. We are also one of the largest bottled Bird's Nest manufacturers in Singapore. Our range of products include bird's nest, Australian abalone, Japanese scallops, Mushroom, Ginseng, Cordyceps and many more.

name: 108 Matcha Saro
description: 108 Matcha Saro ensures only quality ingredients and premium matcha dessert to be served. It is also a vegetarian friendly option and does not consist of pork, lard and alcohol which makes it suitable for people of different dietary needs and preferences to enjoy their wide range of sweet offerings.

name: 4FINGERS Crispy Chicken
description: At 4FINGERS, we're nuts about chicken. So when we discovered the Best Korean crispy chicken in New York City's grungy subway scene, we knew we had to share it. And so began the revolution of crispy chicken. Spicy, crispy, unique and downright addictive - it's chicken that's so good, it's bad. And there are thousands who would agree with us.

name: CHURN
description: At CHURNº, we believe ice cream should be anything but ordinary. Handcrafted in small batches, our scoops churn bold flavours, nostalgic twists, and unexpected combos into pure joy. It’s more than dessert —it’s a vibe.

name: Plum Village
description: Plum Village（梅莊） gives classic plum snacks a fresh, modern twist. Carefully selected and thoughtfully crafted, our plums and dried fruits are all about natural flavours, clean ingredients, and feel-good indulgence. Perfect for everyday treats or easy gifting, Plum Village turns simple snacking into something a little more special — naturally good, beautifully done.

name: ALLU
description: ALLU’s role is to evaluate each luxury item’s potential value and recognize the memories and emotions put into them, then pass them onto the next owner in its true form. Instead of disposing of these luxury items, we give them a new breath of life and play a part in creating a more suitable world. At ALLU, we are passionate about buying your pre-owned luxury items. Sell your pre-loved luxury items conveniently with ALLU.

name: ALUXE
description: As the leading jewelry brand in Taiwan, ALUXE embodies the perfect combination of happiness and jewelry. Whether you are experiencing a wonderful relationship, expressing your feelings to your loved one, or wanting to pamper yourself, ALUXE looks forward to offering you the perfect experience.

name: AMACHA 阿嬷茶语
description: Singapore’s first herbal milk tea brand, Amacha blends Traditional Chinese herbs with modern milk tea culture to create comforting, wellness-inspired beverages for the new generation. Each cup is a tribute to grandma’s timeless recipes — brewed with care, balance, and a touch of nostalgia.

name: Amore Fitness
description: Amore Fitness is the leading fitness gym in Singapore providing unique state-of-the-art gym equipment specially designed for women. The brand is constantly evolving to encourage self-discovery, seek inspiration and to inspire and find fulfilment in life. For over 30 years, with a strong following of customers from all walks of life, Amore Fitness Group is more than a holistic and innovative approach to fitness and healthy living. Expect a combination of affordable world class gym facilities, and over 500 fitness and dance classes, including its six signature classes: BellyBlitz®, BollyBlitz®, CardioLatino®, FunkBlitz®, KickBlitz®, and StretchFit®. Be revived in a haven of serenity with Amore Define. Guests can experience Amore’s five-star spa facilities and an endless selection of quality face and body treatments to indulge in total body rejuvenation. Let your beauty glow from within.

name: An Açaí Affair
description: An Acai Affair serves organic açaí in the purest and least diluted form. Their blend consists only of fresh organic lemons and a small amount of organic coconut nectar, a natural sugar low in the glycemic index. Since they do not add any artificial liquids, this means that thier açaí bowls have one of the lowest calories and sugars per serving, making it even better for your body. To ensure freshness and quality, they work directly with the local communities who wild harvest the açaí. Their single-origin açaí berries are handpicked from the region of Cametá, in Pará.

name: Anothersole
description: Anothersole focuses on providing socially conscious footwear for the modern woman. Parisian designed with style and comfort in mind, Anothersole’s genuine leather flats are crafted with premium materials and an ergonomic footbed for maximum everyday comfort. We believe in honest pricing and are dedicated to giving back to the community. Anothersole's #Buy1Feed1 initiative donates 10% of their profit towards feeding hungry children in third world countries, a cause near and dear to the brand’s “sole”.

name: ANTA
description: ANTA is a global sports brand that was established in 1991. Its Singapore collection is centered around basketball, running, and training (think cross-training and gym shoes and apparel). With the motto "Keep Moving," ANTA aims to make sports accessible to everyone, whether you are a professional athlete or a weekend warrior, so that you can continue pursuing it for life. If you’d like to maintain a regular running routine and meet other runners while at it, consider joining The ANTA Running Tribe, where weekly social runs are organized with bag storage available.

name: Anthony Hair Boutique
description: Anthony Hair Boutique is a Singapore based chain salon founded by Singapore celebrity stylist, Mr Anthony Tang, since 2005. With 30 years of experience in the hair dressing industry, Anthony and his team of talents now have a following among the locals, socialites and expatriates in Singapore with his unique creativity.

name: Apgujeong Hair Studio
description: From hair styling to makeup by international award-winning stylists. Buzzing with energy and enthusiasm, our stylists continually undertake regular training in Korea and are constantly in the know with the latest trends and techniques to offer. At Apgujeong Hair Salon, we always like to go the extra mile. Thanks to our beliefs on the creative talents who share the same friendly nature, profound knowledge and exceptional love of their craft.

name: Awfully Chocolate
description: Awfully Chocolate brings the humble cake back to its glory days! With an exquisite product line including the Super Stacked Cake, White Chocolate Creme Brulee Tart and Salted Butterscotch Brownie, you’ll be spoiled for choice.

name: Bank Of China
description: Established on 15 June 1936, Bank of China Singapore Branch holds the Qualifying Full Bank License (QFB) in Singapore. It has a network of five sub-branches and one remittance centre. With over 70 years of presence in the local banking industry, leveraging on the Group's extensive global network and team of experienced professionals, Bank of China Singapore Branch provides a full range of financial services to its customers from Singapore, China as well as the surrounding region. Over the years, it has demonstrated its long-term commitment to promote bilateral economic and trade relations between China and Singapore. The main businesses of Bank of China Singapore Branch include corporate banking, retail banking, trade financing and international trade settlement, with specialized knowledge and expertise in China-related trade financing and settlements, and remittance services.

name: Bari Bari Steak
description: A concept from Hong Kong that celebrates the art of teppan cuisine. We specialise in premium Japanese steak cuts, alongside carefully selected cuts from other regions, all expertly seared on an iron griddle and served with a hot stone steak pellet made from high-density stone from Japan, heated up to 300°C, allowing you to continue searing your steak to your preferred doneness. Our steaks are served at a perfect medium rare, with specially curated Japanese donburi selections, sides and kids meals included. All teppan dishes come with complimentary free-flow Japanese salad bar, featuring a generous spread of fresh greens, sides, carbs and dessert.

name: Beauty Full Skin Wellness
description: Discover the art of beauty and body wellness. Experience the transformative power of our Signature Bojin Therapy and Japan Face Hibuso treatments at Beauty Full Skin Wellness, where every visit is a step towards sculpting your confidence.

name: Become Aesthetics Clinic
description: Experts in innovative anti-ageing skin and face solutions for a younger and better you. From pigment removal, v shape face lifting to skin rejuvenation, Become Aesthetics Clinic understands your concerns to help elevate your beauty through quality service and safe evidence-based treatments.

name: Benjamin Barker
description: Benjamin Barker is a purveyor of smart-casual, heritage inspired apparel and a lifestyle destination for the discerning gentleman. Working closely with our partners, we make clothes for real men. We make clothes that speak style and personality. We start with our shirts, an eclectic mix that marry versatility and style – a display of sartorial elegance that leans towards design. From the fit, construction and form, we develop and explore different fabrics with modernized style details to add personality and other thoughtful touches. Alongside our own products, we curate brands with similar alignment and have committed themselves to a high degree of handcraftsmanship. Suits, shoes and accessories – a one-stop retail destination to complete the look of the distinguished connoisseur.

name: Bites by Scarlett
description: Bites By Scarlett is a Chinese supermarket that offers value-for-money products in a variety of snack items. A wide range of products is available to ensure that the needs of locals and Chinese are met.

name: BodyWerkz
description: BodyWerkz has been the experts in weight management since 2006. We have helped thousands of women and celebrities regain their silhouette without dieting, pills and injections. Combining Science, Tradition and Technology, this proven multi-faceted approach is effective with results that last. Gain lean mass, lose fat and improve body hydration. Every visit* targets more than 100 grams of pure fat and burns about 400 – 900 kcals. These results persist for a few days and the right food combination, will contribute to a sensible weight loss journey that lasts a lifetime.

name: Boost Juice Bars
description: Boost Juice - the nation’s favourite makers of fresh smoothies and juices! We serve millions of Singaporeans our iconic green cups, filled with fruit and veggie deliciousness. Deliciousness that comes from simple, natural goodness, served to you with a love life attitude that will make you so happy you’ll probably end up high fiving random strangers. It’s about making healthy living easy!! So naturally, nutrition is a key component in developing our range of smoothies and juices that sees us blending through millions of tonnes of fruit and veggies every year.

name: Bottles & Bottles
description: Tenant at Tampines 1 since 2009, homegrown wine and spirits retailer Bottles & Bottles offers some of the world’s most iconic wines and a wide range of versatile, accessible and cost-effective bottles – providing consumers with fuss-free quality wines and spirits

name: Box Hunt
description: At Box Hunt, we believe that joy comes in small, unexpected packages. Specialising in blind boxes, we bring the thrill of mystery and the delight of discovery to collectors and toy lovers of all ages. Whether you're chasing your favourite character or simply love the surprise, each box is a new adventure waiting to be unwrapped. But the fun doesn’t stop there—we also offer a carefully curated collection of soft toys, block toys, die-cast cars, and TCG (trading card game) cards & more, ensuring there’s something for every kind of collector and enthusiast. Every product at Box Hunt is chosen with care to spark imagination, excitement, and the simple joy of play. Whether you're shopping for yourself or searching for the perfect gift, our mission is to help you unbox happiness, one surprise at a time.

name: British Essential
description: British Essential is a one-stop beauty destination with assortments of prestige beauty products. Delightfully serving up hottest Korean beauty trends like Coreana, Senite,Entia, A-Solution, Ferveor Salon Professional, Kerasys, Esthaar, Showermate and Richenna. We also sell products from Kerastase, Redken, Nioxin, Tigi, Sebastain, L'Oreal, SK-II, KOSE, Channel, Johnsons & Johnsons, Pantene and more.

name: By Invite Only
description: By Invite Only is a local jewellery brand based in Singapore, specialising in modern jewellery safe for sensitive skin. Founded in 2009 by CEO Trixie Khong, the brand is built on the belief that jewellery is more than just shiny trinkets – it’s about self-expression, an instrument to have you feel the best version of you there is.

name: Cafe Bom Bom
description: Café BomBom started in 2012, Daegu, South Korea as a takeout café which is loved by students and now people of all ages. Till date, Café BomBom has opened more than 400 affiliated outlets in South Korea. In Singapore, this is the 1st affiliated outlet outside of South Korea bringing to you our popular hot and iced beverages from South Korea. Choose more than 40 over beverages and our Bomcarons are not only bigger but also less sweet! Our coffee is also specially blended for the uniqueness in taste and we are offering our own unique flavors for bingsu. Consumers in Singapore will be spoilt for choice!

name: Cat & the Fiddle
description: Cat & the Fiddle is a renowned cheesecake brand founded by award-winning pâtissier Daniel Tay. Artisanally and intricately crafted, the brand offers a delightful range of cheesecakes that blend timeless classics with bold, Asian-inspired flavours — each one designed to leave you craving for more. Every cheesecake is a luxurious treat, promising an unforgettable indulgence with every bite.

name: CHAGEE
description: CHAGEE is an international tea brand that brings traditional tea to modern life. Drawing from centuries of tea heritage, we craft premium whole-leaf brews that blend tradition with innovation - creating shared moments of connection, every day, in every cup. CHAGEE TOGETHER.

name: Challenger
description: Unveil the world of Challenger – Singapore’s exclusive homegrown electronics chain since 1982. Explore the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials trusted by over half a million loyal members across 40+ island-wide stores. Embrace peace of mind with hassle-free returns and warranties covering 50,000+ top-tier products, including favorites like Apple, Samsung, and an array of other leading names.

name: Chateraise
description: Chateraise have over 470 stores across all of Japan and over 15 stores in Asia. All of their sweets are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as pure natural water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms in Japan. They directly deliver all their sweets from Japan to stores around the world.

name: Cheng Rui Lifestyle Feng Shui
description: Cheng Rui Lifestyle Feng Shui provides services such as: - Personal life analysis - Name analysis - Yi Jing Pu Gua - Name selection for companies, individuals and newborn babies - Feng shui arrange for home, offices etc - Date arrangement for special occasions (e.g. marriage, moving house etc)

name: CHICHA San Chen
description: Originating from Taiwan, CHICHA San Chen was founded in 1998 with a mission to make high-quality freshly brewed teas accessible to discerning tea drinkers. The brand holds a prestigious Highest International Authority ITI certification for quality, and utilises an exclusive patented Teapresso machine that allows custom settings and temperature control brewing technique to bring out the tea’s best flavour and natural scent, and maintain consistency in the quality and taste profiles of their tea. With high-quality tea as its mainstay, CHICHA San Chen marries the best of bubble tea with traditional tea bringing one of life’s greatest pleasures to the world.

name: Clippers Barber
description: Clippers Barber is your affordable classic barbershop with a modern revamp. It is a place where men of all ages can sit back, relax, enjoy a professional grooming service at the hands of the expert barbers, who pride themselves for their superior fades and clean cuts.
