Focusing on mastering the art of no frills personal grooming for quintessential gentleman, Clippers Barber constantly challenge itself to combine technology and social media with the time honored art of barbering, so as to deliver on its promise of service quality at wallet friendly prices; leaving every customer with a fresh new look and a smile on their face.

name: Cold Storage
description: Cold Storage is dedicated to delivering fresh, quality food at great prices. From abundant fruit and vegetables to the freshest seafood and butcher counters - we believe quality food doesn't have to cost the earth. When you visit, you can expect a fresh and contemporary store experience with a friendly team ready to help with a smile.

name: COLLIN’S®
description: A celebration of passion, for the craft of good food and great service to our guests. Established since 2012, COLLIN’S® is one of Singapore’s leading restaurant chains that brings premium Western cuisine to the masses. Using the language of food, COLLIN’S® seek to bring families, friends and loved ones closes as they gather and indulge in good food and company. With a wide selection of great grills, succulent meats, woodfired pizzas and carefully selected wine/beverage list, COLLIN’S® offers an extensive menu that is curated to delight customers from all walks of life. Today, Chef Collin and his team continues to innovate its offerings to ensure the brand stays fresh and relevant in the market.

name: Concierge (Tampines 1)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Crystal Jade Hong Kong Kitchen
description: A popular haunt for regular diners living in the vicinity and shoppers and moviegoers at the mall, the former Crystal Jade Kitchen at Great World has re-opened its doors as Crystal Jade Hong Kong Kitchen – the first outlet of the casual dining brand to unveil the new brand name and refreshed logo, after renovations to present a fresh new look and refreshed menu. Modern, inviting and warm, with touches of pink, Crystal Jade Hong Kong Kitchen at Great World is also the first outlet to launch a tempting new menu that showcases an extensive repertoire of classic and inventive Cantonese dim sum, roast meats, noodles and congee, expertly-executed wok-fried specialities, as well as home-style dishes. Diners at Crystal Jade Hong Kong Kitchen aims to continue the tradition of nourishing the souls and tummies of customers through generations at value-for-money prices.

name: Cube-i
description: CUBE-i carries an array of party supplies and balloons suited for birthdays, baby showers, weddings. Balloon customisation services are available as well.

name: Daiso
description: DAISO is a mega store established in Japan in 1977. Japan’s no. 1 ranking living ware supplier, with 2800 stores across the country and 860 stores in 26 nations worldwide. With over 90,000 different products in inventory and a further 1,000 new products being developed each month, DAISO provides the most variety and value for all your needs.

name: De Arte Hair Studio
description: Experience a subtle change or a complete transformation. De Arte Hair Studio get your desirable hair style with the exclusive hair care system. Create a healthy foundation of hair by focus on every single steps of process to continue a beauty radiance hair.

name: Délifrance
description: A journey to France - this is Délifrance promise to you. For over 30 years, Délifrance Singapore has dedicated itself to bringing a taste of Paris closer to home. The Délifrance brand is centred upon a desire to make every day delicious. This is a testament to their unending search for and provision of the simple pleasures in life put forth in creative and transformative ways. Their French roots and history exist as the foundational structure upon which they innovate authentic cultural fare, culminating in inspired creations of outstanding taste and convenience.

name: Dian Xiao Er
description: Dian Xiao Er, the must eat herbal roast duck in Singapore! Using only the finest quality of Cherry Valley ducks paired with freshest ingredients, our duck are prepared and freshly roast daily. They are marinated with a revitalising blend of Chinese herbs and spices for hours, roasted at a precise temperature to retain its juice while in the oven. Crisp to the touch, and golden brown in appearance, our herbal roast duck is complemented with our specially concocted herbal sauce that makes it impossible to resist!

name: DMK
description: At DMK, we believe in supporting your journey to help you look and feel good. Hence, we create fashion-forward products to support your journey and ensure that they are inclusive. So whether you have wide or narrow feet, we got the best fit for your feet! Since every shoe deserves a complementing handbag, we also design seasonal collections of bags that will complement trending looks.

name: DON DON DONKI
description: DON DON DONKI is a Japanese specialty brand that offers wide variety of high quality Japanese products from premium Japanese meat to ready-to-eat meals. Find everything you're looking for and discover things you never knew you needed, only at DON DON DONKI.

name: Eazea Smart Lock
description: Singapore no.1 digital lock provider, Eazea. More than 3,000 5* Reviews on Facebook and Google. Make your life Eazea!

name: elly sera
description: Elly Sera Florist is a premium florist in Singapore featuring a wide selection of beautiful high-grade blooms and luxury arrangements in a variety of artisanal and modern styles. Get a bespoke gift bouquet to celebrate a special occasion, or pick up curated fresh flowers for the sophisticated home. Enjoy shopping a full array of accompanying gifts such as unique vases, preserved flower arrangements, and plushies.

name: emicakes
description: Emicakes wasn’t just another cake shop—it was a trailblazer in Singapore’s culinary scene. It proudly held the distinction of being the first to specialize in durian cakes, harnessing the bold and unique flavors of the “king of fruits” in its creations.In response to the growing demand for eggless options, Emicakes embarked on a journey of culinary exploration. Drawing upon Emi’s spirit of innovation, they became the first in Singapore to master the art of eggless baking, crafting cakes that were not only delicious but also inclusive of all dietary preferences.

name: fieldnotes
description: Fieldnotes Singapore is a distinguished cakery inspired by nature. They offer a delightful range of beautifully crafted cakes. With over 10 years of experience, they create uniquely flavoured cakes using fruits, teas, herbs and cacao. Some of their bestsellers include the Honey Yuzu, Guava Lychee and Mango Yuzu cakes.

name: From There On
description: At From There On, our ethos remains the same; reinventing everyday staples that will stay with you for years and seasons to come. Timelessness, versatility and comfort are some of our core design beliefs which we know you’ll love and appreciate. We believe that garments should be your lifelong companions that stay with you beyond the passing trends - let us be a part of your life with thoughtfully designed pieces that will be with you from there on.

name: G2000
description: Explore the journey of transformation, where the traditional notions of professional style are reimagined and revitalized. Discover a fresh take on classic workwear staples, with the simplicity of clean lines, muted tones and understated elegance. Elevate your style and make a statement with our new collection, a balance between form and function, updated with contemporary cuts and innovative fabric technology.

name: Gadget MIX
description: Gadget Mix appeals to the highly-connected modern society by providing a range of uniquely designed IT lifestyle gadgets and personal mobility that is both trendy and affordable.

name: Gain City
description: Established in 1981, Gain City started out with a simple quest of improving lifestyles and a focused vision to be Singapore's trusted air-conditioner retailer. Today, renowned as Singapore's largest air-conditioner retailer, the brand is synonymous with excellent air-conditioning installation and maintenance service, as well as being the preferred go-to 1-Stop retailer for consumer electronics. With more than 800 staff, a pool of BCA-certified installation technicians and a fleet of over 180 service vehicles, they are your trusted choice.

name: Gochi-So Shokudo
description: Gochi-so Shokudo actively promotes a transparent, healthy eating practice from farm-to-table. The restaurant is dedicated to being an avenue for customers to enjoy all-natural pork.

name: Greendot
description: Greendot is the largest meat-free chain in Singapore. It is an asian-fusion fast casual dining concept aiming to help people take care and love themselves by making meat-free meals accessible and convenient to everyone.

name: Happie
description: Happie SG is a proudly homegrown Singapore brand dedicated to creating cleaner, healthier living for every home. We believe wellness begins at home — through pure water, fresh air, and thoughtful design that cares for everyday life. With innovative purifiers built on authentic care, reliable quality, and smart technology, Happie makes healthy living effortless and joyful, one home at a time.

name: Haruyama Udon®
description: Haruyama Udon ® - “Spring Mountain Udon”, specialises in Artisan Udon that is handmade daily. We offer an authentic taste of Japan, featuring 4 Artisan Udon from all around Japan. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our daily handmade Udon, ensuring a dining experience that truly captures the essence of Japanese culinary tradition.

name: Hawkers' Street
description: Hawkers’ Street is a concept created to bring all of our favourite and famed hawkers, including Michelin-accredited brands nearer to all Singaporeans to ensure the continuity of our hawker dining habits by placing them under one roof.

name: Heart Springs Spa
description: Spring Into A better You! Heart Springs Spa is an exquisite spa that allows you to indulge your senses, invigorate your body and inspire your mind. Simply devoted to authenticity and harmony, the wide range of beauty services available at Heart Springs Spa includes facials, massages, foot reflexology, hyfro-therapies, body polishes, bust enhancement, ear candling, IPL hair removal, IPL anti-acne and eyebrow embroidery.

name: Highlander London
description: Highlander London is an independent brand for home textile and lifestyle accessories. From Austrian Tencel™, Siberian goose down, to Chinese Silk, we travel the globe to find the best fabric for each collection. Taking pride in offering unique and innovative products – like our green tea scented pillow, we do our homework so you can sleep well, dream better.

name: Hong Kong Egglet / Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specializes in traditional handmade pau from the authentic traditional recipe of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in house.

name: HOOGA
description: HOOGA (hue-guh) is a Singapore home décor brand that is inspired by the Danish art of cosiness. In this Scandinavian concept store, we pursue happiness through appreciating simple pleasures of life as every turn unveils new ornamentations that relate to the many pleasures we associate with everyday living.

name: HUES by Full House Salon
description: Are you looking to transform your damaged, frizzy hair into a flawless cascade? We have got every treatment that your hair needs at Full House – the best hair salon in Tampines. Having an excellent team of well-experienced hair professionals, our goal is to give our valued customers the best hair treatment experience in Tampines. At Full House Hair Salon Tampines, we offer a wide range of hairstyling methods such as hair-cutting, hair coloring, rebonding, and perming.

name: Hysses
description: HYSSES – formerly known as Mt. Sapola (乡术, meaning ‘arts from the village’) embodies a pure and authentic sense of preserving nature, heritage and appreciation for the native communities that have helped shape and broaden our journey. Like the unique DNA of every plant and composition of every sandstone, HYSSES was created organically and inspired by the wisdom of nature.

name: I Love Taimei
description: 我愛台妹 was born for the ♥ of food, particularly Taiwanese food. The concept of Taimei were brought together by two Taiwanese sisters who are passionate foodies. We serve the best of Taiwanese street food culture. Our signature Popcorn Chicken, Mala or BBQ chicken. Pair it up with our signature milk tea drinks and you are good to go!

name: ICON Hair Salon
description: ICON Hair Salon is dedicated to providing exceptional hair services to our clients. We understand that every person's hair is unique, which is why we provide personalized services to meet your specific needs. Our experienced stylists are trained in the latest hair trends and techniques to ensure that you receive the best service possible. We offer a range of services including haircut & styling, treatment, colour, and straighten & perm. At Icon Hair Salon, we strive to make you feel comfortable and confident with your new look.

name: I'M IN
description: I’M IN is a digital native lingerie brand founded in Singapore. I’M IN is founded to provide comfortable, functional and affordable wireless asian-fit lingerie.

name: iSteaks
description: iSTEAKS focus on making SteakHouse quality food more affordable. Steaks of various cuts and qualities are in our regular menu. We source our meat from some of the finest butchery in town! All soups and complements dishes are made from scratch. In fact, we are busy throughout the day, just because we are always preparing our products fresh!

name: Kaleido
description: Kaleido is a local jewellery label based in Singapore. Powered by a belief in individual self-expression, each product is designed to live with you. It’s about fun and freedom and being content with yourself today.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: Killiney Coffee Cafe
description: KILLINEY 1919: A Taste of Heritage Singapore's oldest Hainanese coffee shop is now open at Tampines 1 Mall! Savour our iconic traditional Kopi and Kaya Toast, alongside beloved Asian classics. Serving tradition, since 1919

name: KOMME
description: KOMME (‘come’ in German) is a home interior & lifestyle brand created by a tribe of creatives who share the same obsession with beautifully, well-made home lifestyle products. With a passion and vision for original design and quality homewares, KOMME is simply about sharing great design stories, creating gorgeous spaces together with all proud homeowners.

name: Kuriya Japanese Market
description: Kuriya Japanese Market is your one-stop shop for quick, satisfying Japanese meals and grocery selections. Savour the freshest sushi and seafood, carefully selected and air-flown directly from Japan three times weekly for the highest quality, alongside other imported Japanese seasonings, condiments, snacks, and exclusive sakes. There is also the option to enjoy a variety of Japanese-inspired bento prepared on demand for a fulfilling meal on-the-go. From ready-to-eat sushi boxes and snacks, to sashimi party platters, there is something for everyone!

name: Ladyfinger
description: Ladyfinger is not your ordinary nail care centre. Finely furnished, shoppers can expect professional nail care services that will leave you wanting more. Indulge in a luxurious and extraordinary nail bar services in a relaxing & comfotable ambience at Ladyfinger!

name: Lau Wang Claypot Delights
description: Lau Wang Claypot Delights are derived from a traditional recipe and concept method of preparation, by cooking almost all the dishes in each small claypot, thus ensuring that each dish is freshly cooked and also served piping hot to each customer and that the food would also stay warm up till the end of the meal. Specialties include: Frog Leg Herbal Soup, Sambal Kang Kong With Minced Meat, Sambal Sotong, Sesame Oil Chicken

name: LIANG YI TCM
description: Founded in 2016, LIANGYI™ specializes in pain and sub-health management through Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) treatments and herbal remedies. Committed to being a leading TCM provider in today’s world, LIANGYI™ seeks to educate the public about the benefits and long-term advantages of TCM. By taking a holistic approach to health and wellness, LIANGYI™ is dedicated to helping individuals achieve their optimal well-being, grounded in the belief that our greatest wealth is health.

name: llaollao
description: Born in 2009 in Spain, llaollao ™ is currently a company with an international presence. It has more than 400 yogurt shops located in five continents and ranks as the leader in the frozen yogurt sector. llaollao is proud to serve customers the freshest and most delicious frozen yogurt, using the finest ingredients to maintain both the authenticity and health benefits of yogurt.

name: London Weight Management
description: Award-winning slimming brand, London Weight Management is truly a beauty essential for women who want to lose weight and reshape their silhouettes successfully. Every treatment at London Weight Management consists of a detailed body fat analysis and a series of customised slimming techniques to help you achieve that trim and womanly figure you desire. Safe, effective, and best of all, non-surgical way to slim down easily and quickly.

name: Love and Bravery
description: Love and Bravery is a women’s label that seeks to create a collection of statement pieces and everyday wear for the modern woman. Our pieces are thoughtfully crafted, with a focus on quality, cut and wearability. We’re proud to be a brand that is designed in Singapore.

name: Love Beauty
description: Love Beauty has over 20 years experience in providing beauty services, specializing in nails, lash extensions, and eyebrows.

name: Lovisa
description: At Lovisa, we are driven by our passion for the perfect accessory. Our trend-forecasting departments worldwide take inspiration from runways and current street style to provide the latest trends in fashion accessories.The first Lovisa store opened in Australia in 2010, and since then we have established ourselves as an industry leader, with over 340 stores across 15 countries which includes the US, South Africa, UK to name a few.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Founded in 2017, Luckin Coffee pioneers a technological-driven retail concept aims to provide quality coffee and products accessible to its customers. Using only sustainably, ethically sourced coffee beans roasted to perfection by its WBC Champion Team, Luckin Coffee created a range of unique and delicious blend of coffee that has won the hearts of million coffee lovers. Luckin Coffee’s success and rapid growth over the years are a testament to its unique approach to retail that focuses on technology and customer centric approach, and its relentless dedication to customer satisfaction.

name: Lynn Aesthetic
description: At Lynn Aesthetic, your experience is our priority. Being one of the pioneers in the beauty industry with 35 years of experience since our establishment, we are constantly working to grow with the trends of this increasingly growing market to give our customers an exquisite experience. We are an ever-growing establishment with a strong focus in satisfying our clients’ needs. With the rapid improvement of technology, we are constantly upgrading our machines to keep up with the most recent technology to provide the best quality service for our clients.

name: Mamma Mia Trattoria E Caffè
description: Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffè is a casual-style dining restaurant that serves true and simple Italian fare in an unpretentious and inviting Trattoria atmosphere. Artisan pastas that are handcrafted with fresh ingredients and cooked à la minute take centrestage. From antipasti, handcrafted pasta, rice and other mealtime delectables to mouth-watering desserts, the Italian nosh at Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffè is sure to satisfy all palates.

name: Michael Trio
description: Three sons, three generations, three values. Every engagement ring and fine jewellery piece that bears our name is inspired by the desire to create something lasting together, the lessons our father taught us, and these stories that have endured from over 40 years ago.

name: Milly’s
description: Milly’s provide a range of professional beauty services; eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery, manicure & pedicure, hair extensions & hair removal.

name: Minister Shoe
description: Minister Shoe & Key Service Centre specializes in a range of services at affordable prices. These include shoe repair, key duplication, bag restoration, digital lock installation, condo access card and car remote duplication, etc.

name: misssee
description: Our brand is all about celebrating individual style and helping you express yourself through the latest trends in accessories. We believe that the right accessory can completely transform an outfit and make you feel confident and stylish no matter where you go. At misssee, we offer a wide range of accessories, including jewelry, bags, hats, scarves, and more. Our products are carefully curated to ensure that we are always up-to-date with the latest trends, and we pride ourselves on offering high-quality, affordable accessories that will elevate any outfit.

name: Mister Donut
description: Makers of the legendary Pon De Ring donuts. An iconic Japanese chain with over 900 stores across the country, Singapore's specialty store promises the same high-quality donuts, made using ingredients from Japan and prepared by staff with careful training at the Mister Donut academy in Osaka. Mister Donut serves a delightful array of choices that caters to all tastes, from the iconic Pon De Ring to the delicate Angel Cream, ensuring every bite is a reason to come back!

name: Mister Mobile
description: As Singapore's leading one-stop mobile service provider, Mister Mobile caters to your every mobile need. With multiple stores conveniently scattered across the island and efficient doorstep services, I guarantee prompt on-the-spot repairs, seamless trade-ins and stress-free phone purchases. Certified with ISO 9001 and CaseTrust, Mister Mobile is a beacon of unparalleled quality and reliability. Your mobile journey is in safe hands with Mister Mobile — where service seamlessly meets distinction.

name: Monster Planet
description: Monster Planet is the halal-certified sister brand of Monster Curry. It is iconic for its gigantic 35cm and 41cm plates, filled with delicious curry made using 14 different types of vegetables and spices, served atop rice or noodles. There are five levels of spiciness, ranging from normal spicy to monster spicy. Other than the delectable Japanese curry options, find burgers, pizzas and even delicious Japanese honey toasts on the menu, all perfect for sharing.

name: Mr Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: MUJI
description: Since its birth in 1980, MUJI core principles remain unchanged to this date - Selection of Materials, Streamlining of Processes and Simplification of Packages, which stay true to the brand ethos – “No-brand quality goods”. MUJI’s products are simple, indistinct, affordable and functionality-driven, complementing rational lifestyles in today’s world.

name: Musee Platinum Tokyo
description: Musee Platinum Tokyo is a professional hair removal salon in Singapore. Here at Musee Platinum Tokyo, they use a new state-of-art pain free technology named - Smooth Skin Control Hair Removal. With S.S.C. Hair Removal, the specially formulated gel is activated when exposed to beams of filtered light. As compared with self-treatment such as shaving, plucking and waxing, this technology is gentler to your skin with minimal or no discomfort.

name: My Digital Lock
description: My Digital Lock is the Sole Agent of Korean brand EPIC in Singapore and also Authorized Dealer of Samsung brand in Singapore. EPIC Based on quality proven software development technology and management know-how in the world market. EPIC Digital Locks with Durable metallic body against external shocks and fire, Auto-lock, Re-lock, double lock function for user convenience and security. Random Number and Multi-touch features that enhance, password security (1time entry password available).

name: Nails & Good Company
description: Nails & Good Company is a wellness & lifestyle-centric salon that offers a clean, safe and non-toxic beauty care experience. The salon was conceptualised on the belief that salons can be socially responsible through good practices i.e. doing what's good for the health of our consumers, artists and the environment. With a mission to provide cleaner & safer beauty care, founder Zoe Lim, carefully curates all in-house products to ensure that most have at least one of the following properties: less-toxic, vegan, cruelty-free, organic, breathable, natural and safe. This frees our planet from icky toxics like formaldehyde, toluene, or dibutyl phthalate. Furthermore, prices of all services are kept wallet-friendly – making it an affordable go-to salon in Singapore.

name: Namu Bulgogi
description: First ever Korean Oakwood Smoke-Grill barbecue restaurant in Singapore. Nothing is served until it's perfect. A Feast For Your Sense Pleasing to the eyes, Pleasant to smell - All before stepping into a wondrous world of oakwood-grilling.

name: New York Skin Solutions
description: Established in 2004, New York Skin Solutions has earned an excellent reputation in the beauty industry with proven treatment results* for both male and female customers. Formulated to suit Asian skin types, New York Skin Solutions will work effectively for your particular needs, helping you to restore healthy and radiant skin.

name: Nippon Bite
description: Nippon Bite is a restaurant that follows ancient culinary traditions, combining them with the new age. Our vision is to provide diners with a different experience than what is usually known, mixing different techniques and flavors. You will find different menus and options depending on the stage of the year in which we find ourselves, because we always use fresh seasonal ingredients.

name: Novela
description: Novela is Singapore's home-grown multi-brand beauty retail chain store. Keeping up with the latest trends, Novela aims to capture the hearts of beauty shoppers with a wide range of luxury beauty products including skin & body care, fragrances and makeup. Novela’s logo is a black quill pen, which is symbolic of a woman’s beauty, elegance and knowledge. Indeed, we believe that you can exude beauty from the inside out with the right beauty regime. By curating the best beauty brands from across the globe and offering them at affordable prices, we aim to simplify and elevate your shopping experience with premium products handpicked by us.

name: OH!SOME
description: OH!SOME is an all-in-one lifestyle retail brand from Singapore that offers a curated selection of trendy products across various categories from beauty, toys, fashion accessories, snacks, beverages, daily essentials, to electronics. With its trendy one-stop store concept, OH!SOME aims to be a daily happiness keeper by catering to each individual’s unique lifestyle needs. In addition to Indonesia and Singapore, OH!SOME has also expanded its presence to several Southeast Asian countries, including Malaysia, Cambodia, and Vietnam, as part of its global expansion strategy.

name: OJO Optometry
description: OJO Optometry offers professional optometry services and eye care advice. The open concept store is designed to clearly display a wide array of products from Asia to Europe. Coupled with OJO’s knowledgeable and service-oriented staff to assist your selection of frames and sunglasses, each visit to OJO optometry promises to be a fun and enjoyable experience.

name: Oriental Hair Solutions
description: Oriental Hair Solutions was created to help people with hair and scalp problems caused by a stressful lifestyle, environmental damages, genetic problems and harsh chemicals used in various hairdressing techniques.

name: Paris Miki
description: Founded in Japan in 1930, Paris Miki has more than 1200 stores established in Europe, Asia, Australia and the USA currently. Not only are they updated with the constant changes in eyewear technology and eyecare related issues by attending seminars and courses in order to provide better customer service, they also provide excellent after-sales service.

name: PastaGo
description: Launched in 2022, PastaGo is a halal-certified takeaway kiosk that serves our very own house-made pasta. Different from the usual dried pasta that is commonly found, fresh pasta is silky, smooth, and springy to taste. Each shape is thoughtfully selected to hold the ideal amount of sauce and to provide the best mouthfeel.

name: Pepper Lunch
description: Pepper Lunch is a DIY fast service concept, with more than 200 outlets in Japan and Asia. Pepper Lunch promises a dynamic and fresh culinary experience for everyone by presenting the novel concept of sizzling Steaks, Pastas, Curry Rice, and not forgetting their signature Pepper Rice. All at affordable prices!

name: Perky Lash
description: Perky Lash delivers a featherlite experience with anti-allergy protection, 25% longer lasting and ZERO damage to lashes. We offer a wide variety of curls and designs to enable customers to express better.

name: Pezzo
description: Welcome to Pezzo where every pizza has its own unique character and taste. Meet Big Daddy, Meat Munchers or Garlic Chick for a novel way of enjoying some scrumptious tasting pizzas on-the-go!

name: Pixie Lash
description: Expect a leisure pedicure and manicure spa, or simply an afternoon of escape to beautify your nails with an exceptional customer service and high standards of hygiene practices in a relaxing ambience of cosiness, complemented with soothing music and variety options of treatments that is a perfect venue for an affordable indulgence. Not only you can get to beautify your nails, you can leave your eyelash, eyebrow, lips and many many more to us! A salient feature of Pixie Nail Spa is never to compromise on hygiene practices. All equipment used are sanitised, placed in a sanitising pouch and subsequently kept in a UV Steriliser before using it on our clients. Our experienced manicurists are trained with our standard operating procedures and are sent to specific courses to ensure that they are competent before being assigned to meet our clients’ nail spa treatment requirements.

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Expect a leisure pedicure and manicure spa, or simply an afternoon of escape to beautify your nails with an exceptional customer service and high standards of hygiene practices in a relaxing ambience of cosiness, complemented with soothing music and variety options of treatments that is a perfect venue for an affordable indulgence. Not only you can get to beautify your nails, you can leave your eyelash, eyebrow, lips and many many more to us! A salient feature of Pixie Nail Spa is never to compromise on hygiene practices. All equipment used are sanitised, placed in a sanitising pouch and subsequently kept in a UV Steriliser before using it on our clients. Our experienced manicurists are trained with our standard operating procedures and are sent to specific courses to ensure that they are competent before being assigned to meet our clients’ nail spa treatment requirements.

name: Playdress
description: With a local in-house designer and production capabilities overseas, Playdress offers an extensive range of smart casual wear, upholding quality and affordability at the heart of her philosophy. A women-led brand, Playdress embodies the confident, stylish woman of today, complements Asian body shape and takes one from work to play effortlessly.

name: PlayMade
description: PlayMade has captivated the hearts of tea enthusiasts with our commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. Our handcrafted bubble tea has become a beloved destination for those seeking imaginative and flavourful tea creations. Without the use of additives or preservatives, our bobas exemplify freshness. The result? Bobas that are not only delicious but also healthier, offering a delightful bounce and exceptional flavour.

name: Pop Play Planet
description: Pop Play Planet is a trendy collectibles store for young enthusiasts, featuring 50+ popular IPs like Crayon Shin-chan, Butter Bear, Wa San Sui, and The Avengers, with 6,000+ toys in a constantly updated space to discover the hottest items.

name: Popeyes
description: Over 300 years ago, seven distinctive culinary traditions came together to create the uniquely American cuisine, Louisiana cooking. Now Popeyes is serving it up like nobody else can. Carefully blending their own spices and seasonings, hand battering their famous fried chicken, and tenderly cooking up every delicious bite long slow and easy – with a lot of heart. All to give you an incredibly rich soul-satisfying taste of history!

name: Potato Corner
description: For 27 years, Potato Corner has been serving the world’s best flavored fries. These fries are prepared fresh, fried to order, seasoned with passionately formulated flavors, and served hot and crispy. Potato Corner’s flavors are Cheese, Barbecue, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili Barbecue and a whole lot more!

name: Premier Dead Sea
description: Premier Dead Sea is an international brand of high-end Dead Sea skin care products which are scientifically developed by expert dermatologists and chemists who specialize in aging and skin biology. The unique and award-winning products are based on a modern purification process that extracts necessary active ingredients for renewing and rebuilding skin cells.

name: Purpur
description: Founded locally in 2002, Purpur is now a well established fashion brand with an international e-commerce store and outlets islandwide. At Purpur, we aim to allow every lady to feel joyful and comfortable in our clothes. Our pieces are thoughtfully designed focusing on comfort, quality and affordability. Here at Purpur is where you can be your own kind of beautiful, everyday.

name: Q & M Dental Surgery / Medical & Aesthetic Clinic
description: Q & M Dental Group was first established in November 1996 at Bukit Batok. Over the years, it has grown from strength to strength and now has more than 100 clinics island-wide, thus making it the largest private dental healthcare group in Singapore. Q & M Dental Group is also CHAS/Merdeka Generation (MG)/Pioneer Generation (PG)/Medisave/Baby Bonus accredited. We look forward to serving you there!

name: Queen C
description: QueenC, where beauty meets convenience! We specialize in providing high-quality press-on nails that are easy to apply, affordable and stunningly customizable. Whether you're looking for a quick glam fix for a special event or want to express your style with our wide range of designs, colors and shapes, we've got you covered. Say Hello to effortless beauty with Queen C press-on nails.

name: QUINZEL
description: Welcome to Quinzel, your premier destination for exquisite nail care and pampering at Tampines 1. Our comprehensive nail spa experience includes manicures, pedicures, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery, and waxing, all set within a serene and luxurious ambiance. We strive to offer a relaxing and indulgent environment for modern and discerning individuals, serving both men and women seeking a retreat to unwind and pamper themselves. At Quinzel, we take pride in fostering a serene and inclusive atmosphere for all our valued guests. Our private room is carefully designed to enhance the comfort of our Muslim patrons, ensuring a tranquil and personalized experience. Dedicated to making each visit delightful and memorable, Quinzel is committed to providing the ultimate pampering experience.

name: Raffles Dental / Medical Women’s & Children’s Centre
description: Raffles Dental is an established team-based dental practice comprising dental specialists and general dental surgeons in Raffles Hospital, and supported by a network of dental clinics located island wide. Raffles Dental’s dentists work across specialties with each other to prevent, diagnose, and treat a full range of dental and oral diseases. General services include routine dental checkups, screening and maintenance, dental X-rays, crowns and bridges, dentures, braces and aligners, extractions, fillings, implants, and teeth whitening. Raffles Dental clinics are approved under the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus, and Medisave scheme.

name: Raffles Medical
description: Raffles Medical is the primary care network of Raffles Medical Group, which provides family medicine, health screening, and dental services. Besides operating clinics in China, Japan, Vietnam, and Cambodia, it is one of the largest network of family medicine clinics in Singapore. Our team of family physicians provides care for patients of all ages, including treatment and management of acute and chronic diseases, vaccinations, travel health, and health screening. Raffles Medical clinics are approved to serve Singaporeans under various healthcare and government schemes including the Healthier SG programme, Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus and Flexi-Medisave scheme.

name: Rechic
description: Founded with a vision of modern femininity, RECHIC has become a leading designer fashion brand dedicated to women. Blending everyday practicality with contemporary trends, it offers a diverse range of styles from chic workwear to effortless casual looks, empowering women to dress with confidence, elegance, and individuality.

name: Recoil
description: Recoil is committed to producing affordable and trendiest men’s wear that constantly exceeds the expectations of its customers. Recoil not only delivers quality products and services, it also aims to influence the urban trend setters!

name: Rive Gauche Patisserie
description: RIVE GAUCHE PATISSERIE offers home-made cakes, patisseries and confectionery for all occasions at affordable prices. Known for its traditional cakes, yet garnished with creative and modern designs, RIVE GAUCHE PATISSERIE is a must try!

name: Royce Dental Orthodontic Centre
description: Royce Dental Group was established to provide comprehensive dental services from basic dentistry to specialist treatments, while creating a friendly and approachable environment. With experience and expertise from years of service both in private and public healthcare, our goal is to provide quality dental care that remains cost-effective for all patients. The Royce dental team is equipped with regular training sessions to improve their skills and dental knowledge, and this ensures that our patients are in good hands.

name: rrooll
description: rrooll is a halal-certified bakery that is the first to offer a swirl of both sweet and savoury flavours rolled up in our signature soft and fluffy dough. Our rolls are free of preservatives and artificial flavours. We use only the freshest ingredients paired with precise techniques to bring out the best combination of flavours, texture and aroma. Combining the freshest grade A cinnamon powder topped with our signature cream cheese frosting, our classic cinnamon roll will leave you craving for more.

name: SA SA
description: One of the leading beauty product retailing groups in Asia, Sa Sa exclusive brands cover over 9,000 skincare, fragrance, make-up, hair care and body care products, inner beauty products as well as beauty equipment. Sa Sa prospers on its success-proven “one-stop beauty product specialty platform” concept which aims to provide customers with the widest range of high quality products at the most competitive value.

name: Saizeriya
description: Saizeriya was founded in 1967 in a small town in Chiba, Japan, and has since grown from strength to strength with over a thousand outlets spanned across Asia. With its unique offerings of casual Italian cuisines at affordable prices and an “All-you-can-drink” bar set amidst a comfortable ambience, Saizeriya promises customers a great dining experience every time.

name: Salt Clinic by Premier Dead Sea
description: Embrace the relaxing benefits of a salt room facial while enjoying a treatment tailored to your skin's needs. The products we use at Premier Salt Clinic are designed to be recognized by the skin as beneficial. Minerals and essential oils from the Dead Sea are infused into every product, encouraging your skin's natural renewal process. Premier Dead Sea’s skincare products are formulated by Premier's science team and laboratories by combining nature and technology. These skincare products contain extremely concentrated minerals like magnesium, potassium, calcium, sodium, and iodine, which have properties for your skin and health, unlocking everything nature has to offer.

name: San.wich
description: San.wich is a brand-new concept by Swee Heng Bakery. Specializing in sandwiches with a minimum 3 layers of delicious ingredients with wide variety of natural ingredients based bread which are baked from scratch every day to ensure the beauty of every bite lies in the perfect combination of flavours!

name: Sanook Kitchen
description: Sanook Kitchen is the ultimate destination for Thai food lovers. With a menu crafted using genuine Thai spices and the freshest ingredients, every dish embodies the rich, unpretentious taste of the Land of Smiles, transporting you straight to the heart of Thailand with every bite.

name: Saute Saranghae
description: Saute Saranghae is a Korean Inspired Plant-based Dining Concept by the Saute Group. Indulge in a feast and spread of delicious, wholesome and healthy food that's crafted with passion and dedication.

name: Scent Appeal
description: Scent Appeal is your go-to destination for captivating fragrances that elevate everyday moments. Whether you're seeking a signature scent or the perfect gift for both men and women, Scent Appeal offers timeless classics and modern favorites—all at prices that make indulgence accessible.

name: Shabu Sai
description: An authentic Japanese restaurant that serves all-you-can-eat Shabu-Shabu and Sukiyaki buffet, Shabu Sai serves up to seven tasty soup bases and a splendid array of more than 40 items on the buffet table. The brand earns in name from the word “Shabu” – the sound of ingredients being swished in a boiling pot – and “Sai” which means vegetables. The must-try Shabu Sai specialities include the Tonkotsu soup, prepared using the same recipe as the restaurant’s outlets in Japan, the Sukiyaki soup that offers a sweet-and-savoury Shoyu-based stock for the freshest ingredients to simmer in, as well as signature items such as the pork, beef or chicken served in bamboo.

name: Shakura Pigmentation Beauty
description: Knowing that Asian skin is prone to hyperpigmentation, Shakura, the Pigmentation Specialist™ has developed a powerful yet gentle formulation that’s suitable for all Asian skin types. Each treatment is infused with Milk Essence and plant extracts from Hibiscus Sabdariffa Flower to visibly lighten pigmentation! No lasers and no invasive treatments.

name: Shine Korea
description: Singapore's leading retailer of Korean product, Shine Korea provide the reliable delivery of authentic Korean products at the best price. The wide range of product available from noodles to snacks to sauces and cooking ware makes Shine Korea the go-to-place for everything Korean.

name: Singtel Exclusive Retailer
description: Singtel provides an extensive selection of Singtel services, encompassing mobile and fixed broadband as well as prepaid and postpaid options. You can enjoy a diverse array of choices, from the latest mobile phones to lifestyle-related accessories and gadgets, catering to all your communication and lifestyle needs. We are Asia's leading communications group, providing a diverse range of Innovative services including fixed mobile, data, internet, ICT and TV.

name: Sinjojo
description: Sinjojo is a brand that embodies a specific concept and mindset that emphasizes self-love, strength, and courage. They offer a range of high-quality products at affordable prices, catering to women of various age groups. Their collections are designed to provide a distinct and versatile style that complements everyday outfits.

name: Sinpopo
description: The go-to place for memory-invoking, local delights. Sinpopo Coffee has a unique range of handcrafted cakes, artisanal kueh-kuehs, specialty coffees, and introduces our Sinpopo Singapore Sundae Movement!

name: Skechers
description: Our story begins in a California beach house, where Skechers was born as a utility boot and became an icon of the grunge era. More than 25 years later, we’ve evolved into a footwear powerhouse with styles for men, women and kids around the world.

name: SkinGO!
description: Experience the skin revolution! SkinGO! redefines the meaning of express facials and we believe that express facials are just as effective if not more than the traditional facials. Using advanced technology from Korea, our facials are designed to re-energise and hydrate skin in 15 minutes. Suited for all ages and skin type, you can now be on the road to flawless smooth skin.

name: SkinLab The Medical Spa
description: At SkinLab The Medical Spa, we believe good skin is the foundation of beauty. We are rooted in science-based research and strive to create skincare solutions to help you look good and feel good, no matter your stage in life.

name: Smiggle
description: When it comes to dreaming up new products Smiggle live by the motto - never boring, always fun, something for everyone! With Smiggle you will be able to organise your work or play space with rainbow brights and bold designs, whether it be at home, at school or at the office. Smiggle is passionate about their stuff and they promise to provide you with lots of new stationery and storage ideas in a huge range of colours.

name: Sothys
description: A world of highly refined emotions and sensuality. A legendary name that represents excellence and prestige in beauty institutes all over the world. SOTHYS stands out with its extraordinary commitment to research and innovation, claiming its place as the peerless avant garde beauty expert. Our high standards of perfection and our quest for absolute beauty in women and men, through well-being and effectiveness, has continued for over 70 years.

name: Strip / Browhaus
description: With over 6 million customers worldwide, BROWHAUS is Asia's premier brow-grooming and eye care specialist. STRIP is the market leader for premium hair removal services. With its advanced techniques and first-of-its-kind products and treatments, it has pruned more than 4 million bushes worldwide across its network of over 50 outlets.

name: Subway
description: SUBWAY® is the undisputed leader in fast, healthy food. Our easy-to-prepare sandwiches are made to order right in front of the customer, precisely the way they want – using freshly baked breads, select sauces and a variety of delicious toppings.

name: Sushi Plus
description: An elevated concept that redefines the conventional conveyor belt sushi with state-of-art technology integration of the Shinkansen train system, customers can enjoy ready-to-eat and made-to-order items at the same time. Sushi Plus adopts a modern approach to Japanese cuisine, featuring an extensive menu from classic Japanese dishes to trendy and innovative creations.

name: Sushi Tei
description: Sushi Tei's thoughtfully curated menu showcases more than 370 authentic Japanese cuisines, marrying the intricacies of Sashimi & Sushi to the theatrical flair of Yakimono & Nabemono. Using only fresh and quality ingredients to deliver classic Japanese fare with an innate intuition of local tastes; forging an inimitable and unique epicurean identity to truly remember.

name: SUSHIRO
description: SUSHIRO is Japan’s number 1 kaiten sushi chain. With more than 700 outlets in Japan and other countries, Sushiro serves over 100 varieties of delicious sushi and Japanese dishes to about 150 million customers every year. With the core corporate mission, “Tasty Sushi for All. Tasty Sushi for the Heart.”Sushiro maintains its key focus on careful ingredient selection, constant development of new flavours, employment of advanced technology to enhance service quality and is committed to serving high-quality and value-for-money Japanese sushi to customers.

name: SYOUJIN
description: Syoujin is committed to provide you with a one-stop beauty body, health, slimming, hair removal and other diversified care. In addition to having more than a world-class advanced equipment, the treatments are specially selected from internationally renowned high-quality products, and made more personal, and even medical-grade service solutions to meet the modern pursuit of perfect skin for the demands of men and women .

name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Tai Cheong Bakery was started in 1954 by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. After taking over Tai Cheong Bakery, Au Yeung pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts, refining several other recipes using techniques he learned from his previous work in a hotel baking cakes. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. The popularity of Tai Cheong remains till today.

name: TANYU
description: Among the most well-known grilled fish chains worldwide is TANYU. Their menu features a delicious variety of fish dishes for the authentic Chinese food lovers, and is renowned for its friendly staff and cozy atmosphere. TANYU is a popular spot where people of all ages can go to enjoy a delicious treat with friends and family, whether you prefer modern or old classic flavours.

name: Create By The Alley
description: Having opened its very first outlet in Taoyuan, Taiwan in 2013, The Alley has come a remarkable way today with more than 300 outlets around the world. Renowned for its iconic beverage aesthetics and taste, The Alley continues to make waves in the international food and beverage scene with its signature Brown Sugar Deerioca Series.

name: THE EDITOR'S MARKET
description: We are a modern-day market for everyday fashion and lifestyle. Our raison d'etre is to offer great design and quality, at democratic prices and in an increasingly sustainable manner.

name: The Orange Academy
description: The Orange Academy believes in cultivating children to be confident bilingual speakers in English and Mandarin by providing opportunities to hone their linguistic skills. The physical environment and classroom activities are designed to stimulate children’s creative thinking and logical reasoning and ignite their passion for learning. The Orange Academy strive to equip children with life skills, which are embedded in their holistic curriculum.

name: The s.k.MED Clinic
description: The s.k.MED Clinic is a medical aesthetic and skin clinic. We manage a wide variety of medical dermatological conditions involving the skin, hair and nails, which affect the young to elderly. At our clinics, we strive to combine safe and evidence-based treatment programmes with our efficacious s.k.MED skincare products to get you the best results.

name: The Stage Walk
description: Established in 2008, The Stage Walk is a local fashion brand that has grown vastly over the last 10 years. With each collection, they aim to present more designs and styles suited for women everywhere.

name: The Tinsel Rack
description: Started in 2009, The Tinsel Rack (TTR) is a Singapore-based fashion label helmed by sister duo, Joyce and Jolene. We aspire to create timeless apparel without compromising on quality and wearability. Choosing between comfort and style will never be an issue at TTR because we take pride both in what we do and what we provide. Feeling good in their own skin while comfortably dressed in TTR is what we desire for our customers: always ready to enjoy the little things and tender moments in their daily lives.

name: THEFACESHOP
description: THEFACESHOP began its foundation from the simple desire to keep skin healthy and beautiful through the use of unique natural ingredients. Originated from Korea, THEFACESHOP is a leading global beauty retail brand offering over 1,000 quality products for skin care, body care, hair care and make up. THEFACESHOP focuses on using natural ingredients from all over the world to nourish and revitalize the skin of our valued customers. Our products are modelled around the well-being of individuals and are universally affordable for all ages. As part of our dedication to nature, THEFACESHOP does not allow animal testing on our products and ensures the use of recyclable containers. Such is the natural story.

name: Tim Ho Wan
description: Best known for serving up quality authentic Hong Kong Dim Sum at affordable prices, Tim Ho Wan started off as a ‘hole-in-the-wall’ eatery in Hong Kong and slowly earned many praises through its accolades of refined flavours and taste consistency. Tim Ho Wan’s Hong Kong flagship restaurant at Sham Shui Po has been awarded with One Michelin Star for 11 consecutive years from 2010 to 2021. Prepared daily in-house and cooked only upon order to ensure freshness of Dim Sum and Mains, some of Tim Ho Wan’s award-winning favourites are its signature Baked BBQ Pork Buns, Pork & Shrimp Dumplings, Pork Congee with Century & Salted Eggs, Glutinous Rice wrapped in Lotus Leaf and Hong Kong Braised Beef Noodles. The crown jewel of Tim Ho Wan goes to their acclaimed Baked BBQ Pork Buns. Known for its fluffy baked buns with crumbly-crisp exterior skin, coupled with oozing barbequed pork char siew fillings, its winning-formula promises a unique bite texture and imparts a comforting sweet-salty flavour finish.

name: Tiong Bahru Bakery
description: Bringing more smiles to shoppers and residents in the East, Tiong Bahru Bakery opens its latest outlet at Tampines 1. Be it a quick coffee break before heading off to your next shopping destination or just enjoying a delicious meal with your loved ones, Tiong Bahru Bakery offers a wide variety of viennoiseries, breads, pastries and beverages that will leave you spoilt for choice.

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: TORI-Q
description: TORI-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated “Tare” (sauce) for enhanced flavours.

name: Tun Xiang
description: Tun Xiang actively promotes the concept of “everyone can afford to taste the Iberico pork.” Tun Xiang wishes to give the opportunity for the public to taste the premium food in their restaurant at a reasonable price.

name: Unity
description: Today, it is a part of FairPrice Group. Serving customers at over 90 outlets islandwide, Unity provides consumers with access to a wide range of health supplements, medication, skin care, hair care and oral car

name: V Aesthetics Body Slim
description: V Aesthetics Body Slim is an extension of V Medical Aesthetics Group – Singapore's Largest Aesthetic Group. V Aesthetics Body Slim provide cutting edge technology, and personalized treatment plans for each individual without the need for crash diets, surgeries or pills! With their signature VSlim™ treatment, it effectively targets weight gain issues, water retention, cellulite, flabby arms or thighs, post-natal weight gain or even menopausal weight gain. Explore a whole new experience with them in body sculpting and slimming with V Aesthetics Body Slim today.

name: Valu$
description: Valu$ delivers exactly what the brand suggest, Value for Money! They offer a wide range of lifestye and home living products at highly affordable prices.

name: Venus Tears
description: Venus Tears started out in 2013 as a bridal jewellery store specializing in custom made rings from Japan. We set ourselves apart from local jewellery stores as we do not have ready stock rings available in our store and all our rings are made from scratch in Japan, ensuring every ring is customized. Our friendly and professional staff will guide you on creating your very own unique, one-of-a-kind ring from choosing your favorite ring setting, selecting your base material, and finally choosing your diamond.

name: Wanpo Tea Shop
description: Wanpo Tea Shop, formerly known as Wanpo Island Black Tea, began at a military base village in Taichung, Taiwan. Now has expanded globally. Like any bubble tea store, it has an assortment of flavors you can choose from. Their menu features five categories: Pure Tea, Fruit Tea, Milk Tea, Seasonal, and Cheese. Most of the drinks come in two sizes—medium or large If you are feeling spoiled for choice, we would recommend going for their bestselling seasonal item—Mango Pomelo Sago; expect a fresh mango slushie with heaps of sago topping, grapefruit pulp, taro balls and mango chunks, Alternatively, try Singapore’s first Custard Boba Milk Tea With Oreo. The drink features streaks of custard cream around a cup filled with milk tea, crushed Oreo bits, and pearls. That’s well-loved for being creamy and fragrant. Another unique drink you should consider is the Mochi Soy Creme Tea Latte. The mochi is made to order, so expect it to be soft and chewy when served.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons is Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer with close to 100 stores islandwide. Watsons seeks to bring ‘more’ to customers’ lives by inspiring and enabling every customer to look good and feel great. Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

name: Wine Connection Bistro
description: Wine Connection is the largest chain of wine retail shops and wine-themed restaurants in Thailand and Singapore, importing over 300 exclusive labels directly from vineyards from all around the world, alongside craft beers and gourmet selections. Since 1998, it has grown into a leading Southeast Asian brand with 80+ outlets, built on its integrated retail and dining concept. With a dedicated team tasting over 2,000 wines yearly, Wine Connection carefully curates exceptional bottles from renowned estates to boutique wineries at accessible prices.

name: Yew Kee Specialities
description: Yew Kee Duck Rice uses the traditional Teochew method of braised duck cooking together with special recipes in braised sauce and chili making handed down by the founder’s father. Today, the brand’s outstanding pairing of braised sauce made from 10 over different type of herbs, spices and ingredients with its speciality chilli is the driving force of the brand with over 30 outlets island wide.

name: Zhang Liang Mala Tang
description: Introducing Zhangliang Malatang, the pioneer in the fast food chain of Malatang, with 5800 locations worldwide. Embrace the irresistible flavors of Chinese cuisine and experience our mission to share Chinese food culture globally. Join us in creating a beloved, internationally recognized Chinese fast food brand!

name: 3TMOBILESTORY
description: Specializing in interesting designs and fashion-forward casings for mobile phones and tablets. Shop the latest mobile accessories and electronic gadgets at affordable prices. There is always something for everyone!

name: 50 Years Taste Of Tradition
description: Our brand is a local Singaporean bakery that specializes in traditional bread, egg tarts, traditional coffee, sandwiches, and more. We are committed to offering high-quality, freshly made products at affordable prices, bringing the authentic taste of Singaporean comfort food to our customers. With a focus on tradition and value, we strive to provide a warm and inviting experience for all who visit us.

name: 6 Elements Hair Spa
description: 6 Elements Hair Spa is a botanical‑driven hair and scalp wellness brand, committed to harnessing nature’s potency with science. They meticulously select over 100 plant‑derived botanicals — such as rosemary, turmeric, aloe vera, saw palmetto, licorice, and nettle — and rigorously test each batch for purity and safety (mercury, lead, pesticides, microbial counts). Their therapeutic treatments address a wide spectrum of scalp and hair concerns — oily or dry scalps, dandruff, hair thinning or loss, irritation, sensitivity — by restoring balance to the scalp’s ecosystem. With multiple outlets across Singapore, 6 Elements blends tradition and innovation to create holistic, safe, and effective hair spa experiences that nourish from root to tip.

name: 8 Clover by Bakery Cuisine
description: Discover the perfect treats at 8 Clover by Bakery Cuisine, where every bite is a celebration. Our specialty in mini croissants, artisanal bread, and delectable buns makes any occasion delightful. Ideal for high tea, snacks, or indulgence, each treat is crafted with the finest ingredients for an irresistible flavor.

name: Absolute Bedding
description: Absolute Bedding has a huge selection of mattresses and modern bed frame designs. We also carry leather and fabric sofas from Europe and Asia. Your comfort is our Absolute pleasure.

name: Abundance
description: Abundance serves up Taiwanese cuisine with a contemporary twist, alongside a curated selection of rotating craft beers and handcrafted cocktails and homebrewed tea.

name: All Best Air-Conditioning
description: The first air-con specialty retailer to achieve CaseTrust Accreditation. We specialise in Daikin, LG, Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, Samsung & Toshiba.

name: Aureus Academy
description: Aureus Academy specializes in providing individually tailored piano, violin, guitar, and vocal lessons to students of all ages and abilities. They believe one-on-one is the best environment to learn a musical instrument, but the trick is keeping students engaged while making the lessons fun and rewarding! Their lessons are designed to engage each student in a way that suits their learning style.

name: Ayam Penyet President
description: Ayam Penyet President is a chain of Halal-certified casual dining restaurants serving authentic Indonesian cuisine. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, their signature Ayam Penyet is served with sambal that packs one helluva punch so you'll definitely want to try their Avocado Juice to balance it out. Or perhaps indulge in one of their more interesting concoctions - Soda Gembira (Happy Soda) and Teh Botol Sosro (Indonesian Bottled Jasmine Tea).

name: Bae.gal by Swee Heng
description: Bae.Gal is a brand-new concept by Swee Heng Bakery. Specializing in Asian-style bagels with a soft and chewy texture with our homegrown roots, Bae.Gal seeks to bring more excitement to the world of confectionery. At Bae.Gal, we think that treating our customers to a wide selection of savoury and sweet bites will satisfy their craves for bagels.

name: Bata
description: Home to Bata's Asia Pacific and Africa operations, the Singapore office manages 3,000 outlets in the region and its many dealers and suppliers. As the Procurement Centre for Bata, we also work closely with our corporate partners and dealers through efficient manufacturing and sales service support in our own factories as well as our affiliates in the Far East Region. This means we can apply the very same technology and quality standards for Bata shoes to help our clients achieve their expectations without compromising on their brand identity.

name: Beard Papa’s
description: Since 1999, Beard Papa’s has been baking The World’s Best Cream Puffs. They began in Japan and have expanded to 430+ stores in the world; committed to serving pastries that are super oishii! (delicious!). Beard papa’s signature custard cream is made only from fresh and natural ingredients. You can smell the aroma of genuine vanilla bean, one of the most valuable spices on the planet and the richness of luxurious whipping cream and butter.

name: Beauty Essentials
description: Beauty Essentials is your haven for impeccable nail care and rejuvenating facials. Step into our elegant space and embark on a journey of pampering and renewal. Our skilled nail technicians and estheticians are dedicated to enhancing your natural beauty with personalized attention and top-tier products.

name: BEGA
description: Having been in the fashion scene since 1996, BEGA strives for the highest commitment from designs and fabric selection to cutting and trimming to ensure the best fit for BEGA women to flaunt their curves. The fusion of colour hues, comfortable quality materials, varied textures and fashionable accessories takes on an exciting fashion edge in exuding confidence in BEGA women. BEGA offers an affordable, bold and feminine fashion – a shopping experience women will love! BEGA retail outlets are conveniently located all over Singapore, situated from heartlands to city shopping malls. At BEGA, we believe in delivering service and value to our customers to ensure they receive the best shopping experience.

name: Beijing 101 Hair Consultants
description: With 90% visible results in increased hair growth and 4 decades of experience, Beijing 101 Hair Consultants also won numerous international awards. It is dedicated to treating common hair issues such as hair scalp concerns, greying hair, premature or excessive white hair, male/female pattern hair loss problems. All Beijing 101 hair treatments use premium-grade natural herbs to treat not just the symptoms of hair and scalp issues, but also the very root of the problem in an integrative and harmonious way, that is in line with TCM practices.

name: Big Fish Small Fish
description: Indulge in the freshest seafood experience at Big Fish Small Fish, your ultimate destination for mouth-watering Fish & Chips and an array of delectable fish dishes. Our unique dining concept allows you to personalize your meal to suit your taste buds. At Big Fish Small Fish, we’re committed to serving only the finest, high-quality seafood, meats, and pastas that can be enjoyed exactly as you like it. And, we’re passionate about putting our own creative spin on classic seafood favourites, ensuring every visit is a delightful culinary adventure.

name: Bio Organicare
description: Bio Organicare has been in this industry since 2012 and was established in 2018. We currently have 4 outlets in Singapore, and will continue to expand. We produced our very own organic in-house formulation for our customers to see visible hair growth and hair loss control in the shortest time. We specialised in using an effective blend of natural and organic ingredients. We use America's newest detoxifying treatment to clear oily scalp and help to reduce hair loss, which also prevent environmental and oxidative damage of inflamed and aged scalp.

name: Bober Tea
description: Bober Tea is a brand of artisan tea focused on providing affordable, high-quality and tasty blends of Tea with a hint of local flavour. Our founders had found on their travels abroad the various tastes of Taiwanese, Japanese and Chinese Bubble teas that are vastly superior and have brought back the best of both worlds to Singapore - fusion of quality overseas teas and high grade bobas.

name: Butahage
description: “Butadon no Butahage” is a specialty shop founded in Obihiro, Tokachi in Hokkaido. Best known for its butadon and tendon using not just premium ingredients but also secret recipe sauce past down generations with more than 80 years of history.

name: Cai-Ca
description: Capturing a Moment of Nature, Serving a Sip of Emotion At Caica, we believe every great cup of tea begins with respect for nature. From the careful picking of the finest tea leaves to the smooth blend with Japanese soy milk, we craft each drink with purity, balance, and care. Blending traditional artistry with modern wellness, our teas deliver natural aroma, refined taste, and heartfelt comfort in every sip. Your Moments, Out Tea.

name: Cash Lux
description: Cash Lux is a modernised, branded luxury retailer as well as a pawnbroker. It retails high-quality, value-for-money branded luxuries (bags, gold jewellery & timepieces) at an affordable price. Concurrently, it helps you to monetise your valuables to meet your short-term financial needs.

name: Cheryl W
description: Cheryl W was founded by Cheryl Wee to help other women overcome their weight management issues & self-image. Cheryl W focus on 3 Ws - Women, Wellness, and Weight Management. They adopt a healthy and gradual approach to weight loss, with the aim of passing on the message of health, vitality, and positivity. They don’t just focus on slimming but rather a sustainable weight management plan, where women can be healthy while looking good. Cheryl W aim to promote a positive and long-term lifestyle solution rather than a quick fix.

name: Chip Lee Jewellery
description: Chip Lee Goldsmith Jewellery with 4 stores across Singapore was established in 1984. They have successfully established themselves as a household name reputed for its trustworthiness, extensive product range and excellent customer service.

name: Concierge (Century Square)
unit: L3, next to The Tree Cafe
level: L3, next to The Tree Cafe
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Cow Play Cow Moo
description: Cow Play Cow Moo is the largest homegrown Arcade and Family Fun Amusement brand in Singapore. With over 160 arcade machines and 280 game stations, Cow Play Cow Moo offers a unique and exciting entertainment experience. Boasting some of the most affordable tokens in Singapore, players can win tickets and take home limited edition, exclusive prizes from beloved brands like Disney, Sanrio, and Marvel. Cow Play Cow Moo priority is creating memorable and enjoyable experiences for guests of all ages.

name: Dayspring Medical Clinic
description: Dayspring Medical Clinic offers a range of affordable, quality primary healthcare services to individuals and families. Patients have access to a wide range of medical services, including GP consultations, health screening, vaccinations, chronic disease management, and work permit screening. The patient-centric clinic is CHAS-accredited, and welcomes various corporate plans. Dayspring Medical Clinic is an excellent choice for individuals and families who are looking for quality healthcare services in a convenient and accessible location. With its comprehensive range of medical services, experienced healthcare professionals, and commitment to patient care, Dayspring Medical Clinic is a trusted provider of healthcare services for all.

name: DBS/POSB
description: POSB's first priority is helping you and your family save for the future. Join their community, share your journey with them, because "we’re neighbours first, bankers second."

name: Dickson Nasi Lemak
description: Dickson Nasi Lemak is a fast-growing local F&B brand known for serving one of Singapore’s most beloved heritage dishes. Famous for its signature Ayam Goreng Berempah , each plate of Nasi Lemak is prepared with fragrant coconut rice, house-made sambal, crispy anchovies, roasted peanuts, and freshly fried chicken marinated in aromatic spices. Founded with a passion for authentic flavours and quality ingredients, Dickson Nasi Lemak has quickly become a favorite among diners looking for a hearty and satisfying meal. With multiple outlets across Singapore, Dickson Nasi Lemak continues to bring its signature flavours to new neighbourhoods, offering shoppers and families a delicious, convenient, and affordable dining option within the mall.

name: Dr J
description: Dr J is a Singaporean company dedicated to improving your foot health and posture for over 14 years. We specialise in locally manufactured Foot Orthotics Arches and in-house custom-made shoes suited for the arches. By pairing our arches and footwear together, our customers have found relief from common foot problems like heel pain, bunions, calluses, tendonitis, and plantar fasciitis.

name: EAT.
description: EAT. is a “one-stop” food outlet serving your favourite local traditional fare like fishball noodles, minced meat noodles (‘bak chor mee’), and laksa, enjoyed in a comfortable and cosy setting. You can also find finger foods such as traditional handmade ngoh hiang and homemade iced lemon tea.

name: Eat 3 Bowls
description: Welcome to Eat 3 Bowls, your gateway to an unforgettable culinary journey through the rich diversity of Taiwanese cuisine. Our vibrant space is not just a restaurant; it's a portal that transports you to the heart and soul of Taiwan's culinary treasures. At Eat 3 Bowls, they wholeheartedly celebrate the essence of Taiwanese culture with every dish served. Whether you're savoring their iconic "Braised Pork Rice," reminiscent of the warm, home-cooked meals of Taiwan, or exploring their diverse street food menu, each bite immerses you in Taiwan's flavors and traditions. Their mission is to do more than just serve food; they're here to ignite your senses, stir your memories, and create new ones. With each dish meticulously crafted to honor the essence of Taiwanese culture, Eat 3 Bowls bring a piece of Taiwan’s heart and soul right here to Singapore.

name: eCreative Cake
description: Throughout the years, eEreative Cake has customised hundreds of cakes for a wide variety of special occasions. With our years of experience, we understand the tastes and preferences of our customers.

name: Estetica
description: With over 40 years of expertise and a commitment to innovation, Estetica offers a distinguished array of award-winning aesthetic services. Our treatments are crafted with inspiration from Nobel Prize-winning research and the latest in technological advancements. Experience the pinnacle of luxury with our meticulously curated beauty services, delivered by highly trained estheticians. At Estetica, rest assured that every customer is always In Good Hands.

name: Eu Yan Sang TCM Clinic
description: As a most trusted chain of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and integrative health clinics, Eu Yan Sang genuinely cares about providing good lifelong health to our customers. We believe in a holistic approach to total health and well-being. Our TCM and Western General Practitioner clinics offer a comprehensive range of traditional Chinese medicines and therapies for effective healing and renewed vitality. Whether you seek treatment for acute or chronic health conditions or simply want to optimise your health, our professionally qualified and experienced team can provide a complete health assessment and personalised treatment plan.

name: Eurotex
description: Eurotex Singapore is Singapore’s leading luxury bath, bedding, bedsheet and ready-made designer curtain brand. Aside from its own range of products, the homegrown label is also an authorised licensee for authentic Disney bedding, bedsheet and bath products in Singapore since 2008.

name: Ex Beauty
description: EX beauty is dedicated to professional beauty services using the latest technology and methodology in the beauty industry. Our beauty salons staffs are from the beauty industry with more than 10 years of working experience in various high-profile beauty brands. All of our staff are equipped with recognized professional qualifications in the industry. We are committed to upgrading ourselves consistently professionally in our specialized field to bring the best services to our customers.

name: EX Style
description: EX Style, an AVEDA Salon in Singapore strongly emphasizes the importance of strengthening healthy hair and providing wellness for our customers. We believe that healthy and luscious hair can be achieved through professional care and guidance provided by our hair stylist and therapist. EX Style strives to be the only hair salon that gives you a one-of-a-kind experience by integrating AI mirrors that help to map and analyses facial features data to accurately recommend suitable hairstyles.

name: FairPrice Finest
description: FairPrice Finest seeks to bring the finest things in life to customers. It combines the heritage of a trusted brand with a whole new experience of fine living at affordable pricing. Scrumptious delis and vintage wines in our gourmet selection are a sensory delight to the gastronome. Our fresh seafood along with our seasonal produce and international selection are carefully hand-picked from all over the world to please even the most discerning palates. Not forgetting the health-conscious; they can take delight with our expanding range of prized organic items and fresh fruits. From the conventional to the epicurious, here is where you can celebrate the finest things in life.

name: Fortune Wigs
description: Fortune Wigs is one of Singapore’s most established wig boutiques, spanning a history of 30 years. Our major goals are to provide professional, yet personalised customer service and to preserve our unequaled standard of high quality products.

name: Four Seasons Durians
description: Being the market leader in Singapore's durian industry, Four Seasons Durians take pride in providing customers with quality durian pastries by using only the freshest and most premium ingredients with no added sugar and preservatives.
