All products are locally handmade using 100% pure durian puree. They are vegetarian friendly and halal-certified.

name: Four Star
description: Established in Singapore, Four Star has more than 50 years of expertise in bedding and mattresses. We have been making ground-making innovations for our products and provided customers with better sleep since 1968. Four Star is proud to be the first mattress company to introduce Anti-static and Pocketed Spring Mattresses in Singapore. The multiple international awards we received over the years are a testament to our innovative spirit and quality assurance. Four Star is committed to providing comfort to everyone and this is evident in the partnership we have with the World Federation of Chiropractic (WFC). The WFC helps to develop effective products in the world for people with chiro pain problems and they have allowed us to gain valuable insights on back problems affecting sleep quality. Four Star has become a trusted household brand that has continued to innovate and grow. We are constantly striving to provide technologically advanced mattresses that aim to improve sleep quality for many generations to come.

name: Fried Chicken Master
description: Fried Chicken Master is a young brand created by the Pres-ident of Super Qin Group Mr.Cho Yuan Yu With over 40 years of poultry farming experience, only the most tender, succulent portion of the chicken is used in conjunction with the proprietary marinade to prepare the touching flavor of Taiwanese fried Chicken.

name: Geniebook CAMPUS & AfterSkool
description: At Geniebook CAMPUS, we make tuition more effective and engaging with technology. P3-P6 physical tuition classes are led by experienced teachers in tech-enabled classrooms, using curated materials powered by Geniebook’s proprietary datasets to accelerate improvement. AfterSkool is an established learning centre with a stellar track record of helping students excel in the IB diploma, ‘O’ and ‘A’ Levels. In partnership with Geniebook, its proven curriculum is now enhanced with technology to help your child excel quickly and efficiently

name: Gifts Greetings
description: Gifts Greetings bring smiles to your little ones with our exciting range of toys. Surprise your loved ones with our unique selection of gifts. Delight your guests with our wonderful party ware's theme. A one-stop shop that satisfies your essential needs for any special occasion!

name: Glamour + Nail.Lash.Brow Studio
description: Welcome to our cosy beauty haven! Be pampered with multi award-winning Brows Embroidery, effective Facial Solutions, mesmerizing Lash works & a wide range of beautiful Nail works. Glamour+ is the only Beauty and Embroidery Faceworks Chain in Singapore to receive recognition from the prestigious International Beauty and Health General Union of Korea. We have been recognized for our revolutionary Embroidery Techniques which are the results of extensive research together with the International Semi-Permanent Association in Korea. Each unique embroidery technique uses different (Korean Manufactured) specialized embroidery needle blades specifically designed to enhance the delivered techniques giving amazing results.

name: Glimpse
description: A wide selection of chic and stylish eye-wear to cater to every different individual’s needs. Glimpse provides instant services and glasses that will be ready in 20 minutes.

name: Golden Chopsticks
description: Rooted in Chinese soul, infused with Nanyang flair — we reimagine the rich flavors of Yunnan, Guizhou, and Sichuan for a global audience. Drawing from the wild aroma of Yunnan, the tangy depth of Guizhou, and the bold spice of Sichuan, we reinterpret these iconic regional tastes through a creative Southeast Asian lens — crafting a distinctive flavor journey. Inspired by Nanyang flavors, we combine fresh ingredients, approachable pricing, and refined plating — making Chinese cuisine modern, inviting, and loved by all. Yunnan: Wild mushroom essence Guizhou: Ancient sour broths Sichuan: Numbing spice philosophy Together, these elements let “Yun-Gui-Chuan” dance on the palate — unlocking a new universe of flavor through Nanyang-style fusion.

name: Golden Village
description: Golden Village (GV) is Singapore’s leading cinema exhibitor with 18 multiplexes and 137 screens. GV is the first local cinema company to personalise the movie-going experience through its Movie Club program, which has a reach of over one million movie buffs. GV offers the widest choice of movies, state-of-the-art design, convenience and unparalleled comfort. Beyond showcasing the latest blockbusters, our approach has always been to make innovation a core part of the GV DNA. From exclusive live screenings, VR Concerts, fan meets to conferences and virtual meetings. GV offers visitors a complete entertainment and lifestyle experience, reflecting our unwavering dedication to deliver MORE THAN JUST A MOVIE.

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang is a 100% local-owned brand that was established in 2017 to provide a unique Ma La cuisine experience while retaining the authenticity of the local fan favourite dish. GYMLT offer drinkable Ma La soup bases that do not leave a greasy or overwhelming aftertaste, so that customers can enjoy it till the very last drop. GYMLT understands that different people have different dietary needs and spice preferences. Hence, GYMLT offers other soup bases such as Mushroom, Pork bone, Tomato and Pickled Vegetable soup bases for those who do not enjoy spices We have also come up with a vegetarian friendly soup for our vegetarian consumers.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 100 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products.

name: H2 Hub Timepiece
description: Since 1970, H2 Hub has been a cornerstone in the watch industry, proudly carrying over 50 international brands, including Seiko, Tissot, Citizen, Maserati, and more. As an authorized dealer, H2 Hub offers a wide variety of renowned brands under one roof, ensuring quality and authenticity for every timepiece.

name: HaiDiLao Hot Pot
description: HaiDiLao has always been dedicated to achieving the perfect blend of authentic traditional Chinese food - Hot Pot with the convenience of modern trend.

name: Home's Harmony
description: At Home's Harmony, we're here to help you craft your home with style, comfort, and functionality. We've curated an exquisite collection of bedlinen, bedding accessories, bath essentials and lifestyle décor that elevate your living spaces to new heights.

name: Hua Cheng & Learning Point
description: Hua Cheng and Learning Point is a well-established private education centre in Singapore, dedicated to delivering high-quality enrichment programmes in both Chinese and English. With a strong reputation built over more than two decades, we have been trusted by parents and students alike for our commitment to academic excellence and holistic language development..

name: Ichiban Boshi
description: Ichiban Boshi introduces Japanese dining with a dash of modern simplicity offering the best premium quality sushi, sashimi, seafood and a variety of set meals. With an emphasis on quality, Ichiban Boshi is proud to present premium Japanese cuisine at reasonable prices right throughout the year.

name: ICON Aesthetics
description: ICON Aesthetics is a 5-star luxurious aesthetic medical spa clinic that combines beauty with technology to deliver award-winning results. This exclusive aesthetics club caters to top celebrities in Singapore and is renowned for that red-carpet ready, ICONIC results. ICON Aesthetics is the place to feel and look like a star with signature programs like the ICONIC Glow Laser, Hollywood Smile with LED Teeth Whitening, Freeze 360, Super Laser Hair Removal and many more.

name: Japan Home
description: With more than 65 outlets island-wide, Japan Home has grown from strength to strength. Embodying a philosophy for quality without compromise, Japan Home prides itself in the provision of a wide range of household products at affordable prices. Today, Japan Home is a household name with an unrivaled reputation as a one-stop provider for all your household needs.

name: Japan IPL Express
description: Not your typical IPL salon. Japan IPL Express is the first unisex salon, committed to offering the most effective and convenient Hair Removal and Skin Solution services dedicated to your needs and wants: “No Packages, No Appointments” – that’s our modus operandi.

name: Ji De Chi Dessert
description: Specialising in Asian desserts and snacks — including a delightful mix of local Chinese, Taiwanese, and Hong Kong favourites — Ji De Chi Dessert offers an extensive selection designed to satisfy every craving. From classic tong sui and traditional sweet soups to modern cold treats, chewy mochi, and fragrant herbal desserts, the menu showcases comforting flavours and authentic textures. With its wide variety and consistent quality, Ji De Chi Dessert is a go-to spot for anyone seeking a satisfying and memorable dessert experience.

name: Jollibee
description: Jollibee is the Philippines’ largest food chain, operating a network of more than 1,100 stores worldwide. A dominant market leader in the Philippines, Jollibee has embarked on an accelerated international expansion plan, now with over 230 international stores in 16 countries. Its world-famous crispylicious, juicylicious Chickenjoy has earned the praise of the late chef Anthony Bourdain, was touted as the best fried chicken in Hong Kong by South China Morning Post, and praised by Foodbeast, a popular US-based food publication.

name: Kappa
description: Founded in 1967, Italian brand Kappa combines classic sportswear with contemporary Fashion styling. It’s collections often feature a distinctive palette of vibrant colours, reflecting its fun brand personality. Kappa's rich history and innovative design places it on the global scale across sports and lifestyle.

name: Karva Salon for Family
description: At Karva Salon for Family, our highly motivated team of Stylists and Scalp Consultants are committed to deliver excellence in service at the highest level. The salon uses the latest techniques, equipment and products from France. All KARVA’s guests are treated with a complimentary selection of beverages, including premium tea.

name: KAZO
description: KAZO® (卡滋屋) is a patisserie bakery specializing in Taiwanese premium handmade baked goods. From Crispy Cream Puff, Signature Polo Bun to Baked Cheese Tart, KAZO values freshness, quality, simplicity, and, of course, taste. With a rigorous ingredient selection and product creation process, they put all their love and passion into the oven, baking fresh every day.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: Kiddy Palace
description: Kiddy Palace is a children’s departmental store providing a one-stop shopping experience for doting mummies and daddies. We aim to be a trusted household brand name in Singapore as a specialty retailer for kids, toddlers, children and expectant mothers.

name: Kin Teck Tong
description: Established in 1967, Kin Teck Tong is Singapore’s homegrown Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) brand which started out as a Chinese Medicinal Herbs wholesaler. Leveraging on its heritage and expertise in Chinese Medicine, Kin Teck Tong transformed into a TCM clinic brand offering a full suite of TCM services in 2005 when the practice of TCM locally was regulated in the early 2000s.

name: Krispy Kreme
description: Krispy Kreme an American Icon is home to world-famous awesome doughnuts. Made fresh daily, it delivers an array of delicious taste through our wide variety of doughnuts and beverages. Krispy Kreme creates the most awesome doughnut experience imaginable as our mission is to touch and enhance lives through the joy that everyone deserves a happy place.

name: Lenskart
description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer brand that retails best quality, fashionable eyewear at surprisingly low prices. Lenskart achieves this by establishing a direct route to customers - straight from manufacturing to retail, and by eliminating 7 layers of middlemen. Lenskart has 2 unique products BLU lenses and Air frames. BLU lenses are designed for the digital age. They block blue rays from smartphones and other digital devices, helping prevent eye damage. Lenskart BLU is a fully loaded lens scratch proof, superhydrophobic and aspheric. Air frames are lightweight, flexible, robust and are designed for ultimate comfort and style.

name: Let Color Soar
description: Let Colour Soar Art Studio was established in 2017 and has since expanded to five branches across Singapore. Our center stands out due to our outstanding achievements in a variety of competitions, as well as our exceptional Direct School Admission (DSA) program. These accomplishments showcase our commitment to excellence and our ability to nurture talent, providing students with unique opportunities for growth and success

name: LEWAVE Hair Studio
description: LEWAVE is a full-service hair salon dedicated to consistently providing high customer satisfaction by rendering excellent service, quality products, and furnishing an enjoyable atmosphere at an acceptable price/value relationship. We also maintain a friendly, fair, and creative work environment, which respects diversity, ideas, and hard work.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Founded in 2017, Luckin Coffee pioneers a technological-driven retail concept aims to provide quality coffee and products accessible to its customers. Using only sustainably, ethically sourced coffee beans roasted to perfection by its WBC Champion Team, Luckin Coffee created a range of unique and delicious blend of coffee that has won the hearts of million coffee lovers. Luckin Coffee’s success and rapid growth over the years are a testament to its unique approach to retail that focuses on technology and customer centric approach, and its relentless dedication to customer satisfaction.

name: Maki-San
description: Maki-san serves up customisable sushis and salads with an incredibly wide selection of very tasty ingredients. So you can pick your own favourites for a crazy combo anytime you like!

name: Mayer
description: Mayer is a lifestyle boutique store that showcases the world's finest kitchen brands. Our kitchen appliances are synonymous with high performance, premium quality and durability and promise to enhance any beautiful home with their functional beauty. When you think of premium kitchen appliances, think of Mayer.

name: MINISO
description: Established in Tokyo, Miniso was jointly founded by Miyake Junya, the chief designer of MINISO, and Ye Guofu, a young Chinese entrepreneur, with the aim of advocating a fashionable and relaxed lifestyle. Today, Miniso is a global fast fashion designer brand, offering a wide range of products across 10 product categories including lifestyle, home, gifts, and electronics. Miniso is dedicated to providing customers with quality and creative products at affordable prices.

name: Ministry of Rojak
description: Ministry of Rojak, an expansion of Abdhus Salam Rojak (hailing from Ayer Rajah hawker centre) is dedicated to providing authentic traditional Indian hawker food with an innovative twist without compromising neither its quality nor taste. Its famous sweet potato sauce has a smooth nutty touch that lends a nice texture to the overall sensation and not forgetting a delicious array of Pratas and all the famous mamak gorengs accompanied with its famous hot and cold beverages.

name: Mixue
description: MIXUE is a national chain brand dedicated to creating fresh ice cream and tea for young people. Since establishment in 1997, it has always been adhering to the principle of high quality and affordable price, and committed to promoting better and faster development of the global ice cream and tea industry!

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: Mr You Tiao
description: Since 2007, Mr YouTiao has been promoting youtiao, an otherwise plain and traditional snack. Why youtiao you may ask? Because YouTiao is tasty, crispy, fluffy and chewy all at once! We believe the combination is unique and unmatched among other dough-related food products. They now serve a whole range of food & beverage items that compliment youtiao. Traditional coffee and tea, soya milk, beancurd, porridge, curry chicken, bah kut teh, tastie noodles, butterfly buns… You name it!

name: MultiFlora
description: Established since 2002, MultiFlora has come a long way with the vision to bring health and wellness as well as beauty to all walks of life.

name: My Korean Mom’s Kimchi
description: Annyeong! Korean mom & son duo that brings authentic korean food experience to your home. Enjoy their affordable, authentic takeaway dishes - complete with lovingly handmade banchan. From their signature freshly made kimchi and refreshing cucumber kimchi to hot favourites like hand‑rolled gimbap and spicy chicken katsu bibimbap, there’s something delicious for everyone.

name: Nail Addiction
description: Nail Addiction, with over a decade in manicure and pedicure services, started from one outlet and now operates 13 outlets in key Singapore locations. Committed to growth and quality, we continue to expand with a focus on customer satisfaction. Our expertise lies in top-quality manicure and pedicure services, delivered by specialists updated with the latest trends. We aim to foster a culture of enjoyment and success for all who visit us, and look forward to many more years ahead.

name: Nail Palace
description: Nail Palace is one of the best at its craft because the company thrives on passion and attention-to-detail rather than being profit-oriented. They strive to provide quality services that will pamper your nails and reinvent your style. One requirement that their technicians must fulfill is the love for the job. Nail Palace's range of products and services are highly diverse and readily available to meet and satisfy any needs. Besides first-class pedicures and manicures, they provide nail art services, foot hydro-spa therapy, sole renewal treatment and other services. They also have products from well-known brands such as Seche, OPI, Gelish and Ezflow that consumers love.

name: Nan Yang Dao
description: Serving authentic Malaysian cuisines, Nan Yang Dao aims to bring together the rich flavours and aromas of Malaysia with bold and savoury dishes that are well loved by all. Expect dishes from different parts of Malaysia, such as Penang fried kway teow and Penang assam laksa.

name: Nature's Farm
description: Established in 1982, Nature's Farm is Singapore’s leading health supplements retailer that offers a diverse and comprehensive range of nutritional supplements for the whole family - from children to adults and seniors. We are the first health food retailer in Singapore to introduce Western food supplements. We are also a GMP-certified manufacturer and owns multiple patented-products.

name: New Nada Barber
description: New Nada is a Barber Shop which provides haircuts to males. Our professional and experienced Barbers provide top notch quality haircuts and excellent service at all times.

name: Nine Fresh
description: Nine Fresh is a home-grown brand specializing in a wide selection of chilled taro ball desserts that are freshly scooped and served daily. With 3 different types of signature bases (Bean Curd, Grass Jelly and Ai-Yu Jelly) and a huge variety of toppings such as beans, jellies as well as chewy delights (signature taro balls, mini taro Q and black pearl), they cater to different palates and preferences!

name: Ogawa
description: Dive into the world of wellness with Ogawa Singapore. Massage chairs, gaming seats, slimming massagers, massage pillows & more.

name: Old Tea Hut
description: At Old Tea Hut, we brew fresh all day long, just for you. Our love for fine tea blends, rich coffee roast and tantalising beverages start our dedication to bringing you an exciting gastronome menu experience. We offer different flavours of tea and coffee beverages from time-honoured traditional drinks to original Old Tea Hut creations, as well as flavourful alternative beverages. So whatever your preference is, we’ll have the right beverage to tantalize your taste buds! We welcome you to discover and enjoy a taste of Old Tea Hut today.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: Peniwern
description: Peniwern is your go-to source for styles influenced by the latest fashions with an added flair. They aim to make fashion affordable to everyone, without degrading quality and expectations.

name: Play United
description: This is a fun game that features a claw tour with claw machines.

name: prettyFIT
description: Founded in 1994, prettyFIT is a fashion-forward brand that embodies a confident and unconstrained woman who seeks to express her own unique individuality. Driven by its aspirations to set women free from boundaries, prettyFIT re-defines comfort by incorporating numerous comfort-centered technologies to make our shoes so much softer, more enjoyable and wearable. The brand's intricate, trend-focused products have become sartorial essentials for women from all walks of life.

name: Q & M Dental Surgery
description: Q & M Dental Group was first established in November 1996 at Bukit Batok. Over the years, it has grown from strength to strength and now has more than 100 clinics island-wide, thus making it the largest private dental healthcare group in Singapore. Q & M Dental Group is also CHAS/Merdeka Generation (MG)/Pioneer Generation (PG)/Medisave/Baby Bonus accredited. We look forward to serving you there!

name: Repair Station
description: Repair Station specialize in Mobile Phones and Tablet repair services ranging from Samsung, Apple, LG, Sony, etc.

name: Revival Hair Gallery
description: At Revival Hair Gallery, we believe your hairstyle should be as dynamic and versatile as your lifestyle. Our salon is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge styles that effortlessly transition from the workplace to your evening plans, making sure you look polished and confident no matter the occasion. Whether you're preparing for a high-stakes business meeting or getting ready for a night out with friends, our expert stylists are committed to crafting looks that perfectly blend professionalism with modern flair.

name: Saizeriya
description: Saizeriya was founded in 1967 in a small town in Chiba, Japan, and has since grown from strength to strength with over a thousand outlets spanned across Asia. With its unique offerings of casual Italian cuisines at affordable prices and an “All-you-can-drink” bar set amidst a comfortable ambience, Saizeriya promises customers a great dining experience every time.

name: Scarlett
description: Scarlett Supermarket is the leading one-stop supermarket which sells an extensive range of popular Chinese snacks, dried goods, necessities and beverages imported directly from China. One can find household names like Hai Chi Jia Suan La Fen, Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea and Tsingtao Beer at the most affordable prices islandwide here.

name: Sea Horse
description: "Sea Horse" brand was establish in the mid 80s' in Hong Kong. The major product lines focus on household products. The brand aims at the general public, famous for its excellent quality with economic pricing. In 1987, the Sea Horse Healthy Mattress was launched. The products has been applauded by the users since then. According to SRH report, Sea Horse Mattress and pillow have been the number one best sellers in Hong Kong since 1989. Sea Horse brand is a ideal choice for consumers looking for top grade products with reasonable price.

name: Sealy Sleep Boutique
description: Sealy Posturepedic helps you relax and recover every night. When you purchase a Sealy Posturepedic, you are choosing the world’s most trusted mattress brand.

name: Selffix DIY
description: The leading D.I.Y store in Singapore. My home, my office, my car... My Self Fix! Established in 2004, Selffix is of the leading DIY hardware stores in Singapore with 11 outlets islandwide. We have been in DIY business for almost a decade and have grown to be a household name when it comes to DIY goods, hardware, and appliances, offering a broad portfolio of products to our valued customers.

name: Shara Exchange
description: Shara Exchange specialize in seamless currency conversions for travelers and businesses. Their dedicated team ensures competitive rates, accuracy, and exceptional service. Whether you’re planning an international trip or managing cross-border transactions, count on them!

name: Shoe Clinic
description: Shoe Clinic is committed to operate a chain of Shoe re-crafting outlet in town and in the major heartlands areas. These outlet will offer a variety of sole re-crafting and customisation services. The concept will be enhanced with key duplication services and quality Shoe Care products, and provide our customer with a wider array of shoe repair options. We offer our customer not just regular shoe repair, but a range of exciting high quality Vibram soles from Italy. It is our passion and commitment to provide quality craftsmanship to each and every customer regardless of the brand or the amount too be paid for our services and to provide a fun and exciting recrafting experience for our customer.

name: Sinjojo
description: Sinjojo is a brand that embodies a specific concept and mindset that emphasizes self-love, strength, and courage. They offer a range of high-quality products at affordable prices, catering to women of various age groups. Their collections are designed to provide a distinct and versatile style that complements everyday outfits.

name: Skechers
description: Skechers originated from a south California slang, which means “energetic youngsters”. Skechers designs, develops and markets a diverse range of footwear for men, women and children. Born in a small beachside California community in 1992, SKECHERS has grown from a one-style, one-building company to be one of the world famous footwear brands. SKECHERS is now the No.2 footwear brand in the United States (according to Sporting Goods Intelligence) and was named Company of the Year by Footwear Plus for the 5th time in 6 years (2005, 2006, 2008, 2009, 2010).

name: Solace Studios
description: Established in 2022, Solace Studios is a leading Korean-Style Self Photo Booth Studio in Singapore. Featuring 6 physical outlets and several pop-up booths across Singapore, Solace Studios is the top-of-mind choice for those seeking a memorable photobooth experience.

name: Sorella
description: Sorella believes in treasuring and celebrating every woman's innate femininity. We aim to highlight and enhance your natural beauty and sexy curves with our high quality lingerie, which provide unparalleled support, superior shaping, desired toning and overall flawlessness. Cherish yourself with Sorella and unveil your true feminine allure. Discover, indulge in your body and love yourself entirely through our premium lingerie.

name: Sparkle
description: Sparkle was established in 2019 and have a wide range of products such as gifts, stationery, toys, electronic accessories, party accessories, and other trendy products. Our target segment focuses on the younger spectrum - toddlers, children, adolescents, and young working adults. Sparkle is managed by a young, dynamic, and dedicated team with coverage over the brand's in-house sourcing, merchandising, design, and logistics.

name: Spectacle Hut
description: Spectacle Hut is your partner for all things eye care. We prioritise your eye health by providing quality vision care and tailored solutions to you, your families and friends. We offer extensive range of eyewear product from fast fashion to luxury brands and wide selection of prescriptive lens solution for different needs. Visit us today to find your favourite pair, with complimentary eye screening. Simply visit our website to make an appointment.

name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Stellar
description: Stellar provides a quiet and secure environment to ensure your piercing experience is safe and comfortable. With a strict sanitisation routine and safety protocol, you can be assured that your piercing is performed with high standards of hygiene and precaution.

name: SUKIYA
description: SUKIYA is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant with over 2,600 locations across the world. Founded in 1982 in Yokohama, our mission is to serve authentic Japanese food with reliable quality at affordable prices throughout the world.

name: Sushi Express
description: One of the biggest conveyor belt sushi brands in Asia, offering more than 80 different variations of sushi from $1.50++ per plate. At Sushi Express, we understand that it’s not always about value when it comes to serving our customers, it is about consistently providing quality and innovative products competitively.

name: SuzyAmeer
description: SuzyAmeer Frozen was established as a Muslim-owned company with the goal of providing future generations and busy adults with the ability to quickly prepare meals, even with a packed schedule. As a 100% Halal-certified company, we aim to provide Muslim customers with the assurance that all of our products meet their dietary needs. SuzyAmeer is a convenient one-stop Halal supermarket that caters to your needs.

name: Swee Choon
description: Synonymous with timeless appeal and well-honed craftsmanship, Swee Choon has become a destination F&B venue for both locals and tourists. In “Destination Singapore”, a definitive guide for travel agents, the Singapore Tourism Board lists Swee Choon as one of the country’s must-visit food destinations.

name: TAKA Jewellery
description: TAKA Jewellery is a household brand established in Singapore with a strong presence of stores islandwide. Step into the wonders of treasures and experience an enchanting feature on a wide array of selections. Ranging from timeless classics to contemporary designs, crafted for the unique you.

name: Teahouse by Soup Restaurant
description: During the 1950-70s, there were many renown teahouses in Chinatown. Back then, enjoying a hot soup with a couple of dim sum dishes was a daily habit for folks of Chinatown. At Teahouse by Soup Restaurant, we serve a variety of Nanyang flavors Dim Sum, such as "4 Beauties", "Ma Jie Chives Dumplings" and more. Enliven the Chinatown teahouse dining culture with us at Teahouse by Soup Restaurant.

name: Texas Chicken
description: Texas Chicken serves freshly prepared chicken and tenders with signature sides and handcrafted honey-butter biscuits. We differentiate ourselves from competitors through the care and attention given in the preparation of food - made in small batches all day long to provide freshly-made and piping-hot meals for our patrons.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
description: A premium coffee and tea retailer that offers an extensive variety of expertly crafted beverages, freshly baked pastries, delectable cakes, and party packs. Their whole cakes are perfect for any occasion, and their e-card program rewards loyal customers.

name: The Flip Flop Shop
description: Live, work and play with your toes exposed® and the freedom of flip flops on your feet. Flip Flop Shops® is the authentic retailer of the hottest brands and latest styles of flip flops and casual footwear. It's more than just a shop...it's a lifestyle. They love the water and everything about it. Whether it's surfing at Rincon with friends or standing at the water's edge in Tofino while the waves pull the sand out from under your feet and back to the sea...we love it. They ride powder in Canada, bike the backcountry of New Zealand and raft down the Colorado. They love adventure and traveling. They keep up on the latest fashion trends and make up our own. They sometimes go to bed with salty skin and the smell of the ocean after a day of surfing. They take care of our environment and help out our favorite charities. They love music and singing along with our favourite songs. Their flip flops are an extension of who we are and what we stand for. They live, work and play with their toes exposed® while wearing the freedom of flip flops on our feet.

name: The Food Market by Food Junction
description: Step into The Food Market, and one is centred around fresh, raw produce prepared to order, at a variety of cuisine themed stands. The aroma and sounds of cooking, clangs of woks and pans, along with the hustle and bustle of a cultured market place, sets the ambience. The setting of crates, raw display of ingredients, together with an interior of brown and rust hues, further complements the place.

name: The Green Party
description: The Green Party is dedicated to offering consumers a diverse selection of stylish and innovative green products designed to enhance their lifestyles. We are committed to upholding the essence of style, presenting a contemporary and exquisite range that seamlessly blends quality and comfort for a hassle-free daily life.

name: The Learning Lab
description: The Learning Lab is a leading tuition and enrichment provider for students from Nursery 2 to JC 2, with a strong track record of preparing students for school and for life.

name: The MeatHouse by 18 Chefs
description: We are a halal certified steak house that serves a variety of premium meats such as Tomahawk, OP Ribs and T-Bone Steak. Our premium meats are charcoal-grilled using the renowned Josper grill which is a hybrid grill and oven. This creates a charred flavour on the outside and tender juiciness on the inside!

name: The Orange Academy
description: The Orange Academy believes in cultivating children to be confident bilingual speakers in English and Mandarin by providing opportunities to hone their linguistic skills. The physical environment and classroom activities are designed to stimulate children’s creative thinking and logical reasoning and ignite their passion for learning. The Orange Academy strive to equip children with life skills, which are embedded in their holistic curriculum.

name: The Original Vadai
description: Serving the best Prawn Vadai in town since 1989, their menu has now expanded to other flavours and skewers! Look nowhere, The Original Vadai are the specialist!

name: The Seafood Market Place By Song Fish
description: Discover a world of ocean delights at The Seafood Market Place by Song Fish, where variety meets quality. With 11 outlets across Singapore, we bring the freshest and finest Seafood right to your neighbourhood. Our selection spans from fresh catches to premium frozen items, ensuring every culinary need is met. Convenient and comprehensive, we offer choice picks for every Seafood lover.

name: The Sense House
description: At The Sense House, we offer a curated range of aromatic and wellness products made from the finest ingredients sourced globally. Our collection includes Essential oils, Ultrasonic aroma diffusers, Reed diffusers, Nebulisers, Humidifiers, Aroma solutions, Air revitalisers/purifiers, and other scent-focused items — thoughtfully designed to refresh the senses and enhance everyday living.

name: The Tree Cafe
description: HUB for a delicious blend of Western and Asian fusion flavors! Perfect spot to unwind with friends, enjoy free Wi-Fi, and even squeeze in some study time!

name: Tip Top Curry Puff
description: Tip Top curry puffs has been an iconic heritage brand renowned for deliciously traditional handmade puffs that are made with 18 specially blend of spices, potatoes & ingredients.

name: Tongue Tip Lanzhou Beef Noodles
description: Tongue Tip Lanzhou beef noodles originated from the Lanzhou, Gansu province in China. This dish was first created by the Muslim Chinese (Hui) people and it’s recipe has been passed on for generations since the Tang Dynasty. Original Lanzhou Beef Noodles, using Halal meats, high quality fresh ingredients and a 15 spice blend premium stock.

name: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen
description: Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen is a popular authentic Japanese hot stone ramen with an entertaining twist, with portions and a variety of menu good for sharing and for fun family dining.

name: Universal Optical
description: Universal Optical provide services for your eye-health, such as eye-checks, dispensing optical lenses and contact lenses, and we have a wide range of beautiful frames and sunglasses.

name: V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic
description: V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic is one of the largest medical aesthetics group in Singapore. With clinics island wide and over 30 medical doctors, they offer a plethora of non-surgical and non-invasive treatments for your aesthetics goals. From FDA approved medical aesthetic treatments to affordable and transparent pricing, they set strong priorities in providing patient comfort and safety. Be it to achieve a V shaped face, to have luminous and flawless complexion, V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty is your go-to destination for quality beauty and household cleaning products at unbeatable prices. Explore our curated selection of skincare, haircare, and cosmetics, alongside an array of effective household cleaning essentials. Discover a diverse range of beauty items, from skincare and cosmetics to haircare essentials, all designed to make you feel radiant without breaking the bank. Indulge in a delightful shopping experience where affordability meets quality. From skincare essentials to hou

name: Vivian & Sean
description: Established in 1998, the name Moda Paolo has become synonymous with good quality shoes in the latest designs. Moda Paolo’s shoes are stylish, trendy, durable, comfortable and affordable, providing customers with good value for money. Moda Paolo distinguishes itself as the home-grown footwear retailer which understands consumer preferences in terms of comfort, design and aesthetics especially that of Asian customers. In Nov 2011, the company opened a new outlet under the brand name Vivian & Sean to target a

name: Welcia
description: Welcia Singapore, is a leading health and beauty store dedicated to providing customers with premium Japanese products and services. Focusing on overall well-being, Welcia offers a carefully selected range of Japanese Beauty, Healthcare, and Wellness products, many exclusive to Welcia Singapore. Committed to making customers healthy and beautiful, Welcia aims to deliver solutions through a combination of excellent products, hospitality, and top-notch service. Welcia reflects the brand's vision of promoting well-being and customer satisfaction. Social Media Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/welciasg Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/welciasg Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@welciasg Official Website: https://www.welcia.com.sg

name: Wok The Fish!
description: Wok The Fish! by A-One F&B Group is your ultimate destination for the finest umami Fish Soup. Founded in 2023, we are committed to provide a truly unforgettable dining experience with the use of freshest ingredients. Dive into a world of savory delights at WOK The Fish! and savor the essence of the sea in every spoonful.

name: XW Plus Western Grill
description: Being the western casual dining place, XW Western Grill is your one-stop for all things grilled. Offering a line-up of smoky favourites such as steaks, chicken and fish, the combination of mouth-watering natural juices and charred flavours are perfect for insatiable palates. Our all-you-can-eat salad bar boasting unlimited servings of hot and cold sides won’t disappoint either, it comes free with any main course order or go straight for the à la carte salad bar. Kick back and enjoy western grub in this vibrant value-for-money diner – a perfect avenue for gatherings with family and friends.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.

name: Yang Hua Furniture Trading
description: Yang Hua Furniture Trading is a direct manufacturer of a wide selection of furniture at direct factory price. They are able to customize, give expert advice according to your needs at reasonable price.

name: Young Hearts
description: The Young Hearts brand is fun-loving, high-spirited, feminine and young. They are passionate about living a quality life and hence, support and encourage this by creating and producing products with great attention to research, design, detail, variety and quality. They have a wide selection of daily essential lingerie products to whimsical sleepwear and fun lifestyle products. Young Hearts hope to inspire everyone who comes into contact with us to love life with passion, confidence and enjoyment!

name: Yun Nam Hair Care
description: Throughout the years, Yun Nam’s philosophy of using Chinese herbs of the highest quality to specifically target each individual’s hair and scalp problems remains unchanged. They have continuously refined their herbal formulas, using advances in modern technology to further enhance the efficacy of their treatments to ensure better absorption and longer lasting effects. From using more well-known herbs like Ginseng, Dang Gui and He Shou Wu, to lesser known but no less effective ones like Salvia, Peony Root, and Dodder Seed, no expense is spared when customizing hair treatments to help individuals regain healthy hair.

name: Decathlon
description: A global multi-specialist sports brand catering to everyone from beginners to top athletes, DECATHLON is an innovative manufacturer of sporting goods for all skill levels. With over 102,900 teammates and 1,902 stores worldwide, DECATHLON and its teams have been working since 1976 to make the joys and benefits of sport truly accessible to all.

name: Q & M Dental Surgery
description: Q & M Dental Group was first established in November 1996 at Bukit Batok. Over the years, it has grown from strength to strength and now has more than 100 clinics island-wide, thus making it the largest private dental healthcare group in Singapore. Q & M Dental Group is also CHAS/Merdeka Generation (MG)/Pioneer Generation (PG)/Medisave/Baby Bonus accredited. We look forward to serving you there!

name: XIANG XIANG HUNAN CUISINE 湘香湖南菜
description: We are a locally established chain of Hunan cuisine in Singapore, with more than 20 outlets across the island since 2009. As pioneers of authentic and rare Hunan cuisine, we offer a unique culinary experience deeply rooted in tradition, bringing the rich and diverse flavours of Hunan to Singaporean diners.

name: Ajisen Tanjiro
description: A brand extension of their flagship Ajisen Ramen, Ajisen Tanjiro features signature favourites from its parent brand and more! Beyond its ramen offerings, Ajisen Tanjiro's expanded menu includes Maze Soba, rice set meals and a delectable selection of side dishes to complete the meal.

name: Anake
description: Born from the belief that true beauty transcends cultures, aging, trends, and radiates from an inner feeling of well-being, ANAKE’s mission is to deliver a holistic beauty & wellness experience to our clients - Tailored skincare backed up by science (ANAKE DNA SKIN TEST KIT), a customised regime (ANAKE SKIN) and edible skin food (SUPERFOOD, supplements by Anake). Feel good from the inside-out, a journey towards vibrant health and luminous skin. We call it inside-out beauty.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: BreadTalk
description: A staple in the diet of many in Asia, we honour the art of bread-making by giving life to novel creations since our inception in 2000. BreadTalk is a distinctive, award-winning Singaporean brand that has gained international appeal for its signature Flosss. With the belief that every bun has a life of its own and a story to tell, BreadTalk is renowned for the way it has revolutionised the culture of bread consumption with creativity and innovation. At the heart of our brand, Flosss is an iconic product that has become synonymous with BreadTalk. Our range of breads goes far beyond Flosss, with new and exciting products regularly added to our lineup.

name: Butter & Cream
description: Since 2021, Butter & Cream has proudly expanded to 12 locations across Singapore, renowned for our signature fluffy muffins, egg tarts and burnt cheesecakes. Experience our commitment to freshness, creativity, and excellence in every little bite.

name: CHAGEE
description: CHAGEE is an international tea brand that brings traditional tea to modern life. Drawing from centuries of tea heritage, we craft premium whole-leaf brews that blend tradition with innovation — creating shared moments of connection, every day, in every cup. CHAGEE TOGETHER.

name: Chateraise
description: Chateraise have over 470 stores across all of Japan and over 15 stores in Asia. All of their sweets are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as pure natural water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms in Japan. They directly deliver all their sweets from Japan to stores around the world.

name: Clippers Barber
description: Clippers Barber is your affordable old-school barbershop with a modern revamp. It is a place where our customers of all ages can sit back, relax, enjoy a professional grooming service at the hands of our expert barbers, who pride themselves for their superior fades & clean cuts. We aim to leave you with a fresh new look and a smile on your face.

name: Concierge (Hougang Mall)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Crystal Optics
description: Established in 1996 at Hougang Mall, with a shop area of more than 1000 square feet currently, we are a team of qualified optometrists and opticians. We provide spectacles, contact lenses, as well as professional eye care services to cater to your needs. With an array of branded eye wear, other affordable brands and friendly customer service, we strive to give our customers the best shopping experience possible!

name: Dabba Street
description: At Dabba Street, we've given Indian and Mediterranean classics a refreshing, green twist. Dive into favorites like biryanis and butter chicken, perfectly paired with our range of traditional and healthier sides, dips, and chutneys. You won't find any ghee, heavy oils, added MSG, artificial colors, or flavors here. Just vibrant, wholesome food!

name: Dough Culture
description: Dough Culture is a Singapore-based food and beverage brand established in 2009. The brand preserves the taste of classic local treats while modernizing production through automation and innovation. Committed to quality and hygiene, Dough Culture uses 100% vegetable oil and is both Halal and HACCP certified. Its mission is to bring beloved oriental snacks into the modern lifestyle, maintaining sincerity, passion, and innovation at the heart of its operations.

name: ePLAY
description: ePLAY offers a mobile app that seamlessly connects online and offline shopping experiences for enthusiasts of games, toys, and gadgets. By utilizing our innovative platform, users can conveniently browse and purchase their desired items directly from their smartphones. This revolutionary approach aims to bridge the gap between virtual and physical shopping for tech enthusiasts.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Eu Yan Sang is Asia's leading integrative healthcare and wellness company with a strong foundation in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). Founded in 1879 with the mission of 'Caring for Mankind' - Today, Eu Yan Sang is a trusted household brand. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Foodies’ Garden
description: Drawing upon a diverse spread of culinary cultures, Foodies’ Garden™ presents a variety of food and beverage brands housed under one roof. We aim to connect the community in setting that celebrates our culinary culture. From hawker favourites to international cuisines, a plethora of food awaits you.

name: Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

name: Four Star
description: Established in Singapore, Four Star has more than 50 years of expertise in bedding and mattresses. We have been making ground-making innovations for our products and provided customers with better sleep since 1968. Four Star is proud to be the first mattress company to introduce Anti-static and Pocketed Spring Mattresses in Singapore. The multiple international awards we received over the years are a testament to our innovative spirit and quality assurance. Four Star is committed to providing comfort to everyone and this is evident in the partnership we have with the World Federation of Chiropractic (WFC). The WFC helps to develop effective products in the world for people with chiro pain problems and they have allowed us to gain valuable insights on back problems affecting sleep quality. Four Star has become a trusted household brand that has continued to innovate and grow. We are constantly striving to provide technologically advanced mattresses that aim to improve sleep quality for many generations to come.

name: Giordano
description: Giordano embodies today’s contemporary lifestyle choices – simplicity in design and quality in substance. Their total commitment to superior service and outstanding quality and value has enabled the company to successfully grow the brands Giordano, Giordano Ladies, Giordano Junior, BSX, and Beau Monde. The essence of Giordano is to provide relevant, essential and timeless fashion for all; and to develop apparel for everyone regardless of ethnicity, nationality or culture, truly illustrating their brand value “World Without Strangers”.

name: Glamour Beauty
description: Glamour Beauty is a complete one stop shop for all your beauty needs. We believe in multi-modal approach in beauty. We have years of experience, science and technology to create the most genuine beauty journey you will experience You will enjoy our face, body and eyebrow embroidery carried out by highly qualified, experienced beauticians. We aims to provide each client with exceptional, professional service intended to relax, energize and revitalize you, your skin and your body.

name: Grill N Grill
description: Grill N Grill is a family owned business and been in restaurant/catering for over 30 years. Specializing in BBQ and homemade dishes, Grill N Grill always use the freshest ingredients and take pride in the quality of food served.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian is the Trusted Health & Wellness Advisor in Singapore. Established in 1972, Guardian is Singapore's Trusted Health & Wellness Advisor. With more than 120 stores nation-wide, it retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots to a holistic one-stop solution for customers’ health and beauty needs. It continues to expand its products and service range to meet the redefinition of beauty by today’s customers – where health meets beauty. With a strong health heritage, it has the largest network of award-winning pharmacists and a wide selection of health products. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. Guardian also operates its online app with more than 9,000 products available and offers the “Click & Collect” services.

name: Hang Ten
description: From our surf origins, our aim is to continue inspiring everyone to be master of their own waves. Our apparels are designed to last as long as the surf of your life does. Everyday we hope that you will continue to pursue your dreams with Hang Ten in mind.

name: HAPPY BITES
description: Mini pastries made for big moments of joy. Perfectly bite‑sized treats thoughtfully crafted for sharing, celebrating, and everyday indulgence. Each piece delivers rich flavor and elegant detail, proving that even the smallest bites can create the biggest smiles, warm memories, and meaningful moments worth savoring anytime, anywhere.

name: Harvey Norman
description: Harvey Norman from Australia is a leading electronics, IT, Furniture and Bedding chain in Singapore. You will find a wide range of products ranging from the latest home entertainment systems and computers, to the most stylish and innovative home appliances for your everyday use. You will also find Australian-Made and Italian furniture and bedding products from top brands. Look out for weekly promotions that bring you great value deals so you can shop with confidence.

name: Healthway Hougang Clinic
description: Healthway Medical Corporation Limited (“Healthway Medical” or the “Group”) is a leading private healthcare provider with the largest network of medical centres and clinics in Singapore and a fast developing network in Shanghai, China. The Group has a strong presence in these cities, owning, operating and managing over 100 medical centres and clinics which are easily accessible and located in the communities.

name: Heart Springs Spa
description: Spring Into A better You! Heart Springs Spa is an exquisite spa that allows you to indulge your senses, invigorate your body and inspire your mind. Simply devoted to authenticity and harmony, the wide range of beauty services available at Heart Springs Spa includes facials, massages, foot reflexology, hyfro-therapies, body polishes, bust enhancement, ear candling, IPL hair removal, IPL anti-acne and eyebrow embroidery.

name: Hockhua Tonic
description: Hockhua Tonic, a household name in Singapore and Malaysia since 1989, is known for its retail chain of stores stocked with traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), health supplements and tonics. Renowned for its quality ginseng and wide range of bird's nest products, it also offers seafood delicacies such as abalones, dry scallops, Chinese herbs and a variety types of self-manufactured nutrition organically grown products.

name: IVI Aesthetic
description: Our obsession with perfect, healthy balanced skin has led to the launch of IVI Aesthetic. Because we believe in correction rather than concealment, our goal is to help customers get healthy skin from within. Breaking away from traditional facial spa methods and techniques, IVI Aesthetic focusses on medical grade treatments combined with a tinge of traditional practices to bring customers closer to beautiful, flawless and foundation free skin.

name: Japan Home
description: With more than 65 outlets island-wide, Japan Home has grown from strength to strength. Embodying a philosophy for quality without compromise, Japan Home prides itself in the provision of a wide range of household products at affordable prices. Today, Japan Home is a household name with an unrivaled reputation as a one-stop provider for all your household needs.

name: Jean Yip Salon
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: Jollibee
description: Jollibee is famous across the world since 1978 for delicious crispy Fried Chicken and other comfort food including pies, beef spaghetti, burgers and many more. Try our world famous Chickenjoy fried chicken or our Chicken sandwich and you’ll understand why they bring joy to so many people! There is nothing like eating food with joyfulness with the ones you love.

name: Kai Joo Optical
description: Kai Joo Optical offers professional optometry services (spectacle and contact lenses ) and eye care advice. The open concept store is designed to clearly display a wide array of eyewear from Asia to Europe. Coupled with Kai Joo Optical’s experienced, service orientated optometrists and opticians to assist your selection of frames and sunglasses, each visit to Kai Joo Optical promises to be a fun and enjoyable experience.

name: Kappa
description: Kappa is a global Italian sportswear brand rooted in performance, movement, and modern style. Our stores feature a versatile range of activewear, athleisure essentials, and everyday sports-inspired apparel designed for training, lifestyle, and on-the-go comfort. From performance footwear to iconic Banda styles, Kappa brings sport and style together for today’s active generation.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: KENJO
description: Kenjo is a Singapore-based fashion company, established for a very simple reason: to provide stylish yet affordable clothes that you won’t have to break the bank for. They believe that fashion is a personal expression, one that you should be able to freely express, and one that should EMPOWER you! While making you the trendiest lady on a budget is important, they also care about the quality you are receiving. To ensure that you receive the best quality, they collaborate actively with the manufacturers from South Korea and Hong Kong so as to leverage on their cost-advantage to bring you affordable, yet good quality items. Happy shopping!

name: KOI Thé
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: Koong Woh Tong
description: Koong Woh Tong first began its business of making and selling traditional herbal jelly ‘GuiLingGao’ and herbal tea, namely ‘Ya Sei Mei’ and ‘Wong Lo Kat’ in a small stall in inland China. Due to the popularity and healing effects of these healthy products, the business has since flourished and has been carried on by family member generation after generation. As herbal jelly and herbal tea have proven efficacy, they are becoming popular and well recognized by the people from over 20 countries worldwide. Over the past 25 years, the brand has grown from strength to strength and has become synonymous with Chinese Herbal healthcare product.

name: Kyoto Onimaru
description: Kyoto Onimaru’s rice balls (Omusubis) are meticulously cooked and grilled to perfection. With over 20 delightful flavours, each one is crafted to bring joy to our customers. Every Omusubi is handmade with care, using ingredients thoughtfully selected by Japanese chefs. Since opening our first store in June 2022, Kyoto Onimaru has rapidly expanded across Asia and now operates 27 locations worldwide. Our Omusubis are well loved by both children and the elderly. We are dedicated to spreading happiness — one rice ball at a time — and winning the hearts of everyone we serve.

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Lenskart
description: Lenskart offers a fresh take on eyewear with stylish designs, great prices, and innovative technology. From everyday essentials to fashion-forward styles, we make eyewear affordable and exciting! Experience the future of eyewear shopping with our virtual try-on technology and expert in-store service.

name: LiHO Tea
description: ‘LiHO means “How are you in Hokkien” and we take pride in our name as it celebrates Singapore as a melting pot of culture. A simple greeting of LiHO is a great way for individuals to bond and it is even better with a cup of Singapore’s homegrown tea brand, LiHO Tea. Brown Sugar Pearl, Avocado and Fruit Tea are what LiHO does best and it is the heart of our brand.” Great emphasis is placed on the entire process, from choosing the right tea to roasting, to brewing and finally serving it.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Luckin Coffee is a leading new retail coffee chain brand, pioneering technology-driven retail concept that aims to provide quality coffee and other product offerings without compromising on affordability and convenience to our customers.

name: M.S. Money Exchange
description: M.S. Money Exchange is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore to provide money-changing services. Honest, friendly and efficient service.

name: Ma Kuang TCM
description: Ma Kuang's team of medical staffs aims to treat their patients with "Love, Service, Professionalism, Sincerity", physicians, TuiNa therapists, assistance offer a comprehensive and professional TCM healthcare services. By modernization of traditional Chinese medicine and discriminating process, Ma Kuang is committed to promote the philosophy of TCM worldwide and hopes to help the public to "walk out" of their illnesses and enjoy a healthy lifestyle at the same time. Ma Kuang provides a reliable and high quality one-stop TCM clinic and healthcare services network to the public to become one of the leaders in industry. Ma Kuang has established a professional branding image and has obtained a good branding reputation.

name: Mister Minit
description: Mister Minit specialises in the services of shoe repairs, key cutting and duplication, engraving and watch service. Established in 1957, the Mister Minit team continues to build a strong service brand through commitment to excellence in customer service and continual improvements in relation to our customers changing needs.

name: Mixue
description: Mixue is a bubble tea brand that offers freshly made drinks, specializing in high- quality, affordable products such as bubble tea, fruit tea, and ice cream, providing customers with a convenient and delicious beverage experience

name: MoneyMax
description: MoneyMax is a trusted name in pawnbroking and new gold jewellery retail, offering customers quality, value, and peace of mind. Explore a wide selection of brand-new gold jewellery at great value or visit us for reliable and hassle-free pawnbroking services. With over 50 outlets across Singapore, MoneyMax is one of the largest pawnbroking chains in the country.

name: MOS Burger
description: MOS Burger is a premium Japanese hamburger chain restaurant which offers a wide variety of unique and original tasting burgers. To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers’ order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: My Digital Lock
description: My Digital Lock is the Sole Agent of Korean brand EPIC in Singapore and also Authorized Dealer of Samsung brand in Singapore. EPIC Based on quality proven software development technology and management know-how in the world market. EPIC Digital Locks with Durable metallic body against external shocks and fire, Auto-lock, Re-lock, double lock function for user convenience and security. Random Number and Multi-touch features that enhance, password security (1time entry password available).

name: Nails Fifth Avenue
description: Established nail and lash salon that provides manicure and pedicure services, comprehensive nail care and treatment (in-grown nails) for nail recovery, as well as value added services like nail and lash extensions.

name: NiKU iKU
description: Niku Iku brings you authentic grilled & simmered Japanese takeout, crafted for comfort and satisfaction. From flame-kissed yakiniku to slow-simmered nitsuke, every bowl features rich flavour & the finest cuts — paired with premium Niigata rice and proprietary sauces. Every meal is a satisfying experience.

name: OCBC
description: OCBC and its subsidiaries offer a broad array of specialist financial and wealth management services, ranging from consumer, corporate, investment, private and transaction banking to treasury, insurance, asset management and stockbroking services.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Old Chang Kee is a beloved Singaporean brand celebrated for its iconic Curry’O and a delicious variety of local snacks. Since 1956, it has won the hearts of generations with its tasty, convenient, and affordable treats. Beyond its signature puffs, Old Chang Kee offers crowd favourites like Chicken Wing, Sotong Wing OnStik, Fish Ball OnStik, Spring’O, and more — ensuring there’s something for everyone to enjoy. Whether you're in the mood for a light bite or a satisfying snack, Old Chang Kee is your go-to stop for local delights.

name: Owell BodyCare
description: OWELL BodyCare is a fast expanding retailer of healthcare products. OWELL is innovation-driven and emphasizes on the importance of service quality and product quality and safety. OWELL products are uniquely designed to cater to the lifestyle of today’s fast paced society. Easy to use and portable products provide great convenience for those who are constantly on the go. As an advocate for service excellence, OWELL ensures each staff is trained to identify and understand the unique needs of every customer and to provide simple and non-invasive health services such as body oxygen level check, vascular age check and blood circulation analysis.

name: Owndays
description: OWNDAYS is a leading Japanese eyewear brand with a growing global presence of more than 600 stores across Japan, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Cambodia, the Philippines, Australia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Hong Kong and Dubai. The company designs, manufactures and markets eyewear products and sells over 3.5 million pairs of glasses each year. Pioneering the adoption of the SPA (Specialty store retailer of Private-label Apparel) model in the optical industry, OWNDAYS oversees every step of its operations from design and manufacturing to inventory management and retail. This fully integrated approach allows the brand to uphold exceptional quality standards in line with Japanese Industrial Standards while offering stylish, high-quality eyewear at accessible prices. As OWNDAYS continues to expand across the globe, the brand continues to redefine eyewear by combining functionality, comfort and style. Committed to accessibility and innovation, the brand brings Japanese design and quality to customers everywhere, enriching everyday life through clearer vision and thoughtful craftsmanship.

name: Paris Baguette
description: Paris Baguette, born in 1988, is a global bakery brand of SPC Group, a leading South Korean food and confectionery corporation. From its modest beginnings, the chain has grown steadily to become the No.1 bakery in Korea. From 2004, the brand has expanded internationally, the brand operates around 4,000 stores worldwide across the United States, Canada, France, UK, China and Southeast Asia, solidifying its reputation as a truly global premium bakery brand. Paris Baguette is committed to blending traditional baking techniques with modern innovation to deliver diverse range of products such as breads, pastries, cakes, and beverages that appeal to a wide audience, from everyday treats to special celebration.

name: Pet Lovers Centre
description: Pet Lovers Centre (PLC) boasts of having the widest range of the freshest stock for pet owners to pamper their pets and offers quality pet services including pet grooming, veterinary consultations and excellent home delivery service to reduce the hassle while shopping. PLC also has its very own pet care consultants whom customers can approach with questions regarding their pets!

name: Pezzo
description: Meet the All-New Pezzo at Hougang Mall. From the brand that first introduced pizza by the slice to Singapore, homegrown favourite Pezzo returns with a bold reinvention bigger in flavour, brighter in spirit, and more exciting than ever. The refreshed concept features a revamped store design and packaging, an all-new menu of flavours inspired by iconic global cuisines, and a lineup of mouthwatering sides to match. From its vibrant updated interior to pizzas that transport tastebuds across continents. Pezzo is back, this time with a new flavourful evolution elevating its signature fun-loving spirit that we’ve all come to know and love.

name: Pierre Cardin
description: Pierre Cardin Lingerie is a brand that is synonymous with fashion. Since its introduction to Singapore in 1995, the brand has been inviting women to redefine themselves by offering the most current and stylish designs tailored for the Asian woman in mind.

name: PlayMade
description: PlayMade has captivated the hearts of tea enthusiasts with our commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. Our handcrafted bubble tea has become a beloved destination for those seeking imaginative and flavourful tea creations. Without the use of additives or preservatives, our bobas exemplify freshness. The result? Bobas that are not only delicious but also healthier, offering a delightful bounce and exceptional flavour.

name: Play United
description: We are a professionally operated specialty store blending two passions: authentic Pokémon TCG products and family-friendly claw machine entertainment. Whether you're a competitive player hunting for rare chase cards or a parent looking for a cheerful weekend activity with your little ones, we have something for you. Our card selection includes booster packs, singles, and accessories, all neatly organized. Our claw machines feature cute, high-quality prizes and are adjusted for fair, joyful play. Professional service meets the thrill of the catch ！come play, collect, and win!

name: Poh Heng Jewellery
description: Since 1948, Poh Heng Jewellery has been a symbol of dedication and craftsmanship in Singapore. From our coveted Trust diamonds to the iconic Si Dian Jin Collection, we blend timeless elegance with meticulous craftsmanship. Experience timeless elegance and unwavering quality at Poh Heng.

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Polar prides itself for its long and rich heritage as a three-generation-old family business that has been faithfully serving consistent quality products to its customers since 1926.

name: Potato Corner
description: Global french fries chain Potato Corner has been delighting fries lovers all over the world since 1992, serving up what many have called the “world’s best flavoured fries”. Fries are prepared fresh, fried to order, seasoned with passionately formulated flavours, and served hot and crispy. Take your pick from Cheese, Barbecue, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili Barbecue and a whole lot more!

name: rumeL
description: rumeL at Hougang Mall is a casual, family-friendly dining spot designed for everyday enjoyment. Our concept focuses on freshly made, flavourful handmade sourdough Neapolitan pizza, crafted with naturally fermented sourdough and cooked à la minute for the best texture and taste. We also offer specialty coffee, tea lattes, seasonal beverages, and gelato from Vanda Gelato, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

name: Sanook Kitchen
description: Come to Sanook Kitchen and savour a wide variety of authentic Thai food classics ranging from appetisers, soup, curries to seafood and more at wallet-friendly prices that make every visit satisfying and affordable!

name: Scarlett
description: Scarlett Supermarket is the leading one-stop supermarket which sells an extensive range of popular Chinese snacks, dried goods, necessities and beverages imported directly from China. One can find household names like Hai Chi Jia Suan La Fen, Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea and Tsingtao Beer at the most affordable prices islandwide here.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks
description: Thousands of Taiwanese crowd the local nightmarkets in search of their favorite and delicious snacks, and Taipei’s Shihlin Night Market is the most famous due to its very wide range of local delicacies in its small streets and alleys. If a snack is nice, you can surely find it in Shihlin! The locals say, “If Taiwan has it, Shihlin has it.” With Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks®, the Taiwanese and us alike can now do the same and enjoy the wonderful street snacks of Taiwan!

name: SK Jewellery
description: Unwrap Joy at SK Jewellery — your ultimate destination for all your gifting needs. Discover the first SK store featuring a dedicated Ear Piercing corner, along with gold trade-in services for added value. From Disney magic to timeless pearls, dazzling gold, and wedding wonders, our wide collection is perfect for every celebration.

name: Skechers
description: Est. 1992. Manhattan Beach, California, USA. Our story begins in a California beach house, where SKECHERS was born as a utility boot that quickly became a style icon of the grunge era. In the twenty-five years that followed, the collection grew into the thousands and today spans a wide selection of styles that meet the footwear needs of men, women and kids around the world. SKECHERS has evolved into an award-winning lifestyle and performance powerhouse known for stylish and comfortable footwear and apparel worn by millions.

name: SkinGO!
description: Experience the skin revolution! SkinGO! redefines the meaning of express facials and we believe that express facials are just as effective if not more than the traditional facials. Using advanced technology from Korea, our facials are designed to re-energise and hydrate skin in 15 minutes. Suited for all ages and skin type, you can now be on the road to flawless smooth skin.

name: SKP
