description: The largest supplier of Disposable Food Packaging and party supplies in Singapore, SKP is the one-stop destination for all packaging and party needs. With a global reach in over 20 countries, SKP has committed itself to engaging in more sustainable packaging solutions without compromising quality through their eco-friendly disposable food packaging series – EcoVue.

name: Smooy
description: Founded in 2010, Smöoy brings over 100 years of ice cream-making tradition to life with a modern twist. Backed by four generations of expertise from Spain, Smöoy is known for its signature frozen yogurt, a deliciously healthy treat that’s rich in flavour, low in fat, and high in taste. Our in-house R&D and Food Quality teams work continuously to innovate and perfect our offerings, from classic froyos to smoothies, pints, and seasonal creations. Whether you love something fruity, chocolatety, or packed with toppings, there’s something refreshing waiting for you at Smöoy. Visit us at Hougang Mall and enjoy frozen delights made with care, passion, and heritage.

name: Sorella
description: Sorella believes in treasuring and celebrating every woman's innate femininity. We aim to highlight and enhance your natural beauty and sexy curves with our high quality lingerie, which provide unparalleled support, superior shaping, desired toning and overall flawlessness. Cherish yourself with Sorella and unveil your true feminine allure. Discover, indulge in your body and love yourself entirely through our premium lingerie.

name: Soup Restaurant
description: Our origins may be traced back to 1991 when our first outlet was established in Smith Street. Our founders, Mok Yip Peng, Wong Wei Teck, Wong Chi Keong and Ho Hong Chin observed a surge in the popularity of Herbal Soups in Hong Kong, with the emergence of restaurants specialising in Herbal Soups. Inspired by this development, our founders were of the view that there would be a demand in Singapore for Herbal Soups and home-cooked dishes, especially by young professionals with limited access to home-cooked food.

name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a fast casual kiosk chain focused on Mexican and Turkish takeaways. Serving exceptionally tasty burritos and kebabs, the food is made and prepared fresh daily, right in front of you. The made to order flow allows you to choose whichever toppings you like, and their succulent grilled chicken is remarkably tasty as it is healthy. With its energetic customer base which swears by the food, many have invented their own secret menu of their favorite food combination. Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

name: Subway
description: SUBWAY® is the undisputed leader in fast, healthy food. Our easy-to-prepare sandwiches are made to order right in front of the customer, precisely the way they want – using freshly baked breads, select sauces and a variety of delicious toppings.

name: SUKIYA
description: SUKIYA is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant, founded in 1982 in Yokohama, and has over 2,600 locations across the world. SUKIYA specializes in Gyudon – a delicious combination of thinly-sliced tender beef cooked in a soy sauce-based savory sauce with onions all served on top of fluffy, perfectly-cooked Japanese rice. Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic service, SUKIYA uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.

name: Super Sushi
description: Super Sushi believes in serving fresh and delicious sushi. Our commitment to using only fresh, never frozen, salmon and the finest Niigata rice, along with specially made red vinegar rice prepared fresh in-store, ensures an unparalleled sushi experience. Explore our innovative sushi creations that artfully blend tradition with unique flavors—each bite is a testament to our dedication to delight our customers through quality and creativity.

name: Sushi Express
description: One of the biggest conveyor belt sushi brands in Asia, offering more than 80 different variations of sushi from $1.50++ per plate. At Sushi Express, we understand that it’s not always about value when it comes to serving our customers, it is about consistently providing quality and innovative products competitively.

name: Swee Heng 1989 Classic
description: Swee Heng 1989 Classic is a new brand born from the 1st Singapore full fledge halal bakery chain known as Swee Heng Bakery in the late 80s. Making its official debut at West Mall in 2014. Swee Heng 1989 Classic has since gained wide popularity and recognition from Singaporeans. Till date, we have opened a total of 27 outlets and 1 Bakery Cafes island wide. Holding on to the same promise made by Swee Heng Bakery, sharing our baking passion to all communities. Till now, we remain committed in using the finest ingredients gathered around the world to produce good quality and affordable products. Our vision is to become “Bakery of people, Bread for life”. We strive hard to make Swee Heng the Singapore Bakery that serves all communities.

name: Timezone
description: Looking for fun activities to do this weekend? Try Timezone. Whether you're a kid or an adult, Timezone will provide you with endless entertainment! Timezone is the ultimate destination for your daily dose of happiness and unforgettable celebrations.

name: TORI-Q
description: TORI-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated “Tare” (sauce) for enhanced flavours.

name: Turtle
description: Founded in 2018, Turtle Singapore is a premier destination for home and living products, offering a diverse range of creative and affordable items designed to enhance everyday life. As a well-established chain brand, we specialise in retail, wholesale, and customisation to meet the unique needs of our customers.

name: United Overseas Bank
description: UOB is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 470 branches and offices in 19 markets in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Guided by our values and supported by our fundamental strengths, we focus on supporting our customers as we drive performance across our franchise.

name: Valu$
description: Valu$ delivers to their customers exactly what the brand suggests, Value for Money! We carry a wide range of lifestyle and home living products which are guaranteed to give Value for their Dollars spent.

name: Vanilla Taste of Beauty
description: VANILLA provides exquisite products, facial as well as slimming services and it is an reputable beauty salon in Singapore.

name: Venia Cherie
description: Venia Cherie Press-on Nail is a stylish and personalized brand with adequately creativity and inspiration, which the brand founder has a high passion for fashion and jewelry design, whose dream is to create a practical and personalized accessory. The Venia Cherie Press-on Nail is a story of dream, creativity and passion, stating the founder’s love of fashion and life and the unique style of every woman who owns it. Everyone can find the unique style in fashion trend by the Venia Cherie Press-on Nail.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty offers top-quality beauty and cleaning products at unbeatable prices. Explore skincare, haircare, cosmetics, and household essentials all in one place. Enjoy a budget-friendly shopping experience where affordability meets excellence. Elevate your routine without overspending—visit Venus Beauty today!

name: W.TWO
description: W.TWO introduces a variety of trendy casual shoes and bags suitable for all occassions. Our shoe collection ranges from sports shoes, canvas shoes, workwear flats, sandals, bags and more for men and women.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons is Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer with close to 100 stores islandwide. Watsons seeks to bring ‘more’ to customers’ lives by inspiring and enabling every customer to look good and feel great. Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

name: Winning
description: Since 1991, WINNING has been the biggest supplier of Winter and Outdoor Gear in Singapore. Our line of products ranges from gloves and jackets to luggage and backpacks. We aim to give excellent customer service and to provide after-sales services locally and internationally. We also aim to provide high quality products at reasonable prices and to promote safe and fun outdoor activities.

name: WOK HEY
description: Masters of stir fry ⋅ Lovers of wok hey. Inspired by the cornerstone of Cantonese-styled cooking, WOK HEY is a modern, fast-casual, convenient take-out concept. They offer tasty, nutritional, value for money, customizable fry to order rice and noodle wok dishes.

name: XiaoMi Store
description: Xiaomi is one of the world’s leading consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core. Xiaomi products are present in more than 100 countries and regions around the world.

name: YES LEMON
description: Originating from Nanjing, Yes Lemon has been dedicated to crafting hand-punched lemon tea since its establishment in 2021. We strive to promote both the youthfulness and professionalism of the lemon tea industry. By blending different flavors of lemons, we aim to achieve the perfect taste in our lemon tea. Our products are the cornerstone of our brand, and we always adhere to the principle of quality first while continuously innovating. Our goal is to create a distinctive brand of hand-punched lemon tea with a memorable focus on "specializing in hand-punched lemon tea." We are all about freedom and passion! We aim to create a trendy and fashionable space where like-minded individuals can gather and enjoy our drinks.

name: Young Hearts
description: The Young Hearts brand is fun-loving, high-spirited, feminine and young. They are passionate about living a quality life and hence, support and encourage this by creating and producing products with great attention to research, design, detail, variety and quality. They have a wide selection of daily essential lingerie products to whimsical sleepwear and fun lifestyle products. Young Hearts hope to inspire everyone who comes into contact with us to love life with passion, confidence and enjoyment!

name: 2nd Street
description: 2nd STREET is a global second-hand store with over 1,000 locations worldwide. We buy and sell quality second-hand items—from everyday essentials to the latest fashion trends. Our goal is to make reuse easy, fun, and affordable. At 2nd STREET, you can shop smart and sell with confidence.

name: 4FINGERS Crispy Chicken
description: At 4FINGERS, we're nuts about chicken. So when we discovered the Best Korean crispy chicken in New York City's grungy subway scene, we knew we had to share it. And so began the revolution of crispy chicken. Crispy chicken that will rock your world. No MSG No preservatives. No bull. Just the best clucking' chicken you will ever have.

name: 7-Eleven
description: 7-Eleven is now the store of choice, not just for convenience needs but for a wide range of lifestyle needs such as exclusive snacks, meals on-the-go, top-ups and bill payment services.

name: A-One Signature
description: Embark on a gastronomic journey of authentic claypot wonders that satisfy both palates and soul. A-One Signature offers a wide variety of dishes to suit every diner in a feel-at-home, comfortable modern Chinese interior. With sizzling hot, fragrant local favourites served on piping hot claypots and hotplates, we promise an all-round dining satisfaction that is set to entice and excite every of your senses.

name: Ajisen
description: Originating from Kumamoto Japan, Ajisen Ramen is famous for its white broth, made by simmering pork bones for many hours. Its Tonkotsu soup is rich in collagen, a protein which is good for the skin. Since 1968, Ajisen Ramen has strived to bring delicious and authentic ramen to people from all walks of life, serving young and old with our extensive ramen line-up.

name: Anytime Fitness
description: Anytime Fitness – 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Your key opens all doors of the 4,000+ (and growing) locations worldwide with no additional/hidden charges. Your membership welcomes you to a family that gives the extra push you need, and the extra support you want to help break down barriers to your healthier place. Our staff are trained to help you on your fitness journey, whether it’s your first step or a road you’ve gone down many times before. Our gyms are not just about the facilities and equipment but is about the people who join Anytime Fitness. We have the trainers and the tools to help you get to a healthier place.

name: Banana Story
description: Discover a selection of gift and lifestyle products, especially mobile phone cases & accessories. The available mobile phone products includes accessories in various colors and styles to meet a wide range of preferences and personal choices.

name: Bank Of China
description: Established on 15 June 1936, Bank of China Singapore Branch holds the Qualifying Full Bank License (QFB) in Singapore. It has a network of five sub-branches and one remittance centre. With over 70 years of presence in the local banking industry, leveraging on the Group's extensive global network and team of experienced professionals, Bank of China Singapore Branch provides a full range of financial services to its customers from Singapore, China as well as the surrounding region. Over the years, it has demonstrated its long-term commitment to promote bilateral economic and trade relations between China and Singapore. The main businesses of Bank of China Singapore Branch include corporate banking, retail banking, trade financing and international trade settlement, with specialized knowledge and expertise in China-related trade financing and settlements, and remittance services.

name: Bata
description: Home to Bata's Asia Pacific and Africa operations, the Singapore office manages 3,000 outlets in the region and its many dealers and suppliers. As the Procurement Centre for Bata, we also work closely with our corporate partners and dealers through efficient manufacturing and sales service support in our own factories as well as our affiliates in the Far East Region. This means we can apply the very same technology and quality standards for Bata shoes to help our clients achieve their expectations without compromising on their brand identity.

name: Beauty Language
description: Beauty Language is the largest homegrown hair and beauty retail chain in Singapore. Our journey started in 2000, when our founders were frustrated by the lack of good hair and beauty regimes in the market then. This led to a life-long search and passion to uncover better answers. We constantly globetrot to discover the latest new products that work for our customers. Here you will find the best mix of exclusive and major commercial brands to suit different lifestyles, budgets and occasions.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: Beutea
description: Beutea - a modern tea beverage brand using "Freshly Brewed Chinese Tea" (a combination of ancient Chinese and modern tea beverage). Beutea practices the four ancient tea ceremony skills “moisten”, “soak”, “boil”, and “brew” using extract from the finest hand-picked tea leaves originating from tea mountains of Yunnan and Wuyi in China as the base of their beverages. It is then blended with modern flavours such as fresh milk and fresh fruits to brew unique, exquisite, aromatic and delicious fresh tea beverages. “A sip of tea lingers, two sips come with a long aftertaste” serves as the purpose of founding the brand as they aspire to be the top unique and delicious fresh tea beverage brand.

name: Blue Ribbon Florist & Gifts
description: The Blue Ribbon is a term used to describe or symbolize something of high quality, and is most often associated with 1st prize. This is Blue Ribbon’s corporate value: Ensure quality n strive to deliver nothing but the best for customers.

name: BreadTalk/Toast Box
description: BreadTalk has brought about a renaissance in the bread business, with multiple awards testifying to its branding and business successes. Each BreadTalk bears the urban, clear glass, clean cut look punctuated subtly with detailing of contrasting colours of artworks, unique to each locale. The signature 'see through' kitchens allow their chefs to showcase their expertise upfront, sharing the preparation of the freshly browned breads, each piece has a story to tell... so beautifully crafted, so heavenly in taste. Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: Brow Art Asia
description: YOUR BEAUTY IS OUR GOAL – Brow Art Asia is your one-stop brow, eyelash, eyeliner, and lip grooming salon. We offer wide range of services focusing on enhancing facial features in the most natural manner, whereby one’s beauty is emphasized and achieved.

name: Burger King
description: Welcome to the home of flame-grilled perfection! Enjoy the best-selling, signature flame-grilled WHOPPER®️ as well as other top BK favourites such as the velvety smooth Double Mushroom Swiss, deliciously juicy Tendergrill®️ Chicken that is made of chicken thigh fillet and the irresistible sides such as Onion Rings, Taro Turnover, HERSHEY’S®️ Sundae Pie and more! Sink your teeth in our juicy burgers now.

name: Challenger
description: Unveil the world of Challenger – Singapore’s exclusive homegrown electronics chain since 1982. Explore the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials trusted by over half a million loyal members across 40+ island-wide stores. Embrace peace of mind with hassle-free returns and warranties covering 50,000+ top-tier products, including favorites like Apple, Samsung, and an array of other leading names.

name: Chateraise
description: Chateraise have over 470 stores across all of Japan and over 15 stores in Asia. All of their sweets are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as pure natural water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms in Japan. They directly deliver all their sweets from Japan to stores around the world.

name: Cheryl W
description: Cheryl W was founded by Cheryl Wee to help other women overcome their weight management issues & self-image. Cheryl W focus on 3 Ws - Women, Wellness, and Weight Management. They adopt a healthy and gradual approach to weight loss, with the aim of passing on the message of health, vitality, and positivity. They don’t just focus on slimming but rather a sustainable weight management plan, where women can be healthy while looking good. Cheryl W aim to promote a positive and long-term lifestyle solution rather than a quick fix.

name: Chinese Medical Centre
description: CMC was founded and established by Mr. Joseph Liu Bing-Qiang in 1997. It is Singapore’s first integrated Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and Healthcare centre that provides quality Traditional Chinese Medicine and healthcare services for the public. Today, CMC have 12 branches all over Singapore, with a team of close to 100 experienced TCM Practitioners, Masseurs and Veterans on standby to provide professional quality services of Chinese Medicine, Healthcare Massage and Acupuncture. With the outlets spread all over Singapore, our customers are connected via our unique payment system where one time payment can be shared among multiple users. With a daily flow of over hundred, this system will bring great convenience for our customers.

name: Chip Lee Jewellery
description: Our mission is to provide top-quality jewellery and services that our customers deserve, by providing ASSURANCE through our COMMITMENT in everything we do. Our position in the jewellery market focuses on establishing full TRANSPARENCY, ensuring our messaging centers around educating you about our products and services.

name: COCORO
description: Established in 2014, COCORO is missioned to bring you meticulously handcrafted shoes straight from the heart of shoe makers in Japan. Our mission is to introduce the unique Japanese shoe making technology from seasoned shoe factories in Japan, blending style and comfort seamlessly while remaining affordable.

name: Concierge (Tiong Bahru Plaza)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Crave
description: Savour the nation's favourite by indulging at Crave! Enjoy some award-winning Adam Road Nasi Lemak by Selera Rasa, topped off with crunchy flavourful ikan bilis, nuts and the tantalising iconic sambal!

name: Dabba Street
description: At Dabba Street, we have reimagined Indian and Mediterranean flavours, fusing them together with a green and refreshing twist. Our menu revolves around classics such as biryanis to globally-popular butter chicken; paired with an array of traditional, and healthier iterations of Indian and Mediterranean-inspired sides, dips and chutney options. Our food is prepared without ghee, heavy oils, added MSG, added colour, or artificial flavours. Step onto Dabba Street and create your personalized masterpiece that is bursting with flavours and textures.

name: Dapur Penyet
description: Dapur Penyet aims to serve quality, authentic Indonesian food at value-added prices. Well-known for their signature Ayam Penyet dish, Dapur Penyet also offer a variety of sambal of different spiciness for everyone.

name: Decathlon
description: A global multi-specialist sports brand catering to beginners and top athletes, Decathlon is an innovative maker of sporting goods for all skills. With more than 100,000 teammates and 1,700 stores worldwide, Decathlon and its teams have been working ever since 1976 to fulfil an ongoing ambition: Move people through the wonders of sport, to help them be healthier and happier in a sustainable future.

name: DON DON DONKI
description: DON DON DONKI is a Japanese specialty brand that offers wide variety of high quality Japanese products from premium Japanese meat to ready-to-eat meals. Find everything you're looking for and discover things you never knew you needed, only at DON DON DONKI.

name: Dorra Slimming
description: With the advanced slimming formulation and state-of-the-art technology, the award-winning slimming brand, dorra Slimming has helped over 80,000 women. With it's Signature Intense Fat Burning Slimming Treatment that promises up to 5cm loss in a 20 minute session, it is able to burn stubborn fat, tone and shape bulging tummies, chunky thighs and wide hips. Our fast and effective treatments is perfect for the everyday busy women who wants to slim down, tone up, or achieve overall wellness with no downtime. Make an appointment today at any of our conveniently located outlets island wide.

name: D'Penyetz
description: Home-grown brand D'Penyetz specialising in Ayam Penyet, offers a variety of items on the menu that features predominantly well-loved Indonesian classics with our signature SMASHED-FRIED CHICKEN & delicious Sambal of various spicy levels.

name: Du Du Dumplings
description: Du Du Dumplings offers a delightful experience for dumpling lovers. Known for its delicious and freshly made dumplings, the restaurant serves a variety of options, from savory to spicy, catering to different tastes. Their signature dishes include juicy dumplings filled with flavorful ingredients, all expertly prepared to deliver a satisfying meal. Whether you're craving classic dumplings or trying something new, Du Du Dumplings promises a tasty and enjoyable dining experience.

name: EAT.
description: EAT. is a “one-stop” food outlet serving your favourite local traditional fare like fishball noodles, minced meat noodles (‘bak chor mee’), and laksa, enjoyed in a comfortable and cosy setting. You can also find finger foods such as traditional handmade ngoh hiang and homemade iced lemon tea.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Eu Yan Sang is Asia's leading integrative healthcare and wellness company with a strong foundation in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). Founded in 1879 with the mission of 'Caring for Mankind' - Today, Eu Yan Sang is a trusted household brand. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Eu Yan Sang TCM Clinic
description: As a most trusted chain of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and integrative health clinics, Eu Yan Sang genuinely cares about providing good lifelong health to our customers. We believe in a holistic approach to total health and well-being. Our TCM and Western General Practitioner clinics offer a comprehensive range of traditional Chinese medicines and therapies for effective healing and renewed vitality. Whether you seek treatment for acute or chronic health conditions or simply want to optimise your health, our professionally qualified and experienced team can provide a complete health assessment and personalised treatment plan.

name: Ex Beauty
description: EX beauty is dedicated to professional beauty services using the latest technology and methodology in the beauty industry. Our beauty salons staffs are from the beauty industry with more than 10 years of working experience in various high-profile beauty brands. All of our staff are equipped with recognized professional qualifications in the industry. We are committed to upgrading ourselves consistently professionally in our specialized field to bring the best services to our customers.

name: FairPrice Finest
description: FairPrice Finest seeks to bring the finest things in life to customers. It combines the heritage of a trusted brand with a whole new experience of fine living at affordable pricing. Scrumptious delis and vintage wines in our gourmet selection are a sensory delight to the gastronome. Our fresh seafood along with our seasonal produce and international selection are carefully hand-picked from all over the world to please even the most discerning palates. Not forgetting the health-conscious; they can take delight with our expanding range of prized organic items and fresh fruits. From the conventional to the epicurious, here is where you can celebrate the finest things in life.

name: Fore Coffee
description: In the pursuit of brewing the perfect cup, Fore Coffee is bringing the Indonesian coffee lifestyle to Singapore. As the pioneer that seeks to introduce what it means to enjoy coffee the Indonesian way, we promise to deliver more than just taste, but also a collection of stories brewed together into a solid experience. With Fore Coffee, embrace the evolving coffee culture as we redefine what it means to enjoy a cup of coffee, delivering the best Indonesia has to offer with our signature creations and innovations.

name: Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

name: Fruit Box
description: Fruit Box, with its pure quality, is the best nutritious partner for the city dweller! Providing 100% fresh fruit juices that are all-natural, containing phytonutrients; which are disease-fighting compounds and the healthiest beverage choice. Fruit Box only uses and purchase natural ingredients from reliable, and accredited suppliers who provide high-quality ingredients.

name: Fun Toast
description: Bringing back the traditional Nanyang Coffeehouse nostalgia, Fun Toast serves well-brewed fragrant local Coffee and Tea, deliciously fresh Yuan Yang Soft Bun, Ham & Cheese French Toast and many more. Give their homemade signature Soya Sauce Chicken a try too. It will definitely keep you coming back for more. Check out their new range of merchandise as well, not to be missed!

name: Giordano
description: Giordano embodies today’s contemporary lifestyle choices – simplicity in design and quality in substance. Their total commitment to superior service and outstanding quality and value has enabled the company to successfully grow the brands Giordano, Giordano Ladies, Giordano Junior, BSX, and Beau Monde. The essence of Giordano is to provide relevant, essential and timeless fashion for all; and to develop apparel for everyone regardless of ethnicity, nationality or culture, truly illustrating their brand value “World Without Strangers”.

name: Glassesgateway
description: At Glassesgateway, unlock your style with frames that blend fashion and function. Discover our affordable curated collection with wide range od lens options from progressive office wear to active sports wear and polarised lenses. Find your perfect pair with our expert guidance and pair them with lenses tailored to your needs. Shop online or in-store today!

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang is a 100% local-owned brand that was established in 2017 to provide a unique Ma La cuisine experience while retaining the authenticity of the local fan favourite dish. GYMLT offer drinkable Ma La soup bases that do not leave a greasy or overwhelming aftertaste, so that customers can enjoy it till the very last drop. GYMLT understands that different people have different dietary needs and spice preferences. Hence, GYMLT offers other soup bases such as Mushroom, Pork bone, Tomato and Pickled Vegetable soup bases for those who do not enjoy spices We have also come up with a vegetarian friendly soup for our vegetarian consumers.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 138 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Pharmacy services available! Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for consumers' health and beauty needs. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at all stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. We continue to build on our rich healthcare heritage with an award-winning team of pharmacists who have consistently won multiple pharmacist awards every year.

name: Heart Springs Spa
description: Spring Into A better You! Heart Springs Spa is an exquisite spa that allows you to indulge your senses, invigorate your body and inspire your mind. Simply devoted to authenticity and harmony, the wide range of beauty services available at Heart Springs Spa includes facials, massages, foot reflexology, hyfro-therapies, body polishes, bust enhancement, ear candling, IPL hair removal, IPL anti-acne and eyebrow embroidery.

name: HockHua Tonic
description: Hockhua Tonic, a household name in Singapore and Malaysia since 1989, is known for its retail chain of stores stocked with traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), health supplements and tonics. Renowned for its quality ginseng and wide range of bird's nest products, it also offers seafood delicacies such as abalones, dry scallops, Chinese herbs and a variety types of self-manufactured nutrition organically grown products.

name: Hoe Nam Vintage
description: Hoe Nam Vintage stands as a proud torchbearer of Singapore’s rich Local Delicacies’ heritage, carrying forward the legacy of the famed Hoe Nam (River South) brand while refining its offerings for a new generation of Food lovers. Hoe Nam Vintage Tiong Bahru Plaza is the 8th Outlet under our belt with an outlet-exclusive highlight, the Special Sauce Pig’s Tail delivers a rich, silky indulgence braised to perfection in a fragrant, house-crafted sauce. Best known for its umami-packed prawn noodles, Hoe Nam Vintage elevates a classic favourite with deep, slow-cooked broths, fresh succulent prawns, and springy noodles that absorb every layer of flavour. Each bowl captures the essence of traditional prawn mee yet delivers a polished, contemporary finish, an homage to the beloved original while appealing to today’s discerning palates. Complementing its signature noodles is Hoe Nam Vintage’s modernistic-nostalgic take on Bak Kut Teh. Drawing inspiration from generations-old recipes, the dish balances peppery warmth with a nuanced depth, offering a comforting yet revitalised interpretation of the iconic soup. The tender pork ribs, aromatic spices and carefully calibrated broth reflect both tradition and thoughtful innovation. Together, these offerings embody the brand’s commitment to preserving local food culture while embracing quality and creativity. Hoe Nam Vintage continues to be a culinary anchor in Singapore’s evolving dining scene, an institution that honours the past, delights the present and ensures that cherished flavours endure for years to come.

name: Honor Experience Store
description: Established in 2013, HONOR is a leading global provider of smart devices. They are committed to becoming a global iconic tech brand and enabling a smart life across all scenarios and all channels, for all people. With a strategic focus on innovation, quality, and service, HONOR is dedicated to developing technology that empowers people around the globe, to go beyond its capabilities and forward-looking technology as well as create a new intelligent world for everyone with its portfolio of innovative products.

name: Iliyas Trading Money Changer
description: Iliyas Trading Money Changer, licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore(MAS), has been providing money changing services for over 25 years. We have forged trust and reliability with our customers over the years. With dedicated professionals well versed in the foreign exchange market we pledge to keep up with the current trends and provide competitive rates to our customers.

name: Japan Home
description: With more than 65 outlets island-wide, Japan Home has grown from strength to strength. Embodying a philosophy for quality without compromise, Japan Home prides itself in the provision of a wide range of household products at affordable prices. Today, Japan Home is a household name with an unrivaled reputation as a one-stop provider for all your household needs.

name: Jean Yip Group
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: Jia Li Seafood Soup
description: Local brand name, Umami filled seafood soup, serving the freshest and tastiest seafood soup, every bowl cooked with dedication and perfection. A hearty, comforting meal perfect for any time of the day.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: Kent Ridge Education Hub
description: Founded in 1988, Kent Ridge Education (KRTC) is now a leading education chain in Singapore with more than 100,000 students. We offer a full range of academic and enrichment programmes from 4 years old to 18 years old.

name: KFC
description: Captivating aroma, succulent juicy chicken and thoughtful service are what KFC lovers come back for. Choose between our signature Original Recipe chicken prepared with Colonel Sander's secret blend of 11 herbs & spices, or the all-time favourite Hot & Crispy chicken. Check out the perennially popular KFC a.m. Breakfast menu and the variety of food items from Rice to Egg Tarts as well. Visit KFC today for an experience that is so good.

name: Kimage
description: Kimage believes in individuality. Our experienced, professional stylists provide personal consultations based on your personality and lifestyle. Then they work their magic and transform your look, letting your crowning glory shine through a range of innovative, creative hair services that are customised based on your needs.

name: KKV
description: KKV, a retail brand of exquisite lifestyle, is the first flagship brand of KK GROUP. KKV integrates 9 kinds of exquisite lifestyle products such as fashion toys,exquisite food,quality daily use, creative stationery,and fashion makeup, with more than 20,000 SKUs featuring various well-known brands.

name: KOI Thé
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: Koo Kee
description: Koo Kee serves authentic and flavorful Yong Tow Foo since 1954, building a rich heritage of delicious dishes. In addition to our signature Yong Tow Foo, indulge in nutritious Steamed Rice and Soups. Every visit promises handcrafted ingredients, quality noodles, and comforting broths for a truly satisfying meal.

name: Kopitiam
description: Get ready to embark on a culinary adventure in the spacious environment at Kopitiam, which now boasts 328 seats and is home to nine carefully curated stalls including traditional brands like Qiu Lian Ban Mian, Koo Kee Yong Tow Foo Mee, Lau Di Fang Scissors Cut Curry Rice and Herbal Soup by Master Shen, Pin Wei (Michelin Guide Recommended), old favourite Pepper Kitchen, and relatively new to the hawker trade like Cuo Cuo You Yu, Kallang Airport Wanton Mee, Han Ssik Dang Korean Cuisine and Ipoh Roasted Duck & Chicken.

name: KSkin and Myeongdong Hair Studio
description: KSKIN AND MYEONGDONG HAIR STUDIO offers full Korean hair and makeup services. Our pioneering, International Award Winning Styling team will always strives to push the boundaries and set the trends when it comes to hairdressing. If you can envisage your dream hairstyle or colour, we can create it.

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Lee Heng Jewellers
description: Founded in 1965, Lee Heng Jewellers is one of Singapore’s longest-established jewellers and the exclusive distributor for EITA 916 white gold & 916 yellow gold collections. Their designs range from modern to traditional, so that there is always something for everyone and every occasion. A recipient of the Quality Jewellers of Singapore scheme, you can rely on Lee Heng Jewellers for quality products and excellent service to match.

name: LiHO TEA
description: ‘LiHO means “How are you in Hokkien” and we take pride in our name as it celebrates Singapore as a melting pot of culture. A simple greeting of LiHO is a great way for individuals to bond and it is even better with a cup of Singapore’s homegrown tea brand, LiHO Tea. Brown Sugar Pearl, Avocado and Fruit Tea are what LiHO does best and it is the heart of our brand.” Great emphasis is placed on the entire process, from choosing the right tea to roasting, to brewing and finally serving it.

name: London Weight Management
description: Award-winning slimming brand, London Weight Management is truly a beauty essential for women who want to lose weight and reshape their silhouettes successfully. Every treatment at London Weight Management consists of a detailed body fat analysis and a series of customised slimming techniques to help you achieve that trim and womanly figure you desire. Safe, effective, and best of all, non-surgical way to slim down easily and quickly.

name: Long John Silver's
description: Long John Silver’s mission is to provide everyone great tasting, reasonably-priced seafood and chicken in a fast, friendly manner. Their secret batter is prepared fresh throughout the day and makes Long John Silver's seafood and chicken tastes like no other in the world.

name: Maxi-Cash
description: Maxi-Cash is the first public-listed pawnbroker in Singapore. Besides providing pawnbroking services, Maxi-Cash also retails brand new gold, diamond jewellery and preloved luxury goods.

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's business is never just about providing quick meals. It's always been about you - your tastes, your lifestyle, your choices. And they'd like to keep it that way, with you lovin' every moment of it. This is how McDonald's put their heart and soul into each and every one of their delicious, wholesome meals. Each 'mmm' and 'ahhh' from you is thanks enough. As you change and grow, McDonald's will be right there with you every step of the way. Today and tomorrow.

name: MediFeet
description: MEDIFEET is the leading medical footwear and podiatrist preferred footwear for health, comfort and style. The research and development department are led by a technical team with more than 30 years of experience and supported by our corporate partners, APMA and Australian Podiatry Association. Our orthopedic shoes come in a variety of styles from dress to casual and in multiple sizes and widths. You’ll also find a grand selection of arch supports, orthopedic slippers, house shoes and other foot care products designed to minimize the discomfort caused by diabetic foot problems, plantar fasciitis, bunions, heel pain, post-surgical healing, and other foot conditions. MEDIFEET, the healthier option for on-trend footwear.

name: Mincheng Bibimbap
description: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭 is a renowned establishment specializing in Chinese Korean （中国朝鲜族）ethnic cuisine, offering a unique blend of flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture in China. Our menu boasts diverse dishes, with the iconic Mincheng Bibimbap taking center stage. In addition to this signature dish, we offer Stone Plate series and a selection of savory soups inspired by Korean traditions. Complementing these are complimentary offerings like Rice Kimchi and seaweed soup, ensuring a complete and satisfying dining experience.

name: MINISO
description: Established in Tokyo, Miniso was jointly founded by Miyake Junya, the chief designer of MINISO, and Ye Guofu, a young Chinese entrepreneur, with the aim of advocating a fashionable and relaxed lifestyle. Today, Miniso is a global fast fashion designer brand, offering a wide range of products across 10 product categories including lifestyle, home, gifts, and electronics. Miniso is dedicated to providing customers with quality and creative products at affordable prices.

name: Mobilestop
description: One stop shop for all your mobile accessories needs, featuring cases and gadgets from Aukey, Casetify, Case-Mate, Burga, Moft, and more.

name: MOS Burger
description: MOS Burger is a premium Japanese hamburger chain restaurant which offers a wide variety of unique and original tasting burgers. To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers’ order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: MS NEW
description: Welcome to MS NEW, a distinguished Singaporean brand in the world of women's fashion retail. With 15 years of experience, MS NEW is a household name in the local retail scene, offering a diverse range of high-quality apparel. MS NEW believes that fashion should know no age, and their collection caters to women of all generations.

name: Munchi Pancakes
description: We serve both the classic Min Jiang Kueh and Munchi pancakes with creative hot and cold fillings for a modern twist on tradition. We take pride in using high-quality ingredients to ensure the freshest taste. We also offer vegan-friendly options, so that everyone can enjoy our delicious creations. Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation in every bite.

name: My Digital Lock
description: My Digital Lock provides one stop solution for your Digital Door Lock, Laundry Hanger, Security box, HDB Fire Rated Main Door, HDB Gate, HDB Laminate bedroom door & PVC Slide and swing toilet door. We specialise in KEYWE & EPIC Digital Lock with Digital lock installation for EC Condo and BTO HDB Fire Rated Main Door in Singapore.

name: N20 Nail Spa
description: N20 Nail Spa provides premier nail care manicure, pedicure and beauty services in Singapore. If there is anything we desire the most, it is to delight our customers and earn their smile. At N20, our nail and beauty artists are well-trained, experienced in nail care, beauty, hands and feet therapy.

name: Nailz Gallery
description: At Nailz Gallery, we believe that every man and woman has the right to look and feel their best. Colour is the answer, not only for our nails, but for the ways we show up and express ourselves regardless of gender roles, social status, or feeling the need to “fit in”. Whether you are looking for manicure, pedicure, hand/foot spa, nails treatments, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery or waxing services, we can do it all!

name: Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specialises in traditional handmade pau from authentic traditional recipes of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in-house. You can also indulge yourself in a hearty serving of mee hoon kuay or ke kou mian as well as lor mai kai (glutinous rice chicken) and siew mai, just to name a few.

name: Nan Yang Dao
description: Nan Yang Dao (南洋岛) is a fast-growing Malaysian-inspired kopitiam chain launched in Singapore in 2022 by Malaysian chef Jackson Chu alongside brothers Wee and Vincent Liow. The brand aims to deliver “the best flavours of Malaysia” through classic regional dishes such as Penang fried kway teow, Penang assam laksa, KL Hokkien mee, and its unique Nanyang Fried Nasi Lemak.

name: New Nada Barber
description: New Nada is a Barber Shop which provides haircuts to males. Our professional and experienced Barbers provide top notch quality haircuts and excellent service at all times. Visit them at Tiong Bahru Plaza today!

name: New York Skin Solutions
description: Established in 2004, New York Skin Solutions has earned an excellent reputation in the beauty industry with proven treatment results* for both male and female customers. Formulated to suit Asian skin types, New York Skin Solutions will work effectively for your particular needs, helping you to restore healthy and radiant skin.

name: NiKU iKU
description: NiKU iKU brings you authentic grilled & simmered Japanese takeout, crafted for comfort and satisfaction. From flame-kissed yakiniku to slow-simmered nitsuke, every bowl features rich flavour & the finest cuts — paired with premium Niigata rice and proprietary sauces. Every meal is a satisfying experience.

name: Nine Fresh
description: Nine Fresh is a home-grown brand specializing in a wide selection of chilled taro ball desserts that are freshly scooped and served daily. With 3 different types of signature bases (Bean Curd, Grass Jelly and Ai-Yu Jelly) and a huge variety of toppings such as beans, jellies as well as chewy delights (signature taro balls, mini taro Q and black pearl), they cater to different palates and preferences!

name: OCBC
description: OCBC and its subsidiaries offer a broad array of specialist financial and wealth management services, ranging from consumer, corporate, investment, private and transaction banking to treasury, insurance, asset management and stockbroking services.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Old Chang Kee is a household name famous for it's delectable curry puffs that are filled with curried potatoes, chicken and a slice of hardboiled egg, all cooked with special herbs and spices. Other than curry puffs, Old Chang Kee also boasts spring rolls, crab claws, sotong wings and yam pies amongst it's vast product range.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: Paris Baguette
description: Born from a love of bread and a passion for quality, Paris Baguette is an international, fast-casual bakery founded in 1988 specialized in French-inspired baked goods offering chef-inspired cakes, pastries, freshly made sandwiches and salads with signature coffee and tea. Paris Baguette aims to offer a unique experience to thousands of guests daily.

name: PastaGo
description: Launched in 2022, PastaGo is a takeaway kiosk that serves our very own in-house-made pasta. Different from the usual dried pasta that is commonly found, fresh pasta is silky, smooth, and springy to taste. PastaGo pasta is freshly made from scratch, giving it a silky and velvety texture. Each shape is thoughtfully selected so as to hold the ideal amount of sauce and to provide the best mouthfeel.

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Expect a leisure pedicure and manicure spa or simply an afternoon of escape to beautify your nails with exceptional customer service and high standards of hygiene practices in a relaxing ambience of cosiness. Complementing soothing music and a variety of treatment options, this is a perfect venue for an affordable indulgence. Not only can you beautify your nails, but you can also leave your eyelashes, eyebrows, lips, and many more to us! A salient feature of Pixie Nail Spa is never compromising on hygiene practices. All equipment used is sanitised, placed in a sanitising pouch, and subsequently kept in a UV Steriliser before being used on our clients. Our experienced manicurists are trained with our standard operating procedures and sent to specific courses to ensure that they are competent before being assigned to meet our clients’ nail spa treatment requirements.

name: Pizza Hut
description: Home of the Original Pan Pizza, Pizza Hut Singapore is now the largest pizza chain restaurant in Singapore with 77 outlets. Started in 1981 with our first Singapore outlet in Jalan Jelita, we have an unmatched passion for and celebration of our pizzas. We aim to deliver not just a wide array of pizzas, pastas and other quality foods that are always fresh, but also a casual atmosphere that is fun and friendly. All these without compromising what good restaurants have always stood for, service and customer satisfaction.

name: PlayMade
description: PlayMade has captivated the hearts of tea enthusiasts with our commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. Our handcrafted bubble tea has become a beloved destination for those seeking imaginative and flavourful tea creations. Without the use of additives or preservatives, our bobas exemplify freshness. The result? Bobas that are not only delicious but also healthier, offering a delightful bounce and exceptional flavour.

name: Poh Heng Jewellery
description: Since 1948, every piece of jewellery from Poh Heng has been crafted with passion, utilizing only the finest gold, diamonds, and gems. Our Trust® diamonds are specifically curated for the perfect proposal, while our legendary Si Dian Jin Collection is celebrated for its value and versatility in 22K and 24K yellow gold. Be sure to explore our modern Freestyle collection and timeless Classic pieces—it's easy to fall in love with jewellery from Poh Heng.

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Polar prides itself for its long and rich heritage as a three-generation-old family business that has been faithfully serving consistent quality products to its customers since 1926.

name: POPPIN Marketplace
description: Poppin Marketplace is a vibrant pop-up destination featuring trendy local brands, unique finds, and rotating concepts, offering shoppers fresh discoveries, creative experiences, and exciting lifestyle offerings.

name: POPULAR Bookstore
description: The POPULAR Bookstore is a one-stop retail hub that provides a comprehensive range of merchandise that includes books, stationery, multimedia, music and audio-visual products.

name: POSB Bank
description: POSB's first priority is helping you and your family save for the future. Join their community, share your journey with them, because "we’re neighbours first, bankers second."

name: PUTIEN MAMA
description: PUTIEN MAMA welcomes you with a selection of PUTIEN favourites at everyday locations and prices. Just as mamas are the heartbeat of every family, we care for you with comfort food made from fresh, best-quality ingredients. From savoury, flavourful lor mee to our signature bee hoon made with fine, translucent vermicelli, authentic Heng Hwa recipes are served fresh, hot, and fast with a mama’s touch.

name: QB House
description: QB HOUSE is the pioneer in quick-cut from Japan, founded in 1995. They made their name in Singapore and became known for giving quick, efficient haircuts in 2005. QB House's mission is to provide the value of “Time”. They do not provide shampooing, coloring or perming services. Their original air vacuum washer is used to replace shampooing, which is highly efficient and time saving. QB House aim to save our customers’ time such that they can enjoy more of their private time.

name: Ramen Hitoyoshi
description: Ramen Hitoyoshi specializes in serving one of the world’s most popular dishes, Tonkotsu Ramen. Tonkotsu Ramen comes with a rich and thick broth, coupled with home-made Chashu, noodles, Ajitama (flavoured egg), and other fresh ingredients, making it flavourful and extremely palatable.

name: Royce Dental Centre
description: Royce Dental Centre (Tiong Bahru Plaza) specialises in transforming smiles through quality dental care. Our clinic is designed to provide a comfortable experience for those seeking treatments ranging from braces to Invisalign and general dentistry for families. Our Orthodontic and Aligner team is trained to manage complex adult complications. We focus on delivering tailored treatment plans designed specifically to cater to your needs.

name: rumeL
description: rumeL at Tiong Bahru Plaza is a casual, family-friendly dining spot designed for everyday enjoyment. Our concept focuses on freshly made, flavourful handmade sourdough Neapolitan pizza, crafted with naturally fermented sourdough and cooked à la minute for the best texture and taste. We also offer specialty coffee, tea lattes, seasonal beverages, and gelato from Vanda Gelato, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

name: Safewell
description: Established in 1998, Safewell (formerly Savco) is a leading specialist in safe box, jewellery box and watch winder business in Singapore, that provides families with security and peace of mind that will last for generations to come. Officially a part of the international conglomerate Safewell Group since 2017, Safewell has a wide distribution network of retail outlets all over Singapore and across the globe. With retail and manufacturing operations in many countries such as China, Hong Kong, Macao, Australia, USA, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Dubai, France, United Kingdom, Germany, Safewell is your trusted brand for the safekeeping of your valuable items.

name: Sakon Thai Village
description: Sakon Thai served Authentic Thai Foods with light customization to suit the local taste. The food concept is a combination of flavors from original Sakon Town located in Northeast of Thailand and the Gau Yuak Temple in Chiang Mai . The founder has been a regular donor to the temple and have stayed there for a period of time. He was so impressed by the dishes cook by the local for the temple visitors and have since brought these special flavors to Singapore in 2008 opening the first Sakon Thai in Serangoon North. Today if you visit Sakon Thai you can taste these special recipe in the dishes like the Fried Fish Red & Green Sauce and the Sambal fried kanggong.

name: SBCC Baby & Child Clinic
description: Established in 1980, SBCC Baby & Child Clinic (formerly Singapore Baby & Child Clinic) is a leading paediatric group that provides quality and comprehensive medical services for children in Singapore. In SBCC, we believe there are many sub-specialty areas, e.g. cardiology, neurology, asthma, allergy, gastroenterology, growth, immunology and rheumatology, which require special attention in order to deliver better care. Our paediatricians have been specially trained in these areas and our nurses and clinics are equipped to support them. We are now even more committed in caring for our next generation.

name: Shi Li Fang Hot Pot
description: A Taiwan steamboat restaurant chain since 2013. Shi Li Fang have various types of hot pot provide to customer. We also have some special value set meals, premium set meal for customers to choose. Whether you are working or gatherings, both can be easily get the type of hot pot you like in SHI LI FANG

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food
description: Shihlin Taiwan Street Snacks® is everybody's favorite Taiwanese food chain featuring popular snacks from the alleys of Taiwan's night markets. Prepared the way they do over in Taiwan, the menu features authentic favorites such as XXL Crispy Chicken, Crispy Floss Egg Crepe, Handmade Oyster Mee Sua and Seafood Tempura.

name: Shiok Burger
description: Shiok Burger delivers bold, Singaporean-style burgers that fuse local flavors with juicy, handcrafted patties — a truly shiok taste you won’t forget. Perfect for indulgent meals, hearty bites and flavour-packed comfort food lovers.

name: Singtel Exclusive Retailer
description: Discover a wide range of multimedia services and solutions tailored to your needs at the Singtel Exclusive Retailer. Dedicated sales specialists ensure great service and a seamless experience, so enjoy peace of mind when you visit us. Check in-store for latest promotions and enjoy great value!

name: Skechers
description: Our story begins in a California beach house, where Skechers was born as a utility boot and became an icon of the grunge era. More than 25 years later, we’ve evolved into a footwear powerhouse with styles for men, women and kids around the world.

name: SkinGO!
description: Experience the skin revolution! SkinGO! redefines the meaning of express facials and we believe that express facials are just as effective if not more than the traditional facials. Using advanced technology from Korea, our facials are designed to re-energise and hydrate skin in 15 minutes. Suited for all ages and skin type, you can now be on the road to flawless smooth skin.

name: SKP
description: The largest supplier of Disposable Food Packaging and party supplies in Singapore, SKP is the one-stop destination for all packaging and party needs. With a global reach in over 20 countries, SKP has committed itself to engaging in more sustainable packaging solutions without compromising quality through their eco-friendly disposable food packaging series – EcoVue.

name: Spectacle Hut
description: Spectacle Hut is your partner for all things eye care. We prioritise your eye health by providing quality vision care and tailored solutions to you, your families and friends. We offer extensive range of eyewear product from fast fashion to luxury brands and wide selection of prescriptive lens solution for different needs. Visit us today to find your favourite pair, with complimentary eye screening.

name: Stalford Learning Centre
description: At Stalford Learning Centre, they aim to provide quality education and excellent service to all our students, assisting them in realising their dreams. Our proven teachers and proven methods will help you obtain proven results. Throughout the years, Stalford Learning Centre has strived to bring nothing short of excellence for our students, be it our strong team of over 600 qualified tutors, friendly and efficient staff, carefully aligned curriculum, a conducive and mentally-stimulating environment, and the best teaching materials. With the support of believers of our pedagogy, Stalford Learning Centre has successfully expanded from a mere outlet to a full-fledged education chain with 20 branches islandwide.

name: Standard Photo
description: Standard Photo is a retailer specializing in photography, cameras, home decors and customized products. We provide photo/document printing, photocopying and film processing services

name: Star River Language School
description: Star River Language School is an education institution. We provide Chinese tutoring courses for secondary school, primary school and pre-school students. Use Central Plaza lift to Level 2

name: Steak 99
description: Steak 99 bring affordability with innovative lava stone cookware, offering a healthier and flavourful grilling experience. The porous structure of the stone naturally absorbs excess fat, delivering lower-calories healthier steak without compromising taste. Lava stone’s infrared ray effect and exceptional heat retention and ensures the meat stays hot, flavorful , and juicy from the first bite to the last, creating a unique and satisfying dining experience.

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a fast casual kiosk chain focused on Mexican and Turkish takeaways. Serving exceptionally tasty burritos and kebabs, the food is made and prepared fresh daily, right in front of you. The made to order flow allows you to choose whichever toppings you like, and their succulent grilled chicken is remarkably tasty as it is healthy. With its energetic customer base which swears by the food, many have invented their own secret menu of their favorite food combination. Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

name: Subway
description: SUBWAY® is the undisputed leader in fast, healthy food. Our easy-to-prepare sandwiches are made to order right in front of the customer, precisely the way they want – using freshly baked breads, select sauces and a variety of delicious toppings.

name: Super Sushi
description: Super Sushi believes in serving fresh and delicious sushi. Our commitment to using only fresh, never frozen, salmon and the finest Niigata rice, along with specially made red vinegar rice prepared fresh in-store, ensures an unparalleled sushi experience. Explore our innovative sushi creations that artfully blend tradition with unique flavors—each bite is a testament to our dedication to delight our customers through quality and creativity.

name: Surfers Paradise
description: Surfers’ Paradise came across as a brand that millennials. As a proactive youthful brand, with its defined focus of being aspirational authentic Australian. Ensuring that surfers’ lifestyle apparels to our consumers which is trendy, affordable and easily accessible across island-wide, not resting on our laurels, new designs are constantly produced to transcend trends.

name: Sushi Tei
description: Sushi Tei's thoughtfully curated menu showcases more than 370 authentic Japanese cuisines, marrying the intricacies of Sashimi & Sushi to the theatrical flair of Yakimono & Nabemono. Using only fresh and quality ingredients to deliver classic Japanese fare with an innate intuition of local tastes; forging an inimitable and unique epicurean identity to truly remember.

name: Sushiro
description: SUSHIRO is Japan’s number 1 kaiten sushi chain. With more than 670 outlets in Japan and other countries, Sushiro serves over 100 varieties of delicious sushi and Japanese dishes to about 150 million customers every year. With the core corporate mission, “Tasty Sushi for All. Tasty Sushi for the Heart.” Sushiro maintains its key focus on careful ingredient selection, constant development of new flavours, employment of advanced technology to enhance service quality and is committed to serving high-quality and value-for-money Japanese sushi to customers.

name: TAKA Jewellery
description: TAKA Jewellery is a household brand established in Singapore with a strong presence of stores islandwide. Step into the wonders of treasures and experience an enchanting feature on a wide array of selections. Ranging from timeless classics to contemporary designs, crafted for the unique you.

name: The Body Shop
description: We believe there is only one way to beautiful, nature’s way. We’ve believed this for years and still do. We constantly seek out wonderful natural ingredients from all four corners of the globe, and we bring you products bursting with effectiveness to enhance your natural beauty and express your unique personality. And whilst we’re doing this, we always strive to protect this beautiful planet and the people who depend on it. We don’t do it this way because it’s fashionable. We do it because, to us, it’s the only way.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
description: A premium coffee and tea retailer that offers an extensive variety of expertly crafted beverages, freshly baked pastries, delectable cakes, and party packs. Their whole cakes are perfect for any occasion, and their e-card program rewards loyal customers.

name: The Orange Academy
description: The Orange Academy believes in cultivating children to be confident bilingual speakers in English and Mandarin by providing opportunities to hone their linguistic skills. The physical environment and classroom activities are designed to stimulate children’s creative thinking and logical reasoning and ignite their passion for learning. The Orange Academy strive to equip children with life skills, which are embedded in their holistic curriculum.

name: The Soup Spoon
description: We travel the world, discovering its cultures, one bowl of soup at a time. From the world, to our kitchen, to you.

name: THEFACESHOP
description: THEFACESHOP is a leading global beauty retail brand offering over 1,000 quality products for skin care, body care, hair care and makeup

name: Time Studio
description: Time Studio is a retailer of quality watches for men and women, carrying authentic pieces from brands like AC Watches, Seiko, Hifutre, Casio and more. Visit them to view their latest drops.

name: Tiong Bahru Dental Surgery
description: Our aim is to provide highest quality dental care to every generation of our patients. The clinic is fully equipped with modern facilities, excellent infection control measures, complemented with dedicated staffs and clinicians who will strive to deliver the best value and dental care to our patients. Our clinic is highly accessible as it is conveniently located inside Tiong Bahru Plaza, which is right above Tiong Bahru MRT Station. We are open daily except Sunday and Public Holiday.

name: Tongue Tip Lanzhou Beef Noodles
description: Tongue Tip Lanzhou beef noodles originated from the Lanzhou, Gansu province in China. This dish was first created by the Muslim Chinese (Hui) people and it’s recipe has been passed on for generations since the Tang Dynasty. Original Lanzhou Beef Noodles, using Halal meats, high quality fresh ingredients and a 15 spice blend premium stock.

name: Tonkatsu by Ma Maison
description: Ma Maison, which is French for “my house”, is one of the most well-loved restaurant chain offering Western- Japanese fusion cuisine. One of the main draws is its irresistibly good pork cutlet—available as Rosu (pork loin) Katsu or the leaner Hire (pork fillet) Katsu—which undergoes an aging and marinating process before it is breaded and deep-fried. The pork cutlets are served in sets with rice, shredded cabbage, and tonjiru (miso soup with pork) and pickles—all refillable. To enjoy the best of both land and sea, order the premium Unagi Tonkatsu Kamado Set comprising premium charcoal-grilled unagi from Isshiki in Aichi prefecture, kamado- style rice cooked in a traditional Japanese earthen pot, pickles, nyumen (soup noodles) and a choice of Rosu or Hire Katsu.

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated "Tare" (sauce) for enhanced flavour.

name: uBreakiFix
description: uBreakiFix is a chain store providing professional handphone repair services across Singapore. Unlike traditional mum-and-pop neighborhood handphone shops, we advocate transparent pricing (no hidden costs or "quote cheap ask for more later"). Warranty on repair is provided. Free temporary loan of phone to customer while waiting for repair. We source directly from China, be it glass panels, batteries, LCDs, connectors, microphones, speakers, etc. And so, we are cost competitive. Other value-add services to customers: Buy/Sell/Trade of used phones, Sale of mobile accessories

name: UNIQLO
description: About UNIQLO LifeWear - Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. A perfect shirt that is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hiding the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people’s lives.

name: United Overseas Bank
description: UOB is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 470 branches and offices in 19 markets in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Guided by our values and supported by our fundamental strengths, we focus on supporting our customers as we drive performance across our franchise.

name: Valu$
description: Valu$ delivers exactly what the brand suggest, Value for Money! They offer a wide range of lifestye and home living products at highly affordable prices.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty was born in 2002 with the simple concept of retailing quality everyday products at affordable prices. From personal care, fragrance, household, and even baby products, you are bound to find something that you need!

name: Victoria Facelift
description: The UK anti-wrinkle and sagging expert: Victoria Facelift is here to clear all your ageing skin woes. Targeting to help you solve all wrinkle problems and gets rid of crow’s feet, forehead lines, droopy face, double chin, sagging cheeks, loose Jowl, nasolabial folds and more. Victoria Facelift can help you regain a youthful appearance with our unique signature UK Power-Facelift Treatment.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons is Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer with close to 100 stores islandwide. Watsons seeks to bring ‘more’ to customers’ lives by inspiring and enabling every customer to look good and feel great. Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

name: Wok Hey
description: Masters of stir fry ⋅ Lovers of wok hey. Wok Hey serve the best rice and noodles in town. Cos' they just love stir fry. A modern, fast-casual, convenient take-out concept. Wok Hey offer tasty, nutritious, value-for-money, customisable fry-to-order rice and noodle wok dishes.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.

name: Yun Nam Hair Care
description: Throughout the years, Yun Nam’s philosophy of using Chinese herbs of the highest quality to specifically target each individual’s hair and scalp problems remains unchanged. They have continuously refined their herbal formulas, using advances in modern technology to further enhance the efficacy of their treatments to ensure better absorption and longer lasting effects. From using more well-known herbs like Ginseng, Dang Gui and He Shou Wu, to lesser known but no less effective ones like Salvia, Peony Root, and Dodder Seed, no expense is spared when customizing hair treatments to help individuals regain healthy hair.

name: ZTP Ginseng Birdnest
description: ZTP is one of the largest health food retail chains in Singapore. We are also one of the largest bottled Bird’s Nest manufacturers in Singapore. Our range of products include bird’s nest, Australian abalone, Japanese scallops, Mushroom, Ginseng, Cordyceps and many more.

name: Zuya Vegetarian
description: With years of experience in the vegan food industry, we are committed to bringing you the best & most affordable vegetarian dishes in town, from as low as $2.50 you will be able to enjoy a delicious plate of wok fry bee hoon with our famous crispy bean snacks & vegan char siew that keeps you coming back to us.

name: 3 Little Girls
description: 3 Little Girls specializes in Blind Boxes. As the official distributor for leading brands like Heyone, Hidden Wooo, TNT space and Hey Ciao. We provide high-quality collectibles that bring mystery and joy with every box.

name: 7-Eleven
description: Established in Singapore in 1983, 7-Eleven has since expanded to more than 400 stores island-wide to become the leading 24-hour convenience chain store. We take pride in serving the Singapore community 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. 7-Eleven emphasises convenience and value by offering a wide array of quality products, food and services to satisfy the needs of its customers. Think 7-Eleven, and what comes to mind is the refreshing Slurpee, 7Café, as well as a wide range of quality Ready Meals and sandwiches under 7-Select. 7-Eleven is also a 24/7 one-stop destination for customers who need to access bill payment services in their own time. Our services cover payment of utilities, courier services, and even cash withdrawal.

name: 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles
