description: 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles is the predecessor of the Fei Siong Group as the original stall in Redhill Close belonged to the grandfather of Mr Tan Kim Siong, the managing director of Fei Siong Group. This is now a chain of speciality food establishments in suburban malls and city centre malls comprising 6 specialty restaurants and 1 stall located at Fei Siong at Tangs Market. As the name may suggest, it specialises in teochew style fishball noodles with nostalgic flavour and taste. At 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles, you will savour tasty noodles with good texture served with delicious hand made teochew fishball, meatball and fishcake all made from yellow tail fish. The fishballs are often described as being light and bouncy but dense in flavours. Once inside any 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles outlet, you will get to enjoy this well-loved local fare in a comfortable and cosy setting thereby greatly enhancing your dining experience at 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles.

name: Accentz
description: ACCENTZ is created with a vision of giving our customers high quality fashion and luxury brands with affordable prices. All our brand items are carefully handpicked from designer boutiques. Thus, we guarantee that all the Brand Items offered in our store are 100% Authentic. We also sell fashion bags, accessories and jewelry with good quality.

name: AGrader Learning Centre
description: AGrader is a popular tuition & enrichment centre chain with branches all over Singapore offering high quality tuition & enrichment programmes for Pre-Primary, Primary and Secondary levels.

name: Ai Tang Zu
description: Ai Tang Zu is a fashion retailer offering a range of ready-to-wear apparel and accessories for women.

name: ANAKE
description: Born from the belief that true beauty transcends cultures, aging, trends, and radiates from an inner feeling of well-being, ANAKE’s mission is to deliver a holistic beauty & wellness experience to our clients - Tailored skincare backed up by science (ANAKE DNA SKIN TEST KIT), a customised regime (ANAKE SKIN) and edible skin food (SUPERFOOD, supplements by Anake). Feel good from the inside-out, a journey towards vibrant health and luminous skin. We call it inside - out beauty.

name: Aureus Academy
description: Aureus Academy specializes in providing individually tailored piano, violin, guitar, and vocal lessons to students of all ages and abilities. They believe one-on-one is the best environment to learn a musical instrument, but the trick is keeping students engaged while making the lessons fun and rewarding! Their lessons are designed to engage each student in a way that suits their learning style.

name: Ayam Penyet President
description: Ayam Penyet President is a chain of Halal-certified casual dining restaurants serving authentic Indonesian cuisine. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, their signature Ayam Penyet is served with sambal that packs one helluva punch so you'll definitely want to try their Avocado Juice to balance it out. Or perhaps indulge in one of their more interesting concoctions - Soda Gembira (Happy Soda) and Teh Botol Sosro (Indonesian Bottled Jasmine Tea).

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: BEGA
description: Having been in the fashion scene since 1996, BEGA strives for the highest commitment from designs and fabric selection to cutting and trimming to ensure the best fit for BEGA women to flaunt their curves. The fusion of colour hues, comfortable quality materials, varied textures and fashionable accessories takes on an exciting fashion edge in exuding confidence in BEGA women. BEGA offers an affordable, bold and feminine fashion – a shopping experience women will love! BEGA retail outlets are conveniently located all over Singapore, situated from heartlands to city shopping malls. At BEGA, we believe in delivering service and value to our customers to ensure they receive the best shopping experience.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

name: Boost Juice
description: Boost Juice - the nation’s favourite makers of fresh smoothies and juices! We serve millions of Singaporeans our iconic green cups, filled with fruit and veggie deliciousness. Deliciousness that comes from simple, natural goodness, served to you with a love life attitude that will make you so happy you’ll probably end up high fiving random strangers. It’s about making healthy living easy!! So naturally, nutrition is a key component in developing our range of smoothies and juices that sees us blending through millions of tonnes of fruit and veggies every year.

name: British Essential
description: British Essential is a one-stop beauty destination with assortments of prestige beauty products. Delightfully serving up hottest Korean beauty trends like Coreana, Senite,Entia, A-Solution, Ferveor Salon Professional, Kerasys, Esthaar, Showermate and Richenna. We also sell products from Kerastase, Redken, Nioxin, Tigi, Sebastain, L'Oreal, SK-II, KOSE, Channel, Johnsons & Johnsons, Pantene and more.

name: Butter & Cream
description: Butter & Cream Bakery focuses on muffin, egg tart and burnt cheesecake. Everyday, we are dedicated to achieve an unparalleled level of integration that ensures quality and freshness products to meet our customer’s needs.

name: Capitol Optical
description: Capitol Optical is committed to delivering exceptional eye care, eyewear, and customer service for all ages. Their expert optical team provides personalized services, including Myopia Management and Axial Length Measurement, and specializes in Ortho-K for children. Capitol Optical ensures every visit is enjoyable, whether for an eye test or choosing frames that suit your style. As their brands and stores expand with your support, they aim to elevate the standards of eye care and eyewear in Singapore.

name: Challenger Mobile
description: Unveil the world of Challenger – Singapore’s exclusive homegrown electronics chain since 1982. Explore the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials trusted by over half a million loyal members across 40+ island-wide stores. Embrace peace of mind with hassle-free returns and warranties covering 50,000+ top-tier products, including favorites like Apple, Samsung, and an array of other leading names.

name: Chewy Junior
description: Enjoy Sweet Moments, One Delicious Bite at a Time! We offer freshly baked sweets made from high-quality ingredients, delivering unique and refined flavors. Explore our variety of sweet treats and savor the sweetness with us every day!

name: CHICHA San Chen
description: Originating from Taiwan, CHICHA San Chen was founded in 1998 with a mission to make high-quality freshly brewed teas accessible to discerning tea drinkers. The brand holds a prestigious Highest International Authority ITI certification for quality, and utilises an exclusive patented Teapresso machine that allows custom settings and temperature control brewing technique to bring out the tea’s best flavour and natural scent, and maintain consistency in the quality and taste profiles of their tea. With high-quality tea as its mainstay, CHICHA San Chen marries the best of bubble tea with traditional tea bringing one of life’s greatest pleasures to the world.

name: Chicken Pie Kitchen & Don Signature Crab
description: Singapore’s #1 Original Chicken Pie & Chicken Shepherd’s Pie since 1983. Co-founded by Chef Don Lim, serving pastries such as Kueh Lapis, Prune Lapis, to Apple Pie and Egg Tarts. Every pastry is prepared fresh daily; handcrafted in small batches and freshly baked on the spot. Singapore’s time-tested recipe from the original shop at Far East Square (China Street) and China Square; to Raffles Place in the early 2000s. That familiar taste is now available at White Sands.

name: Chinese Medical Centre 中国中医
description: CMC was founded and established by Mr. Joseph Liu Bing-Qiang in 1997. It is Singapore’s first integrated Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and Healthcare centre that provides quality Traditional Chinese Medicine and healthcare services for the public. Today, CMC have 12 branches all over Singapore, with a team of close to 100 experienced TCM Practitioners, Masseurs and Veterans on standby to provide professional quality services of Chinese Medicine, Healthcare Massage and Acupuncture. With the outlets spread all over Singapore, our customers are connected via our unique payment system where one-time payment can be shared among multiple users. With a daily flow of over hundreds, this system will bring great convenience for our customers.

name: ClawGey
description: Claw machines have always existed in arcades, but the craze has never died. Apart from being a great way to spend time with friends – or simply as a means to add to your collection of stuffed toys – it’s the thrill of winning that keeps people coming back for more. Here’s where you can hone your plushie-catching skills at.

name: Clippers Barber
description: Clippers Barber is your affordable classic barbershop with a modern revamp. It is a place where men of all ages can sit back, relax, enjoy a professional grooming service at the hands of the expert barbers, who pride themselves for their superior fades and clean cuts. Focusing on mastering the art of no frills personal grooming for quintessential gentleman, Clippers Barber constantly challenge itself to combine technology and social media with the time honored art of barbering, so as to deliver on its promise of service quality at wallet friendly prices; leaving every customer with a fresh new look and a smile on their face.

name: Concierge (White Sands)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Cookhouse By Koufu
description: Cookhouse by Koufu is the perfect spot for pleasant dining and superb cuisine ranging from local fare to international cuisine. The concept food halls offer a wide array of great selections, which would delight your appetite with the food offerings and its themed designs.

name: Crocodile
description: Crocodile is a leading brand of men’s apparel in Singapore. The brand offers a wide variety of clothing items like Polo, Tees, Shirts, Pants, Bermuda, Undergarment and Accessories.

name: DABBA STREET
description: At Dabba Street, we have reimagined Indian and Mediterranean flavours, fusing them together with a green and refreshing twist. Our menu revolves around classics such as biryanis to globally-popular butter chicken; paired with an array of traditional, and healthier iterations of Indian and Mediterranean-inspired sides, dips and chutney options. Our food is prepared without ghee, heavy oils, added MSG, added colour, or artificial flavours. Step onto Dabba Street and create your personalized masterpiece that is bursting with flavours and textures.

name: Donna Beauty
description: A pioneer in the beauty industry, giving you internal wellness to the external glow and life into every pair of perfectly designed brows and complete nail spa experiences, Donna Spa never wavered from our belief in bringing affordable luxury to your convenience and being there for you in every stage of life.

name: Dough Culture
description: Dough Culture Pte Ltd is the largest manufacturer of You Tiao in Singapore. Being a pioneer in its industry and a firm believer in innovation, the company constantly engages in the research and development of new food products with strategic partners, to introduce exciting new brands such as Dough Culture to the market. Dough Culture brand of products are manufactured under the most stringent food safety and hygiene standards. Our products are HACCP and Halal certified.

name: Duke Bakery
description: Duke Bakery strives to bring healthier baked alternatives by focusing on 3'Low's': Low Sugar, Low Fat and Low in Calories. We are using Queen Flour from Japan and premium ingredients which give the breads a more soft and chewy texture that the customers love the most. Also, all the breads are freshly baked and handmade, no added preservatives. Get your bread today!

name: Eat 3 Bowls
description: Welcome to Eat 3 Bowls, your gateway to an unforgettable culinary journey through the rich diversity of Taiwanese cuisine. Our vibrant space is not just a restaurant; it's a portal that transports you to the heart and soul of Taiwan's culinary treasures. At Eat 3 Bowls, we wholeheartedly celebrate the essence of Taiwanese culture with every dish we serve. Whether you're savoring our iconic "Braised Pork Rice," reminiscent of the warm, home-cooked meals of Taiwan, or exploring our diverse street food menu, each bite immerses you in Taiwan's flavors and traditions. Our mission is to do more than just serve food; we’re here to ignite your senses, stir your memories, and create new ones. With each dish meticulously crafted to honor the essence of Taiwanese culture, we’re bringing a piece of Taiwan’s heart and soul right here to Singapore. Join us at Eat 3 Bowls, where the joy of eating isn’t confined to just one bowl. Indulge, explore, and immerse yourself in the flavors that beckon you to savor not just a meal, but an experience that resonates with the People, Culture and Food from the beautiful country, Taiwan. One bowl simply won’t suffice.

name: EduGrove Mandarin Enrichment Centre
description: EduGrove Mandarin Enrichment Centre offers quality Mandarin programmes to playgroup toddlers from 1 year old; students in kindergarten, primary and secondary levels; and even to adults trying to learn to speak a new language. EduGrove also specializes in teaching Mandarin to students from international schools and students from non-Mandarin speaking families. Designed to break away from the rigid way in which Mandarin is traditionally taught, our programmes put the emphasis on FUN! To ensure that every element of learning remains FUN, as well as ENGAGING, and most important of all EFFECTIVE, we use specially designed word games, drama techniques (including improvisation and role-play) and stimulating discussion sessions during which students are encouraged to share their thoughts and ideas. Our revolutionary methods, award winning curriculum and dedicated teachers have a proven track record of delivering results while igniting every student’s passion for learning the language.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Eu Yan Sang is Asia's leading integrative healthcare and wellness company with a strong foundation in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). Founded in 1879 with the mission of 'Caring for Mankind' - Today, Eu Yan Sang is a trusted household brand. Calm Hours To create a calm and sensory-friendly environment for neurodivergent individuals and their caregivers, this store has designated "Calm Hours" where noise and lighting levels are reduced. “Calm Hours” at this store are: Every Mon & Tue 10am - 11am Dementia Go-to Points This shop serves as a Dementia "Go-To Point", a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Available every day during operating hours. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Eurotex
description: Eurotex Singapore is Singapore’s leading luxury bath, bedding, bedsheet and ready-made designer curtain brand. Aside from its own range of products, the homegrown label is also an authorised licensee for authentic Disney bedding, bedsheet and bath products in Singapore since 2008.

name: FairPrice
description: From one supermarket, NTUC FairPrice has grown to become a leading retailer in Singapore serving more than half a million shoppers daily through a network of over 370 outlets. It comprises FairPrice supermarkets, FairPrice Finest, FairPrice Xtra, FairPrice Shop, Cheers convenience stores, FairPrice Xpress, and Unity pharmacy. Today, with its multiple retail formats serving the varied needs and interests of people from all walks of life, NTUC FairPrice has kept pace with the changing needs of its customers while remaining committed to its social mission and its aspiration to be Singapore’s leading world-class retailer with a heart.

name: Famous Amos
description: Since 1975, Famous Amos has been Singapore's go-to for freshly baked cookies. Our legendary cookies boasts that irresistible crunch and melt-in-your-mouth satisfaction that generations have loved. Beyond the iconic crunchy cookie flavours you know and love, be spoilt with our range of chunky cookies, fluffy muffins, brownies and more. Need a smile, a perfect perk-me-up or the ideal gift for any special occasion? Our cookie gift items are the perfect treat to share with friends, family or simply indulge in yourself. They're guaranteed to bring back happy memories and create new ones!

name: Four Leaves
description: Established since 1981, Four Leaves has developed into one of the leading chain bakeries in Singapore. Walk into any Four Leaves bakery and you will be welcomed by the aroma of the freshly baked products, as well as getting spoilt for choice due to the wide variety that they offer.

name: Freeman Florist
description: Freeman Florist recommends flowers for any occasion! They specialise in roses, arrangements and reliable flower deliveries using top quality roses and flowers. Freeman Florist delivers flowers all over Singapore.

name: Fun Toast
description: Bringing back the traditional Nanyang Coffeehouse nostalgia, Fun Toast serves well-brewed fragrant local Coffee and Tea, deliciously fresh Yuan Yang Soft Bun, Ham & Cheese French Toast and many more. Give their homemade signature Soya Sauce Chicken a try too. It will definitely keep you coming back for more. Check out their new range of merchandise as well, not to be missed!

name: G Military
description: G Military outlet is a great option for those in search of camping and outdoor supplies. It offers a wide range of products to cater to your needs in these areas. Customers can find everything they require for their camping trips and outdoor adventures at this store. It is worth considering G Military as a potential destination for all your camping and outdoor requirements.

name: Geláre
description: Geláre is a great place for a perfect meal at anytime of the day. We serve a variety ranging from hot western cuisine and light bites to desserts. Our specialty, freshly baked waffles, is paired with a wide selection of premium ice creams to be enjoyed by all.

name: Giordano
description: Giordano embodies today’s contemporary lifestyle choices – simplicity in design and quality in substance. Their total commitment to superior service and outstanding quality and value has enabled the company to successfully grow the brands Giordano, Giordano Ladies, Giordano Junior, BSX, and Beau Monde. The essence of Giordano is to provide relevant, essential and timeless fashion for all; and to develop apparel for everyone regardless of ethnicity, nationality or culture, truly illustrating their brand value “World Without Strangers”.

name: Global Art
description: Global Art Singapore is a group whose main purpose is to provide a systematic yet straightfoward approach of teaching art to children. They believe that art and creative drawing have the power to enhance a child’s mental development, broaden the scope of imagination, and unleash hidden creative potential. Positive experience in art also increases self-esteem, boosts confidence in problem solving, and promotes adoption of logical sequencing in the developing of ideas.

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 138 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Pharmacy services available! Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for consumers' health and beauty needs. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at all stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. We continue to build on our rich healthcare heritage with an award-winning team of pharmacists who have consistently won multiple pharmacist awards every year.

name: Hockhua Tonic
description: Hockhua Tonic, a household name in Singapore and Malaysia since 1989, is known for its retail chain of stores stocked with traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), health supplements and tonics. Renowned for its quality ginseng and wide range of bird's nest products, it also offers seafood delicacies such as abalones, dry scallops, Chinese herbs and a variety types of self-manufactured nutrition organically grown products.

name: HUGABO
description: Hug A Bowl of HUGABO's flavourful, nutritional soup! When you eat better, you feel better. That's why HUGABO uses only all-natural and nutrient-dense ingredients for their stock. Each stock is painstakingly double-boiled for hours in-house to create their signature rich and super-tasty base. Customize your soup the way you love from a wide variety of superfoods (legumes, leafy greens, seafood, etc.) to give your health a further boost! Through their soups, they hope you'll experience warmth and comfort, just like you would with a loving embrace.

name: Japan Home
description: With more than 65 outlets island-wide, Japan Home has grown from strength to strength. Embodying a philosophy for quality without compromise, Japan Home prides itself in the provision of a wide range of household products at affordable prices. Today, Japan Home is a household name with an unrivaled reputation as a one-stop provider for all your household needs.

name: Jean Yip Hairdressing
description: With 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Since inception, Jean Yip has gradually increased its range of services from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: K Shoe & Bags Services
description: Since 1983, K Shoe & Bags Services has become a well-known Shoe Repair Shop in Singapore. What started out as a hobby has now become their passion. K Shoe & Bags Services offer quality repairs at affordable prices. Their intense passion for fixing what’s broken has brought them to the forefront of the repair industry, and their impeccable results have kept them there.

name: kcuts
description: Enjoy your basic, no-frills Korean themed hair cut here at kcuts. With outlets conveniently located all across the island, kcuts provide reasonably priced and stylish haircuts wherever you are.

name: KFC
description: Captivating aroma, succulent juicy chicken and thoughtful service are what KFC lovers come back for. Choose between our signature Original Recipe chicken prepared with Colonel Sander's secret blend of 11 herbs & spices, or the all-time favourite Hot & Crispy chicken. Check out the perennially popular KFC a.m. Breakfast menu and the variety of food items from Rice to Egg Tarts as well. Visit KFC today for an experience that is so good.

name: Kiddy Palace
description: Kiddy Palace is a children’s departmental store providing a one-stop shopping experience for doting mummies and daddies. We aim to be a trusted household brand name in Singapore as a specialty retailer for kids, toddlers, children and expectant mothers.

name: KOI Thé
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: Kopi & Tarts
description: “Kopi & Tarts” is a new local Halal coffee concept by Mayson Bakery, where we marry the love of coffee with our freshly baked tarts and pastries. We aim to delight the palate with both sweet and savoury offerings, allowing family, friends and loved ones to take a break and enjoy the simple pleasures in life.

name: Kskin
description: Kskin is a Korean Express Facial Salon that caters to both genders. Customers walk in to enjoy their facial treatment with no need for any appointment booking. Cashless payment can be made at self-serve payment kiosks before service, and there is no package selling involved. Using our specially formulated, pharmaceutical grade proprietary solutions, coupled with the latest machines in skin care technology, the duration of the facial treatment only requires 15 minutes to ensure skin is refreshed, prepped, and glowing. The premium quality of skin care ingredients, paired with Kskin's proprietary treatment efficiency, enable our customers to maximize time in the midst of their busy schedule to achieve their skincare goals without compromising results.

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Lenskart
description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer brand that retails best quality, fashionable eyewear at surprisingly low prices. Lenskart achieves this by establishing a direct route to customers - straight from manufacturing to retail, and by eliminating 7 layers of middlemen. Lenskart has 2 unique products BLU lenses and Air frames. BLU lenses are designed for the digital age. They block blue rays from smartphones and other digital devices, helping prevent eye damage. Lenskart BLU is a fully loaded lens scratch proof, superhydrophobic and aspheric. Air frames are lightweight, flexible, robust and are designed for ultimate comfort and style.

name: LiHO Tea
description: ‘LiHO means “How are you in Hokkien” and we take pride in our name as it celebrates Singapore as a melting pot of culture. A simple greeting of LiHO is a great way for individuals to bond and it is even better with a cup of Singapore’s homegrown tea brand, LiHO Tea. Brown Sugar Pearl, Avocado and Fruit Tea are what LiHO does best and it is the heart of our brand.” Great emphasis is placed on the entire process, from choosing the right tea to roasting, to brewing and finally serving it.

name: Long John Silver's
description: Long John Silver’s mission is to provide everyone great tasting, reasonably-priced seafood and chicken in a fast, friendly manner. Their secret batter is prepared fresh throughout the day and makes Long John Silver's seafood and chicken tastes like no other in the world.

name: Luckin Coffee
description: Founded in 2017, luckin coffee pioneers a technological-driven retail concept aims to provide quality coffee and products accessible to its customers. Using only sustainably, ethically sourced coffee beans roasted to perfection by its WBC Champion Team, luckin coffee created a range of unique and delicious blend of coffee that has won the hearts of million coffee lovers. Luckin coffee’s success and rapid growth over the years are a testament to its unique approach to retail that focuses on technology and customer centric approach, and its relentless dedication to customer satisfaction.

name: Maki-San
description: Maki-san serves up customisable sushis and salads with an incredibly wide selection of very tasty ingredients. So you can pick your own favourites for a crazy combo anytime you like!

name: McDonald's
description: McDonald's business is never just about providing quick meals. It's always been about you - your tastes, your lifestyle, your choices. And they'd like to keep it that way, with you lovin' every moment of it. This is how McDonald's put their heart and soul into each and every one of their delicious, wholesome meals. Each 'mmm' and 'ahhh' from you is thanks enough. As you change and grow, McDonald's will be right there with you every step of the way. Today and tomorrow.

name: Men Men Don Don
description: Men Men Don Don is a modern Japanese food kiosk which serves Fast, Affordable, Delicious bowls of rice and noodles.

name: Minmed Clinic
description: Minmed Clinic offers a wide range of high-quality primary healthcare services for individuals and families. With conveniently located clinics islandwide, we provide GP consultations, health screening, vaccinations, chronic disease management, and work permit screening. Our patient-focused approach, CHAS accreditation, and acceptance of various corporate health plans ensure comprehensive care for all. With its diverse range of medical services, experienced healthcare professionals, and commitment to patient care, Minmed Clinic is a trusted provider of healthcare services for all.

name: Mister Mobile
description: As Singapore's leading one-stop mobile service provider, Mister Mobile caters to your every mobile need. With multiple stores conveniently scattered across the island and efficient doorstep services, I guarantee stress-free phone purchases, prompt on-the-spot repairs, seamless trade-ins. Certified with ISO 9001 and CaseTrust, Mister Mobile is a beacon of unparalleled quality and reliability. Awarded the esteemed Carousell InstantBuy Award and adorned with numerous 5.0-star ratings on Google and Carousell, I consistently deliver excellence and customer satisfaction. Your mobile journey is in safe hands with Mister Mobile — where service seamlessly meets distinction.

name: MoneyMax
description: MoneyMax is a leading pawnbroker, retailer and trader of jewellery, pre-owned luxury bags and watches, with a presence in both Singapore and Malaysia. MoneyMax is proud to be the first ISO 9001 (ISO9001:2008) and CaseTrust Accredited Pawnbroker in Singapore.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: Munchi Pancakes
description: At Munchi Pancakes, we serve both classic Min Jiang Kueh, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, as well as Munchi pancakes with creative yet delicious hot and cold fillings. We take pride in using premium ingredients to ensure the freshest taste, and we offer vegan-friendly options so everyone can enjoy our delicious creations. Experience the perfect balance of tradition and innovation with every bite

name: Music Delight School
description: Choose your instrument, enrich your skills & shine on stage. At Music Delight, we nurture your musical journey from lessons to performances.

name: My Digital Lock
description: My Digital Lock is the Sole Agent of Korean brand EPIC in Singapore and also Authorized Dealer of Samsung brand in Singapore. EPIC Based on quality proven software development technology and management know-how in the world market. EPIC Digital Locks with Durable metallic body against external shocks and fire, Auto-lock, Re-lock, double lock function for user convenience and security. Random Number and Multi-touch features that enhance, password security (1time entry password available).

name: Myeongdong Hair Studio
description: Myeongdong Hair Studio offers full Korean Style Hair cutting, colouring, perming, styling and treatment services.

name: Nail Palace
description: Nail Palace is one of the best at its craft because the company thrives on passion and attention-to-detail rather than being profit-oriented. They strive to provide quality services that will pamper your nails and reinvent your style. One requirement that their technicians must fulfill is the love for the job. Nail Palace's range of products and services are highly diverse and readily available to meet and satisfy any needs. Besides first-class pedicures and manicures, they provide nail art services, foot hydro-spa therapy, sole renewal treatment and other services. They also have products from well-known brands such as Seche, OPI, Gelish and Ezflow that consumers love.

name: Nailz Gallery
description: At Nailz Gallery, we believe that every man and woman has the right to look and feel their best. Colour is the answer, not only for our nails, but for the ways we show up and express ourselves regardless of gender roles, social status, or feeling the need to “fit in”. Whether you are looking for manicure, pedicure, hand/foot spa, nails treatments, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery or waxing services, we can do it all!

name: Nanyang Bliss
description: Nanyang Bliss rediscovers the taste of home with a single beverage, bringing new life to the classics. While preserving the essence of Southeast Asian desserts, Nanyang Bliss breaks through tradition by combining red beans, green beans, and cendol with the smoothness of milkshakes. Each sip is filled with rich sweetness yet remains healthy and light, suitable for everyone.

name: Nanyang Educational Consultancy
description: Nanyang Educational Consultancy offers targeted and results-driven programmes for Primary and Secondary students in Mathematics, Science, Chemistry, Physics, English, and Chinese. Our engaging and interactive teaching approach helps students strengthen core concepts, build confidence, and improve their academic performance in an enjoyable learning environment.

name: New York Skin Solutions
description: Established in 2004, New York Skin Solutions has earned an excellent reputation in the beauty industry with proven treatment results* for both male and female customers. Formulated to suit Asian skin types, New York Skin Solutions will work effectively for your particular needs, helping you to restore healthy and radiant skin.

name: NK Hairworks
description: NK Hairworks is the premier destination for exceptional scalp & hair care experiences in Singapore. With 11 conveniently located outlets islandwide, we offer a comprehensive range of services, from haircuts, colouring, perms, and rebonding to advanced hair and scalp treatments. Since 1992, we’ve built a reputation as a trusted name in Singapore’s hair industry, known for our consistent excellence and attentive service. Our team of skilled professionals is dedicated to delivering personalised, transformative experiences that leave every client feeling confident, beautiful, and truly cared for. Experience our commitment to nurturing beauty in every customer, every day.

name: OCBC
description: OCBC and its subsidiaries offer a broad array of specialist financial and wealth management services, ranging from consumer, corporate, investment, private and transaction banking to treasury, insurance, asset management and stockbroking services.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Old Chang Kee is a household name famous for it's delectable curry puffs that are filled with curried potatoes, chicken and a slice of hardboiled egg, all cooked with special herbs and spices. Other than curry puffs, Old Chang Kee also boasts spring rolls, crab claws, sotong wings and yam pies amongst it's vast product range.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: Paris Baguette
description: Born from a love of bread and a passion for quality, Paris Baguette is an international, fast-casual bakery founded in 1988 specialized in French-inspired baked goods offering chef-inspired cakes, pastries, freshly made sandwiches and salads with signature coffee and tea. Paris Baguette aims to offer a unique experience to thousands of guests daily.

name: Pasir Ris Library
description: Set up to reach out to young families in the Pasir Ris community, the Pasir Ris Library boasts a special space for teenagers. We provide a variety of services and facilities to enhance your library experience, from managing your library membership to booking study areas.

name: Perfetto
description: At Perfetto, their mission is to always strive to provide quality of the highest standards and modern designs. To deliver more value to customers that earns their respect and loyalty. To beautify the world with meticulously crafted fine jewelry, jadeite jade, crystals, pearls and dzi beads.

name: Pet Lovers Centre
description: Pet Lovers Centre (PLC) boasts of having the widest range of the freshest stock for pet owners to pamper their pets and offers quality pet services including pet grooming, veterinary consultations and excellent home delivery service to reduce the hassle while shopping. PLC also has its very own pet care consultants whom customers can approach with questions regarding their pets!

name: Pezzo
description: Welcome to Pezzo where every pizza has its own unique character and taste. Meet Big Daddy, Meat Munchers or Garlic Chick for a novel way of enjoying some scrumptious tasting pizzas on-the-go!

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Pixie Nail Spa is one of Singapore’s largest nail spas, providing luxury beauty services such as manicures and pedicures, eyelash extensions, eyebrow embroidery, lips embroidery, waxing, and many more! A salient feature of our nail spa is never to compromise on hygiene practices. Feel good, and feel at ease!

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Polar prides itself for its long and rich heritage as a three-generation-old family business that has been faithfully serving consistent quality products to its customers since 1926.

name: POPULAR Bookstore
description: The POPULAR Bookstore is a one-stop retail hub that provides a comprehensive range of merchandise that includes books, stationery, multimedia, music and audio-visual products.

name: POSB Bank
description: POSB's first priority is helping you and your family save for the future. Join their community, share your journey with them, because "we’re neighbours first, bankers second."

name: Potato Corner
description: Global french fries chain Potato Corner has been delighting fries lovers all over the world since 1992, serving up what many have called the “world’s best flavoured fries”. Fries are prepared fresh, fried to order, seasoned with passionately formulated flavours, and served hot and crispy. Take your pick from Cheese, Barbecue, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili Barbecue and a whole lot more!

name: PrimaDéli
description: PrimaDéli serves all-time favourites that everyone loves and enjoys. With an extensive selection of premium quality cakes and scrumptious treats, signature products include Chicken Pie, Egg Tart, Singapore Curry Puff, Premium Pandan Chiffon, Mango Delight Cake as well as their immensely popular Waffles.

name: Q & M Dental Surgery
description: Q & M Dental Group was first established in November 1996 at Bukit Batok. Over the years, it has grown from strength to strength and now has more than 100 clinics island-wide, thus making it the largest private dental healthcare group in Singapore. Q & M Dental Group is also CHAS/Merdeka Generation (MG)/Pioneer Generation (PG)/Medisave/Baby Bonus accredited. We look forward to serving you there!

name: Qi Ji
description: Embracing quality and consistency as their cornerstones, Qi Ji has captivated people’s taste buds for decades with their irresistible and original recipes. As a Singaporean foodie, they aspire to preserve the heritage of authentic Singapore fare and grow its prominence on the culinary world map.

name: Raffles Dental
description: Raffles Dental is an established team-based dental practice comprising dental specialists and general dental surgeons in Raffles Hospital, and supported by a network of dental clinics located island wide. Raffles Dental’s dentists work across specialties with each other to prevent, diagnose, and treat a full range of dental and oral diseases. General services include routine dental checkups, screening and maintenance, dental X-rays, crowns and bridges, dentures, braces and aligners, extractions, fillings, implants, and teeth whitening. Raffles Dental clinics are approved under the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus, and Medisave scheme.

name: Raffles Medical
description: Raffles Medical is the primary care network of Raffles Medical Group, which provides family medicine, health screening, and dental services. Besides operating clinics in China, Japan, Vietnam, and Cambodia, it is one of the largest network of family medicine clinics in Singapore. Our team of family physicians provides care for patients of all ages, including treatment and management of acute and chronic diseases, vaccinations, travel health, and health screening. Raffles Medical clinics are approved to serve Singaporeans under various healthcare and government schemes including the Healthier SG programme, Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS), the Pioneer and Merdeka Generation scheme, Baby Bonus and Flexi-Medisave scheme.

name: Rahim Traders Money Changer
description: If you're looking for travel money for your next trip, or if you need to exchange foreign currency notes back to SGD, visit Rahim Traders Money Changer. We offer reliable money-changing services to help you get your foreign currency ready before you jet off on your holidays.

name: Sa’Yang Hair
description: SA’YANG HAIR is a contemporary hair salon that celebrates diversity and individuality. We provide professional hair services in a welcoming, inclusive environment where clients feel empowered and cared for. Our salon is designed to be a comfortable space for self-expression, community, and well-being.

name: Saap Saap Thai
description: Featuring all-time favorites dishes we Singaporeans are familiar with. Savour Authentic Street side Fried Chicken, Stir Fried Rice Dishes with a twist, Thai Noodles, flavorful Spicy Thai Salad, desserts and original drinks in a relaxing and inviting Restaurant, self-service style.

name: Saizeriya
description: Saizeriya was founded in 1967 in a small town in Chiba, Japan, and has since grown from strength to strength with over a thousand outlets spanned across Asia. With its unique offerings of casual Italian cuisines at affordable prices and an “All-you-can-drink” bar set amidst a comfortable ambience, Saizeriya promises customers a great dining experience every time.

name: SF Fruits & Juices
description: SF started off with its first outlet in Orchard Road in 2004 selling cut fruits and juices. They now have around 30 outlets island wide with some selling whole fruits as well. SF strives to provide quality fruits and farm produce to all at affordable prices.

name: Shi Li Fang Hot Pot & One Pot
description: At 热辣滚烫 One Pot, we bring you Ma La Tang and Ma La Ban with a local twist! Our delicious broth is packed with rich flavors, and our wide selection of fresh ingredients lets you create the perfect bowl, just the way you like it. Whether you prefer soup or dry mix, mild or bold flavors, there’s something for everyone. Pair it with crispy fried toppings and silky scrambled eggs for an unforgettable meal. Shi Li Fang Hot Pot has become the most economical hot pot restaurant chain that provides the widest range of dishes and sauces in Singapore. They have successfully created a healthy Singapore centric hot pot through careful food selection according to Singapore's multi- ethnicity, suitable for all demographics. Committed to share their hot pot creations to all, they will continue to expand and reach everyone here in Singapore.

name: Shihlin Taiwan Street Food
description: Inspired by Taiwan’s vibrant night market culture, Shihlin Taiwan Street Food brings authentic street favourites to everyday moments. From the iconic XXL Crispy Chicken and comforting Mee Sua to newer favourites like Braised Chicken Rice, each dish is crafted to deliver bold flavours and familiar comfort. Rooted in authenticity and made for modern lifestyles, Shihlin continues to evolve its menu while staying true to the tastes customers know and love. Whether it’s a quick bite or a satisfying meal, Shihlin offers a true taste of Taiwan in every visit. Shihlin Reimagined. 戀．原味。

name: Shreeyaasha Hair & Beauty Salon
description: Shreeyaasha are pioneers in beauty treatments with more than 20 years of experience in the beauty industry known for their herbal way. Their bandwagons of contented customers irrespective of their races spread all over Malaysia and Singapore are testimony to this fact. Shreeyaasha use only Shanaz beauty materials for all treatments, and offer a wide range of all natural and ayurvedic cosmetics, their own formula for skin care, makeup, & body care solutions. Very effective and safe on even the most sensitive of skin, these are most suited for those with allergies, sensitivities, or those who simply want clean and natural products.

name: Skechers
description: Our story begins in a California beach house, where Skechers was born as a utility boot that quickly became a style icon of the grunge era. For more than 25 years, the collection has grown into the thousands and today spans a wide selection of styles that meet the footwear needs of men, women and kids around the world. Skechers has evolved into an award-winning lifestyle and performance powerhouse known for stylish and comfortable footwear and apparel worn by millions.

name: SKP
description: The largest supplier of Disposable Food Packaging and party supplies in Singapore, SKP is the one-stop destination for all packaging and party needs. With a global reach in over 20 countries, SKP has committed itself to engaging in more sustainable packaging solutions without compromising quality through their eco-friendly disposable food packaging series – EcoVue.

name: Smoovee Skin
description: Smoovee Skin is Korea's specialist in Hair Removal and Skin Rejuvenation Salon. It is a revolutionary salon that provides services for both males and females. Their services are suitable for all skin colours and types at an affordable price tag. Smoovee Skin is different as they believe in a "No Appointment and No Package" concept. Their treatments require zero down-time in which they are non-invasive and painless. Smoovee Skin strive to meet our customers' desired goals by ensuring quality is assured and our treatments are highly effective with 3x faster results.

name: Sorella
description: Sorella believes in treasuring and celebrating every woman's innate femininity. We aim to highlight and enhance your natural beauty and sexy curves with our high quality lingerie, which provide unparalleled support, superior shaping, desired toning and overall flawlessness. Cherish yourself with Sorella and unveil your true feminine allure. Discover, indulge in your body and love yourself entirely through our premium lingerie.

name: Spectacle Hut
description: Spectacle Hut is your partner for all things eye care. We prioritise your eye health by providing quality vision care and tailored solutions to you, your families and friends. We offer extensive range of eyewear product from fast fashion to luxury brands and wide selection of prescriptive lens solution for different needs. Visit us today to find your favourite pair, with complimentary eye screening.

name: Spicy Chef
description: The “SPICY CHEF” brand is a new dining concept that focuses on Chinese-style stir-frying, with spicy stir-fried meat as its flagship dish. It is dedicated to promoting the culture of freshly-cooked Chinese cuisine and aims to provide consumers with safe, reliable, and cost-effective dining services.

name: Stalford Learning Centre
description: At Stalford Learning Centre, they aim to provide quality education and excellent service to all our students, assisting them in realising their dreams. Our proven teachers and proven methods will help you obtain proven results. Throughout the years, Stalford Learning Centre has strived to bring nothing short of excellence for our students, be it our strong team of over 600 qualified tutors, friendly and efficient staff, carefully aligned curriculum, a conducive and mentally-stimulating environment, and the best teaching materials. With the support of believers of our pedagogy, Stalford Learning Centre has successfully expanded from a mere outlet to a full-fledged education chain with 20 branches islandwide.

name: Standard Photo
description: Standard Photo is a retailer specializing in photography, cameras, home decors and customized products. We provide photo/document printing, photocopying and film processing services

name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Stryv
description: Experience innovative hair care and grooming solutions that are formulated with cutting-edge technology. From professional hair dryers and salon-grade treatments to quality grooming essentials, pamper yourself at home with stryv!

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a fast casual kiosk chain focused on Mexican and Turkish takeaways. Serving exceptionally tasty burritos and kebabs, the food is made and prepared fresh daily, right in front of you. The made to order flow allows you to choose whichever toppings you like, and their succulent grilled chicken is remarkably tasty as it is healthy. With its energetic customer base which swears by the food, many have invented their own secret menu of their favorite food combination. Go for the chicken kebabs if you’re new to Stuff’d, or if you’re looking for something even more filling, go for their Burritos!

name: Subway
description: SUBWAY® is the undisputed leader in fast, healthy food. Our easy-to-prepare sandwiches are made to order right in front of the customer, precisely the way they want – using freshly baked breads, select sauces and a variety of delicious toppings.

name: Sukiya
description: Sukiya is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant, which operates more than 2,600 locations across the world. Sukiya specializes in Gyudon – a delicious combination of thinly-sliced tender beef cooked in a soy sauce -based savory sauce with onions all served on top of fluffy, perfectly-cooked Japanese rice.Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic-service, Sukiya uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.

name: Super Sushi
description: Super Sushi believes in serving fresh and delicious sushi. Our commitment to using only fresh, never frozen, salmon and the finest Niigata rice, along with specially made red vinegar rice prepared fresh in-store, ensures an unparalleled sushi experience. Explore our innovative sushi creations that artfully blend tradition with unique flavors—each bite is a testament to our dedication to delight our customers through quality and creativity.

name: Sushi Express
description: One of the biggest conveyor belt sushi brands in Asia, offering more than 80 different variations of sushi from $1.50++ per plate. At Sushi Express, we understand that it’s not always about value when it comes to serving our customers, it is about consistently providing quality and innovative products competitively.

name: Swee Heng 1989 Classic
description: Swee Heng 1989 Classic is a new brand born from the 1st Singapore full fledge halal bakery chain known as Swee Heng Bakery in the late 80s. Making its official debut at West Mall in 2014. Swee Heng 1989 Classic has since gained wide popularity and recognition from Singaporeans. Till date, we have opened a total of 29 outlets and 1 Bakery Cafes island wide. Holding on to the same promise made by Swee Heng Bakery, sharing our baking passion to all communities. Till now, we remain committed in using the finest ingredients gathered around the world to produce good quality and affordable products. Our vision is to become “Bakery of people, Bread for life”. We strive hard to make Swee Heng the Singapore Bakery that serves all communities.

name: Sweet Home
description: Sweet Home is a one-stop home concept store that offers premium home textiles, cleaning & disinfection, storage, and personal care products made of the finest materials to brighten your home. We have eight outlets at shopping centers in Singapore. We bring you a premium selection of home products backed by a 100% product satisfaction guarantee.

name: SYOUJIN
description: Syoujin is committed to provide you with a one-stop beauty body, health, slimming, hair removal and other diversified care. In addition to having more than a world-class advanced equipment, the treatments are specially selected from internationally renowned high-quality products, and made more personal, and even medical-grade service solutions to meet the modern pursuit of perfect skin for the demands of men and women .

name: Teo Heng KTV Studio
description: Teo Heng was established in 1989, with the objective of providing an affordable & safe space for everyone to sing. Teo Heng have always kept to their mission and vision where they follow a no-alcohol/smoking policy. Since the day of operations, their drinks are still kept at $1 and patrons are allowed to bring their own food & drinks.

name: The Soup Spoon Union
description: We travel the world, discovering its cultures, one bowl of soup at a time. From the world, to our kitchen, to you.

name: Tokyo Zone 1945
description: We started our business in 2000 here in Singapore and continually flourishing until today.

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori-Q is a popular and trendy Japanese yakitori chain, driven by the passion to deliver the original taste from Japan and committed to serve only the freshest and finest. Using their customised auto-rolling machine to grill the yakitori sticks, they are then being dipped into their specially formulated "Tare" (sauce) for enhanced flavour.

name: Twyst
description: Twyst is a fast casual F&B concept offering a delectable range of freshly cooked pasta at affordable price points. Their food provides the unexpected twist that gives a delightful surprise, because of their no-holds-barred innovative approach towards flavours that are familiar yet sinfully good.

name: uBreakiFix.sg
description: UBreakifix.sg provides professional handphone, computer repair services including the replacement of broken screens, damaged microphones and speakers, including mobile phones trade-in.

name: Unity Pharmacy
description: Originally established in 1992, Unity Pharmacy's mission is to improve the health and total well-being of its customers by being the most professional pharmacy chain while delivering the highest level of customer satisfaction at the most competitive prices. There are currently some 60 Unity Pharmacy stores island-wide, which offer a wide range of health supplements, healthcare and skincare products, medicines and first aid items. Pharmacists are trained to give professional advice on health concerns, and can help in services such as dispensing of medication, medication reviews, advice on chronic disease management and drug interaction.

name: V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic
description: V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic is one of the largest medical aesthetics group in Singapore. With clinics island wide and over 30 medical doctors, they offer a plethora of non-surgical and non-invasive treatments for your aesthetics goals. From FDA approved medical aesthetic treatments to affordable and transparent pricing, they set strong priorities in providing patient comfort and safety. Be it to achieve a V shaped face, to have luminous and flawless complexion, V Medical Aesthetics & Laser Clinic wants to embark the pursuit of glowing skin with you.

name: Valu$
description: Valu$ delivers exactly what the brand suggest, Value for Money! They offer a wide range of lifestye and home living products at highly affordable prices.

name: ValueMax
description: Founded in 1988, ValueMax is a pawnbroking chain that has been steadfastly serving the community in Singapore. ValueMax is also a mainboard-listed jewellery and gold dealer with over 75 outlets in Singapore and Malaysia. Our collection offers a palette of wearable pieces embellished with elegance. An award-winning company with strong business practices, we are a trusted retailer that guarantees authenticity for jewellery of renewed condition at superb value.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty is your go-to destination for quality beauty and household cleaning products at unbeatable prices. Explore our curated selection of skincare, haircare, and cosmetics, alongside an array of effective household cleaning essentials. Discover a diverse range of beauty items, from skincare and cosmetics to haircare essentials, all designed to make you feel radiant without breaking the bank. Indulge in a delightful shopping experience where affordability meets quality. From skincare essentials to household must-haves, Venus Beauty is your one-stop destination for budget friendly beauty and cleaning solutions. Elevate your routine without compromising your budget – Visit Venus Beauty today and experience the joy of affordable excellence.

name: Victoria Facelift
description: The UK anti-wrinkle and sagging expert: Victoria Facelift is here to clear all your ageing skin woes. Targeting to help you solve all wrinkle problems and gets rid of crow’s feet, forehead lines, droopy face, double chin, sagging cheeks, loose Jowl, nasolabial folds and more. Victoria Facelift can help you regain a youthful appearance with our unique signature UK Power-Facelift Treatment.

name: Vivian & Sean
description: Established in 1998, the name Moda Paolo has become synonymous with good quality shoes in the latest designs. Moda Paolo’s shoes are stylish, trendy, durable, comfortable and affordable, providing customers with good value for money. Moda Paolo distinguishes itself as the home-grown footwear retailer which understands consumer preferences in terms of comfort, design and aesthetics especially that of Asian customers. In Nov 2011, the company opened a new outlet under the brand name Vivian & Sean to target at different segment of consumers.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons is Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer with close to 100 stores islandwide. Watsons seeks to bring ‘more’ to customers’ lives by inspiring and enabling every customer to look good and feel great. Watsons has enhanced its health platform with pharmacies located within more than 30 key stores, offering medication dispensing and other medical services.

name: Wingstop
description: Serving the World Flavour through an unparalleled guest experience and offering of classic wings, boneless wings and tenders, always cooked to order and hand-sauced-and-tossed in fans’ choice of 10 bold, distinctive flavours, including fans’ favourite Kecap Manis that is exclusive to Singapore. Wingstop’s menu also features signature sides including seasoned fries, hand-breaded mushroom fritters and freshly-made ranch dip.

name: Wok Hey
description: Masters of stir fry ⋅ Lovers of wok hey. Wok Hey serve the best rice and noodles in town. Cos' they just love stir fry.

name: XCYD
description: XCYD offers some of the best Chinese Cuisine serving a tantalizing collection of dishes that are suitable for family, large groups, catching up with friends and colleagues. From Sichuan cuisine bento to noodle, its extensive menu is reflective of the restaurant’s efforts to cater to every palate. This outlet at White Sands Mall pioneers a new concept serving takeaway Sichuan barbecue skewers and cup noodles for quick bite on the go. Must Tries: Indulge in their mouth-watering dishes such as Mala Mutton Skewer, Braised Beef Cup Noodle and Sichuan Fries.

name: Xin Wang Hong Kong Café
description: Street favourites of Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore take centrestage at Xin Wang Hong Kong Café, a modern café that offers all-day dining in a modern setting. Boasting an extensive menu with Hong Kong style items, diners can savour comfort food borne from simple recipes characteristic of the typical Hong Kong and Macau cafes, home recipes we grew up on, local Singapore favourites, Dim sum and tea-time snacks. Whether it’s breakfast, a brunch meet-up with friends or late night supper with the family, Xin Wang Hong Kong Café is your one stop restaurant for all-day dining.

name: Y.Y. Household
description: Specialising in household and hardware items, get your tools, lighting and household equipment here at Y.Y Household.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.

name: Zheng Nan Qi Bai and Dong Lai Handmade Fresh Buns Shop
description: Zheng Nan Qi Bai introduces the newly upgraded sour & spicy rice noodle series, with every bowl packed with irresistible aroma! It is known for serving authentic Chongqing-style rice noodles, featuring dishes like the signature Mountain City Hotpot Beef Brisket.

name: 365 Juices Bar
description: 365 Juices Bar provides Refreshing and Healthy fruit juices & Smoothies for our customer made with 100% natural fruits. We seek to satisfy the daily nutritional needs of our customers with high quality fruits. We aim to make Singapore a healthier country through our contribution as a fruit juice bar. With our reward cards, you are entitled to a buy 10 get 1 FREE offer at all our outlets island wide with NO expiry date.

name: 49 Seats
description: 49 Seats has been in F&B industry for 5 years and has established a strong local presence. It is recognised for the fusion style meals with a slight twist of local flavour. The menu features the best selling dish, Tom Yum Seafood Pasta, which has made our dining a must go to place for spicy savoury flavour while Smoked Duck Pasta remains one of the most talked about smoked duck related dishes in the market. Other main courses like Fish & Chips with alscampi or tom yum sauce is infused with our special sauce and ingredients that leaves one craving for more. Having a strong branding concept is our forte which focus on unique interior that features an old coffee shop metal gate. The uniform design has two suspender design that adds to the old school casual atmosphere. Not forgetting the food and beverages are served in metal plates and mugs just like in the olden days. Founded on the belief of creating a friendly and fun environment, 49 Seats offers a casual dining experience that continue to serve quality food to the guest's heart. With a price that is comfortably affordable to all, customers get to enjoy our fusion food at anytime of the day & late night.

name: Absolute Boutique Fitness Studio
description: Absolute Boutique Fitness Studio is Asia's largest boutique fitness studio. We offer a complete 360 degree fitness solution to ensure lasting results. Start your fitness journey with us, get on the bikes for a true New York rhythm cycling experience to get your cardio fix or strengthen and tone your body with Pilates Reformer classes at our studio.

name: Accessity
description: Accessorized Necessity. T-shirt Concept Store for the Family! Step into Accessity, your go-to destination for essential everyday fashion. The store offers versatile pieces that make dressing up simple, stylish, and enjoyable for the entire family.

name: Amazing Collective
description: Amazing Speech Therapy started from a simple dream from our founder Beatrice Teo. With a desire to break out of traditional speech therapy boundaries and a vision to innovate and create new possibilities for those living with communication and swallowing difficulties, she started her private practice in April 2016. Over the years, we have expanded our team of dynamic and passionate specialist speech therapists who all believed in the same vision and to genuinely make a difference in someone’s lives. We serve clients across all ages, providing high quality personalised speech therapy sessions both in the clinic and at our clients’ homes.

name: AMB Aquatic Hub
description: AMB Aquatic Hub is your premier destination for all things aquarium-related. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or just starting out, we cater to your every need with a wide range of aquariums, accessories, and expert advice. Discover top-quality tanks, vibrant aquatic life, and specialized equipment to create your perfect aquatic habitat. Visit AMB Aquatic Hub today and explore endless possibilities for your hobby.

name: Angelique Boutique
description: Angelique specialises in red carpet couture and custom-made outfits.

name: ASTONS Steak & Salad
description: Astons brand established itself as a household name, synonymous with quality and affordability. The introduction of Astons Steak & Salad was the result of fulfilling a better commitment to all customers. This restaurant features Astons in a Steak & Salad bar concept where there are over 80 selections of all-you-can-eat salads at the bar including home-made soup, fresh greens and dessert. Our menu boasts a variety of main courses including our signature steaks, which comes with buffet serving at the salad bar. Other items on the menu include seafood entree, grilled chicken and kids meal. The restaurant is simply designed to give a pleasant and private atmosphere with jazz music in the background. It will be a place for all occasions. At Astons, it is a quality and value for money concept.

name: Auntie Ashley
description: Rooted in the rich culinary heritage of Ipoh, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam brings the true taste of Malaysia’s most celebrated food town to the heart of Orchard, The Centrepoint. Inspired by the success of Choy Kee Bakery in Ipoh, this new outlet continues the same dedication to authenticity, tradition, and comfort food that generations have grown up loving. Every dish served is a tribute to Ipoh’s time-honoured kopitiam culture, where simple ingredients are elevated through craftsmanship, patience, and recipes passed down through generations. At the heart of the menu is our signature Nasi Ayam Goreng Berempah, marinated with over ten aromatic Malay spices and fried to golden perfection—crispy on the outside, juicy within, and deeply fragrant. Our Ipoh Hor Fun is another standout, made using rice noodles renowned for their silky smooth texture, a hallmark of Ipoh’s mineral-rich spring water. Served in comforting chicken broth or bold curry, each bowl delivers warmth, depth, and unmistakable authenticity. Complementing the mains are classic sides like Hainanese Chicken Chop Rice, Sizzling Hot Plate Claypot Noodles, and freshly prepared dim sum that recall the bustling kopitiams of old Ipoh. No Ipoh experience is complete without coffee. Our authentic Ipoh Chang Jiang White Coffee, roasted with butter for a smoother, richer aroma, stays true to the original Ipoh method, offering a nostalgic cup that pairs perfectly with Choy Kee Egg Tarts. From hearty rice dishes to nostalgic desserts and handcrafted drinks, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam is more than a meal — it is a comforting journey home, familiar yet exciting, for those who are seeking genuine Ipoh flavours in Singapore.

name: Bakery Cuisine
description: Bakery Cuisine was established in 2018, building on over 20 years of baking expertise from its Managing Director, Ken, and a rich family heritage in snacks and food quality from his wife, May. Their dedication to quality and innovation has driven the brand’s success, sourcing the freshest ingredients, including imports from Taiwan, and drawing inspiration from Japanese, Taiwanese, and Malaysian baking traditions. Renowned for their aromatic and freshly made pastries, Bakery Cuisine’s products prioritize four principles: Quality, Colorful, Aromatic, and Taste. With 21 outlets across Singapore and a reputation for catering large-scale events, the brand has earned recognition, including the Singapore Prestige Brand Award (Promising Brand) in 2016, delighting customers with exceptional breads and pastries daily.

name: BBounce Studio
description: Located along Orchard Road, BBounce (pronounced as B-Bounce) Studio is Singapore's first dedicated rebounding fitness studio that offers a range of comprehensive strength and cardio workouts on rebounders. Hybrid Rebounding, the first of its kind in Singapore, is unique to the BBounce Fitness Method. It incorporates mini trampolines with resistance bands, weights and strength training to give you a dynamic workout. We have reinvented workouts to be fun, inspiring and exciting! Besides that, our signature body-changing bootcamp workout also offers individuals the chance to go the extra mile. Consisting of a mixture of interval cardiovascular and strength workouts, our bootcamp classes focus on different muscle groups every day so that you get a thorough workout unlike any other. See and feel for yourself why it has gained cult status amongst celebrities, models and even professional athletes.

name: Be U Hair Design
description: Be U Hair Design is a one-of-a-kind hair salon in Singapore. Compared to other regular hair salons in Singapore, Be U Hair Design offers tailored and customised services to each customers and pride themselves in bringing out customers’ individuality through their hairstyles each time.

name: Beautique
description: Beautique by DNA Brands Co. – the ultimate destination for all things beauty! They are a passionate team dedicated to offering a wide range of beauty products and services, carefully curated to meet the diverse needs of our customers. Beautique's mission is to provide you with an unmatched shopping experience, empowering you to feel and look your best every day.

name: Beauty in The Pot
description: Savour the essence of health & beauty from our ten nourishing soup bases, which includes the all-time favourite Beauty Collagen Broth, Spicy Nourishing Broth and exclusive private room new soup selections. Every steaming pot of broth is prepared using an array of quality ingredients specially selected for a divine experience.

name: Belle Watch
description: Buy, sell, & recondition luxury watches. We have a wide selection of brands and models. We also buy name brand luxury watches at great prices. We're a luxury watch business specializing in buying and selling high-end timepieces. We're dedicated to delivering exceptional service and ensuring utmost customer satisfaction.

name: Best Imprezzione
description: Since 1992, Best Imprezzione has been the trailblazer in crafting personalized, custom-designed 3D handprint and footprint masterpieces as well as hand and foot casts for newborn, children, adults and pets too. Based in Singapore, we take immense pride in our unique creations that has garnered recognition not just locally, but on a global scale. A product of Singapore!

name: Bioskin
description: Bioskin is a one stop beauty centre providing an extensive range of premium solutions to all your skincare, body, hair and scalp concerns. Bioskin caters specially to Asian skin and is a trusted brand among many for their advanced technology and comprehensive treatments. Their new flagship store features a grand Prestige area which provides a luxurious experience coupled with top-notch services for your ultimate pampering beauty session.

name: Bioskin Luxe Aesthetic Clinic
description: Bioskin Luxe Aesthetic Clinic is the realization of Mathilda Koh’s lifelong dedication to redefining beauty. Since beginning her journey in 1996, Mathilda has grown Bioskin into one of Singapore’s most trusted and leading beauty and wellness brands. Today, she channels her pioneering spirit into this new chapter—seamlessly bridging Bioskin’s holistic philosophy with the cutting-edge science of medical aesthetics.

name: Bird Avenue
description: Discover a haven of classic comfort food at Bird Avenue. Whether you're looking for a quick lunchtime fix or some delightful dinner we've got you covered. From our Spring Chicken to our popular Mixed Grill to our delectable House Pastas, there's something to satisfy every craving. Join us and indulge in timeless flavors that define casual dining at its best.

name: Bottles & Bottles
description: BOTTLES & BOTTLES offers a wide variety of wine, champagne and liquor. Imported from around the world, BOTTLES & BOTTLES would be an ideal place to purchase premium wine for party and fine dining.

name: Bratpack
description: Bratpack is a specialty store that offers backpacks and lifestyle footwear catering to the lifestyles of today’s youth with a taste for adventure and an eye for design.

name: Cardboard Collectible
description: Cardboard Collectible is a shop that specialises in Kuji and Anime Goods. Ranging from collectible figures, plush toys & key chains, each ticket gives customers a chance to win limited-edition prizes.

name: Caribbean
description: Caribbean is your ultimate destination for fun and excitement! We pride ourselves on offering an unmatched gaming experience with easy wins and a diverse range of game plays. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned player, you'll find something to enjoy in our vast selection of claw machines. From plush toys to unique prizes, there's always something new to discover. Come and experience the thrill of winning at Caribbean, where every play is a chance to win big!

name: Carousell Luxury
description: Carousell Luxury is part of leading multi-category classifieds and recommerce marketplace Carousell. Established in 2021, Carousell Luxury currently operates in Singapore, providing a trusted, omnichannel experience to buy and sell verified pre-owned luxury goods across its dedicated website, an in-app official store, and a flagship store on Orchard Road. The platform offers one of the largest and most curated selections of verified luxury items and is distinguished by its flexible selling model, which provides clients with direct buy-out, trade-in, and traditional consignment options.

name: Cellini
description: Cellini is a home-grown designer furniture brand that designs and curates inspiration for all modern homes. A trusted Singapore brand of over 36 years, Cellini brings you quality craftsmanship, exclusive designs, and an extensive collection of timeless furniture and mattresses designed and produced by Cellini. Experience dedicated service at the exclusive Nightingale by Cellini mattress boutique and shop for exquisite home furnishings at the furniture gallery. Speak with Cellini’s friendly staff in-store to select the best furniture for your home.

name: Chrysalis Spa
description: Chrysalis Spa is a one-stop spa haven in Singapore established since 2001. Chrysalis Spa continues to evolve, in delivering its many sought-after beauty, wellness & health treatments to satisfy its clients’ unique needs.

name: Clariti - Hearing Care Professionals
description: At Clariti, we focus on the improvement of our customers' quality of life through better hearing. We prescribe only the premium hearing aid brands with the latest technologies that take care of background noises and dynamic listening environment.

name: Clearlab
description: At Clearlab, we believe there is a better way to serve consumers. A more valuable, less invasive way where customers truly enjoy affordable and exceptional quality contact lenses. We're obsessively passionate about it, we know contact lenses more than any retailers in the market because we MAKE them here in Singapore and we are excited to bring a true Direct to Consumers “everyday low price” experience for all.

name: Coslab
description: Coslab is a premier beauty & body slimming spa. It is the perfect beauty spa for relaxation and tranquility. Coslab offers a variety of treatments, including Massage Therapy with registered Massage Therapists (I.T.E.C), Aroma-therapy Massage, Traditional Javanese Massage, Advanced Facial Treatments , Anti Stress Ear Candling, Body Polish and Wraps and other skin & body treatments.
