At Coslab, we also offer special exotic treatments as well as our signature & exclusive anti wrinkle treatment.

name: Concierge (The Centerpoint)
description: Our friendly customer service staff are here to ensure a smooth and enjoyable shopping experience. From assisting with information, directions and shopping rewards to facilitating customers with special needs, we're here to deliver. Dementia Go-To Point This customer service counter serves as a Dementia Go-To-Point, a safe space manned by trained personnel to support and assist individuals with dementia when they require help. Learn more about accessibility at the Malls of Frasers Property

name: Dapur Penyet
description: Dapur Penyet aims to serve quality, authentic Indonesian food at value-added prices. Well-known for their signature Ayam Penyet dish, Dapur Penyet also offer a variety of sambal of different spiciness for everyone.

name: Decathlon
description: A global multi-specialist sports brand catering to beginners and top athletes, Decathlon is an innovative maker of sporting goods for all skills. With more than 100,000 teammates and 1,700 stores worldwide, Decathlon and its teams have been working ever since 1976 to fulfil an ongoing ambition: Move people through the wonders of sport, to help them be healthier and happier in a sustainable future.

name: Diamond Ateliers
description: Welcome to Diamond Ateliers: Singapore’s Premier Bespoke Engagement Ring Boutique At Diamond Ateliers, we believe that every love story is unique—your engagement ring should be too. As Singapore’s leading bespoke engagement ring studio, we specialize in crafting lab and Natural diamond rings that reflect your individuality, values, and vision.

name: Din Tai Fung
description: Ranked as one of the world's Top Ten Best Restaurants by The New York Times, the Michelin-star restaurant has its roots dating back to Taiwan more than 40 years ago. The arrival of Din Tai Fung in Singapore in 2003 made waves in the local dining scene and has since built a huge following with its famous signature Xiao Long Baos (Steamed Pork Dumplings), Steamed Chicken Soup and Fried Rice with Shrimps & Eggs amongst many popular favourites.

name: DLUSH.SG
description: DLUSH is about redefining traditional silhouettes and prints into fresh designs full of zest.

name: DrScalp
description: At DrScalp, we are more than just a scalp centre—we are pioneers in advanced scalp health solutions. Our mission is to provide our customers with customised treatments that address the root cause of scalp issues like hair loss, dandruff and inflammation. We combine state-of-the-art technology with personalised care to help you achieve healthier hair from scalp up

name: Eclado
description: Eclado Singapore provides therapy for customers to enjoy healthy skin. It prides itself on constant research to solve skin problems in safe and effective treatments. Based in Korea, Eclado has 20 years of history and research. Eclado offers a wide range of products and facial services to help our customers to maintain young and healthy skin. At Eclado, we are committed to provide the best service quality through our professional skin analysis and facial treatment for both men and women.

name: Elements Wellness
description: With 22 years of experience, Elements Wellness adopts a holistic approach through the power of technology, products, ancient healing traditions, and the magic of touch to provide the best treatments for wellness and beauty.

name: FairPrice Finest
description: FairPrice Finest seeks to bring the finest things in life to customers. It combines the heritage of a trusted brand with a whole new experience of fine living at affordable pricing. Scrumptious delis and vintage wines in our gourmet selection are a sensory delight to the gastronome. Our fresh seafood along with our seasonal produce and international selection are carefully hand-picked from all over the world to please even the most discerning palates. Not forgetting the health-conscious; they can take delight with our expanding range of prized organic items and fresh fruits. From the conventional to the epicurious, here is where you can celebrate the finest things in life.

name: Fire Ramen
description: Japanese Authentic Fire Ramen Experience from Kyoto Serving Full Courses from Appetisers, Mains (Ramen, Don, Sushi, Sashimi, Sumiyaki-Charcoal Grill), Sides, Beverages to Desserts & Alcohols. From native Kyoto, we are proud to bring Fire Ramen to Singapore. Experience it yourself with our fire-pouring chefs as they ignite the oil to create tall, dramatic flames, and pour it over their signature broth covered with Negi (green onions). The result is a unique flavor that can only be experienced at our restaurant. So come on down and try it for yourself!

name: Flower Matters
description: Flower Matters is a charming florist known for whimsical botanical artistry. Their “little wonderland” features exotic flowers and foliage from around the world, paired with creative passion and close customer connections.

name: Fore Coffee
description: It starts with a simple desire: to bring better coffee, closer where you are. Now at The Centrepoint, you can find Fore Coffee serving premium blends crafted to match your pace, your taste, and your everyday moments. Since 2018, Fore Coffee has been on a journey to create exceptional coffee experiences for everyone. Inspired by the word "forest", our name reflects growth, connection, and a return to what grounds us. We believe great coffee starts with intention, using 100% high-quality Arabica beans, carefully sourced and locally roasted to bring out their fullest character. In the middle of life's rush, Fore Coffee is your pause - a space to slow down, take a sip, and reconnect with what truly matters. Because sometimes, all it takes is a good cup of coffee to remind you to Grind the Essentials.

name: Fotohi Carpet Gallery
description: Founded in 1994, Fotohi Carpet Gallery is a retailer of carpets in Singapore. Our showroom features an outstanding and extensive array of fine quality machine-made and hand-knotted nomadic/ tribal, village and city carpets. For the discerning collector, we possess an unsurpassed collection of new and antique masterpieces.

name: FREE Skin & Body Perfect
description: Engineered for perfection, FREE Skin & Body Perfect capitalizes on the most advanced technologies and specialised products to bring out the best in you.

name: GEOX
description: At Geox, innovation and style fuse to deliver a customer-centric shopping experience. Each single detail is carefully curated to make sure that you enjoy premium-quality products and omni-channel services in a distinctive welcoming atmosphere. From the courtesy and professionalism of our staff to an obsessive attention to details, Geox goes to extreme lengths to guarantee a shopping experience that exceeds expectations. Welcome to a world where your satisfaction comes before all else and where retail excellence becomes a shopper's way of life. With Geox, each step is an opportunity to discover retail excellence and fall in love with it. The word GEOX is made up of Geo (from the Greek word for “earth”) and X (symbolising advanced technology developed in Italian laboratories and protected by patents on an international level). This name captures the essence of our efforts and energies, our drive and know-how and our care and attention to detail, as we place research at the service of quality and everyday elegance. We invest in innovation and create footwear and apparel to cosset you with all the comfort you deserve, boosting your levels of well-being and ensuring that you feel good at all times.

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang is a 100% local-owned brand that was established in 2017 to provide a unique Ma La cuisine experience while retaining the authenticity of the local fan favourite dish. GYMLT offer drinkable Ma La soup bases that do not leave a greasy or overwhelming aftertaste, so that customers can enjoy it till the very last drop. GYMLT understands that different people have different dietary needs and spice preferences. Hence, GYMLT offers other soup bases such as Mushroom, Pork bone, Tomato and Pickled Vegetable soup bases for those who do not enjoy spices We have also come up with a vegetarian friendly soup for our vegetarian consumers.

name: GoroGoro Steamboat & Korean Buffet
description: GoroGoro Steamboat & Korean Buffet is the first hotpot concept in Singapore with a Korean twist. It caters to different taste preferences by having seven choices of soup bases to choose from, including Singapore’s famous Pepper Bakuteh, Korean’s favourite Ginseng, Japanese soup - Collagen as well as Mala that’s well-loved by the Chinese. Guests can expect up to 70 selections of raw food items to dip in the pipin’ hot soups, while indulging in Korean, Japanese and local delicacies. Although many Non-Korean speakers mistakenly thought that "GoroGoro" is a word from the Korean or Japanese vocabulary, it certainly is not. The name actually are suggestions of a rumbling tummy when you are hungry, and the hot bubbling sound of the steamboat soups when they are boiling. GoroGoro - Quality food and service, wide variety, cozy ambience, value for money!

name: Guardian
description: Guardian Health & Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. With over 138 stores island-wide, Guardian Health & Beauty operates the nation's biggest chain of pharmacies and retails a comprehensive range of health & beauty products. Pharmacy services available! Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for consumers' health and beauty needs. Professional services such as patient-care counselling, dispensary services, beauty and personal care solutions are offered at all stores as a convenient one-stop for health and beauty. We continue to build on our rich healthcare heritage with an award-winning team of pharmacists who have consistently won multiple pharmacist awards every year.

name: Guo Tai TCM Rehab & Wellness Centre
description: At Guo Tai TCM, we seamlessly blend the timeless wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine with the cutting-edge advancements of Western medical technology. Our personalised care plans are uniquely tailored to meet each customer’s specific needs, reflecting our unwavering commitment to their health and well-being. We pride ourselves on our sincere, professional approach, consistently prioritising our customers’ best interests.

name: Gyushi
description: Our menu is inspired by the streets of Japan but made with local tastes in mind. Whether you’re a student looking for a quick lunch, a family dining out, or just craving something satisfying, Gyushi is your go-to destination for hearty, fuss-free meals served with a smile. From our signature Gyudon (beef bowl) to crispy karaage and plant-based options, there’s something for everyone at Gyushi. Each bowl is a balance of tradition, comfort, and creativity. Made fresh, fast, and always affordable.

name: HAACH
description: Since 1997, HAACH has been a cornerstone of beauty and wellness in Singapore, redefining the boundaries of premium spa and skincare services. Celebrating our 27th anniversary in 2024, we are renowned for our commitment to excellence, consistently receiving "Best in Beauty" awards from prestigious publications such as Her World, Harper’s Bazaar, Elle, Women's Weekly, and Cleo. Our mission is to empower our clients to achieve their skincare goals by delivering exceptional and transformative experiences.

name: HAKKA
description: A unique shop with treasures for all ages — from curious kids to thoughtful adults and wise seniors. Explore educational toys that spark creativity, stylish home décor that brightens any space, and practical electronic gadgets that make life easier. Whether you’re searching for a meaningful gift or treating yourself, every visit feels like discovering hidden gems. Step inside and let joy surprise you at every corner.

name: Healing Touch Spa
description: Healing Touch was established since 2001, currently with 9 branches across Singapore. Healing Touch has won multiple spa and beauty awards from Women’s Weekly, Her World, Expat Living, Daily Vanity, Influential Brands over the years and has received the certificate of Excellence from Tripadvisor in 2016/17/18/19. Healing Touch offers award-winning body massage, slimming and facial treatments with the underlying emphasis on holistic wellness and is committed to wow our customers with delightful treatment experience and results. Our commitment to customers: Caring Hand, Divine Treats.

name: Healthway Medical & Straits Podiatry
description: Getting a health assessment can uncover key insights about your current health status, as well as identify any future risks for early intervention. Healthway’s comprehensive range of health screening packages and wellness programmes are tailored to the individual who demands quality and convenience. Their medical professionals offer personalised recommendations and treatments to guide you in your journey to better health and wellbeing.

name: House of Cars
description: House of Cars offer an expansive collection of toy cars, featuring everything from vintage classics to the latest releases. Whether you are a dedicated collector or looking for the perfect gift, House of Cars promises an exciting experience for all toy car enthusiasts.

name: Hush Puppies
description: Hush Puppies was founded in 1958, an era where uncomfortable dress shoes were your only choice of footwear – even on the weekends. They set out to find a solution for sore feet, otherwise known as “barking dogs.” Introducing the world to casual shoes and a more casual lifestyle, Hush Puppies created shoes to help them hush their puppies. They’ve stood for comfort from the beginning, and they continue to innovate through their Bounce Technology platform today.

name: iClaw Taiwan
description: iClaw Taiwan SG proudly brings the first-ever Taiwanese-style claw machine shop to Singapore! Step in for endless fun and try your luck at winning from their exciting range of plushies, toys, and prizes.

name: Imago Aesthetic
description: Catering to the demands of an image-conscious, fast-paced modern society, Imago Aesthetic Clinic an aesthetic clinic in Singapore, was born in 2018 with the focus on aesthetic procedures that involved little or no downtime to cater to busy working professionals. Our aesthetic clinic provides only aesthetic treatments that are scientifically-proven to be safe and effective.

name: Ji Xiang Kueh
description: Since 1988, Ji Xiang Ang Ku Kueh is a Singaporean brand which specializes and preserves the traditional Chinese pastry called Ang Ku Kueh. The name Ang Ku Kueh is translated “Red Turtle Cake”, which symbolizes prosperity, longevity and wealth.

name: JM Taekwondo
description: Takewondo is a total learning activity. Trainees begin by practicing basic patterns and forms, board breaking, kicking, blocking, striking, and punching. These fundamental skills increase trainee’s physical coordination, flexibility, balance, and mental acumen. Taekwondo also develops trainee’s athletic abilities and self-awareness, and improves the child’s capabilities in self-defence.

name: Jullia Olger
description: Jullia Olger is a premium hair wig brand from Japan, renowned for its craftsmanship, quality and personalized hair solutions since 1967. Our commitment to excellence is epitomized by the motto, "Your Best Smile Is What We Want". Fashion and medical-grade wigs are available for both Men and Ladies with ready-made and custom-made options tailored to suit individual’s needs. Designed for comfort, confidence, and everyday elegance, each Jullia Olger creation is thoughtfully crafted using high-quality materials and meticulous techniques to ensure a seamless fit, natural movement, and lasting wearability.

name: JungSung Hair Salon by Joel Park
description: Our salon’s name is JungSung Hair Salon, which means “to care for each client with wholehearted dedication from beginning to end.” At Jung Sung, our mission is to redefine beauty by seamlessly blending the rich heritage of Korean hairstyling with contemporary innovations. We strive to inspire confidence and individual expression, fostering a space where each client can discover their unique beauty within our salon’s welcoming ambiance.

name: Junior Page
description: Junior Page is founded in Singapore by a group of book lovers who simply think that amid rising inflation, books should always remain affordable especially for our children who are our future leaders! Our Primary Mission is to source for good quality Children books at everyday low prices and promote good reading habits amongst our young. Our team comprises of book buyers who have been in the business for almost 20 years and we hope to use this experience to benefit you!

name: JustCo
description: JustCo is Asia’s leading flexible workspace partner. We help to connect businesses, people and ideas through intelligent and flexible workspace planning and solutions. Following more than a decade of growth, innovation and diversification, JustCo is home today to globally recognised brands across all industries, in more than 40 locations across APAC, from Singapore to Tokyo, Seoul to Sydney. JustCo offers • Private Offices: Whatever your team size, our flexible office spaces scale up or down to your needs. Compared to traditional office leases which lock in high rent for long periods, our private offices balance cost-effectiveness with short-term adaptability. • Hot Desks: Enjoy flexible workspace with a vibrant community. The go-to choice for independent entrepreneurs, remote workers and digital nomads. • Meeting Rooms and event spaces: Conduct productive meetings with state-of-the-art video-conferencing technology and amenities.

name: Kappa
description: Founded in 1967, Italian brand Kappa combines classic sportswear with contemporary Fashion styling. It’s collections often feature a distinctive palette of vibrant colours, reflecting its fun brand personality. Kappa's rich history and innovative design places it on the global scale across sports and lifestyle.

name: Kashmir Heritage
description: With a legacy spanning over 80years, we are proud to bring to you a curated collection of exquisite Handmade Carpets, intricate Paper Mache, luxurious authentic Pashmina Shawls, enchanting Turkish Lights, and an array of captivating Arts and Crafts.

name: Kawai Music School
description: Kawai Music School teaches music in both individual and group classes. Music books are also available for purchase in the school.

name: KAYLÎE
description: Bringing forth garments for the versatile corporate lady, we delve into the realms of timeless, exquisite pieces. At KAYLIE, we firmly believe in diversity and superior quality. Apparel and accessory lines for every size, shape, style, occasion – you will leave with garments fitted to perfection, by our very own tailors, and most importantly, with your style reveries materialized.

name: KIMISTRY
description: Their name, Kimistry, is a play on the different meanings of the word ‘chemistry.’ Chemistry — as a branch of science — deals with the fusion of different elements and the conducting of chemical experiments at the lab. Similarly, it is a place where their team of stylists is constantly experimenting and working closely together with their customers to concoct new hairstyles. It also reflects the level of expertise of the team in handling and executing complex chemical works in modern hair treatments. Besides that, the Kimistry name represents their goal to forge strong relationships with their clients and to maintain that chemistry to ensure consistent levels of satisfaction.

name: KIMOJ
description: KIMOJ is a total fashion brand established in 2013. KIMOJ houses the latest collection of fashion accessories, eyewear and lifestyle items shipped weekly from fashion designer houses all over the world.

name: KOI Thé
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means “TEA” in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese “TÉ” in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI’s authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: KPLUS
description: Located at The Centrepoint #01-33 in Singapore, KPLUS – A vibrant expression of style, sustainability, and affordability. As a Seoul-based spatial experience, eyewear design, and manufacturing company since 2013, KPLUS bridges the cutting-edge design of Korean brands with contemporary aesthetics. Our collections cater to 18-38 year old males and females who are passionate about Korean brands, designs, and experiences.

name: LAC
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Luxe Maison
description: LUXE MAISON, Singapore's Luxury goods, bags and accessories reseller. Your House of Authenticated Luxury is located at The Centrepoint. When you step into Luxe Maison, you are transported into a world of treasures and gems that can only be found in the iconic orange box.

name: Malaysia Boleh!
description: Convening some of the best Malaysian street hawker fare under one roof, Malaysia Boleh! is the go-to dining destination for those who want a taste of Malaysia without crossing the Straits. Malaysia Boleh! is the result of a country-wide scour, featuring big-name specialties such as Penang Jalan Cheong Fatt Tze prawn noodles soup, Petaling Street famous claypot rice and Klang Bak Kut Teh. All the dishes served in this self-operated food atrium are prepared following time-honoured secret recipes handed down from top-rated Malaysian street hawkers, thus ensuring authentic flavours that are true to the original. Decked with vintage pushcarts and signboards, and decorated to mimic rows of old shophouses, the food atrium exudes the vibe of Malaysian streets circa 1960s. Combining taste and ambience, Malaysia Boleh! is a must-visit for a destination-themed dining experience filled with vibrancy and variety.

name: Masterpiece Jewellery
description: Masterpiece Jewellery has been producing genuine handmade jewellery since 1991. Creating unique and bespoke jewellery catered to our customer's desires has always been the company's philosophy. With cutting-edge 3D computer-aided design software and the hands of skilled craftsmen and artisans, we are able to create timeless pieces of art, catered to your every need. We also provide repair services to keep your jewellery in prime condition. Services include: repairs and alterations; watch strap and bracelet repairs; standard white and yellow gold plating and electro plating for watch straps, bracelets and figurines. Visit us now at 01-K3 to be part of something unique; to create something truly special.

name: MODE Aesthetics
description: MODE Aesthetics is where beauty meets style. MODE delivers award-winning results with innovative treatments ensuring 100% customer satisfaction with quality assurance. Get your top to toe beauty fix from the signature AlmaLASE™ Laser Facial to LED Teeth Whitening to Fat Freeze, the possibilities at MODE are endless. MODE delivers a safe and non-invasive total aesthetic solution for an overall transformation. MODE Aesthetics - Beauty in Mode.

description: Molecule is set up for the purpose of meeting the growing needs of the increasingly sophisticated customers who appreciate high quality, unique, affordable furnishing products all found under one-roof. Popular for its exclusive everyday products, Molecule has a vast collection of swanky and contemporary clocks and carpets, bean bags, alongside with vases, lamps, art pieces and sculptures etc to meet every proud home owner’s furnishing needs. Each unique on its own; most items are exclusively carried by Molecule. Besides smaller items, Molecule also showcase an extensive range of larger items such as designer sofas, dining tables, coffee, side tables, multi-purpose occasional tables and barstools etc. products to surprise you throughout the year. Your next visit to Molecule will definitely bring you new surprises and inspirations!

Crafted in 18k gold vermeil, natural gemstones and moissanites, each collection is thoughtfully designed to reflect your personal narrative, your mood, or your spirit. Look good and do good —10% of our profits are donated to charities that support the communities around us

name: MOS Burger

To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers’ order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

Hair Removal, our specially formulated gel is activated when exposed to beams of filtered light. As compared with self-treatment such as shaving, plucking and waxing, this technology is gentler to your skin with minimal or no discomfort.

Regardless of face, body or skin, NeuGlow delivers maximum benefits with minimal discomfort. Our team of skilled doctors and registered nurses are representative of Singapore's most trusted medical aesthetics brand.

With those core values in mind, Rachel’s Best Soaps is proud to offer premium quality bath and cleansing products made with natural ingredients and produced in the land that inspired Rachel’s creations, the USA.

description: REFASH is the largest thrift store brand in Singapore. With a mission to 'inspire the next generation of consumers to think secondhand first', we give new life to millions of used clothing, offsetting the environment and financial cost of fashion. Discover your love for thrifting at any of our outlets islandwide, featuring brands you love like Zara, Love Bonito, The Editor's Market, Lovet & more at up to 90% off retail prices!

description: Robert Piano is a leading purveyor of musical instruments in Singapore. Whether it is the traditional piano or the latest innovation in digital sound, Robert Piano has a vast selection of fine instruments to meet every musical need.

description: Seimpi Education Group started its first centre in 2002 (operating as Seimpi School of Music). Since then, it has gained strong support and recognition from parents in Singapore as one of the leading institutions for music education, especially with its popular proprietary course, the Music for the Intelligent MindTM (MIMÂ®). The impressive achievements of our students in competitions, at local and international scenes, have raised our reputation further as the leader of music, performing arts and language education, spreading to Malaysia and Indonesia in recent years. Our teachers are carefully selected from Singapore and all over the world to make sure our students get the first-class delivery of all our courses.

description: The leading D.I.Y store in Singapore. My home, my office, my car... My Self Fix! Our senior specialist eye doctors have a wealth of experience in treating a wide range of eye conditions.

The goal of Short-Q is to improve the service that businesses offer to their customers by providing supply chain management solutions.

description: SKN MediAesthetics uses cutting-edge FDA-approved technology to provide the perfect combination of beauty and cosmetic treatments backed by medical science. Visit us for a consultation and enjoy our signature treatments.

For 18 years, So Do Fun has remained one of the most beloved Sichuan restaurants, consistently ranking as a top choice on local food charts. Today, we operate nearly 100 outlets across China, Singapore, and Malaysia, serving over one million bowls of boiled fish annually.

name: Sol Mart
description: The first Korean grocery chain in Singapore. Providing the widest range of Korean F&B products in Singapore since 2003

Yet their pushcart icon reminds us what they are about, an original Bak Kut Teh experience: tender, fall-off-the-bone pork ribs; hot, flavourful, spicy-peppery soup; a 1960s roadside dining ambience. At Song Fa, the heritage of Bak Kut Teh lives on in its truest sense.eritage of good old Bak Kut Teh in it's truest sense.

description: The World's First Restaurant Dedicated to Chicken Specialty Cuts, Six Unique Specialty Cuts of Fresh, Whole Chicken Founded in Seongsu, Seoul, Song Gye Ok is Korea’s most talked-about chicken grill house, drawing queues for its juicy 6-part chicken cuts and soul-warming herbal Samgyetang. Now in Singapore, we continue this legacy with the same recipes, premium ingredients, and hospitality. Designed with traditional Hanok elements, our space blends modern city life with Korea’s timeless dining culture.

name: Spacio TCM Wellness
description: Embrace the holistic approach to health and wellness with Spacio TCM Wellness. Whether you're seeking relief from specific ailments or simply striving to achieve balance and harmony in your life, Spacio TCM Wellness is your destination for authentic TCM remedies and expert advice.

name: SPARKLE

Sparkle is managed by a young, dynamic, and dedicated team with coverage over the brand's in-house sourcing, merchandising, design, and logistics.

name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Sugarwaxed
description: Sugarwaxed was founded in 2021 and has since earned the trust of clients as their favourite sugaring destination in Singapore. We’re the first and only unisex professional squeeze bottle sugaring studio in Asia. This is an innovative hybrid method of sugaring and waxing, the best of both worlds. Our hair removal specialists are the best in the industry. They are trained, qualified and insured in the “art of professional body sugaring” and have developed a technique that is quick with minimum discomfort. Only the best hair removal specialist use this method. At Sugarwaxed, we hand sugar the traditional, all the way in order to make sure no hair is left behind or broken, to help you achieve optimum results every time.

name: Sunglass Avenue

Their collection feature an extensive range of sunglasses, optical glasses, and contact lenses from renowned brands such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Prada, and many others.

name: Teo Heng KTV Studio

Since the day of operations, their drinks are still kept at $1 and patrons are allowed to bring their own food & drinks.

name: The Chrono Vault

Visit us in‑store at The Centrepoint to explore our curated collection, or contact us if you’re looking for something specific—we’re always pleased to help.

description: The Dim Sum Place first outlet opened in 2016, the restaurant soon became a well-known Halal casual dining restaurant that serves a wide range of 100% homemade Hong Kong-style dim sum and authentic Cantonese cuisines, some even with a local twist. Today, not only is The Dim Sum Place a popular Halal restaurant among Singaporeans, but it is also a must-visit restaurant for many international tourists. Over the years with valuable feedback from our customers and guidance from renowned international chefs, the team improved the food quality and is consistently curating new dishes that cater to a wider range of taste buds.

description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era. More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.

As a leading art education center, we provide inspiring and innovative art classes that ignite imaginations and create a lasting passion for art through painting to printmaking.

name: Wigwise Hair Solution
description: WigWise specializes in custom-designed wigs made from 100% natural human hair, helping individuals regain confidence and embrace their unique beauty with professional craftsmanship and personalized service.

name: Wolfgang Violin Studio
description: Wolfgang Violin Studio is a premier music academy that specialises in strings for all ages. With violin, cello, and piano lessons for students from 3 years old to adults. Founded by Program Director Min Lee in 2009, Wolfgang Violin Studio is named as a tribute to the world's most iconic prodigy, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Conceived with the aim of redefining how classical music is taught to young minds, the lessons are specially designed to provide students with a holistic education.

name: X-Zen Hair Salon
description: Established in 1997, X-Zen Hair Salon offers a wide range of hair services such as hair-cutting, colouring, texturizing and much more. We provide the latest and trendiest looks through cutting-edge innovation and constant upgrading of skills and attending of hair science seminars by our highly-trained stylists.

name: Zanetta
description: Zanetta is a brand that redefines the modern footwear with stylish and eco-friendly sandals for women and men. Using the best sustainable material available to produce an everyday footwear. Zanetta strives to exemplify the best in comfort sandals. We feature a unique anatomical foot-bed that replicates the contours of the foot, just like a footprint in the sand.

name: 2it & drink
description: To eat and drink - life can be that simple! And 2it & Drink is all about that; wonderful pizzas, pastas, lovely tiramisu, and more. It is a celebration of authentic homemade Italian cuisine with your whole family and friends in a modern buzzing surrounding. It is good to know that we care as much as you do about the true flavours of fresh authentic Italian food. Located at the corner of Valley Point, next time you are in the neighbourhood, join us at cozy tables outside, have your aperitivo at the bar or dine inside while you watch our experienced Italian pizzaiolo, spin your pizza and the chef prepare your fresh pasta at the pasta lab. If you prefer, you can even impress your guests at home with our takeaway menu of delicious pizzas and fresh pasta. Buon Appetito!

name: 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles
description: At 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles, you will savour tasty noodles with good texture served with delicious hand made teochew fishball, meatball and fishcake all made from yellow tail fish. The fishballs are often described as being light and bouncy but dense in flavours. Once inside any 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles outlet, you will get to enjoy this well-loved local fare in a comfortable and cosy setting thereby greatly enhancing your dining experience at 85 Redhill Teochew Fishball Noodles.

name: Anytime Fitness
description: Anytime Fitness fits your busy schedule and on-the-go lifestyle. With your membership, you can workout when it's best for you, day or night! Our clubs are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

name: Au Croissant
description: Au Croissant delivers a offering an exquisite selection of artisanal breads and pastries. Our bakery prides itself on using high-quality, sourced ingredients to create authentic flavors. From buttery croissants and rustic sourdough loaves. Au Croissant is the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee or indulging afternoon treat.

name: Crystal Wines
description: Crystal Wines carries a splendid portfolio of prestigious brands from all over the world, including Argentina, Australia, Chile, France, Italy, New Zealand and Spain. Its 2,000 square feet retail premise located at Valley Point comes complete with premium built-in wine cellar and wine cabinets to ensure that all wines are stored and delivered to wine lovers in perfect conditions. To make learning and buying of wine rapturous, the retail outlet is equipped with wireless internet access and has a lifestyle corner for public and members to discover fine wines through related wine books and magazines in a convivial setting.

name: Elegant Nails
description: Elegant Nails provides manicure, pedicure services and is well-know for its facial treatments.

name: FairPrice Finest
description: With the freshest seafood and exotic seasonal produce from the world over, Fairprice Finest has just about anything to please the most discerning of palates.

name: GreenLeiF
description: The one-stop online shop that provides professional services and quality products to all home & garden owners. Whether you're shopping for BBQ grills or home & gardening supplies, we have everything you need! GreenLeif is also a trusted local supplier and sole distributor of BBQ Grills, grilling supplies, DIY home and gardening accessories. We distribute more than 700 products from many leading brands and work with retail partners such as multi-outlet hardware stores in Asia. Our goal is to create an e-commerce site for consumers to shop for an extensive range of quality products anytime, anywhere and at their convenience.

name: Hom Yoga
description: Hom Yoga is based on the principles of transformation and empowerment through high quality yoga teaching. Through its deep legacy of teaching in Singapore and internationally for many years, Hom Yoga brings the highest quality in the teaching of yoga today. The modern practise of yoga has evolved dramatically in the last few years. Initially, it was practiced for physical fitness either in a hot or traditional environment. Today, it now brings both physical wellbeing and a deeper sense of transformation and purpose to our lives. The search for greater meaning in our lives, is the most powerful motivation towards transformation in the way we live. Hom Yoga, through our deep and long history of teaching, offers the best means to continue this journey of transformation.

name: kcuts
description: To enjoy your no frills Korean themed hair cut immediately, there is kcuts. We do not provide coloring, perming, shampooing, shaving and blowing. kcuts provides stylish no frills hair cut service to our customers. We provide 10 minutes hair cut service that saves time at a reasonable price.

name: Little Farms (Cafe)
description: Cafe and Bistro craft healthy and delicious meals and beverages, while our baristas serve up some of the best coffee and tea in Singapore.

name: Little Farms (Grocer)
description: Singapore's local gourmet grocer. We farm - you eat. Little Farms is Singapore’s friendly neighbourhood market, specialising in the highest quality and freshest all-natural and organic produce, meats, seafood, dairy and grocery. Freshness Guaranteed means we are committed to offering you the freshest, healthiest and most delicious groceries from trusted farmers and artisans around the world.

name: LR Boulangerie
description: “We all have our food memories, some good and some bad. The taste, smell, and texture of food can be extraordinarily evocative, bringing back memories not just of eating food itself but also of place and setting. Food is an effective trigger of deeper memories of feelings and emotions, internal states of the mind and body.” – The Harvard University Press on John S. Allen’s The Omnivorous Mind. We bring all our good memories all around the world back to LR boulangerie. Not only is it about the bread, the dessert, the coffee or the ice cream but also the ingredients, the seasonings, the tools and the recipe. Hope that you would happen to recall good memories in your own life from what we serve. The name LR is derived from the French word Le Rustique. Although residing in metropolis, we are yearning for rural life. We found the most diversity of culture and food while we were travelling around every small village and town. That's where the major source of the inspiration of our food, materials and ingredients comes from. That's food memories. C'est la vie.

name: Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specializes in traditional handmade pau from the authentic traditional recipe of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in house. You can also indulge yourself in a hearty serving of glutinous rice chicken and siew mai, just to name a few.

name: Natureland Massage & Therapy
description: Natureland offers a wide range of massage and therapy services. Revitalise your mind, body and spirit with Spa Massage treatments to your needs.

name: Pet Lovers Centre
description: Pet Lovers Centre (PLC) boasts of having the widest range of the freshest stock for pet owners to pamper their pets and offers quality pet services including pet grooming, veterinary consultations and excellent home delivery service to reduce the hassle while shopping. PLC also has its very own pet care consultants whom customers can approach with questions regarding their pets! For more information, visit www.petloverscentre.com.

name: Phat Burger Bro
description: What does PHAT exactly mean?” A common question asked by many Singaporean customers. The word Phat is actually an American slang, which means something great or awesome and used often to describe something that is cool or hip, like that's a Phat new car! And bro. is short for brother because here at Phat Burger Bro., we treat all our customers with warmth & sincerity like family. Our concept is simple: Incredibly good, crafted burgers, sandwiches, salads, and desserts, made with premium quality fresh ingredients, prepared in-house by your bro's. Phat Burger Bro.'s aim is to redefine the way people experience fast food dining. Just one meal with us and we will definitely make you leave our restaurant, thinking that was a Phat experience.

name: Sabai Sabai Thai Private Kitchen
description: Sabai Sabai Thai Private Kitchen offers a cosy and intimate dining experience, as if customers are dining right in the chef's own home kitchen. Savour a medley of authentic Thai classics and daily specials prepared using only the freshest of ingredients.

name: Starbucks
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: The Achievers’ Learning Place
description: Proprietary English Mastery, Maths Mastery, Science and Chinese enrichment programme preparing students towards success for PSLE and O Levels.

name: Vets for Life Animal Clinic
description: Vets for Life Animal Clinic is a full-service veterinary clinic located in the east of Singapore, along Tanjong Katong Road, and near the residential districts of Katong and Marine Parade. Our team of animal doctors and veterinarians at Vets for Life Animal Clinic are highly experienced in the field of veterinary science and are dedicated to providing only the best of care for your pet.
